sum: This study investigates the origin of rejuvenated ocean island basalt (OIB) volcanism on Aitutaki Island in the central Pacific, which erupted ~8 Myr after shield-stage magmatism. Using new olivine microanalysis, major and trace element measurements, and radiogenic Sr-Nd-Hf-Pb isotopes from 21 lavas, the authors discover a previously undocumented geochemical bimodality. Geochemical and open-system melt modelling indicates that the lavas are best reproduced by low-degree (0.1–3%) melting of an enriched, hybridised pyroxenitic source fluxed by carbonatitic melt at ~3 GPa. This depth corresponds to pargasitic amphibole breakdown and a slow seismic velocity anomaly at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB). The novelty lies in demonstrating how long-lived, volatile-enriched partial-melt pockets underplating the LAB can be selectively reactivated millions of years after plume activity ceases, explaining both extreme chemical bimodality and isotopic kinship across distal hotspot islands like Aitutaki, Rarotonga, and Samoa.

The dataset comprises 21 rejuvenated alkalic lavas (alkali basalts, tephrites, foidites, hawaiite) from Aitutaki Island analysed for major/trace elements and Sr-Nd-Hf-Pb isotopes, plus 96 EPMA analyses of olivines from five xenolith-bearing samples.

Pressure estimations (~3.2–4.2 GPa) are limited by the thermobarometer's ability to represent metasomatism and uncertainties in mantle Fo content, and shield-stage comparison relies on a single sample.

Reveals previously undocumented geochemical bimodality at Aitutaki and proposes selective reactivation of carbonatite-hybridised partial-melt pockets stored at the LAB to explain rejuvenated volcanism and inter-island isotopic kinship.

Demonstrated via forward trace-element and open-system flux-melting models that an enriched pyroxenitic source fluxed by carbonatitic melt at ~3 GPa reproduces the rejuvenated lavas.

Proposed a genetic model where plume-derived enriched partial melts pond at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and are selectively reactivated, explaining isotopic similarities between Aitutaki and Samoa.

sum: Fluid injection during hydraulic fracturing, enhanced geothermal systems (EGS), and geologic carbon storage induces frequent microseismicity whose Gutenberg-Richter b-values vary widely by lithology (~2.0 in layered shales vs. ~1.0 in crystalline basement). This paper uses a simple mean-field theory (MFT) of slip avalanches to bridge nanometer-scale laboratory experiments and meter-scale field observations. High-temperature nanoindentation experiments (25–500 °C) on three Cane Creek shale samples of varying mineralogy reveal universal pop-in size distributions matching the MFT critical exponent (κ = 1.50). Similarly, five non-sedimentary field microseismic catalogs follow κ ≈ 1.50 (b ≈ 0.75–1.00). The authors show that the inflated exponents in two layered sedimentary microseismic catalogs (κ* ≈ 2.35, b ≈ 2.00) arise quantitatively from integrating over heterogeneous stress states and power-law distributed stratigraphic layer thicknesses (α = 1.70) bounded by weak bedding planes, allowing microseismic statistics to constrain subsurface bedding structure.

Nanoindentation tests on three Cane Creek shale samples across four temperatures (25–500 °C) and seven public microseismic catalogs from two sedimentary (HF) and five non-sedimentary (EGS/GCS) formations.

Bridges nanoscale shale plasticity and meter-scale induced seismicity using a single avalanche model, quantitatively explaining elevated b-values (~2.0) in sedimentary basins via power-law bedding thickness constraints.

sum: Conventional finite-difference (FD) wavefield simulation is bottlenecked by numerical dispersion and Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) stability constraints. This paper introduces a conditional generative diffusion wavefield propagator that recursively advances acoustic seismic wavefields from one time step to the next. Conditioned on the five most recent wavefield snapshots, the velocity model, and the time-step index, the U-Net denoiser uses direct clean-signal (x0) parameterization. This strong physical conditioning enables replacing the costly iterative reverse diffusion process with a single forward pass per time step. To suppress recursive error accumulation, the authors propose an adaptive causal time-weighted loss using exponential moving averages of per-snapshot errors. Trained on 10th-order staggered-grid FD simulations across 7,871 velocity patches, the propagator advances wavefields at a physical time step 10 times larger than the FD stability limit (0.01 s vs 0.001 s). Tests on Overthrust, SEG/EAGE, and out-of-distribution Marmousi models demonstrate accurate wavefields and a 2.17x end-to-end GPU speedup.
针对传统有限差分法（FD）受数值频散和CFL稳定性条件限制的问题，本文提出一种基于条件扩散模型的递归波场传播器。该模型以最近5个时间步的波场快照、速度模型和时间步索引为条件，采用直接预测干净波场（x0）的参数化方案，从而在推理时仅需单次网络前向传播即可生成下一时刻波场。为抑制长时程递归误差累积，提出……

t: A conditional U-Net diffusion model predicts the next clean wavefield snapshot (x0-prediction) in one step, conditioned on five recent snapshots, the velocity model, and the time index, trained with an EMA-based causal time-weighted loss.
基于条件U-Net扩散模型与因果加权损失，结合5帧历史波场和速度模型单步直接预测下一干净波场。

Trained on 7,871 benchmark velocity patches resized to 128x128 (10 m grid), with five shots per model simulated by a 10th-order staggered-grid acoustic FD solver (15 Hz Ricker, dt=0.001 s, saved every 0.01 s).
使用7871个128×128基准速度切片，由十阶交错网格声波FD模拟生成（步长0.001秒，每0.01秒采样）。

Advances wavefields at 10x the FD time step with a 2.17x GPU speedup (2.71 s vs 5.87 s). Causal loss reduces MAE to ~0.0020–0.0029 (SNR 25.69–33.70 dB) in-distribution and ~0.0239 (SNR 10.81 dB) on Marmousi.

Formulates recursive time-domain wave propagation via conditional diffusion with one-step x0 inference and an EMA-based causal time-weighted loss to bypass both iterative diffusion sampling and FD CFL stability limits.

kc: Formulated time-domain seismic wave propagation as a recursive conditional diffusion task conditioned on a 5-frame wavefield history, velocity model, and time-step index.
Enabled single-step diffusion inference by combining strong physical conditioning with direct clean-wavefield (x0) prediction, bypassing iterative reverse sampling.
Introduced an adaptive causal time-weighted loss based on exponential moving averages of per-snapshot errors to suppress error amplification over long recursive rollouts.
Decoupled inference time steps from the FD CFL stability condition (10x larger step size), achieving a 2.17x end-to-end speedup over a GPU-accelerated 10th-order FD solver.
将时域地震波传播构建为以5帧历史波场快照、速度模型和时间步索引为条件的递归条件扩散生成任务。

提出了基于每快照误差指数移动平均（EMA）的自适应因果时间加权损失，有效抑制了长时程递归推理中的误差累积放大。
将推理时间步长与有限差分CFL稳定性条件解耦（步长扩大10倍），相比GPU加速的十阶有限差分求解器实现了2.17倍端到端加速。

Recursive one-step inference starting from pure Gaussian noise at t=T alongside physical conditioning channels.
Adaptive causal time-weighted training objective maintained via a stop-gradient exponential moving average (EMA) buffer across snapshot indices.

tm.why: The paper develops a conditional generative diffusion model (U-Net) to learn and recursively predict seismic wavefield propagation.
The core problem addressed is accelerating acoustic seismic wavefield simulation beyond the CFL stability limits of conventional finite-difference solvers on GPUs.

sum: Tunnel boring machine (TBM) excavation produces strong mechanical noise that obscures weak microseismic responses from structural-plane activation. This study presents the Signal-Constrained Activation Detection and Localization (SCADL) framework for 12-station three-component geophone arrays. SCADL combines an adaptive multi-station consistency trigger with coherence and polarization screening to reject mechanical noise. First arrivals are picked by fusing statistical abrupt change, onset gradient, and polarization variation. Events are localized using an ahead-of-face layered velocity model and double-difference-style relative correction of similar event pairs, then ranked by a multi-evidence structural activation index. Tested on 16 hours of continuous field data, SCADL detected 263 valid propagating events (F1-score 0.88), achieved a 2.4 ms median picking error, 2.9 ms localization residual, and 0.82 m cluster thickness. Eighty-six high-confidence activation events formed two clusters matching the F04 and F02 structural zones confirmed by post-excavation geology.
针对TBM掘进强机械噪声掩盖微弱结构面活化微震信号的问题，本文提出信号约束活化检测与定位（SCADL）框架。利用12台三分量检波器阵列16小时连续记录，通过自适应多台一致性触发与相干-极化联合筛选剔除机械干扰；融合统计突变、局部梯度和极化变化拾取初至；结合超前分层速度模型与相似事件对相对校正进行定位……

t: SCADL uses adaptive multi-station consistency triggering, coherence-polarization screening, fused statistical-gradient-polarization arrival picking, layered-velocity-model location with relative pair correction, and a multi-evidence index to identify structural-plane activation.
集成自适应多台触发、相干极化筛选、统计-梯度-极化融合拾取、分层速度模型相对定位及多证据活化指数。
A 16-hour continuous three-component geophone record sampled at 1 kHz from 12 stations spaced at 1 m along a TBM tunnel, paired with an ahead-of-face layered velocity model.

sum: This paper presents a novel implementation of the seismic Time-Reversal Mirror (TRM) method using Vibroseis technology. Instead of retransmitting impulsive signals from receiver positions, the authors utilize an electromagnetic vibrator to generate frequency-swept ground vibrations. This approach overcomes the energy limitations of impulsive sources by injecting greater total energy into the subsurface over time. By leveraging the convolution properties of the sweep signal, the backpropagated swept wavefield maintains focal strength at the target. The authors introduce a quantitative metric to compare impulsive and Vibroseis focal strengths, validating their method with both numerical simulations and field experimental data.

Field experimental data using an electromagnetic vibrator and a geophone array, supplemented by synthetic numerical simulations.

sum: This study introduces a novel seismic traveltime tomography method that reparameterizes the velocity model using an untrained deep neural network (DNN). By mapping network parameters to the velocity field, the network's inherent structure acts as an implicit spatial regularization, eliminating the need for manual tuning of inversion grids and regularization parameters. Synthetic tests show that this approach outperforms conventional tomography in recovering fine-scale structures and maintaining stability in data-sparse regions. Its application to real seismic data from central Chile successfully images a clearer subducting slab with fewer artifacts, demonstrating its robustness and practical utility.

sum: This study investigates the mechanisms behind the spatial overlap of coseismic slip and postseismic afterslip following the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo earthquake. Using ~2 years of postseismic and ~7 years of interseismic Sentinel-1 InSAR data, the authors isolate transient postseismic deformation by removing interseismic velocities and long-wavelength noise. Bayesian kinematic slip inversions reveal up to 0.4 m of shallow afterslip (0-4 km depth) overlapping with coseismic rupture along the central Jiangcuo Fault. To explain this overlap, 2D quasi-dynamic earthquake cycle simulations with depth-dependent rate-and-state friction are conducted. The simulations demonstrate that a shallow velocity-strengthening layer (thickness <4 km, (a-b) = 0.01-0.03) can rupture seismically via dynamic stress overshoot and subsequently creep postseismically. Although the dynamic model predicts ~0.2 mm/yr of interseismic creep, screw dislocation modeling of interseismic InSAR profiles detects no clear creep (<0.1 mm/yr), suggesting creep is either below InSAR detection limits or postseismic slip is driven by coseismic...

sum: This paper introduces CDS-Polytope, a parameter-free framework for detecting critical transitions in 4D event clouds by discretizing the unit 3-sphere onto the 24-cell regular polytope. The framework provides an intrinsically interpretable similarity measure without training data or hyperparameter tuning. It is validated across three independent physical domains: seismology (retroactively recovering the Kato et al. 2012 foreshock migration sequence to within 0.52 degrees), typhoon climatology, and ENSO dynamics. The framework provides explainability by construction, as each of the 24 vertices carries a human-readable axis-combination label.
本文提出了一种无参数的CDS-Polytope框架，通过将单位3-球面离散化到24胞体正多胞体上，来检测四维事件云中的临界转变。该框架无需训练数据或超参数微调，即可提供具有本质可解释性的相似性度量。该方法在三个独立的物理领域得到了验证：地震学（追溯性地恢复了Kato等（2012）的前震迁移序列，误差……

t: Discretization of the unit 3-sphere onto the 24-cell regular polytope to create an interpretable 4D similarity measure without training data.

Tested on Lorenz system simulations, Northwest Pacific typhoon tracks (71,161 points), and the Kato et al. 2012 seismic foreshock sequence.
在Lorenz系统模拟、西北太平洋台风路径（71,161个点）和前震序列数据上进行了测试。
Successfully recovered the 2011 Tohoku-Oki foreshock migration sequence to within 0.52 degrees and estimated the Lorenz attractor dimension as 1.991.
成功恢复了2011年东北大地震前震迁移序列，空间误差在0.52度以内。
The abstract does not explicitly detail limitations, but the method is intrinsically designed for and restricted to 4D spatial-temporal event clouds.
该方法目前主要针对并局限于四维时空事件云的分析。
First use of 24-cell regular polytope discretization to provide an explainable, parameter-free 4D similarity measure across seismology and climatology.
首次利用24胞体正多胞体离散化，为地震学和气候学提供无参数、可解释的四维相似性度量。

kc: Introduced CDS-Polytope, a parameter-free framework for 4D event cloud discretization.
Demonstrated cosD as a surrogate Lyapunov exponent tracking order-to-chaos transitions.
Successfully recovered the 2011 Tohoku-Oki foreshock migration sequence within 0.52 degrees.
引入了CDS-Polytope，一种用于四维事件云离散化的无参数框架。
证明了cosD可作为追踪有序到混沌转变的替代李雅普诺夫指数。
成功恢复了2011年东北大地震前震迁移序列，误差在0.52度以内。
me: Discretization of the unit 3-sphere onto the 24-cell regular polytope.
Cosine distance (cosD) measurement between empirical vertex occupancy and uniform baseline.
Effective dimension (D_eff) estimation for fractal dimension recovery.
将单位3-球面离散化到24胞体正多胞体上。
测量经验顶点占用分布与均匀基线之间的余弦距离（cosD）。
用于分形维度恢复的有效维度（D_eff）估计。
de: Lorenz chaotic system simulation data.
Northwest Pacific typhoon track data (71,161 points, 1951-2023).
Seismic event catalog for the 2011 Tohoku-Oki foreshock migration sequence.
Lorenz混沌系统模拟数据。
西北太平洋台风路径数据（1951-2023年，共71,161个点）。
2011年东北大地震前震迁移序列的地震目录数据。
li: The method is currently optimized for 4D spaces and may require adaptation for higher-dimensional event clouds.
该方法目前针对四维空间进行了优化，对于更高维度的事件云可能需要进行适配。

tm.why: The paper applies a 4D event cloud discretization method to seismology, specifically retroactively recovering the Kato et al. 2012 foreshock migration sequence.
It introduces a parameter-free framework (CDS-Polytope) for detecting critical transitions and measuring similarity in 4D event clouds.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Understanding the physical processes governing earthquake initiation in the final seconds before rupture remains a major challenge due to scarce observational evidence. This study analyzes three-component broadband waveforms from 41 regional stations in central Alaska to investigate a Mw 4.2 earthquake in the Minto Flats strike-slip fault zone at 18 km depth. Using double-couple moment tensor grid-search inversions (MTUQ) across multiple passbands and waveform cross-correlation, the authors resolve a three-stage initiation sequence lasting 42.5 s. An emergent high-frequency foreshock signal begins 42.5 s before the mainshock, joined 18.9 s later by a Mw 3.8 very-low-frequency earthquake (VLFE) occurring 23.6 s prior to dynamic rupture. The VLFE and mainshock share nearly identical focal mechanisms (8° difference) and locations (within 0–2 km), with source durations of ~8.0 s and ≤1.0 s, respectively. This provides rare, well-constrained seismic evidence of a slow-to-fast transitional rupture during earthquake nucleation.
揭示地震破裂前数秒内的成核物理机制因缺乏观测证据而极具挑战。本文利用阿拉斯加中部41个区域宽频带台站的三分量波形，研究了Minto Flats走滑断裂带18 km深处的Mw 4.2地震。通过多频段双力偶矩张量网格搜索反演（MTUQ）和波形互相关分析，解析了持续42.5秒的三阶段起始序列：主震前42.……

t: Double-couple moment tensors are estimated via grid search in MTUQ by fitting three-component P and surface waves against 1D regional synthetics across multiple passbands, complemented by waveform cross-correlation.
利用MTUQ拟合一维区域理论波形与三分量P波和面波以反演双力偶矩张量，并结合波形互相关测定相对走时差。
Three-component broadband displacement waveforms recorded at 41 regional stations within 300 km of the Minto Flats fault zone for the August 2025 sequence and comparison events.
Minto Flats断裂带震中距300 km内41个区域宽频带台站记录的2025年8月地震序列及对比事件的三分量位移波…
A 42.5 s precursory signal contains a Mw 3.8 VLFE (duration 8.0 s) 23.6 s before a Mw 4.15–4.2 earthquake at 18 km depth, with focal mechanisms differing by only 8°.
18 km深处的Mw 4.2地震前存在42.5秒前兆，含主震前23.6秒发生的Mw 3.8超低频地震（持续8秒），两者机…
Resolving the exact spatial offset between the VLFE and mainshock requires accounting for extreme 3D structural variations and modeling incoherent high-frequency waveforms.
未考虑区域强三维速度结构变化，且高频前震缺乏台站间相位相干性，限制了相对位置的精确测定。
Provides the clearest seismic observational evidence of a well-constrained VLFE and high-frequency signal transitioning directly into a dynamic earthquake rupture with identical faulting geometry.
提供了慢变形（VLFE）伴随高频辐射直接向同断层几何动态破裂转换的最清晰地震学观测证据。

kc: Documented a three-stage earthquake initiation sequence (high-frequency signal, Mw 3.8 VLFE, and Mw 4.2 earthquake) lasting 42.5 s at 18 km depth in the Minto Flats fault zone.
Demonstrated via moment tensor inversion that the preceding VLFE and subsequent mainshock share nearly identical strike-slip mechanisms (minimum rotation angle of 8°).

Constrained the relative timing (23.6 ± 0.5 s), close spatial proximity (0–2 km), and distinct source durations (~8.0 s for the VLFE vs. ≤1.0 s for the mainshock), evidencing a slow-to-fast rupture transition.
记录了Minto Flats断裂带18 km深处持续42.5秒的三阶段地震成核序列（高频前兆信号、Mw 3.8超低频地震和Mw 4.2主震）。
通过矩张量反演证明前兆VLFE与随后主震具有几乎一致的走滑震源机制（最小旋转角仅差8°）。
约束了二者的相对发震时间差（23.6 ± 0.5秒）、空间距离（0–2 km）及不同的震源持续时间（VLFE约8.0秒，主震≤1.0秒），证实了慢-快破裂转换过程。
me: Double-couple moment tensor grid-search inversion using 1D regional velocity models (tactmod) implemented in MTUQ.
Multi-bandpass waveform sensitivity analysis across 55 passbands (periods 2.5 to 40.0 s) to isolate the VLFE signal (optimal band 12.5–27.5 s).
Time-domain waveform cross-correlation of low-frequency displacement traces to measure differential origin times between the VLFE and mainshock.
基于区域一维速度模型（tactmod）并使用MTUQ软件包进行双力偶矩张量网格搜索反演。
在55个不同通带（周期2.5至40.0秒）下进行多频段波形敏感性分析，提取VLFE最佳频段（12.5–27.5秒）。
对低频位移波形进行时域互相关分析，精确测定VLFE与主震之间的相对发震时间差。
de: Three-component broadband seismic waveforms from 41 regional stations (networks AK, XV, TA, IU) within 300 km epicentral distance in central Alaska.
Analysis of the August 20, 2025 Mw 4.2 sequence alongside comparison earthquakes in the Minto Flats fault zone from 2015 (Mw 2.85), 2019 (Mw 4.20), and 2022 (Mw 4.50).
阿拉斯加中部震中距300 km内41个区域宽频带台站（AK、XV、TA、IU台网）的三分量地震波形数据。
2025年8月20日Mw 4.2地震序列以及Minto Flats断裂带2015年（Mw 2.85）、2019年（Mw 4.20）和2022年（Mw 4.50）对比地震事件的分析。
li: Extreme 3D crustal and basin velocity variations are not accounted for in the 1D synthetic waveform modeling, limiting precise relative relocation of the VLFE.
Lack of waveform phase coherence in the emergent high-frequency foreshock signal across the closest stations prevents precise microsource tracking without specialized coherence techniques.
一维理论波形建模未考虑区域极强的三维地壳和盆地速度结构变化，限制了对VLFE精确相对位置的约束。
最近台站记录的涌现型高频前震信号缺乏明显的波形相位相干性，难以直接追踪微震源演化。

tm.why: The paper presents observational evidence of a Mw 3.8 very-low-frequency earthquake (VLFE) and high-frequency precursory slip immediately preceding a Mw 4.2 earthquake.
The study performs moment tensor inversions, analyzes source durations, and investigates the slow-to-fast rupture transition during earthquake initiation.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 4 figures, Table 1, methodology, results, and discussion sections.

sum: This study evaluates the geodynamics of the early Earth during the Hadean eon (≥4.03 Ga) using a stochastic model of impact flux. The authors demonstrate that the time-integrated heat generated by asteroid impacts significantly exceeded internally generated heat. This intense impact heating caused the Hadean crust to remain extensively molten below a depth of a few kilometers. This melting drove gravitational segregation of dense iron- and magnesium-rich materials, progressively enriching the remaining crustal composition in silica. As the impact flux declined sharply after 3.9 Ga, the crust was finally able to cool, solidify, and thicken, marking the onset of enduring continental crust.
本研究利用随机撞击通量模型评估了冥古宙（≥4.03 Ga）早期地球的动力学演化。研究表明，陨石撞击产生的累积热量远超地球内部热源。这种强烈的撞击加热导致几公里深处的冥古宙地壳广泛熔化，引发富含铁、镁的深色物质发生重力分异，促使平均地壳成分向富硅方向演化。随着3.9 Ga后撞击通量显著减弱，地壳得以冷……

t: Stochastic modeling of the Hadean impact flux combined with geodynamic simulations of crustal thermal evolution and melting.
结合地壳热演化和熔融地球动力学模拟，对冥古宙撞击通量进行随机建模。
Synthetic impact histories and flux parameters derived from empirical constraints of early solar system bombardment.
根据早期太阳系撞击历史的经验约束，获取合成撞击历史和通量参数。
Impact heating kept the Hadean crust extensively molten below a few kilometers, with stable crustal thickening only becoming possible after 3.9 Ga.
撞击热使几公里深处的冥古宙地壳广泛熔化，直到3.9 Ga后地壳才得以稳定增厚。
The model's accuracy is limited by uncertainties in the exact timing, size distribution, and decay rate of the Hadean impactors.
模型准确性受限于冥古宙撞击体的具体时间、尺寸分布和衰减率的不确定性。
Demonstrates that external impact heating, rather than internal mantle heat alone, was the primary driver of Hadean crustal geodynamics and differentiation.
证明了外部撞击加热而非单一的内部地幔热，是冥古宙地壳动力学和分异的主导力量。

kc: Demonstrated that Hadean impact heating was the dominant heat source, dwarfing internal radiogenic and primordial heat.
Showed that impact-induced melting below a few kilometers depth drove gravitational segregation, making the crust increasingly silica-rich.
Linked the decline of the impact flux after 3.9 Ga directly to the stabilization and thickening of the first enduring continental crust.
证明了冥古宙时期的撞击加热是主导热源，远超地球内部的放射性热和原始热。
表明几公里深处的撞击诱发熔融导致了重力分异，使地壳成分逐渐富硅化。
将3.9 Ga后撞击通量的衰减与首批持久性大陆地壳的稳定和增厚直接联系起来。
me: Stochastic modeling of the Hadean impact flux and associated thermal evolution.
Geodynamic and thermodynamic modeling of crustal melting and gravitational segregation.
冥古宙陨石撞击通量及相关热演化的随机模拟。
地壳熔融与重力分异的地球动力学和热力学模拟。
de: Synthetic impact histories generated using stochastic flux models based on lunar and terrestrial impact records.
基于月球和地球撞击记录，利用随机通量模型生成的合成撞击历史数据。
li: The conclusions rely heavily on the assumed Hadean impact flux curve, which remains subject to uncertainties in early solar system dynamics.
研究结论在很大程度上依赖于所假设的冥古宙撞击通量曲线，而早期太阳系动力学仍存在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper models early Earth geodynamics, crustal melting, and the formation of the first continental crust during the Hadean eon.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata from Science and Semantic Scholar.

sum: This study performs large-scale, 3D physics-based finite-difference simulations up to 3 Hz to investigate regional seismic-wave propagation and ground-motion characteristics along the northern Dead Sea fault (DSF). Simulating nine Mw 7 strike-slip rupture scenarios using a detailed 3D geological velocity model, the authors generate over 32,000 synthetic seismograms. The results reveal pronounced basin-controlled amplification, strong rupture directivity, and near-fault pulse-like motions with periods of 2–6 s. Regression analyses show that conventional ground-motion models (GMMs) underestimate hazard in deep sedimentary basins and fail to capture component-specific directivity, highlighting the critical need for nonergodic, region-specific GMMs in data-limited tectonic environments.
本研究利用大尺度三维物理有限差分模拟（最高3 Hz），探讨了死海断裂带北部的区域地震波传播与强地面运动特征。基于详细的三维地质速度模型，模拟了9个Mw 7走滑破裂情景，生成了超3.2万条合成地震动记录。结果表明，该区域存在显著的盆地放大效应、强烈的破裂方向性以及周期为2-6秒的近断层脉冲型运动。回归……

t: Large-scale 3D finite-difference wave propagation up to 3 Hz combined with kinematic rupture modeling of nine Mw 7 strike-slip scenarios.
采用最高达3 Hz的大尺度三维有限差分波动传播模拟，结合9个Mw 7走滑破裂情景的运动学模拟。
More than 32,000 three-component synthetic seismograms generated on a dense spatial grid using a detailed 3D geological velocity model of the Dead Sea fault.
基于死海断裂带详细的三维地质速度模型，在密集网格上生成了超过32,000条三分量合成地震动。
Pronounced basin amplification, strong directivity, and near-fault pulses (2-6 s) were observed, with significant positive GMM residuals persisting in deep basins.
观测到显著的盆地放大、强方向性及2-6秒的近断层脉冲，且深部盆地内存在显著的正GMM残差。
The study is limited by the lack of high-frequency resolution (>3 Hz) and potential epistemic uncertainties in the 3D velocity model.
模拟受限于3 Hz的最大截止频率，且结果依赖于三维速度模型的精确度。
First large-scale 3D physics-based ground-motion simulation for the northern Dead Sea fault, addressing the critical lack of regional strong-motion data.
首次针对死海断裂带北部开展大尺度三维物理地面运动模拟，填补了该区强震观测数据的空白。

kc: Generated a comprehensive database of over 32,000 three-component synthetic seismograms for the Dead Sea fault region.
Quantified the combined effects of 3D basin amplification and rupture directivity along the northern DSF.
Demonstrated that orientation-independent intensity measures in conventional GMMs may underestimate hazard for near-fault structures.
为死海断裂带区域生成了包含超过32,000条三分量合成地震动记录的完整数据库。
定量评估了死海断裂带北部三维盆地放大与破裂方向性的耦合效应。
证明了传统地面运动模型中与方向无关的强度指标可能会低估近断层结构的地震灾害。
me: 3D finite-difference wave propagation modeling up to 3 Hz.
Kinematic rupture simulation of nine Mw 7 strike-slip earthquake scenarios.
Regression analysis using a simplified ground-motion model (GMM) to evaluate residuals.
最高频率达3 Hz的三维有限差分地震波传播数值模拟。
9个Mw 7走滑地震情景的运动学破裂模拟。
使用简化地面运动模型（GMM）进行回归分析以评估残差。
de: Utilized a detailed 3D geological velocity model of the Dead Sea fault zone.
Simulated ruptures on three major segments of the northern Dead Sea fault.
利用了死海断裂带区域详细的三维地质速度模型。
在死海断裂带北部的三个主要断层段上模拟了破裂过程。
li: The simulations are limited to a maximum frequency of 3 Hz, which may not capture very high-frequency ground-motion characteristics.
The results are dependent on the accuracy and resolution of the input 3D geological velocity model.
数值模拟受限于3 Hz的最大截止频率，可能无法完全捕获极高频的地面运动特征。
模拟结果依赖于输入的三维地质速度模型的准确性与分辨率。

tm.why: The study uses large-scale 3D finite-difference wave propagation simulations up to 3 Hz to model regional seismic-wave propagation.
The paper evaluates ground-motion characteristics, basin amplification, directivity, and ground-motion models for seismic hazard assessment.
It simulates nine Mw 7 strike-slip rupture scenarios on major segments of the Dead Sea fault.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from BSSA and Semantic Scholar.

sum: This study investigates the post-test seismicity at North Korea's Punggye-ri nuclear test site following the sixth nuclear test on 3 September 2017. Using continuous waveform data from 2016 to 2024, the authors applied the match-and-locate method to detect 647 new seismic events, which differ significantly in waveform characteristics from the nuclear test and subsequent collapse. Precise relocation of 491 events using hypoDD reveals a north-northwest–south-southeast distribution trend, concentrated 4–9 km north and northwest of the test site. Over the 2017–2024 period, the seismicity exhibits a distinct spatial migration trend southeastward toward the test site, providing critical insights into the post-explosion stress relaxation and crustal deformation processes.
本研究针对朝鲜2017年9月3日第六次核试验后丰溪里核试验场周边的地震活动进行了系统分析。利用2016至2024年的连续波形数据，研究人员采用“匹配与定位”（M&L）方法检测出647个新地震事件，其波形特征与核爆及塌陷事件显著不同。通过双差定位法（hypoDD）对其中491个事件进行精确重定位，结果……

t: The study utilizes the match-and-locate (M&L) template-matching method for event detection and the double-difference (hypoDD) algorithm with bootstrap resampling for high-precision relocation.
采用匹配定位（M&L）模板匹配技术进行地震检测，并结合双差定位法（hypoDD）进行高精度重定位。
Continuous seismic waveform data recorded from 2016 to 2024 around the Punggye-ri nuclear test site in North Korea.
使用2016至2024年间记录朝鲜丰溪里核试验场周边活动的连续地震波形数据。
Detection of 647 new events (magnitudes 1.5–2.5) and relocation of 491 events showing a NNW-SSE trend and a southeastward migration toward the test site from 2017 to 2024.
检测到647个新事件，重定位显示其呈北北西-南南东向分布，且在2017-2024年间向试验场方向迁移。
The spatial resolution and detection threshold are inherently constrained by the sparse regional station coverage surrounding the restricted Punggye-ri test site.
由于无法获取近场台站数据，定位精度和检测灵敏度受限于区域台网的分布。
Provides a long-term (2016–2024) high-resolution catalog revealing a clear multi-year southeastward migration of triggered seismicity back toward the nuclear test site.
首次给出了长达八年的高精度爆后地震目录，并发现了地震活动向核爆中心迁移的演化规律。

kc: Detected 647 new seismic events around the Punggye-ri nuclear test site using continuous waveform data from 2016 to 2024.
Relocated 491 post-test seismic events with high precision, revealing a north-northwest–south-southeast spatial distribution.
Identified a temporal migration trend of seismicity moving southeastward toward the nuclear test site over a seven-year period.
利用2016至2024年连续波形数据，在丰溪里核试验场周边检测到647个新地震事件。
高精度重定位了491个爆后地震事件，揭示了呈北北西-南南东向的空间分布特征。
发现了地震活动在七年间（2017-2024年）向核试验场东南方向迁移的时间演化趋势。
me: Match-and-locate (M&L) method for high-sensitivity seismic event detection.
Double-difference earthquake relocation algorithm (hypoDD) for high-precision event hypocenter determination.
Bootstrap method for estimating location uncertainties of the relocated events.
采用匹配定位（Match-and-locate, M&L）方法进行高灵敏度地震事件检测。
应用双差定位算法（hypoDD）获取地震事件的高精度震源位置。
使用自助法（Bootstrap）评估重定位结果的位置不确定性。
de: Continuous seismic waveform data spanning from 2016 to 2024 around the North Korean nuclear test site.
使用2016至2024年间覆盖朝鲜核试验场周边的连续地震波形数据。
li: The study relies on regional/teleseismic stations due to restricted local station access in North Korea, which may limit detection thresholds and location resolution.
由于无法在朝鲜境内布设近场台站，研究依赖区域台网，这可能限制了检测下限和定位分辨率。

tm.why: The paper uses the match-and-locate method and hypoDD to detect and relocate 647 new seismic events near the Punggye-ri nuclear test site.
The study investigates the spatial and temporal characteristics of seismicity triggered or induced after North Korea's sixth nuclear test.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata of the paper, as no PDF was available.

sum: This dataset provides a simple text grid file representing the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) depths across the African Plate. The depths are derived from the 3D wave speed model of vertically polarized shear waves (Vsv) published by van Herwaarden et al. (2023). It serves as a key resource for understanding the crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning variations beneath Africa, particularly along the East African Rift System.
该数据集提供了一个简单的文本网格文件，代表非洲板块的岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）深度。这些深度源自 van Herwaarden 等人（2023年）发表的垂直极化剪切波（Vsv）三维波速模型。该数据是理解非洲大陆（特别是东非裂谷系统）地壳和岩石圈地幔变薄变化的关键资源。

t: Extraction of lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) depths from a pre-existing 3D vertically polarized shear-wave velocity model.
从已有的三维垂直极化剪切波速度模型中提取岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）深度。
A digital text grid file containing LAB depths across the African Plate.
包含整个非洲板块LAB深度的数字文本网格文件。
A mapped representation of lithospheric thickness variations, highlighting mantle thinning beneath regions like the East African Rift.
展示了岩石圈厚度变化，突出了东非裂谷等区域下方的地幔变薄特征。
Dependent on the assumptions and resolution limits of the underlying seismic velocity model of van Herwaarden et al. (2023).
依赖于 van Herwaarden 等人（2023年）基础地震速度模型的假设和分辨率限制。
First publicly available, unified digital LAB depth grid for the entire African Plate derived from modern adjoint tomography.
首个公开的、基于现代伴随层析成像提取的整个非洲板块统一数字LAB深度网格。

kc: Provides a digital grid map of the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) depths for the African Plate.
Enables quantitative geodynamic and structural modeling of the African continent and its rift systems.
提供了非洲板块岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）深度的数字网格地图。
为非洲大陆及其裂谷系统的定量地球动力学和结构建模提供了支持。
me: Derived LAB depths from the vertically polarized shear wave (Vsv) speed model of van Herwaarden et al. (2023).
基于 van Herwaarden 等人（2023年）的垂直极化剪切波（Vsv）速度模型提取LAB深度。
de: A text-based grid file containing geographic coordinates and corresponding LAB depths.
包含地理坐标及对应LAB深度的文本网格数据文件。
li: The resolution and accuracy of the LAB map are inherently limited by the resolution of the underlying seismic tomography model.
LAB地图的分辨率和准确性本质上受限于所采用的地震层析成像模型的分辨率。

tm.why: The dataset provides a lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) depth map of the African Plate.
The LAB depths are derived from a 3D shear-wave velocity model of the African Plate.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the Zenodo abstract and Google search metadata linking this dataset to a 2026 paper on crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning beneath the East African Rift.

sum: Whether a mega-ultralow velocity zone (mega-ULVZ) exists at the root of the Cape Verde deep mantle plume has remained unknown. This study examines transverse-component core-diffracted shear-wave (Sdiff and sSdiff) waveforms from two independent earthquakes in Botswana (2017 Mw 6.5) and Argentina (2015 Mw 6.3) recorded at epicentral distances of 100°–130°. The data exhibit pronounced quasi-hyperbolic postcursors arriving 30–40 s after the main phase, which cannot be explained by existing 3D tomographic mantle models. Using the sandwiched Coupled Spectral Element Method (Coupled-CSEM) down to 10 s period, the authors superimpose trial cylindrical anomalies onto tomographic model SEMUCB-WM1. The postcursors are best explained to first order by a quasi-cylindrical mega-ULVZ centered at (8.65°N, 19.64°W) with an ~800 km diameter, ~40 km height, and a 20% shear-velocity reduction. This first detection of a mega-ULVZ beneath Cape Verde reinforces a systematic global link between mega-ULVZs and deep mantle plumes.
佛得角热点下方的深部地幔柱底部是否存在超低速区（ULVZ）此前一直未知。本研究分析了2017年博茨瓦纳Mw 6.5和2015年阿根廷Mw 6.3两次独立地震在震中距100°–130°记录到的核幔边界绕射横波（Sdiff和sSdiff）切向分量波形，发现了主震相后30–40秒到达的显著准双曲线型后至波……

t: The authors use the sandwiched Coupled Spectral Element Method (Coupled-CSEM), coupling 3D SEM in a 370-km lowermost-mantle shell (SEMUCB-WM1 plus cylindrical ULVZ) with 1D Normal Mode Summation outside down to 10 s period.
采用夹层耦合谱元法，在核幔边界上方370 km壳层用三维谱元法，外部耦合一维简正模计算至10秒周期。

Transverse-component Sdiff and sSdiff waveforms (100°–130° distance, filtered 7–18 s, SNR > 3, stacked in 1° azimuth bins) primarily from a 2017 Mw 6.5 Botswana earthquake and a 2015 Mw 6.3 Argentina earthquake.
2017年博茨瓦纳Mw 6.5和2015年阿根廷Mw 6.3地震在100°–130°记录的7–18秒切向Sdiff与sS…

Quasi-hyperbolic Sdiff postcursors arriving 30–40 s after the main phase are best fit by a cylindrical mega-ULVZ centered at (8.65°N, 19.64°W) with an 800 km diameter, 40 km height, and 20% shear-velocity reduction.
主震相后30–40秒的后至波最佳拟合为(8.65°N, 19.64°W)处直径800 km、高40 km、波速降20%的…

Strong parameter trade-offs exist among ULVZ height, diameter, and velocity reduction, and the SH-only dataset cannot constrain P-wave velocity or density to distinguish melt from solid-state enrichment.
高度、直径与波速降幅存在强折衷，且纯SH数据无法约束纵波速度与密度以区分熔融或固态成因。
First seismic detection and 3D waveform modeling of a mega-ULVZ beneath the Cape Verde hotspot, confirming a large low-velocity root at the base of the Cape Verde mantle plume.
首次在佛得角热点下方探测并三维正演约束了地幔柱根部的巨型超低速区（mega-ULVZ）。

kc: First seismic detection and characterization of a mega-ULVZ at the core-mantle boundary beneath the Cape Verde hotspot using two intersecting source-receiver geometries.
Forward 3D waveform modeling with Coupled-CSEM constrains the Cape Verde ULVZ to a cylinder of ~800 km diameter, ~40 km height, and 20% shear-velocity reduction at (8.65°N, 19.64°W).
Strengthens the global observational link showing that mega-ULVZs are a common, potentially systematic feature at the roots of broad deep mantle plumes.
利用两组交叉的震源-台站射线路径，首次在佛得角热点下方的核幔边界探测并表征了一个巨型超低速区（mega-ULVZ）。
通过耦合谱元法（Coupled-CSEM）三维波形正演模拟，约束该ULVZ中心位于(8.65°N, 19.64°W)，直径约800 km，高度约40 km，剪切波速降低20%。
强化了巨型ULVZ普遍甚至系统性地存在于大型深部地幔柱根部的全球观测证据。
me: Azimuthal binning (1° bins), bandpass filtering (7–18 s), and visual inspection of transverse-component (SH) Sdiff and sSdiff record sections to identify quasi-hyperbolic postcursors.
Back-projection along the azimuth of minimum postcursor delay time to estimate candidate ULVZ locations guided by SEMUCB-WM1 velocity minima.

3D synthetic waveform forward modeling down to 10 s period using the sandwiched Coupled Spectral Element Method (Coupled-CSEM), coupling a 370 km thick 3D SEM shell above the CMB with 1D Normal Mode Summation in PREM.
对切向分量（SH）Sdiff和sSdiff波形进行7–18秒带通滤波和1°方位角叠加，识别准双曲线走时的后至波。
结合SEMUCB-WM1低速极值区，沿后至波最小延迟时间的方位角进行反投影以估计候选ULVZ位置。
采用夹层耦合谱元法（Coupled-CSEM）计算精确到10秒周期的三维合成地震图，在核幔边界上方370 km壳层内使用三维SEM，外部耦合一维PREM简正模求和。
de: Event 1 (April 3, 2017, Mw 6.5, depth 30 km, Botswana) recorded by USArray at distances >100° sampling Cape Verde along a NW-SE path.
Event 2 (February 2, 2015, Mw 6.3, depth 172 km, Argentina) recorded by European/Mediterranean broadband networks sampling Cape Verde along a NE-SW path.
Forward-modeling parameter sweeps varying cylinder location, diameter (700–900 km), and shear-velocity reduction (-10% to -30%) superimposed on 3D mantle model SEMUCB-WM1.
事件1（2017年4月3日博茨瓦纳Mw 6.5地震，深度30 km），由USArray在>100°震中距记录，沿NW-SE方向采样佛得角下方下地幔。
事件2（2015年2月2日阿根廷Mw 6.3地震，深度172 km），由欧洲宽频带台网记录，沿NE-SW方向采样同一核幔边界区域。
在三维地幔模型SEMUCB-WM1基础上叠加圆柱体异常，对位置、直径（700–900 km）和剪切波速降幅（-10%至-30%）进行正演参数测试。
li: Strong trade-offs exist among ULVZ height, diameter, and velocity reduction within the 7–18 s period band, making the simplified cylindrical model non-unique.
Extending Coupled-CSEM simulations to higher frequencies to resolve detailed internal 3D geometry is currently computationally challenging.
The shear-wave-only (SH) dataset cannot constrain compressional wave velocity or density, preventing discrimination between partial melt and iron-rich solid-state (Mg,Fe)O compositions.
在7–18秒周期频带内，ULVZ的高度、直径和波速降幅之间存在强烈折衷关系，简化的圆柱模型解具有非唯一性。
目前将Coupled-CSEM模拟扩展到更高频率以约束精细三维几何形态在计算上仍具挑战性。
仅使用横波（SH）数据无法约束纵波速度或密度，因此无法区分部分熔融与富铁固态(Mg,Fe)O成因机制。

tm.why: The paper detects and characterizes a mega-ultralow velocity zone (ULVZ) at the core-mantle boundary beneath the Cape Verde hotspot and links it to deep mantle plumes.
The study relies on forward waveform modeling using the sandwiched Coupled Spectral Element Method (CSEM) down to 10 s period in a 3D lowermost mantle shell.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 19-page manuscript and supplementary information PDF.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the complete dataset and Python code supporting the paper 'Low frequency icequakes generated during transient cavity drainage on a Greenlandic outlet glacier'. It includes downsampled MSEED seismic data from a nodal array, GNSS displacement data, Matched Field Processing (MFP) event localizations (1.5-21 Hz and 4-6 Hz), hydraulic potential maps, and ice thickness kriging models. The resources enable the reproduction of the paper's figures and facilitate further research into cryoseismic signals, subglacial hydrology, and the mechanical response of outlet glaciers to transient water routing.
该Zenodo仓库包含了支持格陵兰冰川瞬态空腔排水期间低频冰震研究的完整数据集与Python代码。数据包括节点地震台网的下采样MSEED波形、GNSS位移数据、匹配场处理（MFP）事件定位结果（1.5-21 Hz和4-6 Hz）、水力势能图以及冰川厚度克里金插值模型。这些资源可用于重现论文插图，并促……

t: Matched Field Processing (MFP) is used to localize low-frequency icequake sources within the 1.5-21 Hz and 4-6 Hz frequency bands.
采用匹配场处理（MFP）方法对1.5-21 Hz和4-6 Hz频段内的低频冰震源进行定位。
Nodal seismic array waveforms (downsampled to 200Hz), GNSS data, ice thickness kriging models, and subglacial hydraulic potential maps.
包含节点地震台网波形（下采样至200Hz）、GNSS数据、冰川厚度模型及冰下水力势能图。
The dataset enables mapping of low-frequency icequake families (surface and deep sources) associated with transient subglacial cavity drainage.
该数据集成功关联并定位了与冰下瞬态空腔排水相关的浅部和深部低频冰震群。
The seismic data is temporally limited to a three-day window (September 10-12, 2024) and downsampled to 200 Hz.
地震数据在时间上仅限于三天窗口（2024年9月10-12日），且采样率降至200 Hz。
Provides an integrated open-source package of seismic, geodetic, and hydraulic data specifically capturing transient subglacial cavity drainage processes.
提供了一个整合地震、大地测量和水力学数据的开源包，专门用于捕获冰下瞬态排水过程。

kc: Provides a comprehensive, open-access cryoseismic and geodetic dataset from a Greenlandic outlet glacier.
Shares Matched Field Processing (MFP) localization catalogs for low-frequency icequakes (1.5-21 Hz and 4-6 Hz).
Includes Python scripts to fully reproduce the figures of the associated scientific paper.
提供了一个格陵兰外流冰川的综合性、开放获取冰震与大地测量数据集。
共享了低频冰震（1.5-21 Hz和4-6 Hz）的匹配场处理（MFP）定位目录。
包含了用于完全重现相关学术论文插图的 Python 脚本。
me: Matched Field Processing (MFP) for localizing low-frequency icequake sources.
Kriging interpolation for mapping ice thickness.
Hydraulic potential modeling for subglacial water routing analysis.
用于定位低频冰震震源的匹配场处理（MFP）方法。
用于绘制冰川厚度图的克里金插值法。
用于冰下水流路径分析的水力势能建模。
de: Downsampled (200 Hz) MSEED seismic waveform data from a nodal array collected between September 10-12, 2024.
GNSS displacement time-series data from stations F and G.
Hydraulic potential and water routing GeoTIFF maps.
2024年9月10日至12日期间节点台网采集的下采样（200 Hz）MSEED地震波形数据。
来自F站和G站的GNSS位移时间序列数据。
水力势能与水流路径 GeoTIFF 地图。
li: The seismic data is downsampled to 200 Hz, which may limit the analysis of very high-frequency cryoseismic events.
The dataset covers a short temporal window of three days (September 10-12, 2024).
地震数据被下采样至 200 Hz，这可能会限制对极高频冰震事件的分析。
数据集仅覆盖了2024年9月10日至12日为期三天的较短时间窗口。

tm.why: The dataset and code are designed to study low-frequency icequakes generated during transient cavity drainage on a Greenlandic outlet glacier.
The resources include seismic node array data and Matched Field Processing (MFP) localizations.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed Zenodo repository abstract and file list, which outlines the data types, methods (MFP, kriging), and the specific figures generated by the provided Python scripts.

sum: Existing urban telecommunications fibers have tree-like topologies with frequent switching nodes, making long-range Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) suboptimal for city-scale monitoring. Assuming emerging short-range, on-chip DAS interrogators, this study models urban street networks as planar Gabriel graphs to establish coverage requirements across applications. Using percolation theory, the authors identify three regimes: low coverage (<10% of streets) suffices for earthquake early warning (EEW), geological mapping, groundwater monitoring, and urban activity tracking; a bond percolation transition at 51.6% forms a Giant Connected Component enabling statistical city-wide traffic monitoring; and near-complete coverage (~100%) is needed for infrastructure monitoring and individual vehicle or pedestrian tracking, ensuring low privacy risks. Using OpenStreetMap and WorldPop data, the authors formulate optimization algorithms (knapsack, minimax P-wave delay, and maximum coverage) for sensor placement in San Francisco, Berlin, Singapore, Mexico City, and Paris, providing a quantitative roadmap for smart-city DAS deployment.
针对城市通信光缆拓扑限制长距分布式声学传感（DAS）的问题，本文结合图论与逾渗理论，将城市路网建模为平面Gabriel图，评估了短距片上DAS的监测潜力。研究利用OpenStreetMap与WorldPop数据，提出了背包问题、P波走时极小化及最大覆盖优化算法。结果表明城市监测存在三个区间：低于10……

t: Urban street networks are modeled as planar Gabriel graphs where junctions are nodes and streets are edges. Percolation theory and combinatorial optimization (knapsack, minimax P-wave delay, maximum coverage) determine optimal short-range DAS placement.
将城市路网建模为平面Gabriel图，利用逾渗理论与组合优化算法确定短距DAS的最优布设。

The study uses OpenStreetMap street topologies across 8,900+ cities (average 17,000 junctions, 99.8 edges/km^2), WorldPop population density data, and a 433-address fiber availability survey in Tel Aviv showing 91.0% coverage.
使用全球8900多个城市的OpenStreetMap路网、WorldPop人口数据及特拉维夫光纤覆盖调查数据。

Low street coverage (<10%) suffices for EEW, groundwater, and activity monitoring (e.g., 74 interrogators cover 91.5% of Paris's population). A percolation transition at c* ≈ 51.6% enables city-wide traffic sensing, while individual tracking requires ~100% coverage.
低于10%覆盖率即可满足地震预警与活动监测，51.6%达到逾渗阈值支持全城交通监测，个体追踪需近100%覆盖。
The analysis assumes array length and single-street SNR are not limiting factors, whereas subsurface imaging may require contiguous multi-street arrays and straight fiber geometries.
假设单条街道长度与信噪比足够，未考虑地下成像对跨街连续直线阵列的需求。
First application of planar graph and percolation theory to link urban fiber network topology with short-range on-chip DAS coverage thresholds and city-scale sensor placement optimization.
首次结合平面图论与逾渗理论量化城市短距片上DAS覆盖率阈值及传感器优化布设。

kc: Modeled urban fiber-optic and street networks as planar Gabriel graphs to evaluate distributed short-range DAS (DDAS) architectures.

Identified three distinct coverage regimes governed by a bond percolation threshold at c* ≈ 51.6%, separating sparse geophysical sensing (<10%), statistical city-wide monitoring (>51.6%), and individual tracking (~100%).
Developed and demonstrated task-specific sensor placement optimization algorithms for traffic monitoring, earthquake early warning, and urban activity tracking across major global cities.
将城市光缆与街道网络建模为平面Gabriel图，以评估分布式短距DAS（DDAS）架构的监测性能。
基于51.6%的键逾渗阈值划分了三个覆盖区间：稀疏地球物理传感（<10%）、全城统计监测（>51.6%）及个体追踪（~100%）。
针对交通监测、地震预警和城市活动追踪开发了传感器布设优化算法，并在全球多个大都市进行了验证。
me: Planar graph and Euclidean Gabriel graph modeling of urban street networks with average node degree <k> ≈ 4.
Bond percolation analysis and mean-field critical distance derivation linking street coverage ratio c to dimensionless hop distance d and physical radius r.

Combinatorial optimization for DAS placement: 0-1 greedy knapsack for traffic flow, population-weighted minimax M-th nearest sensor P-wave delay for EEW, and greedy maximum coverage for activity tracking.
利用平均节点度约为4的平面图和欧几里得Gabriel图对城市街道网络进行拓扑建模。
采用键逾渗分析与平均场临界距离推导，建立街道覆盖率c与无量纲跳数距离d及物理半径r的定量关系。
构建DAS布设组合优化算法：交通流量的0-1贪婪背包算法、地震预警的人口加权P波延迟极小化算法，以及活动监测的贪婪最大覆盖算法。
de: Telecommunication fiber availability survey across 410 geolocated addresses in Tel Aviv-Jaffa (showing 91.0% fiber coverage) and an illustrative DAS recording along Ibn Gvirol St.
Global urban street network statistics from over 8,900 cities via OpenStreetMap/OSMnx (average N ≈ 17,660 junctions, street density ρ ≈ 99.8 km^-2).
City-scale optimization simulations using OpenStreetMap road hierarchies and WorldPop density data for San Francisco, Berlin, Singapore, Mexico City, and Paris.
特拉维夫410个地理编码地址的光纤可用性调查（显示覆盖率达91.0%）及Ibn Gvirol街的DAS实测示例。
基于OpenStreetMap/OSMnx的全球8,900多个城市路网统计数据（平均约17,660个交叉口，街道密度约99.8 km^-2）。
结合OpenStreetMap道路等级和WorldPop人口密度数据，在旧金山、柏林、新加坡、墨西哥城和巴黎开展的城市级优化仿真。
li: Assumes short-range on-chip DAS interrogators can be deployed on any street up to 500 m without power or physical access constraints.
Assumes single-street recording provides sufficient array length and SNR, whereas subsurface imaging often requires longer, straight, contiguous multi-street arrays.
Relies on fragmented commercial/governmental fiber ownership where inaccurate mapping and privacy concerns may hinder collaboration.
假设短距片上DAS调制解调器可在任意街道部署（最大500米），未计入实际的电力供应和物理接入限制。
假设单条街道记录即可提供足够的阵列孔径和信噪比，而实际地下成像往往需要跨街道的更长连续直线段。
城市光纤所有权分散于不同商业运营商和政府机构，映射不准及数据隐私顾虑可能限制实际共享接入。

tm.why: The paper develops a graph theory and percolation framework for designing and optimizing city-scale short-range Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) networks.
It focuses on optimal sensor placement and array architecture for distributed short-range on-chip DAS interrogators across urban street networks.
One of the core optimization case studies is designing urban DAS networks for rapid P-wave detection in Earthquake Early Warning (EEW).

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF analyzed, including main text, methods, figures, tables, and supplementary appendices.

sum: Optimizing vapor-dominated geothermal reservoirs requires high-resolution imaging of fracture networks and fluid pathways. This study analyzes 1,276 induced micro-earthquakes (2006–2015) near the Prati-9 and Prati-29 injection wells in the northwestern Geysers, California. By applying inter-event interferometry to vertical-component waveforms on horizontal layers spaced every 100 m, the authors extract Rayleigh-wave phase velocities (0.05–0.20 s) using Aki's spectral method and fast-marching surface-wave tomography. Jointly inverting these local phase velocities with previously derived group velocities yields a quasi-3D shear-wave velocity (Vs) model resolved at ~100 × 100 × 10 m blocks. The model identifies three main low-Vs anomaly classes: (I) fault-related damage and hydrothermal alteration zones, (II) topographic transitions across the steam-cap and normal-temperature-reservoir (NTR) boundary at ~900–1,400 m depth, and (III) localized or vertically elongated patches driven by cold-water injection, thermal cracking, and buoyant fluid migration.
本研究利用2006至2015年间加州西北部盖瑟斯地热田Prati-9和Prati-29注水井附近的1,276次诱发微震，开展储层高分辨率成像。通过事件间地震干涉技术提取相距100米水平层上的经验格林函数，结合Aki谱方法与快行进面波层析成像获取0.05–0.20秒瑞利波相速度，并与前人群速度联合反演……

t: Inter-event interferometry extracts Rayleigh-wave phase dispersion (0.05–0.20 s) on 100-m depth layers via Aki's spectral method and FMST, followed by joint 1D damped least-squares inversion (surf96) with group velocities for a quasi-3D Vs model.
通过事件间干涉、Aki谱方法与FMST提取100米分层瑞利波相速度，并与群速度联合反演构建准三维Vs模型。

Vertical-component waveforms from NCEDC for 1,276 induced micro-earthquakes (Md 0.95–3.16, 2006–2015) within a 1 × 2 km² area (0.9–2.2 km depth) between injection wells Prati-9 and Prati-29 in the NW Geysers.
盖瑟斯西北部Prati-9和Prati-29注水井间1×2 km²（深0.9–2.2 km）内1,276次诱发微震的垂直…

The ~100 × 100 × 10 m quasi-3D Vs model reveals three low-Vs anomaly types: fault zones (I), steam-cap/NTR boundary undulations at 900–1,400 m depth (II), and injection-induced ellipsoidal zones extending up to 500 m laterally (III).
100×100×10米准三维Vs模型揭示三类低速异常：断层破碎带、900–1400米NTR界面起伏及横向达500米的注水…

Small-scale scattering, fluid-related anelastic attenuation biasing phase velocities, virtual-source directional sensitivity, and lack of time-lapse resolution limit the purely elastic static Vs interpretation.
小尺度散射、流体非弹性衰减偏差、虚拟震源方向敏感性及缺乏延时成像限制了静态弹性解释。
Extends inter-event interferometry to retrieve Rayleigh-wave phase velocities and jointly inverts them with group velocities to achieve 100 × 100 × 10 m Vs resolution at geothermal reservoir depths.
将事件间干涉拓展至相速度提取并与群速度联合反演，在地热储层深度实现100×100×10米高分辨率成像。

kc: Extended inter-event seismic interferometry to extract high-frequency (0.05–0.20 s) Rayleigh-wave phase velocities across 100-m spaced depth layers in The Geysers.
Constructed a fine-scale (~100 × 100 × 10 m) quasi-3D Vs model by jointly inverting local Rayleigh-wave phase and group velocity dispersion curves.
Categorized reservoir low-Vs anomalies into fault-damage zones, steam-cap/NTR boundary undulations, and ellipsoidal/vertical fluid-injection footprints up to 500 m laterally.
将事件间地震干涉扩展应用于盖瑟斯地热田，在100米间距深度层上提取了高频（0.05–0.20秒）瑞利波相速度。
通过联合反演局域瑞利波相速度与群速度频散曲线，构建了精细尺度（~100 × 100 × 10米）的准三维Vs模型。
将储层低Vs异常划分为三类：断层破碎带、蒸汽帽/NTR界面起伏，以及横向延伸达500米的椭球状/垂向注水影响区。
me: Inter-event interferometry (virtual seismometer method) cross-correlating vertical-component waveforms for event pairs within ≤1° azimuthal difference, stacked via phase-weighted stacking (PWS).
Phase-velocity dispersion measurement (0.05–0.20 s) on 100-m depth layers using Aki's spectral zero-matching method.
2D Fast Marching Surface Wave Tomography (FMST) on a 100 × 100 m horizontal grid with L-curve regularization and 3-sigma outlier rejection.
Joint 1D damped least-squares inversion (surf96) of local phase and group dispersion curves, resampled to 10-m vertical intervals to build a quasi-3D Vs model.
事件间干涉法（虚拟地震仪法）：对共同台站方位角差≤1°的事件对垂直分量波形进行互相关，并采用相位加权叠加（PWS）。
利用Aki谱零点匹配法，在100米间距深度层上测量0.05–0.20秒周期的瑞利波相速度频散曲线。
在100×100米水平网格上进行二维快行进面波层析成像（FMST），采用L曲线优选正则化参数并以3σ准则剔除异常值。
使用surf96阻尼最小二乘算法联合反演各网格点的相速度与群速度频散曲线，重采样至10米垂向间隔以构建准三维Vs模型。
de: 1,276 induced micro-earthquakes (Md 0.95–3.16) from Jan 2006 to Jun 2015 in the Prati-9 and Prati-29 cluster (1 × 2 km² lateral area, 0.9–2.2 km depth) from IS-EPOS.
Continuous vertical-component waveforms from NCEDC recorded by at least 17 stations per event, filtered for SNR ≥ 4, hypocentral uncertainty < 50 m, azimuthal gap < 75°, and RMS residual < 0.05 s.
Synthetic checkerboard resolution tests with ±0.3 km/s alternating anomalies at twice the horizontal cell size.
来自IS-EPOS平台的2006年1月至2015年6月Prati-9和Prati-29震群的1,276次诱发微震（Md 0.95–3.16，横向范围1×2 km²，深度0.9–2.2 km）。
从NCEDC获取的连续垂直分量波形，每次事件至少被17个台站记录，筛选标准为SNR ≥ 4、震源不确定性<50米、方位角空隙<75°及RMS残差<0.05秒。
合成棋盘格分辨率测试，采用两倍于水平网格尺寸、幅值为±0.3 km/s的高低速交替异常。
li: Discrepancies between phase (C) and group (U) velocity maps persist due to small-scale scattering, anelastic attenuation from fluid infiltration, and regularization trade-offs.
Apparent phase velocities may be biased by frequency-dependent attenuation rather than purely elastic structure.
The study provides a time-averaged static model over 2006–2015 and does not resolve time-lapse Vs variations across individual injection cycles.
由于小尺度散射、流体渗入引起的非弹性衰减以及正则化折衷，相速度（C）与群速度（U）层析成像结果之间仍存在差异。
视相速度可能受到频率相关衰减的偏差影响，而非完全反映纯弹性结构。
本研究仅提供2006–2015年间的静态平均模型，未能解析随单个注水周期演化的四维（延时）Vs变化。

tm.why: The study images a vapor-dominated geothermal reservoir around injection wells Prati-9 and Prati-29 using 1,276 induced micro-earthquakes.
The authors apply fast-marching surface-wave tomography to Rayleigh-wave phase velocities and jointly invert them with group velocities for a quasi-3D Vs model.
Empirical Green's functions are extracted via inter-event seismic interferometry (virtual seismometer method) by cross-correlating earthquake pairs at common stations.

ev.notes: Full 31-page article-in-press PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§4), references, and Figures 1–6 with captions.

sum: This paper proposes a theoretical model based on two self-replicating mechanisms of energy accumulation in a pointlike seismic focus to explain deviations from the standard Gutenberg-Richter (GR) law at large magnitudes. Below a critical magnitude region, energy accumulation slows down, preserving the GR probability density while reducing the exceedance distribution and potentially generating precursors ('self-arresting' earthquakes). Above the critical region, energy accumulation accelerates, reducing both exceedance and probability density without precursors ('dragon-king' earthquakes). Integrating these regimes introduces a critical magnitude parameter and reveals a ~0.43 magnitude gap separating two distinct distribution branches. Time-correlation effects are also derived, showing minimal impact on large events. The theoretical distribution is illustrated using 3,361 earthquakes (M >= 3) from the 1981-2018 Vrancea, Romania catalog, which exhibits two branches around M 5.5.
本文提出震源能量积累的两种自复制机制理论模型，以解释大震偏离标准古登堡-里克特（GR）定律的现象。在临界震级区以下，能量积累减缓，降低超越概率但保持GR概率密度不变，并可能产生前震（对应“自停止”地震）；在临界区以上，能量积累加速，同时降低超越概率和概率密度且无前震（对应“龙王”地震）。结合两种机制……

t: Applies an infinite series self-replication procedure to the focal energy accumulation law around a critical energy threshold, deriving two analytical branches for earthquake magnitude exceedance and probability density below and above a critical magnitude.
对临界能量附近的震源能量积累应用无穷级数自复制过程，推导出临界震级上下两个分支的超越概率和概率密度解析式。
Uses 3,361 earthquakes with moment magnitude M >= 3 (bin width 0.1) from the 1981-2018 Romanian Earthquake Catalog in the Vrancea seismic region (lat. 45-46 deg, long. 26-27 deg).
使用1981-2018年罗马尼亚Vrancea地震目录中3361个震级M≥3（步长0.1）的地震数据。

Finds a crossover magnitude range of ~0.43 around the critical magnitude where exceedance frequency splits into two branches; for M >= Mc, exceedance frequency is reduced by a factor of ~0.58 and probability density by ~0.79.
发现在临界震级附近存在约0.43的过渡震级间隙，在M≥Mc区域超越频率降低至约0.58倍，概率密度降低至约0.79倍。

The model does not specify why or under what physical conditions the two self-replicating energy accumulation mechanisms operate, and requires cutting off unphysical singularities near the critical energy.
无法解释两种自复制机制发生的物理原因和条件，且需人为截断临界点附近的非物理奇点。

Introduces two self-replication energy accumulation mechanisms and a critical magnitude parameter that unify 'self-arresting' and 'dragon-king' earthquakes into a two-branch Gutenberg-Richter exceedance law with a magnitude gap.
引入两种能量自复制机制和临界震级参数，将“自停止”和“龙王”地震统一到含震级间隙的双分支G-R分布中。

kc: Formulates two self-replicating energy accumulation mechanisms (slowed-down vs. accelerated) in a seismic focus around a critical energy/magnitude threshold.
Derives modified Gutenberg-Richter exceedance and probability density functions that provide a mathematical basis for 'self-arresting' and 'dragon-king' earthquakes.
Identifies a theoretical crossover magnitude gap of approximately 0.43 around the critical magnitude Mc where probability density drops to zero.
Demonstrates the two-branch magnitude distribution empirically using the 1981-2018 Vrancea (Romania) earthquake catalog.
提出了临界能量/震级阈值附近震源能量积累的两种自复制机制（减缓与加速）。
推导了修正的G-R超越概率和概率密度函数，为“自停止”和“龙王”地震提供了数学物理基础。
发现在临界震级Mc附近存在约0.43的理论震级过渡间隙，该处概率密度为零。
利用1981-2018年罗马尼亚Vrancea地震目录实证展示了震级分布的两个独立分支。
me: Analytical derivation of energy accumulation time series using geometric self-replication (Euler transform) around a critical energy Ec.
Derivation of modified exceedance frequencies and magnitude probability densities for both independent and time-correlated earthquakes.
Empirical parameter fitting of the modified Gutenberg-Richter distribution to regional earthquake catalog data.
利用几何级数自复制过程（欧拉变换）解析推导临界能量Ec附近的能量积累时间。
推导独立地震和时间相关地震的修正超越频率及震级概率密度函数。
将修正的古登堡-里克特分布对区域地震目录数据进行经验参数拟合。
de: Romanian Earthquake Catalog (1981-2018) for the Vrancea region (lat. 45-46 deg, long. 26-27 deg), comprising 3,361 earthquakes with moment magnitude M >= 3 (bin size 0.1).
罗马尼亚Vrancea地区（北纬45-46度，东经26-27度）1981-2018年地震目录，包含3361个震级M≥3的地震（震级间隔0.1）。
li: The theoretical model cannot explain the physical conditions or underlying reasons that trigger either the slowed-down or accelerated self-replicating mechanism.
The analytical expressions exhibit unphysical singularities right at the critical energy threshold, requiring an ad-hoc crossover cutoff.
理论模型无法解释触发减缓或加速自复制机制的具体物理条件与底层原因。
解析表达式在临界能量阈值附近存在非物理奇点，需要人为定义过渡截断区间。

tm.why: Analyzes earthquake magnitude frequency distributions, catalog completeness deviations, and empirical fitting using the Romanian earthquake catalog.
Models the physical mechanisms of energy accumulation in a seismic focus leading to self-arresting and dragon-king earthquakes.
Investigates exceedance probabilities and recurrence intervals of very large earthquakes, which directly impact statistical seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 12-page arXiv PDF text and figures.

sum: Based on aphanitic fault-filling rocks ('flinty crush rock', FCR) in calderas, previous 'super-fault' models inferred extremely rapid caldera collapse rates sufficient to cause frictional melting. This study re-examines the classic Glencoe caldera ring-fault in Scotland using optical/SEM petrography, EDS chemical mapping, and geochemical mass balance calculations. The authors show that FCR chemistry and textures are consistent with an extracted melt from a dioritic magma mush (represented by late-stage fault-intrusions) mixed with 30–70% brecciated quartzite wall rock, rather than frictionally melted country rock. They propose a dilation-sintering model where fragmental magma ascends through dilational ring-fault conduits, capturing and sintering fine pyroclasts along conduit walls before late-stage mush plugs the system. This novel reinterpretation removes the requirement for catastrophic frictional melting and suggests caldera faults can remain active throughout sustained, incremental eruptions.
以往“超级断层”模型根据破火山口隐晶质断层填充岩（燧石破碎岩，FCR）推断破火山口塌陷滑移极快并引发摩擦熔融。本研究结合光学/扫描电镜岩相学、能谱分析及地球化学质量平衡计算，重新检验了苏格兰经典格伦科（Glencoe）破火山口环状断层。结果表明，FCR成分与结构符合从闪长质岩浆晶粥（对应晚期断层侵入……

t: Combined optical petrography, SEM-BSE micro-imaging, and EDS spectral chemical mapping of Glencoe ring-fault rocks with two-component geochemical mass-balance mixing calculations comparing FCR matrix, quartzite wall rock, and crystal-rich fault-intrusions.
结合光学岩相学、扫描电镜背散射成像、EDS化学面扫描及双端元地球化学质量平衡混合计算。

Field observations and rock samples across the Glencoe caldera ring-fault (~3.5 km paleo-depth) at Stob Mhic Mhartuin and An-t-Sròn, supplemented by compiled XRF, EDS, and microprobe geochemical analyses.
格伦科破火山口环状断层（古深度约3.5 km）两个露头的岩石样本，以及汇编的主量元素地球化学数据。

Adding 30–40% quartzite to mean FCR matrix reproduces bulk FCR composition, 30–70% reproduces contact breccias, and up to 70 wt.% interstitial melt extraction from diorite fault-intrusions explains the FCR matrix.
FCR基质混入30–70%石英岩可重现全岩及角砾岩成分，闪长质侵入体提取最多70 wt.%熔体可解释FCR基质。

Sintering and mush mobilization overprint primary textures, leaving no direct textural record of pyroclast welding or melt extraction; alkali mobility also compromises haplogranite phase equilibrium projections.
烧结与晶粥活化抹除了原始碎屑与熔体提取的直接结构证据，且碱金属活动性影响相平衡投图。

Demonstrates that Glencoe's classic 'pseudotachylyte' ring-fault rock is a sintered pyroclastic conduit fill rather than a frictional melt, challenging the catastrophic 'super-fault' caldera collapse paradigm.
证实格伦科经典环状断层隐晶质岩为烧结火山碎屑通道填充物而非摩擦熔融岩，挑战了“超级断层”灾变塌陷模型。

kc: Reinterprets the classic 'flinty crush rock' (FCR) at Glencoe caldera as a sintered volcanic tuffisite lining an eruptive ring-fault conduit rather than a frictional melt (pseudotachylyte).
Demonstrates via geochemical mass balance that FCR and wall-rock breccias reflect 30–70% mechanical mingling of quartzite with melt extracted (up to 70 wt.%) from dioritic fault-intrusion mush.

Proposes a four-stage 'dilation-sintering model' connecting dilational ring-fault opening, pyroclastic venting and wall-sintering, mush bleb entrainment (porphyritic rhyolite), and terminal mush plugging.
将格伦科破火山口经典的“燧石破碎岩”（FCR）重新解释为喷发环状断层通道壁上的烧结凝灰岩脉（tuffisite），而非摩擦熔融形成的假玄武玻璃。
通过地球化学质量平衡证明，FCR与围岩角砾岩反映了30–70%的石英岩与从闪长质断层侵入体晶粥中提取（最高达70 wt.%）的熔体之间的机械混合。
提出了四阶段“张裂-烧结模型”，将张性环状断层开启、火山碎屑喷发与管壁烧结、晶粥团块卷入（斑状流纹岩）以及最终晶粥堵塞过程联系起来。
me: Field mapping and lithological sampling across ring-fault exposures at Stob Mhic Mhartuin and An-t-Sròn in Glencoe, Scotland.
Optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) back-scattered electron (BSE) imaging, and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) chemical mapping.
Geochemical mass balance mixing calculations and haplogranite ternary phase stability projections.
在苏格兰格伦科Stob Mhic Mhartuin和An-t-Sròn环状断层露头开展野外填图与岩石采样。
光学显微镜观察、扫描电镜（SEM）背散射电子（BSE）成像及X射线能谱（EDS）化学元素面扫描分析。
地球化学质量平衡混合计算与花岗岩三元相平衡稳定性投图分析。
de: Hand samples and thin sections of basement quartzite, brecciated quartzite, flinty crush rock (FCR), porphyritic rhyolite (PR), and dioritic fault-intrusions from Glencoe (~3.5 km paleo-depth).
Major element geochemical datasets (XRF, EDS, electron microprobe) compiled from Garnham (1988) and Hickman and Wright (1983).
采集自格伦科（古深度约3.5 km）基底石英岩、角砾状石英岩、燧石破碎岩（FCR）、斑状流纹岩（PR）及闪长质断层侵入体的手标本与薄片。
汇编自Garnham (1988)和Hickman and Wright (1983)的主量元素地球化学数据集（XRF、EDS、电子探针）。
li: Sintering inherently overprints primary particulate textures, and late-stage mush mobilization overprints melt extraction textures, leaving no direct textural proof of sintering or cumulate extraction.
Poor outcrop exposure and erosion of >1 km of syn-caldera volcanic cover at Glencoe limit constraints on total fault displacement and sequence of activity.
Alkali element mobility likely affected haplogranite ternary phase equilibrium projections, preventing reliance on thermodynamic disequilibrium as primary evidence.
烧结过程本身会抹除原始碎屑结构，且晚期晶粥活化会改造熔体提取结构，导致缺乏烧结或堆晶提取的直接结构证据。
格伦科露头出露有限且超过1 km的同破火山口火山盖层已被剥蚀，限制了对断层总位移量和活动序列的约束。
碱金属元素的活动性可能影响了花岗岩三元相平衡投图，因此无法将热力学不平衡作为主要证据。

tm.why: The paper investigates the dynamics of caldera-forming volcanic eruptions, ring-fault conduits, and magma fragmentation/sintering at Glencoe caldera.
It re-evaluates the 'super-fault' frictional melting hypothesis (pseudotachylyte formation) along caldera ring-faults, proposing instead slower, incremental dilational slip and pyroclast sintering.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF examined, including abstract, main text (§1–§7), and all 5 figures.

sum: This study evaluates four hypotheses regarding spatiotemporal Gutenberg-Richter b-value variations around large earthquakes using 62 independent M≥6 sequences from the JMA catalog (2000–2025). Using the b-positive estimator to mitigate short-term aftershock incompleteness and the b-significant method for hypothesis testing, the authors find that b-values vary significantly more in space and time than expected at random (H1). However, paired t-tests reveal no systematic pre-mainshock b-value decrease (H2) nor post-mainshock increase (H3). Large earthquakes preferentially localize in regions with slightly lower b-values (Δb = 0.05) compared to their surroundings (H4), though this difference is small (<6%) relative to inter-sequence variability (0.5–1.2). Furthermore, a 3D Voronoi b-value map generated from non-overlapping background seismicity accurately recovers sequence b-values (slope 1.05). Extensive robustness tests across 324 parameter combinations confirm that b-values are primarily location-controlled by crustal properties and stress regime rather than transient mainshock effects.
本研究利用2000–2025年日本气象厅目录中62个独立的M≥6地震序列，结合b-positive估计器与b-significant检验方法，评估了大地震序列b值时空变化的四个假设。结果显示，b值在空间和时间上的变化显著高于随机预期（H1），但在主震前并未出现系统性下降（H2），主震后也未显著上升（……

t: Applies the b-positive estimator and b-significant hypothesis testing alongside paired one-sided t-tests on 62 isolated M≥6 earthquake sequences to evaluate spatiotemporal b-value variations without short-term aftershock incompleteness bias.
对62个独立M≥6地震序列应用b-positive估计器、b-significant检验及配对单侧t检验，评估时空b值变…
Uses the JMA earthquake catalog from January 2000 to July 2025 (depth ≤ 150 km, coastal distance ≤ 40 km, Mc = 0.7), comprising 1,757,289 events and 62 independent M≥6 sequences.
使用2000–2025年JMA目录（深度≤150 km，离岸≤40 km，Mc=0.7），共175.7万事件和62个序列…
Finds no pre-mainshock b-value drop (p = 0.56) or post-mainshock increase (p = 0.59), but confirms lower b-values within half a rupture length (Δb = 0.05, p = 0.00) and strong spatial control.
未发现震前b值下降（p=0.56）或震后上升（p=0.59），但近场b值略低（Δb=0.05，p=0.00）且受空间控制…

Spherically symmetric sequence definitions ignore fault geometry, and only 11 of 62 sequences have enough near-source (< L(Mi)/2) pre- and post-mainshock seismicity to resolve localized temporal changes.
球对称序列定义忽略了断层几何，且仅11个序列有足够近场数据检验局部时间变化。
Demonstrates across 324 parameter combinations and an independent 3D spatial catalog map that sequence b-values are governed by mainshock location rather than temporal mainshock stress perturbations.
通过324种参数测试与独立背景地震3D成图，证实序列b值取决于主震位置而非时间演化。

kc: Statistically tests four prominent hypotheses on spatiotemporal b-value variations across 62 independent M≥6 earthquake sequences in Japan using the b-positive and b-significant methods.

Demonstrates no statistically significant evidence for pre-mainshock b-value drops (p = 0.56) or post-mainshock b-value increases (p = 0.59), challenging temporal traffic-light forecasting assumptions.

Shows that mainshocks occur in regions with slightly lower b-values than their surroundings (Δb = 0.05, p = 0.00), while independent 3D spatial mapping confirms b-values are predominantly location-controlled across 324 parameter combinations.
使用b-positive和b-significant方法，对日本62个独立M≥6地震序列的四个b值时空变化假设进行了严格的统计检验。
证明主震前b值下降（p = 0.56）和主震后b值上升（p = 0.59）均无显著统计证据，对基于时间演化b值的红绿灯地震预测系统提出了质疑。
表明大地震发生区域的b值略低于周边（Δb = 0.05, p = 0.00），并通过独立数据集的3D空间成图及324组参数测试证实b值主要由空间位置决定。
me: Sequence separation isolating 62 independent M≥6 earthquake sequences within twice the Wells & Coppersmith rupture length and 10 years prior to 100 days post-mainshock.
Estimation of completeness magnitude via maximum curvature (+0.2 correction) and b-value calculation via the b-positive estimator excluding the first 1–2 days of aftershocks to mitigate STAI.
Statistical hypothesis testing using the b-significant method, paired one-sided Student's t-tests on transformed b-values, changepoint analysis, and 3D random Voronoi tessellation mapping.
序列分离方法：在两倍破裂长度及震前10年至震后100天窗口内提取62个相互独立的M≥6地震序列。
采用最大曲率法（+0.2校正）估算完备震级，结合b-positive方法并剔除震后前1–2天余震以消除短期余震不完备性（STAI）偏差。
利用b-significant方法、转换b值的配对单侧t检验、变点分析以及3D随机Voronoi剖分法进行统计假设检验与空间成图。
de: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) earthquake catalog from January 2000 to July 2025, filtered to depth ≤ 150 km, distance to coast ≤ 40 km, and Mc = 0.7 (1,757,289 total events).
62 filtered independent M≥6 sequences out of 97 initial sequences after removing overlapping events (such as the 2011 M9 Tohoku-Oki sequence).

Robustness experiment spanning 324 distinct sequence definitions varying coastal distance, depth threshold, 2D/3D distance, mainshock magnitude threshold, post-event duration, and rupture length scaling.
2000年1月至2025年7月的日本气象厅（JMA）地震目录，筛选深度≤150 km、距海岸≤40 km、完备震级Mc=0.7，共包含1,757,289个事件。
剔除受其他大震（如2011年Tohoku-Oki M9地震）重叠影响的事件后，从97个M≥6序列中筛选出62个独立序列。
涵盖324种参数组合的稳健性实验，测试海岸距离、深度阈值、2D/3D维度、主震震级阈值、震后天数和破裂长度经验关系的影响。
li: Isotropic spherical sequence definition ignores specific fault plane geometry and sophisticated declustering, potentially masking highly localized changes within a few kilometers of the fault.
Small sample sizes near the mainshock (< L(M)/2) limit statistical power, leaving only 11 of 62 sequences with sufficient pre- and post-mainshock data in the immediate vicinity.
采用各向同性球对称窗口定义序列，未考虑具体断层几何形态和精细去丛集，可能掩盖断层周边几公里内的高度局部化变化。

sum: This paper presents a hybrid-grid finite-difference strategy to balance accuracy and efficiency in seismic wave modeling with irregular topography. Near the free surface, the highly accurate but computationally expensive Fully Staggered Grid (FSG/Lebedev) scheme is applied in curvilinear coordinates to model surface waves. In deeper regions, the standard staggered-grid (SSG) scheme is used to save costs. An overset grid strategy ensures smooth wavefield transitions between the two grids, reducing computation time by nearly 50% while eliminating source injection errors.

sum: This study presents a collaborative inversion framework that integrates vertical gravity gradient (VGG) anomalies from the SWOT satellite with multibeam echo sounder (MBES) data to accurately model asymmetric seamount morphology. By combining OpenCV image analysis, fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering, and a radially asymmetric function, the authors automatically extract edge contours and estimate geometric parameters. They construct a global dataset of 3,838 seamounts (1,487 constrained by MBES and 2,351 remodeled). The results reveal significant morphological heterogeneity, with heights ranging from 121.8 to 4199.0 m and a high ratio of semi-major to semi-minor axis standard deviation (5.6 km vs 1.7 km), indicating strongly non-axisymmetric development under tectonic forcing. This dataset improves global seafloor topography representation for geodynamic and oceanographic studies.

sum: This study analyzes the six-component (6C) seismic response of a densely instrumented 50-story skyscraper in Kunming, China, during the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay, Myanmar earthquake. Despite small peak interstory drifts, the building exhibited a long-duration (24 min) vibration with prominent beating. The authors demonstrate for the first time that beating can be directly caused by the input ground motion. Specifically, the transverse beating resulted from the coupling of the building's fundamental transverse mode (0.267 Hz) with narrowband surface-wave energy in the ground motion (0.235 Hz). Meanwhile, torsional beating was caused by the coupling of the fundamental torsional (0.353 Hz) and longitudinal (0.377 Hz) modal responses. This highlights how distant earthquakes can generate prolonged, fatigue-inducing structural vibrations.

sum: The authors propose the Layered-Integrated Density Inversion Method (LID) to address non-uniqueness, noise sensitivity, and inter-layer crosstalk in 3D gravity gradient inversion. LID first performs a layered inversion using wavelet decomposition, then uses this integrated result as the initial model for a simulated annealing inversion. Synthetic tests show that LID reduces the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) by over 50% compared to traditional wavelet-based methods, even under noisy conditions. Applying LID to SWOT satellite vertical gravity gradient data in the South China Sea (SCS) successfully imaged seafloor spreading traces, subduction-related fractures, and a potential Paleo-Pacific plate remnant southeast of Palawan, providing independent evidence for regional rift dynamics and crustal evolution.

sum: This paper introduces a nonparametric statistical method to improve ambient-noise horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) analysis. Traditionally, HVSR curves are represented by the lognormal median of window-wise ratios, which can bias results when distributions are skewed or multimodal. The authors propose using kernel density estimation (KDE) to estimate the probability density of log-amplitudes, transforming it to linear space, and taking the linear-domain mode as the representative curve. Uncertainty is quantified using highest-density intervals (HDIs). Tested on microtremor data, the KDE-mode method successfully tracks lognormal modes in simple cases and resolves complex multimodal and directional branches without requiring strict window rejection.

sum: This study investigates four recurring slow slip events (SSEs; 2011, 2013–2014, 2018, and 2024) offshore the Boso Peninsula, Japan, using 5-minute high-rate GNSS data from 40 GEONET stations. To overcome temporal smoothing artifacts in standard state-space filters, the authors combine sparse modular regression change-point analysis with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo Bayesian slip inversion using a sparsity-inducing horseshoe prior. Despite quasi-periodic recurrence in the same region with Mw 6.4–6.6, the four SSEs exhibit striking diversity: the 2011 event nucleated shallowly near land with an abrupt onset and gradual end; the 2013–2014 and 2024 events initiated deeper offshore with symmetric temporal profiles; and the 2018 event propagated up-dip from deep to shallow regions with a gradual onset and sharp termination. This diversity indicates along-dip frictional heterogeneity at ~10 km scales and demonstrates that slow slip persists beyond periods detected by single-station change points.
