t: Applies modular regression change-point analysis with a Laplace prior to 5-minute GNSS series, followed by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo Bayesian slip inversion using a sparsity-inducing horseshoe prior without explicit spatial smoothing.
对5分钟GNSS序列进行拉普拉斯先验分段回归变点分析，并采用无平滑约束的马蹄形先验哈密顿蒙特卡洛贝叶斯反演估算断层滑移。

Uses 5-minute Precise Point Positioning (PPP) horizontal GNSS time series from 40 GEONET stations around the Boso Peninsula for the 2011, 2013–2014, 2018, and 2024 SSEs, plus JMA earthquake catalog data (MJMA >= 2.0).
使用房总半岛40个GEONET台站在2011、2013–2014、2018和2024年事件期间的5分钟PPP水平GNSS…

Estimated Mw is 6.5, 6.4, 6.6, and 6.5 for the four SSEs. The 2011 SSE was shallow with fast-start–slow-end; 2018 propagated up-dip with slow-start–fast-end; 2013–2014 and 2024 occurred deeper offshore with symmetric evolution.
四次事件震级为Mw 6.4–6.6；2011年浅部成核、快起慢止，2018年由深向浅传播、慢起快止，2013–2014和…
GNSS stations are restricted to land northwest of the source area, causing uneven offshore spatial resolution, and change-point durations (5–12 days) underestimate moment-rate durations (12–19 days).
GNSS台站仅分布于西北侧陆地，近海空间分辨率不均；变点分析持续时间（5–12天）低于矩率持续时间（12–19天）。

Replaces temporally smoothing Kalman filtering on daily GNSS with sparse change-point analysis and horseshoe-prior HMC inversion on 5-minute GNSS, newly resolving SSE onset/termination asymmetries and along-dip segmentation.
以5分钟高频GNSS稀疏变点分析与马蹄形先验HMC反演替代传统日解卡尔曼滤波，首次精细解析了慢滑移起止不对称性与倾向分段…

kc: Resolved sub-daily onset, growth, and termination asymmetries of four Boso SSEs (2011–2024) using 5-minute PPP GNSS solutions and sparse change-point analysis.
Applied hierarchical Bayesian slip inversion with a horseshoe prior and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (NUTS) without explicit spatial smoothing constraints.
Demonstrated distinct along-dip slip partitioning and contrasting temporal profiles (fast-start vs. fast-end vs. symmetric) among nominally repeating SSEs, indicating ~10 km frictional heterogeneity.
利用5分钟PPP GNSS解算数据与稀疏变点分析，解析了2011–2024年四次房总慢滑移事件的起止不对称性与生长阶段。
采用带马蹄形先验的层级贝叶斯滑移反演与哈密顿蒙特卡洛（NUTS）采样，无需显式空间平滑约束即可实现局部滑移成像。
揭示了名义上重复的慢滑移事件在倾向滑移分布和时间演化模式上的显著差异，表明俯冲界面存在约10公里尺度的摩擦非均质性。
me: Sparse change-point analysis using modular piecewise linear regression with a Laplace prior on normalized 5-minute horizontal GNSS time series.
Hierarchical Bayesian fault slip inversion on an 8×8 subfault mesh (~10 km patches) along the Philippine Sea Plate interface using a horseshoe prior.
Posterior sampling via the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm, alongside synthetic checkerboard/patch sensitivity tests.
基于拉普拉斯先验的模块化分段线性回归稀疏变点分析，用于提取归一化5分钟水平GNSS时间序列的趋势转折点。
在菲律宾海板块俯冲界面8×8子断层网格（约10 km尺度）上，采用马蹄形稀疏先验进行层级贝叶斯断层滑移反演。
利用自适应哈密顿蒙特卡洛（NUTS）算法进行后验采样，并结合合成斑块敏感性测试评估陆基台网的分辨率。
de: 5-minute Precise Point Positioning (PPP) horizontal GNSS time series from 40 GEONET stations around the Boso Peninsula provided by the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory.
JMA unified earthquake hypocenter catalog (MJMA >= 2.0, depth < 40 km) concurrent with the 2011, 2013–2014, and 2018 SSEs.
Synthetic resolution tests for along-dip and offshore slip patches.
内华达大地测量实验室（NGL）提供的房总半岛周边40个GEONET台站的5分钟精密单点定位（PPP）水平GNSS时间序列。
日本气象厅（JMA）在2011、2013–2014和2018年慢滑移事件期间的地震目录（MJMA >= 2.0，深度 < 40 km）。
针对倾向和近海滑移斑块的合成数据分辨率测试。
li: Land-based GNSS stations lie entirely to the northwest of the offshore source region, causing uneven spatial resolution that degrades with distance offshore.

Single-station change-point analysis underestimates total SSE durations (5–12 days) compared to network-wide moment rate functions (12–19 days) because low-level slip falls below the detection threshold.
陆基GNSS台站集中分布在震源区西北侧陆地上，导致近海滑移分布的空间分辨率不均匀且随离岸距离增加而降低。
与全网矩率函数（12–19天）相比，单台变点分析低估了事件总持续时间（5–12天），因为低于检测阈值的缓慢滑移可能持续更长时间。

tm.why: The paper investigates the onset, growth, termination, and along-dip variability of four recurring slow slip events (SSEs) offshore the Boso Peninsula, Japan.
Fault slip evolution and its uncertainty are estimated through hierarchical Bayesian inversion using a horseshoe prior and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF analyzed, including equations, methodology, synthetic resolution discussion, and all 11 figures.

sum: Temporary broadband seismic stations in India's Deccan Volcanic Province (DVP) are typically installed in surface vaults on basalt outcrops due to rocky terrain and monsoon flooding risks. This study evaluates a low-cost, shallow (~1 m deep) underground vault built using an inverted 1000-litre plastic water tank at IISER Pune (station ISRP). Using ObsPy probabilistic power spectral densities (PPSD) and regional/teleseismic earthquake waveforms, the authors compare ISRP against a co-located surface vault 40 m away (ANX) and a 9-station rural surface-vault array (the Mahabaleshwar profile). While the rural array meets international noise standards, the urban underground vault (ISRP) achieves the lowest long-period (>10 s) horizontal noise across all stations, outperforming ANX by up to 17 dB between 30–100 s by mitigating pressure-induced tilt noise. This demonstrates a practical, inexpensive field installation improvement that significantly enhances long-period horizontal earthquake recordings.
受硬岩地形和季风洪涝限制，印度德干火山省（DVP）的流动宽频带地震台通常采用地表台基安装。本研究评估了一种利用1000升塑料水箱构建的低成本浅层（约1米深）地下窖井安装方案（ISRP台）。通过计算概率功率谱密度（PPSD）并对比区域及远震波形，作者将该地下台与相距40米的地表台（ANX）以及由9个乡……

t: The authors apply the ObsPy-PPSD algorithm (McNamara and Buland, 2004) to continuous three-component waveforms using 1-hour segments with 50% overlap to statistically characterize ambient noise PSD-PDFs and compare median spectra.
采用ObsPy-PPSD算法（1小时窗长，50%重叠）计算连续三分量波形的概率功率谱密度，统计对比台站背景噪声中值谱及地…

Data come from two co-located urban stations at IISER Pune (shallow ~1 m underground vault ISRP and surface vault ANX) and a 9-station rural surface-vault array (Mahabaleshwar profile), all using Trillium Compact 120s sensors.
包含浦那校园同址地下台ISRP（1米深）与地表台ANX逾两个月记录，以及9个乡村地表台组成的Mahabaleshwar测…

The underground vault (ISRP) achieves the lowest long-period (>8 s) horizontal noise among all stations, reducing noise by up to 17 dB compared to the surface vault (ANX), with peak reduction between 30 and 100 s.
ISRP地下台在长周期（>8 s）水平向噪声最低，相比同址地表台ANX降低达17 dB（30–100 s最显著），显著改…
Shallow burial alone fails to mitigate high-frequency (>1 Hz) urban cultural noise, and whether groundwater can breach the vault's open bottom during a full monsoon season remains untested.
1米浅埋难以抑制高频（>1 Hz）城市人文噪声，且水箱窖井开放底部能否抵御整个印度季风季的地下水渗漏仍有待检验。
First trial and quantitative benchmarking of a low-cost plastic water-tank underground seismic vault against traditional surface vaults in the hard-rock Deccan Volcanic Province.
首次在德干火山省硬岩区设计并量化评估了基于塑料水箱的低成本浅层地下地震窖井方案相对于传统地表台基的性能提升。

kc: Designed and tested a low-cost, ~1 m shallow underground seismic vault in the Deccan Volcanic Province using a 1000-litre plastic water tank.
Quantified a long-period (>8–10 s) horizontal noise reduction of up to 17 dB in the shallow vault compared to a co-located surface vault and a 9-station rural array.
Presented a data quality report for the 9-station Mahabaleshwar broadband profile deployed across the Western Ghats during 2024–2026.
在德干火山省设计并测试了一种使用1000升塑料水箱的低成本浅层（约1米深）地下地震计窖井安装方案。
量化了浅层地下窖井相比同址地表台及9台乡村台阵在长周期（>8–10 s）水平向高达17 dB的降噪效果。
提供了2024–2026年间横跨西高止山脉布设的9台Mahabaleshwar宽频带地震测线的数据质量报告。
me: Constructed a ~1 m deep underground vault using an excavated pit, concrete base, plastic bucket, and 1000-litre water tank shell.
Computed Probabilistic Power Spectral Densities (PPSD) using ObsPy on continuous 3-component records parsed into 1-hour segments with 50% overlap.
Compared time-domain filtered waveforms (10–50 s and 50–150 s bands) for four regional and teleseismic earthquakes across co-located surface and underground sensors.
通过开挖基坑、浇筑混凝土底座并嵌套塑料桶与1000升水箱外壳，构建了约1米深的地下地震计窖井。
利用ObsPy对连续三分量记录（1小时窗长，50%重叠）计算概率功率谱密度（PPSD）。
在10–50 s和50–150 s周期带内，对比了同址地表台和地下台记录的4个区域及远震事件波形。
de: Over two months of continuous broadband data (Julian days 101–168, 2026) from co-located campus stations ISRP (underground vault) and ANX (surface vault) at IISER Pune.
Continuous waveform data from the 9-station East-West trending Mahabaleshwar profile deployed in two phases during 2024–2026 across rural Maharashtra.
All stations equipped identically with Nanometrics Trillium Compact 120s seismometers and Centaur digitizers.
印度科学教育与研究所（IISER Pune）校园内相距40米的ISRP（地下台）和ANX（地表台）超过两个月的连续宽频带记录（2026年第101–168儒略日）。
2024–2026年间分两期在马哈拉施特拉邦乡村地区布设的9台东西向Mahabaleshwar线性测线连续波形数据。
所有台站均统一配备Nanometrics Trillium Compact 120s地震计和Centaur数据采集器。
li: Shallow burial (~1 m) provides limited improvement at short periods (<1 s or >1 Hz) and cannot mitigate high-frequency urban cultural noise.
Resistance to water breaching from the open bottom of the tank vault during a full Indian monsoon season remains unproven at the time of writing.
One station (MDG) in the Mahabaleshwar profile exhibited anomalous long-period noise above the NHNM due to a suspected digitizer malfunction.
浅层掩埋（约1米）在短周期（<1 s或>1 Hz）改善有限，无法有效抑制城市高频人文噪声。
水箱窖井底部开放结构在整个印度季风季期间是否会发生地下水渗漏仍有待完整雨季的检验。
Mahabaleshwar测线中的MDG台站疑似因采集器故障，其长周期中值噪声高于全球高噪声模型（NHNM）。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the field installation design and noise performance of broadband seismometers in surface versus shallow underground vaults, as well as a 9-station temporary seismic array.
The study serves as a data report for the 9-station Mahabaleshwar broadband array deployed in the Deccan Volcanic Province to image the crust and lithospheric mantle.

sum: Acquiring dense seismic data in urban areas to characterize the shallow subsurface (upper 30 m) is often hindered by logistical barriers to deploying traditional active sources and geophones. This study demonstrates a novel opportunistic approach using footsteps recorded by distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) at Sandia National Laboratories' FACT site. Using 53 footsteps along a 50-m path parallel to a 142-m fiber-optic cable, the authors extract surface wave dispersion curves via Multi-channel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) and invert them using an evolutionary algorithm to construct a 2-D shear-wave velocity (Vs) profile. They also perform common depth point (CDP) reflection stacking. The results resolve subsurface structure down to ~25 m, yielding a Vs30 of 335±16 m/s and a coherent reflector at ~18 m depth, closely matching ground-truth active-source (accelerated weight drop) models and 2-D finite-difference synthetics.
城市浅地表（上30米）密集地震数据采集常受限于传统震源和检波器布设困难。本研究利用分布式声学传感（DAS）记录的53个行进脚步声作为机会震源，通过多道面波分析（MASW）提取频散曲线，并采用进化算法反演构建了二维横波速度（Vs）剖面，同时进行了共深度点（CDP）反射叠加成像。结果显示该方法能有效分辨……

t: Extract dispersion curves from 40-channel footstep DAS gathers via MASW, invert for 1-D Vs models using an evolutionary algorithm, stitch into a 2-D profile, and perform NMO-corrected CDP reflection stacking.
利用MASW从脚步声DAS道集提取频散曲线，经进化算法反演Vs剖面，并进行CDP反射叠加。
53 footsteps along a 50-m path and 3 accelerated weight drop shots recorded by a 142-m armored fiber-optic cable (1000 Hz, 3 m gauge, 0.25 m spacing) at Sandia's FACT site.
桑迪亚FACT场地142米铠装光缆（采样率1000Hz，道间距0.25米）记录的53个脚步声和3炮落重数据。
Resolved 2-D Vs down to ~25 m (300 to 450 m/s), estimated Vs30 at 335±16 m/s (within ~10% of 372±9 m/s ground truth), and imaged a coherent reflector at ~0.1 s TWTT (~18 m depth).
解析了25米以浅Vs结构，估算Vs30为335±16 m/s，并在约18米深处成像出连续反射界面。
Footstep sources lack low-frequency (<10 Hz) energy and attenuate below ~0.2 s TWTT, limiting imaging depth to ~25 m and underestimating Vs compared to weight-drop sources.
脚步声缺乏10Hz以下低频能量，双程走时0.2秒以下信号微弱，穿透深度受限于约25米。
First demonstration of combining MASW dispersion inversion and high-fold CDP reflection imaging using individual footsteps recorded by DAS to resolve shallow subsurface structure and Vs30.
首次利用DAS记录的单个脚步声同时实现MASW速度反演、Vs30估算及高覆盖次数CDP反射成像。

kc: Demonstrated that opportunistic footsteps recorded by DAS can generate reliable 2-D shear wave velocity (Vs) profiles down to ~25 m depth via MASW and evolutionary algorithm inversion.

Produced coherent shallow common depth point (CDP) reflection profiles (up to 42-fold) using footstep-DAS gathers, identifying a clear soil horizon reflector at ~0.1 s two-way travel time (~18 m depth).

Validated the footstep-DAS Vs model, Vs30 estimates (335±16 m/s), and reflection images against legacy 3-D accelerated weight drop (AWD) geophone tomography, contemporary AWD-DAS shots, and 2-D finite-difference acoustic synthetics.
证明了利用DAS记录的机会性脚步声，通过MASW和进化算法反演，能够生成可靠的25米以浅二维横波速度（Vs）剖面。
利用脚步声-DAS道集生成了高相干性的浅层共深度点（CDP）反射剖面（最高42次覆盖），在双程走时约0.1秒（约18米深）处识别出清晰的土层反射界面。
将脚步声-DAS反演的Vs模型、Vs30估算值（335±16 m/s）及反射图像与已有的三维加速落重（AWD）检波器层析模型、同期的AWD-DAS记录以及二维有限差分声波合成记录进行了对比验证。
me: Multi-channel analysis of surface waves (MASW) to extract frequency-velocity dispersion curves from 40-channel footstep DAS gathers.

Stochastic 1-D isotropic layered shear-wave velocity inversion using an evolutionary algorithm (1000 iterations, 10,000 models evaluated per footstep) stitched via Gaussian smoothing into a 2-D profile.
Common depth point (CDP) sorting, normal moveout (NMO) correction, and stacking (up to 42-fold) of footstep-DAS traces for shallow reflection profiling.
2-D finite-difference acoustic wave equation forward modeling (100 Hz first-derivative Gaussian source) to generate synthetic reflection profiles for consistency validation.
利用多道面波分析（MASW）从包含40个通道的脚步声DAS道集中提取频率-速度频散曲线。
采用进化算法进行随机一维各向同性层状横波速度反演（每个脚步声迭代1000次，评估10,000个模型），并通过高斯平滑拼接成二维剖面。
对脚步声-DAS地震道进行共深度点（CDP）抽道集、正常时差（NMO）校正和叠加（最高42次覆盖）以获取浅层反射剖面。
采用二维有限差分声波方程正演模拟（100 Hz一阶导数高斯震源）生成合成反射剖面以进行一致性验证。
de: DAS dataset recorded at Sandia National Laboratories' FACT site using a Silixa iDAS-MG interrogator along a 142-m single-mode armored cable (1000 Hz sampling rate, 3 m gauge length, 0.25 m channel spacing).
53 individual footsteps recorded along a ~50 m unpaved road parallel to the fiber (43 retained after quality control).
Three accelerated weight drop (AWD) shots recorded concurrently by the DAS array for comparison.
Ground-truth 3-D Vs model from Abbott et al. (2006) derived from AWD sources and a 2-D array of 4.5 Hz vertical geophones.
在桑迪亚国家实验室FACT场地使用Silixa iDAS-MG解调仪沿142米单模铠装光缆采集的DAS数据集（采样率1000 Hz，标距3米，道间距0.25米）。
沿平行于光缆的约50米未铺砌道路记录的53个独立脚步声（质控后保留43个）。
由DAS阵列同期记录的3炮加速落重（AWD）数据，用于对比分析。
来自Abbott等（2006）由AWD震源和二维4.5 Hz垂直检波器阵列构建的基准三维Vs模型。
li: Footstep sources have weaker low-frequency (<10 Hz) power compared to active weight drops, limiting penetration depth to ~25 m and slightly underestimating Vs by ~5–10% (~25 m/s).
Weak footstep energy below ~0.2 s two-way travel time prevents imaging deeper bedrock interfaces (~40 m depth).
Short recording duration prevented comparing the footstep results against ambient noise interferometry on the same DAS array.
与主动落重震源相比，脚步声震源在低频段（<10 Hz）能量较弱，导致穿透深度受限于约25米，且Vs估算值偏低约5–10%（约25 m/s）。
双程走时0.2秒以下的脚步声能量微弱，无法对更深的基岩界面（约40米深）进行反射成像。
有限的数据采集时长使得本研究无法在同一DAS阵列上开展背景噪声干涉成像对比。

tm.why: The study records footstep-generated seismic waves using a 142-m single-mode armored fiber-optic cable and a Silixa iDAS-MG interrogator to image shallow subsurface structure.
The authors apply Multi-channel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) and evolutionary algorithm inversion to footstep dispersion curves to construct a 2-D shear wave velocity (Vs) profile.
The recovered 2-D Vs profile is used to estimate Vs30 (time-averaged shear wave velocity in the top 30 m), a critical parameter for urban ground motion and seismic hazard analysis.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF from Seismica (2026) was read and analyzed, including all sections, equations, and all 9 figures.

sum: This study presents 3-D apparent bulk and shear attenuation models beneath the Alaska Peninsula by jointly inverting P- and S-wave spectral decay using a transdimensional Bayesian tomography method. The authors semi-quantitatively interpret shear-wave velocity (Vs) and shear attenuation (Qs^-1) using a laboratory-based anelastic model. In the fore-arc mantle, low Vs and low Qs^-1 indicate low temperatures and potential serpentinization. Across the mantle wedge, low Vs and elevated Qs^-1 suggest supersolidus temperatures and the presence of partial melts. Crucially, very high Qs^-1 paired with normal Vs in some areas cannot be explained solely by grain-boundary sliding, suggesting additional attenuation mechanisms. This work provides a quantitative framework for interpreting seismic velocity and attenuation in subduction zones.
本研究利用跨维度贝叶斯断层成像方法，联合反演P波和S波谱衰减，构建了阿拉斯加半岛下方三维视体积与剪切衰减模型。结合实验室滞弹性模型，对剪切波速度（Vs）和剪切衰减（Qs^-1）进行了半定量解释。结果显示，弧前地幔的低Vs和低Qs^-1反映了低温及蛇纹石化；地幔楔的低Vs和高Qs^-1指示了超固相线温……

t: Joint inversion of P- and S-wave spectral decay using a transdimensional Bayesian tomography method to construct 3-D apparent bulk and shear attenuation models.
利用跨维度贝叶斯断层成像方法联合反演P波和S波谱衰减，构建三维视体积和剪切衰减模型。
P- and S-wave spectral decay data from earthquakes recorded in the Alaska Peninsula subduction zone.
阿拉斯加半岛俯冲带记录的地震P波和S波谱衰减数据。
Identified low Vs and low Qs^-1 in the fore-arc (serpentinization) and low Vs with elevated Qs^-1 in the mantle wedge (supersolidus temperatures and partial melts).
发现弧前低Vs和低Qs^-1（蛇纹石化），以及地幔楔低Vs和高Qs^-1（超固相线温度与部分熔融）。
The simplified laboratory-based anelastic model cannot fully explain the observed very high Qs^-1 and normal Vs in some parts of the mantle wedge.
简化的实验室滞弹性模型无法完全解释地幔楔部分区域极高Qs^-1与正常Vs并存的现象。
Jointly inverting bulk and shear attenuation using transdimensional Bayesian tomography and semi-quantitatively interpreting them alongside velocity using laboratory-based models.
利用跨维度贝叶斯方法联合反演体积与剪切衰减，并结合实验室模型与速度进行半定量解释。

kc: Developed 3-D apparent bulk and shear attenuation models beneath the Alaska Peninsula using transdimensional Bayesian tomography.
Semi-quantitatively interpreted Vs and Qs^-1 jointly using a laboratory-based anelastic model.
Identified distinct thermal and compositional regimes, including fore-arc serpentinization and mantle wedge partial melting.
Highlighted that grain-boundary sliding alone cannot explain very high Qs^-1 paired with normal Vs, suggesting additional attenuation mechanisms.
利用跨维度贝叶斯断层成像方法构建了阿拉斯加半岛下方三维视体积和剪切衰减模型。

识别出不同的热与成分状态，包括弧前蛇纹石化和地幔楔部分熔融。
指出仅靠晶界滑动无法解释极高Qs^-1与正常Vs并存的现象，暗示存在其他衰减机制。

Joint inversion of P- and S-wave spectral decay.
Laboratory-based anelastic modeling for semi-quantitative interpretation.

来自阿拉斯加半岛俯冲带局部/区域地震的P波和S波谱衰减数据。

The study uses a transdimensional Bayesian tomography method to jointly invert P- and S-wave spectral decay.
The paper interprets the thermal and compositional conditions (serpentinization, partial melts) of the Alaska Peninsula mantle wedge.

sum: This study analyzes ground deformation at Masaya volcano, Nicaragua, from January 2018 to February 2024 using Sentinel-1 InSAR time series processed via StaMPS/MTI. The authors invert quadtree-downsampled line-of-sight displacements using a Mogi point-source model and the Neighborhood Algorithm. Results show the Masaya Central Reservoir (MCR) at ~3,200 m depth deflated by ~1.3 × 10^6 m^3 from 2018 to mid-2022, then transitioned to inflation (~4.5 × 10^5 m^3) from mid-2022 to 2024, indicating renewed magma supply. Concurrently, a localized region around the active Santiago crater continuously deflated throughout 2018–2024, modeled as a second shallow reservoir at ~200 m depth losing 4,000–6,000 m^3. The novelty lies in identifying independent, simultaneous deformation of a dual-reservoir plumbing system at Masaya, analogous to Kīlauea, providing critical constraints for volcanic hazard assessment.
本研究利用Sentinel-1卫星InSAR时间序列（StaMPS/MTI处理）分析了2018年1月至2024年2月尼加拉瓜马萨亚火山的地表形变。结合四叉树降采样、Mogi点源模型和邻域算法（NA）进行反演，发现深约3200米的中央岩浆囊（MCR）在2018至2022年中期收缩了约1.3×10^6立……

t: Quadtree-downsampled InSAR line-of-sight displacements are inverted for Mogi point-source location, depth, and volume change in a homogeneous elastic half-space using the non-linear Neighborhood Algorithm.
对四叉树降采样的InSAR视线向位移，采用弹性半空间Mogi点源模型和邻域算法进行非线性反演。
Sentinel-1 C-band SAR data from January 2018 to February 2024 processed with GAMMA and StaMPS/MTI using a 12 m TanDEM-X DEM to extract Persistent Scatterer LOS time series.
2018年1月至2024年2月的Sentinel-1 SAR数据，利用GAMMA、StaMPS/MTI及12米TanDE…

The Masaya Central Reservoir at ~3,200 m depth deflated by ~1.3 × 10^6 m^3 (2018–2022) and inflated by ~4.5 × 10^5 m^3 (2022–2024), while a 200 m deep reservoir beneath Santiago crater deflated by 4,000–6,000 m^3.
3200米深的MCR先收缩1.3×10^6 m^3后膨胀4.5×10^5 m^3；火山口下200米浅源持续收缩4000–…
Only three GPS stations existed in Nicaragua as of February 2020 and all required updates, preventing ground-based GNSS validation and requiring reliance solely on relative InSAR measurements.
尼加拉瓜境内缺乏可用GPS站点，无法提供地面GNSS验证，仅能依赖相对InSAR测量。
Identifies a mid-2022 transition from deflation to inflation in the deeper MCR alongside continuous, independent deflation of a second shallow reservoir beneath Santiago crater through 2024.
首次发现深部MCR在2022年中期由收缩转为膨胀，同时浅层圣地亚哥火山口岩浆囊持续独立收缩。

kc: Documented a mid-2022 transition from deflation to inflation at the Masaya Central Reservoir (MCR) using 2018–2024 Sentinel-1 InSAR time series.
Constrained the MCR to ~3,200 m depth with volume changes of -1.3 × 10^6 m^3 (2018–2022) and +4.5 × 10^5 m^3 (2022–2024) via Neighborhood Algorithm inversions.
Identified a second, shallower (~200 m depth) deflating magma reservoir beneath the Santiago crater operating independently of the deeper MCR.
利用2018–2024年Sentinel-1 InSAR时间序列记录了马萨亚中央岩浆囊（MCR）在2022年中期由收缩转为膨胀的过程。
通过邻域算法反演将MCR约束在约3200米深处，2018–2022年和2022–2024年的体积变化分别为-1.3 × 10^6 m^3和+4.5 × 10^5 m^3。
识别出圣地亚哥火山口下方约200米深处存在第二个持续收缩的浅层岩浆囊，其活动独立于深部MCR。
me: Persistent Scatterers InSAR time series processing using GAMMA and StaMPS/MTI with a 12 m TanDEM-X DEM.
Quadtree downsampling of cumulative line-of-sight (LOS) displacement maps.
Non-linear geodetic inversion using a Mogi point-source in an elastic half-space optimized via the Neighborhood Algorithm.
使用GAMMA和StaMPS/MTI结合12米TanDEM-X DEM进行永久散射体InSAR时间序列处理。
对累积视线向（LOS）位移图进行四叉树降采样。
采用弹性半空间中的Mogi点源模型，通过邻域算法（NA）进行非线性大地测量反演。
de: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR ascending and descending imagery spanning January 2018 to February 2024 (extended to April 2026 in discussion).
12 m resolution TanDEM-X Digital Elevation Model for topographic phase removal.
2018年1月至2024年2月（讨论中扩展至2026年4月）的Sentinel-1 C波段SAR升轨和降轨影像。
用于去除地形相位的12米分辨率TanDEM-X数字高程模型。

Simplifying assumption of an isotropic, homogeneous elastic half-space and point-source (Mogi) geometry ignores topographic and structural heterogeneities.
研究期间尼加拉瓜缺乏可用的地面GNSS站点，无法进行独立的三维大地测量验证。
均匀各向同性弹性半空间和Mogi点源几何形态的简化假设忽略了地形和结构非均质性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the magma plumbing system and ground deformation of Masaya volcano using satellite geodesy and compares the reservoir depth with seismic ambient noise tomography results.
The study employs the Neighborhood Algorithm for non-linear geophysical inversion of geodetic data to estimate Mogi point-source parameters.

ev.notes: All metadata, methodology, quantitative inversion results, and figure analyses were extracted directly from the 9-page GRL PDF.

sum: Characterizing fine-scale subduction interface structure is vital for understanding megathrust earthquakes, yet challenging due to depth and low seismicity. This study introduces a quasi-autocorrelogram stacking technique for Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data that cross-correlates local P-wave scattered codas across multiple template events to amplify weak slab-converted phases (Ps, Sp, PMs, SMp). Applied to 23 intraslab earthquakes recorded by a 15-km fiber array above the Gorda slab in southern Cascadia, the method detects conversions in 11 events (versus 3 visually). Combining differential travel-time picks with 3D raytracing and 1D synthetic modeling, the authors show the Gorda slab is generally shallower than Slab2, has a 6–10 km thick crust, and exhibits kilometer-scale interface bumps (~300 m high, 3 km wide). Polarity reversals and double peaks further indicate elevated pore fluid pressure in the locked slab crust and a <1 km fault interface zone.
刻画俯冲带界面精细结构对理解巨型逆冲地震至关重要。本文提出一种针对分布式声学传感（DAS）数据的“准自相关图叠加”新方法，利用多个模板事件初至P波产生的局地散射波场与目标板内地震互相关并对齐叠加，显著增强了微弱的板片转换波（Ps、Sp及板片莫霍面转换波）。将该技术应用于卡斯卡迪亚南部戈尔达板片上方1……

t: Cross-correlates 2-s P-wave scattered coda templates from 60 local earthquakes with intraslab earthquake DAS wavefields, aligns on direct P correlation peaks, and stacks these quasi-autocorrelograms to pick differential times and polarities of slab-converted phases.
将60个模板地震初至P波2秒散射尾波与板内地震DAS波场互相关，对齐直达P波峰值并叠加准自相关图以拾取转换波走时差与极性…

Earthquake wavefields from 23 candidate intraslab events (M2.5+, >10 km below Slab2) and 60 template events recorded on the ~15 km GorDAS telecommunications fiber array between Arcata and Eureka, California.
加州阿卡塔至尤里卡约15公里GorDAS通信光缆记录的23个M2.5+板内地震与60个模板地震波场及共址节点仪数据。

Identified slab conversions in 11 of 23 events, revealing Slab2 depth discrepancies (-2.5 to +1 km), 6–10 km slab crustal thickness, a ~300 m high by 3 km wide megathrust bump, and hydrated locked-zone slab crust.
在11个事件中提取出转换波，揭示板片比Slab2浅达2.5公里、壳厚6–10公里、高300米宽3公里的界面凸起及板片水化…
Hypocenter depth errors trade off with Sp depth estimates, forearc Vp/Vs uncertainties trade off with Ps depths, and geometric raytracing ignores finite-frequency and ray-bending effects.
震源深度和浅部Vp/Vs误差与板片深度存在折衷，几何射线追踪忽略了射线弯曲与有限频效应。

First multi-event template quasi-autocorrelogram stacking method for DAS to extract weak, high-frequency (>5 Hz) slab-converted phases and image sub-kilometer megathrust roughness and fluid variations.
首创多事件散射模板准自相关叠加法，从DAS提取高于5 Hz的微弱板片转换波以成像亚公里级逆冲界面粗糙度。

kc: Developed a quasi-autocorrelogram stacking method leveraging locally scattered P-wave templates to extract weak secondary converted phases in DAS data.
Detected slab interface and slab Moho conversions (Ps, Sp, PMs, SMp) in 11 of 23 intraslab events in southern Cascadia, nearly quadrupling visual detection.
Constrained Gorda slab depth (mostly shallower than Slab2 by up to 2.5 km), crustal thickness (6–10 km), and sub-kilometer megathrust roughness (~300 m high, 3 km wide bump).
Demonstrated sharp variability in forearc/slab hydration and identified a <1 km interface layer using converted phase polarities and >6 Hz waveforms.
开发了利用局地散射P波模板的准自相关图叠加方法，从DAS数据中提取信噪比低于噪声水平的微弱次生转换震相。
在卡斯卡迪亚南部23个板内地震中的11个事件中检测出板片界面和板片莫霍面转换波，检测率接近肉眼识别的四倍。
约束了戈尔达板片绝对深度（整体比Slab2浅，偏差在浅2.5公里至深1公里之间）、地壳厚度（6–10公里）及高约300米、宽约3公里的界面粗糙度。
利用转换波相对极性和大于6 Hz的高频双峰特征，揭示了弧前与板片流体含量的剧烈空间变化及厚度小于1公里的界面薄层。
me: Quasi-autocorrelogram stacking: cross-correlating 2-s P-wave scattered wavefield windows from 60 template events with candidate intraslab events (1–10 Hz whitened), aligning on zero-phase P peaks, and stacking.
3D pseudo-ray-bending travel-time calculation (TomoDD grid search at 10-m spacing on Slab2 and 7 km deeper Moho) using the Guo et al. (2021) 3D velocity model.
1D synthetic strain waveform modeling using Frequency-Wavenumber (FK) summation and TauP across four velocity/Vp-Vs hydration models.
Linear interpolant slab depth inversion with Gaussian process spatial smoothing (750 m correlation length scale) and PyKonal fast-marching sensitivity tests.
准自相关图叠加：将1–10 Hz谱白化后的60个模板事件初至P波2秒散射窗与目标板内地震互相关，按直达P波零相位峰值对齐并极性校正后叠加。
三维伪射线弯曲走时计算：基于Guo等（2021）三维速度模型和TomoDD网格搜索（Slab2界面及深7公里的板片莫霍面上10米网格间距）计算理论到时。
一维理论应变波形模拟：使用频率-波数（FK）求和法与TauP对四种不同水化状态（Vp/Vs变化）的一维速度模型计算合成自相关图。
板片深度与形貌反演：建立深度-走时差线性插值函数，结合相关长度为750米的高斯过程空间平滑反演界面起伏，并用PyKonal进行敏感性测试。
de: GorDAS deployment: ~15 km telecommunications fiber array between Arcata and Eureka, CA, recorded at 250 Hz (2 m spacing, 8 m gauge) and later 100 Hz (5 m spacing).
23 candidate intraslab earthquakes (M2.5+, >10 km below Slab2 interface) and 60 high-SNR template earthquakes selected from >200 M2.5+ NCSN catalog events within 100 km.
Collocated 3-component nodal seismometer data during the Mw 5.3 intraslab earthquake (nc73827571) used for polarization verification.
GorDAS光纤阵列数据：部署于加州阿卡塔至尤里卡之间约15公里的通信光缆，前期采样率250 Hz（道间距2米，标距8米），后期100 Hz（道间距5米）。
地震事件数据集：从100公里内超200个M2.5+目录地震中选出60个高信噪比模板事件，以及23个位于Slab2界面以下超10公里的板内候选地震。
共址三分量节点地震仪数据：记录了Mw 5.3板内地震（nc73827571），用于验证转换波偏振特征。
li: Tradeoffs between inverted slab depth/topography and uncertainties in earthquake hypocenter depth (especially for Sp) and shallow (<5 km) forearc Vp/Vs ratios (especially for Ps).
Relatively short fiber aperture (~15 km) limits moveout constraints and spatial sampling outside the southern Cascadia locked zone.
Linear depth interpolation and geometric raytracing neglect finite-frequency sensitivity kernels and ray-bending smoothing/bias from short-wavelength interface bumps.
反演的板片深度与震源深度不确定性（对Sp影响大）及弧前浅部5公里内Vp/Vs模型误差（对Ps影响大）存在折衷。
光纤阵列孔径相对较短（约15公里），限制了时差曲线约束能力以及对闭锁区以外区域的对比观测。
线性深度插值与几何射线追踪忽略了有限频核效应以及短波长界面起伏引起的射线弯曲平滑偏差。

tm.why: The study deploys a 15-km DAS array on telecommunications fiber to measure and stack earthquake wavefields for subduction zone imaging.
The core objective is identifying and picking high-frequency P-to-S and S-to-P converted phases from the megathrust interface and slab Moho.
The paper constrains sub-kilometer megathrust roughness, slab crustal thickness, absolute slab depth, and fluid distribution in the Gorda slab and Cascadia forearc.

ev.notes: Full 25-page Nature Communications Article-in-Press PDF analyzed, including main text, Methods, and Figures 1–5.

sum: This supplementary document supports the performance assessment of two real-time earthquake localization algorithms, RTLoc and MParLoc, designed for Earthquake Early Warning Systems (EEWS) in the Ibero-Maghrebian Region. It presents Table S1, which details the horizontal (ΔR) and vertical (ΔZ) location errors at the time of the first alert (TFIRST) across various configurations. These configurations utilize combinations of differential arrival times (ΔTimes), amplitude ratios (ΔAmp), and back-azimuth (BAZ) estimates. The dataset includes the number of available observables such as P-wave picks, BAZ estimates, and peak displacement (Pv) values for selected seismic events, enabling a rigorous comparative analysis of the algorithms' localization accuracy and speed.
本补充材料支持对伊比利亚-马格里布地区地震预警系统中RTLoc和MParLoc实时定位算法的性能评估。Table S1给出了首次警报时刻在仅走时差、走时+振幅+后方位角等四种配置下的水平和垂直定位误差，并记录了P波拾取、后方位角和最大位移等观测值数量，为评估算法在预警中的精度和时效提供了定量依据。

Seismic phase picks (P-picks), back-azimuth (BAZ) estimates, and peak amplitude (Pv) values for selected earthquakes in the Ibero-Maghrebian region.
伊比利亚-马格里布地区的地震波形数据，提取P波走时、后方位角和最大位移。

给出了不同数据配置下首次警报时刻的水平和垂直定位误差定量对比。
Limited to the specific events and station distribution of the Ibero-Maghrebian region analyzed in the main text.
作为补充材料，仅提供表格数据，缺乏详细的理论推导与讨论。
Comparative evaluation of RTLoc and MParLoc under real-time EEW constraints using multi-parameter observables.
在实时预警约束下，定量对比了多参数输入对两种定位算法精度的影响。

kc: Provides quantitative performance metrics (ΔR and ΔZ) for RTLoc and MParLoc algorithms.
Compares different data configuration inputs (times, amplitudes, and back-azimuths) for real-time localization.
Tabulates the number of available seismic observables (P-picks, BAZ, Pv) for the analyzed events.
提供了RTLoc和MParLoc算法的定量性能指标（ΔR和ΔZ）。
对比了用于实时定位的不同数据配置输入（走时、振幅和后方位角）。

me: Real-time earthquake localization using RTLoc and MParLoc algorithms.
Multi-parameter configuration testing (combining arrival times, amplitude ratios, and back-azimuths).

tm.why: The paper evaluates real-time earthquake localization algorithms (RTLoc and MParLoc) for early warning systems.

sum: Learned time-lapse (4D) seismic inversion methods typically rely on Gaussian training perturbations that fail to capture anomalous fluid transport in heterogeneous reservoirs. This study introduces a physics-informed synthetic data generator governed by the space-time fractional diffusion equation with elliptical anisotropy, independently controlling memory effects (subdiffusion) and nonlocal transport (superdiffusion). By sampling fractional exponents, diffusivity tensors, and peak amplitudes, the authors synthesize 5000 velocity-update models embedded in a 2D Brazilian pre-salt baseline velocity model and simulate acoustic Ocean Bottom Node (OBN) seismic differences. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is trained to map time-lapse seismic residuals directly to 2D reservoir velocity updates. Across 30-fold Monte Carlo cross-validation, the CNN achieves a median structural similarity (SSIM) of ~0.999 and median plume-masked MSE below 0.1 across all diffusion regimes, demonstrating that reconstruction accuracy is governed by anomaly amplitude and edge sharpness rather than transport regime.
现有的深度学习时移（4D）地震反演多依赖高斯扩散训练数据，难以刻画非均质储层中的反常流体运移。本文提出基于椭圆各向异性时空分数阶扩散方程的物理启发式数据生成器，独立控制时间记忆效应（次扩散）和空间非局域运移（超扩散）。基于巴西盐下2D速度模型与海底节点（OBN）采集系统，合成了涵盖4种扩散机制的50……

t: Synthesizes non-Gaussian reservoir velocity anomalies via an anisotropic space-time fractional diffusion equation solved spectrally with a Mittag-Leffler propagator, then trains a CNN to map 4D seismic residuals to 2D velocity updates.
通过Mittag-Leffler传播子谱方法求解各向异性时空分数阶扩散方程合成非高斯速度异常，并训练CNN反演2D速度更…
5000 synthetic 2D monitor models in a 20 km by 7.5 km Brazilian pre-salt velocity model, simulated with 2D acoustic wave propagation using 1 surface shot and 49 Ocean Bottom Nodes.
基于20×7.5 km巴西盐下模型的5000个合成监测模型，采用单炮和49个OBN节点进行2D声波正演。
Over 30 Monte Carlo cross-validation folds, the CNN achieves a median plume-restricted SSIM of ~0.999 (IQR 0.998–0.9995) and a median masked MSE below 0.1 (IQR 0.02–0.18).
30折交叉验证中，CNN在羽流区域的SSIM中位数达0.999，掩膜MSE中位数低于0.1（四分位距0.02–0.18）…
Adopts a linear rock-physics proxy instead of Gassmann fluid substitution and assumes perfectly repeated baseline/monitor acquisition without field non-repeatability noise.
采用线性岩石物理近似代替Gassmann方程，且假设完美重复采集，未考虑非重复性噪声。

Replaces classical Gaussian training priors in learned 4D seismic inversion with an anisotropic space-time fractional diffusion generator capturing heavy-tailed subdiffusive and superdiffusive reservoir anomalies.
用各向异性时空分数阶扩散生成器替代传统高斯先验，实现了重尾次扩散和超扩散储层异常的深度学习4D反演。

kc: Formulated an anisotropic space-time fractional diffusion generator using Caputo time derivatives and Riesz fractional Laplacians to synthesize non-Gaussian 4D seismic velocity anomalies.

Trained an amortized CNN inverse operator mapping pre-stack OBN time-lapse seismic differences directly to 2D reservoir velocity updates across normal, subdiffusive, superdiffusive, and time-subordinated regimes.

Demonstrated via 30-fold Monte Carlo cross-validation that CNN reconstruction achieves near-unity SSIM (~0.999), with errors driven by peak amplitude and gradient sharpness rather than diffusion regime.
基于Caputo时间导数与Riesz分数阶拉普拉斯算子构建了各向异性时空分数阶扩散生成器，用于合成非高斯4D地震速度异常。
训练了摊销式CNN反演算子，将叠前OBN时移地震残差直接映射为涵盖正常、次扩散、超扩散及时间从属机制的2D储层速度更新。
通过30折蒙特卡洛交叉验证证实CNN重建的SSIM接近1（~0.999），且误差主要受峰值振幅和梯度锐度控制，而非扩散机制。
me: Spectral synthesis of anomalous diffusion plumes via the one-parameter Mittag-Leffler propagator and an anisotropic quadratic diffusivity tensor.
Linear rock-physics proxy mapping normalized particle transport density fields to acoustic velocity perturbations.
2D scalar acoustic wave-equation forward modeling of baseline and monitor surveys to obtain time-lapse waveform residuals.
Hybrid CNN architecture combining Conv2D/max-pooling feature extraction layers with fully connected regression layers, evaluated via plume-masked MSE and SSIM over 30 Monte Carlo folds.
利用单参数Mittag-Leffler传播子和各向异性二次扩散张量在谱域合成反常扩散羽流。
采用线性岩石物理近似将归一化粒子输运密度场映射为声波速度扰动。
利用2D标量声波方程正演模拟基线和监测地震数据以获取时移波形残差。
结合Conv2D/最大池化特征提取与全连接回归层的混合CNN架构，通过30折蒙特卡洛交叉验证及羽流掩膜MSE和SSIM进行评估。
de: 2D Brazilian pre-salt baseline acoustic velocity model (20 km wide by 7.5 km deep) containing a 1.6 km thick, 4 km wide reservoir target.
Controlled Ocean Bottom Node (OBN) acquisition geometry with 1 central sea-surface shot and 49 seabed receivers across a 20 km aperture.
Synthetic ensemble of N = 5000 monitor velocity models spanning four canonical fractional diffusion regimes split 80%/20% into training and test sets.
20 km宽、7.5 km深的2D巴西盐下基线声波速度模型，包含厚1.6 km、宽4 km的储层目标。
受控海底节点（OBN）观测系统，包含模型中心海面1个震源点及海底20 km孔径内分布的49个接收器。
涵盖四种典型分数阶扩散机制的5000个合成监测速度模型数据集，按80%/20%划分为训练集和测试集。
li: Uses a simplified linear rock-physics proxy relating transport probability directly to velocity change rather than first-principles Gassmann fluid substitution.
Assumes perfectly repeated baseline and monitor seismic acquisition, ignoring field non-repeatability noise, source/receiver positioning errors, and ambient noise.
Restricted to 2D isotropic acoustic wave propagation with a single surface shot and 49 OBN receivers.
使用简化的线性岩石物理近似直接将输运概率转换为速度变化，未采用第一性原理的Gassmann流体替换。
假设基线和监测地震采集完全可重复，忽略了实际野外观测的非重复性噪声、震源/检波器位置误差及环境噪声。
局限于单炮激发、49个OBN接收器的2D各向同性声波方程模拟。

tm.why: The paper trains a convolutional neural network to perform amortized time-lapse seismic inversion directly from differential seismic waveforms to velocity updates.
The learned operator is designed as an amortized alternative to computationally expensive time-lapse full-waveform inversion (FWI) of acoustic wavefields.
The work focuses on constructing a physically grounded anomalous-diffusion prior for amortized inference in nonlinear wavefield inverse problems.

ev.notes: Full 10-page arXiv manuscript PDF including equations, Table I, and Figures 1–6 was analyzed.

sum: Low-velocity layers (LVLs) and high-conductivity anomalies atop the 410-km seismic discontinuity are widely attributed to dehydration partial melting of upwelling mantle transition zone material, yet the intrinsic electrical conductivity of such deep hydrous melts remained unmeasured at relevant pressures. Using impedance spectroscopy in a Kawai-type multi-anvil apparatus with single-crystal diamond capsules, the authors directly measured the electrical conductivity of hydrous ultramafic melts (6.3–18.6 wt% H2O) and dry KLB-1 peridotite at 13 GPa. They found that hydrous ultramafic melts are exceptionally conductive—approaching or exceeding alkali-carbonate melts—and their conductivity increases systematically with water content due to melt network depolymerization. Combining these measurements with Hashin–Shtrikman bounds and regional magnetotelluric conductance estimates (3 × 10^4 S) demonstrates that <1 vol% interconnected hydrous melt can produce conductive layers thicker than 10 km, reconciling electromagnetic and seismic constraints on the 410-km LVL.
410 km地震间断面之上的低速层（LVL）和高导异常通常归因于地幔过渡带物质上涌引发的脱水部分熔融，但相关压力下含水熔体的本征电导率此前缺乏直接测量。本研究利用Kawai型大腔体压机结合单晶金刚石样品舱与阻抗谱技术，在13 GPa下直接测量了含水超镁铁质熔体（6.3–18.6 wt% H2O）及干……

t: Electrical conductivity of hydrous ultramafic melts was measured at 13 GPa using impedance spectroscopy in a Kawai-type multi-anvil apparatus, sealing samples in single-crystal diamond capsules connected to Pt electrodes.
利用Kawai型多面砧压机和单晶金刚石样品舱，在13 GPa下通过阻抗谱测量含水超镁铁质熔体电导率。
Impedance spectra of incipient hydrous ultramafic melts with H2O contents systematically varied between 6.3 and 18.6 wt% and dry KLB-1 peridotite at 13 GPa.
13 GPa下水含量在6.3至18.6 wt%之间系统变化的含水超镁铁质熔体及干KLB-1橄榄岩的复阻抗谱数据。

Hydrous ultramafic melts are extremely conductive (approaching carbonate melts), and Hashin–Shtrikman modeling shows <1 vol% interconnected melt can explain LVLs thicker than ~10 km with 3 × 10^4 S conductance.
含水超镁铁质熔体电导率极高，<1 vol%的连通熔体即可产生3×10^4 S电导并解释>10 km厚的低速层。

Resolving electrical conductivity at mantle transition zone depths using electromagnetic techniques remains challenging with large uncertainties, and Fe-bearing samples suffered Fe loss to Pt electrodes.
地幔过渡带深度的电磁反演分辨率有限且不确定性大；含铁样品向铂电极发生了明显的铁流失。
First direct electrical conductivity measurements of hydrous ultramafic melts at 13 GPa (410-km depth conditions), overcoming previous <10 GPa pressure limits and water-loss issues.
突破以往<10 GPa压力限制与水流失瓶颈，首次直接测量410 km深度（13 GPa）含水超镁铁质熔体电导率。

kc: Directly measured the electrical conductivity of hydrous ultramafic melts with 6.3–18.6 wt% H2O at 13 GPa using single-crystal diamond capsules to prevent water loss.
Demonstrated that hydrous ultramafic melts at 410-km depth conditions are extremely conductive, matching or exceeding carbonate melts due to strong depolymerization.
Established an empirical Arrhenius formulation quantifying the temperature and water-content dependence of ultramafic melt conductivity and compared it against melt viscosity.

Showed via Hashin–Shtrikman modeling that <1 vol% interconnected hydrous silicate melt explains both the 3 × 10^4 S conductance and >10 km thickness of the 410-km LVL, outperforming carbonatite models.
利用单晶金刚石样品舱防止水流失，在13 GPa下直接测量了含水量6.3–18.6 wt%的超镁铁质熔体电导率。
证明410 km深度条件下的含水超镁铁质熔体因高度解聚而具有极高电导率，达到或超过碳酸盐熔体水平。
建立了量化超镁铁质熔体电导率对温度和水含量依赖性的经验阿伦尼乌斯公式，并与熔体粘度进行了对比分析。
通过Hashin–Shtrikman建模证明，<1 vol%的连通含水硅酸盐熔体即可同时解释410 km低速层的3 × 10^4 S电导和>10 km厚度，比碳酸岩熔体模型更合理。
me: High-pressure, high-temperature impedance spectroscopy in a Kawai-type multi-anvil apparatus at 13 GPa.
Encapsulation in single-crystal diamond capsules with Pt electrodes to suppress water loss and chemical reactions.
Arrhenius empirical fitting of superliquidus electrical conductivity as a function of temperature and H2O concentration.
Hashin–Shtrikman upper-bound modeling combining melt and dry KLB-1 peridotite end-members to link melt fraction with layer thickness.
在13 GPa下利用Kawai型多面砧压机开展高温高压交流阻抗谱测量。
采用单晶金刚石样品舱配合铂电极封装样品，有效抑制水逃逸及熔体-样品舱化学反应。
对液相线以上的电导率数据进行关于温度和水含量的阿伦尼乌斯经验公式拟合。
结合含水熔体和干KLB-1橄榄岩端元开展Hashin–Shtrikman上限建模，建立熔体体积分数与层厚度的定量关系。
de: Impedance spectra of Fe-free and Fe-bearing hydrous ultramafic melts (6.3, 7.4, 10.5, 14.6, and 18.6 wt% H2O) measured along heating and cooling paths up to ~2200 K at 13 GPa.
Reference electrical conductivity measurements of anhydrous KLB-1 peridotite at 13 GPa up to 1900 K.
Post-experimental textural and compositional characterization of quenched samples using FE-SEM and EDS.
在13 GPa、高达~2200 K的升降温路径下，测量了不含铁和含铁含水超镁铁质熔体（水含量6.3、7.4、10.5、14.6和18.6 wt%）的复阻抗谱。
在13 GPa、高达1900 K条件下测量了无水KLB-1橄榄岩的参考电导率数据。
利用场发射扫描电镜（FE-SEM）和能谱仪（EDS）对实验回收淬火样品进行了显微结构与成分表征。
li: Fe-bearing melt samples experienced significant iron loss to the Pt electrodes during high-temperature runs.
Electromagnetic inversions at mantle transition zone depths have large uncertainties and struggle to resolve fine-scale thin layers.
Buoyant, low-viscosity hydrous melts may rapidly migrate upward as 'mantle rain' unless stalled by dehydration or intermittent plume activity.
含铁熔体样品在高温实验过程中向铂电极发生了显著的铁流失。
地幔过渡带深度的电磁反演存在较大不确定性，难以精确分辨细尺度的薄层结构。
低粘度且具浮力的含水熔体可能以“地幔雨”形式快速向上迁移，除非因脱水或间歇性地幔柱活动而停滞。

tm.why: The paper directly constrains the melt fraction, composition, and origin of the low-velocity layer and high-conductivity anomaly in the deep upper mantle just above the 410-km discontinuity.
The experimental constraints are specifically used to interpret the structure and origin of the low-velocity layer atop the 410-km seismic discontinuity detected by receiver functions.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all main text sections, equations, and figures (Figures 1–3).

sum: Conventional ETAS models characterize earthquake triggering with a scalar branching ratio. This paper introduces a three-type Hawkes-ETAS theoretical framework that resolves strike-slip, normal, and reverse/thrust earthquakes using a 3x3 directed branching matrix N. Drawing from Andersonian receiver-fault availability, Coulomb stress projection asymmetry, mechanism-dependent Gutenberg-Richter b-values, tectonic loading directions, and near-degenerate self-triggering, the author demonstrates that N is generically non-normal (non-orthogonal eigenvectors). While the spectral radius ρ(N) < 1 governs asymptotic stability, eigenvector geometry controls finite-generation amplification. A physically informed parametrization separates diagonal self-triggering, a dominant tectonic driver column, and weak secondary couplings. Numerical examples and five tectonically informed scenario matrices (Tohoku-Oki, Wenchuan, Southern California, Central Italy, Ridgecrest) show that directed off-diagonal couplings can nearly triple cascade sizes at fixed eigenvalues. The novelty lies in linking fault mechanics to non-normal operator theory, yielding six falsifiable catalog predictions and explaining apparent near-criticality in scalar ETAS fits.
传统ETAS模型使用标量分支比表征地震触发。本文提出一种三类型Hawkes-ETAS理论框架，通过3×3有向分支矩阵N解析走滑、正断和逆冲地震。基于安德森断层可用性、库仑应力投影非对称性、机制相关的b值、构造加载方向及近简并自触发，作者证明N普遍具有非正规性（特征向量非正交）。谱半径ρ(N)<1控制……

t: Formulates a three-channel Hawkes-ETAS model for strike-slip, normal, and reverse earthquakes, decomposing the 3x3 branching matrix into diagonal self-triggering, a dominant tectonic driver column, and weak secondary couplings.
构建解析走滑、正断和逆冲地震的三通道Hawkes-ETAS模型，将3×3分支矩阵分解为自触发对角阵、主导驱动列和弱次级耦…

Evaluates synthetic numerical examples and five tectonically informed scenario matrices (Tohoku-Oki, Wenchuan, Southern California, Central Italy, Ridgecrest) normalized to a subcritical spectral radius of 0.75.
采用受控数值算例及归一化至谱半径0.75的五个构造启发情景矩阵（东北冲、汶川、南加州、中意大利、里奇克莱斯特）。

Switching on directed off-diagonal couplings at fixed spectral radius ρ(N) = 0.70 nearly triples expected reverse-initiated progeny from 2.33 to 6.68; in the Tohoku scenario (ρ = 0.75), progeny doubles from 2.34 to 4.94.
在固定谱半径0.70下引入有向非对角耦合使预期余震总数从2.33增至6.68；东北冲情景下（ρ=0.75）后代数量从2.…

The three-class mechanism partition misses intra-class conjugate strike-slip transfers (e.g., Ridgecrest), and the five regional matrices are illustrative scenarios rather than empirical likelihood estimates.
三类机制划分无法解析同类内部的共轭走滑触发，且五个构造矩阵为说明性情景而非实际目录的统计拟合。

Replaces the scalar ETAS branching ratio with a physics-based non-normal 3x3 branching matrix, showing how eigenvector geometry drives finite-generation cascade amplification and inflates scalar criticality estimates.
用基于物理的非正规3×3分支矩阵替代标量ETAS分支比，揭示特征向量几何如何驱动瞬态放大并推高标量视临界率。

kc: Formulates a three-channel Hawkes-ETAS model resolving strike-slip, normal, and reverse/thrust faulting mechanisms via a 3x3 branching matrix N.
Derives five physical constraints from fault mechanics and stress transfer that force N to be asymmetric, non-normal, and near-defective.
Introduces an exact, physically interpretable parametrization separating diagonal self-triggering, a dominant tectonic driver column, and weak back-couplings.
Formulates six falsifiable predictions for mechanism-resolved earthquake catalogs and demonstrates that scalar ETAS fits absorb non-normal amplification into an inflated apparent branching ratio.
构建了通过3×3分支矩阵N解析走滑、正断和逆冲断层机制的三通道Hawkes-ETAS模型。
从断层力学和应力传递推导出五项物理约束，证明矩阵N必然是非对称、非正规且接近亏损的。
提出了物理意义明确的精确参数化分解，将对角自触发、主导构造驱动列和弱次级耦合分离开来。
针对含震源机制的地震目录提出了六项可证伪预测，并证明标量ETAS拟合会将多类型非正规放大吸收为偏高的视分支比。
me: Multidimensional linear Hawkes point process and multitype Galton-Watson branching theory.
Non-normal matrix spectral geometry analysis using eigenvector condition numbers κ(V), resolvent bounds, and Jordan block asymptotics.
Mechanistic factorization of branching coefficients into Andersonian receiver availability, Coulomb stress-transfer gain, and Gutenberg-Richter source productivity.
Structural decomposition of the branching matrix into diagonal self-triggering D, rank-one dominant driver column, and residual weak coupling matrix B_weak.
多维线性Hawkes点过程与多类型Galton-Watson分支过程理论。
利用特征向量条件数κ(V)、预解式界和Jordan块渐近分析进行非正规矩阵谱几何分析。
将分支系数力学分解为安德森接收断层可用性、库仑应力传递增益和Gutenberg-Richter震源生产力三部分。
将分支矩阵结构分解为对角自触发矩阵D、秩一主导驱动列和残余弱耦合矩阵B_weak。
de: Controlled numerical experiments comparing well-separated versus near-degenerate diagonal self-triggering rates and off-diagonal shear effects at fixed spectral radius ρ(N) = 0.70.

Construction and evaluation of five tectonically informed illustrative scenario matrices normalized to ρ(N) = 0.75 for 2011 Tohoku-Oki, 2008 Wenchuan, Southern California, 2016 Central Italy, and 2019 Ridgecrest.
在固定谱半径ρ(N)=0.70下，对比分离与近简并自触发率以及非对角剪切效应的受控数值实验。
针对2011年日本东北冲、2008年汶川、南加州、2016年意大利中部和2019年里奇克莱斯特五个构造背景，构建并评估了归一化为ρ(N)=0.75的说明性情景分支矩阵。
li: Coarse three-class Andersonian categorization loses information for oblique/mixed ruptures and cannot resolve conjugate strike-slip transfers (e.g., Ridgecrest) without finer orientation subdivision.
The five tectonic matrices are illustrative scenarios with imposed ρ(N) = 0.75 rather than formal statistical likelihood fits to empirical earthquake catalogs.
粗略的三类安德森机制划分会损失斜滑或混合破裂信息，且在不细分断层走向时无法解析共轭走滑断层间的传递（如Ridgecrest序列）。
五个构造矩阵是设定ρ(N)=0.75的说明性情景，并非对实际地震目录进行严格统计似然拟合的估计结果。

tm.why: The paper develops a multitype Hawkes-ETAS statistical framework to model earthquake triggering cascades and formulate falsifiable predictions for mechanism-resolved earthquake catalogs.
The physical structure of the branching matrix is derived directly from Andersonian fault mechanics, Coulomb failure stress transfer, tectonic loading, and fault network geometric incompatibilities.
The study explicitly resolves and models interactions among three focal-mechanism families (strike-slip, normal, and reverse/thrust) and their source productivity differences.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF provided and analyzed, including main text (Sections I-VI), Table I, and Appendix A.

sum: Atmospheric acoustic waves from thunder couple into the ground to produce seismic signals termed thunderquakes, but complex air-ground wavefields have previously prevented their use in seismic imaging. This study demonstrates that thunderquakes recorded on a 4-km telecommunication fiber using distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) contain coherent air-coupled dispersive Rayleigh waves suitable for near-surface tomography. The authors validate the acoustic-to-elastic conversion mechanism using 2D and 3D spectral-element (SPECFEM3D) simulations. Analyzing 458 lightning-verified thunderquakes across 2.5 years of continuous DAS data in State College, Pennsylvania, they apply FK filtering, cross-correlation virtual-source interferometry, stacking, and coherent wavefield semblance denoising to extract surface-wave dispersion curves. Inverting 309 virtual shot gathers yields a 2D shear-wave velocity model to ~100 m depth, revealing four previously undetected karst fracture weak zones corroborated by MASW surveys, borehole logs, and InSAR subsidence measurements. This establishes thunderquakes as a novel meteorologically driven seismic source.
雷电产生的大气声波耦合入地形成“雷震”，但复杂的气-固耦合波场限制了其成像应用。本研究利用4公里通信光缆上的分布式声学传感（DAS）分析了2.5年内的458次雷震事件，并通过三维谱元法模拟验证了大气声波向频散瑞利面波的转换机制。通过频率-波数滤波、互相关虚拟震源干涉、叠加及相干波场相似性去噪，提取了……

t: Thunderquake DAS records are bandpass and FK filtered (450–2100 m/s), cross-correlated into 120-m virtual sources, stacked across 458 events, denoised via coherent wavefield semblance, and inverted for 1D Vs profiles using a recursive Neighborhood Algorithm.
对雷震DAS数据进行FK滤波、互相关构建虚拟震源、458事件叠加、相似性去噪，并用邻域算法递推反演一维Vs结构。

Continuous DAS data from 2019 to 2021 across 2137 channels (2-m spacing, 4-km fiber) of the FORESEE array in State College, PA, encompassing 458 thunderquakes verified by National Lightning Detection Network records.
宾州州立大学4公里FORESEE光纤阵列（2137道，2米间距）2019–2021年连续数据及NLDN验证的458次雷震…

Inversion of 309 virtual shot gathers resolves shear-wave velocity down to 100 m (median misfit 2.3%), revealing four 40–100 m wide low-velocity karst weak zones (initiating at ~28–50 m depth) and pinnacled bedrock corroborated by boreholes, MASW, and InSAR.
反演309个虚拟炮集获得100米深Vs剖面（中位拟合差2.3%），揭示4个宽40–100米的岩溶薄弱带并获钻孔和InSA…
Extremely shallow sediments with shear-wave phase velocities below the air-wave acoustic velocity (~343 m/s) cannot be resolved, and 3D numerical modeling is computationally limited to ~4 Hz.
无法分辨剪切波速度低于空气声速（~343 m/s）的极浅层沉积物，且三维模拟受算力限制主频仅4 Hz。

First demonstration of subsurface seismic tomography using thunderstorm-generated acoustic waves, establishing thunderquakes recorded on urban DAS fiber as repeatable, meteorologically driven seismic sources.
首次实现利用雷暴声波激发的雷震波进行地下层析成像，确立了雷震作为新型气象驱动地震震源的可行性。

kc: Demonstrates that atmospheric thunder acoustic waves couple into the ground as dispersive Rayleigh waves above the air-wave phase velocity (~343 m/s).
Validates 3D acoustic-elastic air-ground coupling over complex topography using SPECFEM3D Cartesian simulations.
Develops an interferometric and semblance-denoising workflow for 458 DAS-recorded thunderquakes to extract broadband surface-wave dispersion (down to <30 Hz).
Images shear-wave velocity down to 100 m beneath an urban karst setting, identifying four fracture-complex weak zones corroborated by boreholes, MASW, and InSAR subsidence.
证明雷电大气声波在相速度高于空气声速（~343 m/s）时可耦合转化为频散瑞利面波。
利用SPECFEM3D三维谱元模拟验证了复杂地形下的大气声波-地下弹性波耦合机制。
针对458个DAS雷震事件开发了虚拟震源干涉与相干波场相似性去噪流程，提取出宽频带面波频散。
反演了城市岩溶区地下100米剪切波速度结构，识别出4个经钻孔、MASW和InSAR验证的岩溶裂隙薄弱带。
me: 2D and 3D coupled acoustic-elastic spectral-element wavefield modeling (SPECFEM3D Cartesian) with vertical depth stretching.
Dual positive/negative FK filtering (450 to 2100 m/s), 0.1–50 Hz bandpass filtering, spectral whitening, and one-bit normalization.
Cross-correlation virtual-source interferometry (60-channel / 120-m aperture) and linear stacking across 458 thunderquake events.
Multi-aperture coherent wavefield semblance denoising and phase-shift frequency-velocity dispersion analysis.
Recursive Neighborhood Algorithm (Dinver/Geopsy) 1D shear-wave velocity inversion across 309 virtual shot gathers.
结合垂直深度拉伸策略的二维与三维声-弹耦合谱元法数值模拟（SPECFEM3D Cartesian）。
正负双向FK滤波（450–2100 m/s）、0.1–50 Hz带通滤波、谱白化与单比特归一化预处理。
利用60道（120米）孔径进行互相关虚拟震源构建，并对458个雷震事件进行线性叠加。
多孔径相干波场相似性去噪及相移法频率-相速度频散提取。
基于邻域算法（Dinver/Geopsy）对309个虚拟炮集进行递推一维剪切波速度反演。

Validation datasets including 5 geotechnical borehole logs (B-1 to B-5), 2 active-source MASW surveys, and Sentinel-1 InSAR line-of-sight surface deformation (2017–2025).

sum: Slow earthquakes, including episodic tremor and slip (ETS), are sensitive to small stress perturbations, with previous studies attributing northern Cascadia tremor seasonality to annual hydrological loading. Examining multi-decadal slow slip event (SSE) records (since 1994), tremor catalogs (since 1997), and GRACE/GRACE-FO hydrological models, this study reveals that tremor seasonality changed significantly after 2015, shifting from late summer peaks to spring and late fall, which cannot be explained by hydrological stress (~300 Pa). Instead, cumulative tectonic shear stress changes (~4–8 kPa) from past SSEs and multi-year stress rates modulate tremor seasonality; high tectonic stress rates during 2015–2024 masked hydrological influences. Furthermore, the authors discover a major reversal in ETS nucleation and propagation direction in northern Cascadia around 2012 (from northward to southward), driven by along-strike relative stress imbalances from past ETS events. These findings separate intrinsic fault stress feedback from external environmental forcings.
本文结合1994年以来的GNSS慢滑移事件（SSE）历史、1997年以来的颤动目录及GRACE水文负荷数据，系统研究了卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带构造与环境应力对慢地震（ETS）的调制作用。研究发现，北卡斯卡迪亚的颤动季节性在2015年后发生显著改变，不再与峰值水文应力（~300 Pa）一致，而是受控于历史SS……

t: Combined GNSS-derived SSE slip histories and inter-ETS stressing rates to compute detrended tectonic shear stress changes over 30–50 km depth, comparing them against GRACE/GRACE-FO hydrological Coulomb stresses and tremor catalogs.
结合GNSS慢滑移历史与间期加载率计算30-50 km深度的去趋势构造剪应力，并与GRACE水文库仑应力及颤动目录对比。
Analyzed PNSN (2010–2024) and Kao (1997–2015) tremor catalogs, continuous GNSS slip inversions for 37 ETS events (since 1994), and GRACE/GRACE-FO water mass change records (2002–2024).
使用了PNSN（2010–2024）和Kao（1997–2015）颤动目录、37个SSE事件的GNSS滑动模型及GRAC…

Tectonic stress changes (~4–8 kPa) exceed hydrological stresses (~300 Pa). High tectonic stress rates (-0.79 kPa/yr in 2015–2019; 0.63 kPa/yr after 2019) suppressed hydrological seasonality, and along-strike stress differences reversed ETS propagation around 2012.
构造应力变化（4–8 kPa）远大于水文应力（~300 Pa）；2015年后高构造应力率掩盖了水文季节性，且2012年E…

The correlation between tremor activity and tectonic stress rate lacks rigorous statistical quantification due to high uncertainty in tectonic stress rate seasonality, and inter-ETS loading is assumed constant.
颤动与构造应力率的相关性缺乏严格统计量化，且假设ETS间期构造加载率恒定及2005年前GNSS台网稀疏。

Identifies previously unreported post-2015 shifts in Cascadia tremor seasonality and a 2012 reversal in ETS propagation direction, demonstrating that internal SSE stress redistribution dominates over external hydrological forcing.
首次发现2015年后颤动季节性转变及2012年ETS传播方向反转，证明慢滑移内部应力反馈主导了慢地震演化。

kc: Demonstrated that northern Cascadia tremor seasonality shifted after 2015, breaking the previously established correlation with annual hydrological loading.

Showed that tectonic stress changes from past SSEs (~4–8 kPa) are an order of magnitude larger than hydrological stresses (~300 Pa) and mask hydrological modulation when multi-year tectonic stress rates are high.
Discovered a reversal in ETS propagation direction in northern Cascadia around 2012 (from northward to southward), linked to along-strike relative shear stress differences.
证实北卡斯卡迪亚颤动的季节性规律在2015年后发生转变，打破了此前认为与年际水文荷载一致的关联。
表明历史慢滑移产生的构造应力变化（~4–8 kPa）比水文应力（~300 Pa）大一个数量级，高构造应力速率会掩盖水文调制效应。
发现了2012年前后北卡斯卡迪亚ETS传播方向由向北转为向南的反转现象，并将其与沿走向的相对剪应力差异联系起来。
me: Computed tectonic shear stress changes along the subduction interface (30–50 km depth) by combining GNSS-derived time-dependent SSE slip histories with a constant inter-ETS slip deficit rate and removing the long-term linear trend.
Calculated hydrological Coulomb stress perturbations using equivalent water thickness from GRACE and GRACE-FO missions (2002–2024) via the ISSM software.
Determined ETS nucleation locations and propagation directions by linearly fitting manually picked tremor bursts and SSE stress-change arrival times along latitude.
结合GNSS反演的时变SSE滑动历史与恒定的ETS间期滑动亏损率，扣除长期线性趋势后计算了俯冲界面（30–50 km深度）的构造剪应力变化。
利用GRACE和GRACE-FO任务（2002–2024年）反演的等效水厚数据，通过ISSM软件计算了水文库仑应力扰动。
通过对人工拾取的颤动簇和SSE应力变化到时沿纬度进行线性拟合，确定了ETS的成核位置和传播方向。
de: PNSN tectonic tremor catalog (2010–2024) covering the entire Cascadia subduction zone and the Kao tremor catalog (1997–2015) for northern Cascadia.
Time-dependent slip models of 37 major SSEs (since 1994) derived from continuous GNSS observations.
Total water mass change data from GRACE and GRACE-FO missions spanning 2002–2024.
覆盖整个卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带的PNSN构造颤动目录（2010–2024年）以及北卡斯卡迪亚的Kao颤动目录（1997–2015年）。
基于连续GNSS观测反演的1994年以来37个主要慢滑移事件（SSE）的时变滑动模型。
2002至2024年期间GRACE和GRACE-FO卫星任务获取的总水质量变化数据。
li: The correlation between tremor activity and tectonic stress rate is not quantified in a rigorous statistical sense due to high uncertainty in the seasonality of tectonic stress rates.
Assumes a constant inter-ETS tectonic stress loading rate, neglecting second-order temporal variations.
Pre-2005 tectonic stress evolution is poorly constrained due to sparse GNSS network coverage.
由于构造应力率的季节性存在高度不确定性，颤动活动与构造应力率之间的相关性缺乏严格的统计量化。
假设ETS间期的构造应力加载率恒定，忽略了二阶时间变化的影响。
受限于2005年之前稀疏的GNSS台网覆盖，早期的构造应力演化约束较差。

tm.why: The paper investigates how tectonic and hydrological stress perturbations modulate episodic tremor and slip (ETS) and slow slip events (SSEs) in the Cascadia subduction zone.
It systematically examines non-tectonic environmental forcings, specifically seasonal hydrological loading derived from GRACE/GRACE-FO, on tremor seasonality.

sum: This study performs 3D dynamic rupture simulations of the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri, Tibet, earthquake using the spectral element method. Incorporating a 3D curved fault and a Bayesian von Karman parameterized initial slip, the model successfully reproduces observed InSAR coseismic deformation. The results show a predominantly unilateral northward-propagating rupture lasting ~25 s. An asymmetric initial stress distribution arrested southward propagation, while a geometric bend in the northwestern segment acted as a barrier, causing localized stress concentrations and slip rates up to ~1.0 m/s. These findings demonstrate how complex fault geometry and stress heterogeneity control normal-faulting earthquake dynamics, with significant implications for seismic hazard assessment in the Shenzha-Dingjie rift.
本研究利用谱元法对2025年西藏定日Mw 7.1地震进行三维动态破裂模拟。模型结合弯曲断层与贝叶斯参数化初始滑移，成功重现了InSAR同震形变。结果显示，非对称初始应力导致了单侧向北破裂（持续约25秒），西北段几何弯曲作为屏障引发局部应力集中。该研究揭示了断层几何与应力非均匀性对正断层地震动力学的控……

t: 3D dynamic rupture simulations using the spectral element method, incorporating a 3D curved fault with initial slip parameterized via a Bayesian von Karman approach.
基于谱元法的三维动态破裂模拟，结合三维弯曲断层及贝叶斯参数化初始滑移。
Observed Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) coseismic deformation, localized surface ruptures, and heterogeneous aftershock clusters.
观测到的InSAR同震形变数据、局部地表破裂以及余震序列空间分布。
A predominantly unilateral northward-propagating rupture lasting ~25 s, with an asymmetric stress distribution controlling directivity and a geometric bend causing slip rates of ~1.0 m/s.

First 3D dynamic rupture model of the 2025 Dingri earthquake integrating curved fault geometry and Bayesian-derived stress heterogeneity to explain InSAR and surface observations.
首次结合弯曲断层几何与贝叶斯应力非均匀性，对2025年定日地震进行三维动态破裂模拟。

成功模拟了2025年定日Mw 7.1地震的三维动态破裂过程。

sum: This study addresses the underestimation of high-frequency ground motions in physics-based simulations of the 2023 Mw 6.0 Jishishan earthquake. By developing a broadband hybrid source model that integrates deterministic features from finite-fault inversion with stochastic high-frequency components, the authors successfully reproduce observed peak ground velocity (PGV) and peak ground acceleration (PGA). The results demonstrate that simulated ground motions are jointly controlled by well-constrained large-scale rupture characteristics (slip distribution and rupture velocity) and poorly-constrained rise-time distributions. This work highlights the critical role of broadband hybrid source models in improving physics-based ground-motion simulations and seismic hazard assessments.
本文针对2023年积石山Mw 6.0级地震物理模拟中高频不足的问题，开发了宽频带混合震源模型。该模型结合了有限断层反演的确定性特征与高频成分，模拟的峰值地面速度与观测高度吻合。研究表明，地面运动受大尺度破裂特征与上升时间分布的共同控制。该成果对改进强地面运动模拟及地震危险性评估具有重要意义。

t: Broadband hybrid source modeling combining deterministic finite-fault inversion features with stochastic high-frequency components for physics-based ground-motion simulations.
结合确定性有限断层反演特征与随机高频成分的宽频带混合震源建模方法。
Observed ground-motion waveforms, PGV, and PGA from the 2023 Mw 6.0 Jishishan earthquake, alongside an inverted finite-fault rupture model.
2023年积石山Mw 6.0级地震的观测地面运动波形、PGV、PGA及有限断层破裂模型。
The hybrid source model successfully reproduces observed PGV, showing that ground motions are jointly controlled by large-scale rupture characteristics and rise-time distributions.
混合震源模型成功再现了观测的PGV，表明地面运动受破裂特征与上升时间共同控制。
Rise-time distributions, which significantly control high-frequency ground motions, are typically poorly constrained in the source model.
对高频地面运动有重要控制作用的上升时间分布通常缺乏有效约束。
Developing a broadband hybrid source model specifically for the Jishishan earthquake to resolve the underestimation of high-frequency ground motions in deterministic simulations.
针对积石山地震构建宽频带混合震源模型，解决了确定性模拟中高频不足的问题。

kc: Developed a broadband hybrid source model for the 2023 Mw 6.0 Jishishan earthquake.
Successfully reproduced observed PGV and macroseismic intensity by incorporating high-frequency components.
Demonstrated the joint control of large-scale rupture characteristics and rise-time distributions on simulated ground motions.
构建了2023年积石山Mw 6.0级地震的宽频带混合震源模型。
