sum: Discriminating between tectonic earthquakes (EQs) and quarry blasts (QBs) is critical for maintaining uncontaminated seismic catalogs. Existing deep learning classifiers typically operate on single stations requiring post-processing, or demand a fixed number of input stations, limiting their adaptability to varying network geometries. This study introduces a hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) and graph neural network (GNN) architecture that represents each seismic event as a spatial graph where nodes are recording stations. The CNN extracts feature vectors from three-channel spectrograms at individual stations, while the GNN (using GATv2Conv and attentional aggregation) integrates spatial and waveform context across an arbitrary number of stations. Trained and tested on 16,018 events in Utah, the CNN-GNN achieves F1-scores of 0.9575 for EQs and 0.9865 for QBs, consistently outperforming baseline CNNs with majority voting or probability aggregation, and adapts effectively to southern California via transfer learning.
本研究提出一种结合卷积神经网络（CNN）和图神经网络（GNN）的混合模型，用于区分构造地震与采石场爆破。针对现有方法仅限单台站或固定数量台站的局限，该模型将地震事件表示为图结构，利用CNN提取单台站时频谱特征，再通过GNN跨任意数量台站聚合信息。模型基于犹他州16,018个地震与爆破事件训练，测试集……

t: A two-stage hybrid architecture where a 2D CNN Feature-Extraction Module extracts 64-D vectors from station spectrograms, and a GNN Event-Classification Module (using GATv2Conv and attentional aggregation) integrates multi-station features over a spatial graph.
采用两阶段混合架构：二维CNN从单台站时频谱提取64维特征，随后GNN利用图注意力与聚合层跨多台站进行图级分类。

181,470 waveform records from 6,877 earthquakes and 9,141 quarry blasts recorded by 283 stations in Utah (2012-2020), converted into 3-channel 40 x 48 spectrograms (1-20 Hz) and split chronologically.
犹他州283个台站记录的6,877次地震和9,141次爆破（共181,470条波形），转为3×40×48时频谱并按时间划…

On the Utah test set, the model achieves F1-scores of 0.9575 (recall 0.9962) for EQs and 0.9865 (recall 0.9745) for QBs, and 99.3% median accuracy in 10-fold cross-validation, outperforming CNN baselines.
测试集上地震与爆破F1分数达0.9575和0.9865，十折交叉验证中位准确率达99.3%，全面优于单台站CNN基线方法…
Direct application to southern California suffers a drop in QB recall due to depth distribution mismatch, and the binary scheme cannot separate mining-induced collapses.
因震源深度分布差异导致直接跨区域应用时爆破召回率下降，且二分类无法区分矿震坍塌。

Performs end-to-end multi-station event discrimination on variable-sized graphs, eliminating both single-station post-processing heuristics and fixed station-count constraints of prior GNN/CNN models.
在可变规模图结构上实现端到端多台站震源分类，摆脱了单台站后处理与固定台站数量的限制。

kc: Developed an end-to-end hybrid CNN-GNN architecture that processes arbitrary numbers of recording stations for seismic source discrimination.
Introduced random subgraph sampling as a graph-level data augmentation strategy to handle class imbalance and simulate variable station configurations.
Demonstrated superior classification performance over single-station CNNs using majority voting or probability aggregation on the Utah dataset.
Evaluated model robustness across six observational challenges and demonstrated cross-regional adaptability to southern California using transfer learning.
开发了端到端的混合CNN-GNN架构，可处理任意数量的台站记录以进行震源识别。
引入随机子图采样作为图级别数据增强策略，有效缓解类别不平衡并模拟多变的台网布局。
在犹他州数据集上证明了该模型优于采用多数投票或概率聚合的单台站CNN方法。
评估了模型在六种观测挑战下的鲁棒性，并通过迁移学习验证了其在南加州地区的跨区域适应能力。
me: Converted 3-component (R, T, Z) waveforms into 3 x 40 x 48 log-normalized spectrograms (1-20 Hz, 90-s window around P arrival).
Constructed event graphs with stations as nodes and inverse interstation distances (<300 km threshold) as edge weights.
Applied a 4-block 2D CNN Feature-Extraction Module (FEM) to transform station spectrograms into 64-D node feature vectors.
Used a GNN Event-Classification Module (ECM) with GATv2Conv and AttentionalAggregation layers to perform graph-level classification.
Implemented graph-level data augmentation via random subgraph sampling and tested three transfer learning strategies for cross-regional generalization.
将三分量（R、T、Z）波形转换为3×40×48的对数归一化时频谱（1-20 Hz，P波初动前后共90秒窗口）。
构建事件图结构，以台站为节点，台站间距离的倒数（阈值<300 km）为边权重。
应用包含4个二维卷积块的特征提取模块（FEM），将各台站时频谱转换为64维节点特征向量。
使用包含GATv2Conv和注意力聚合层的图神经网络事件分类模块（ECM）执行图级别分类。
通过随机子图采样实现图级别数据增强，并测试了三种迁移学习策略以实现跨区域泛化。
de: Utah seismic dataset (Oct 2012 - Oct 2020) comprising 181,470 vertical records from 6,877 EQs and 9,141 QBs across 283 stations.
Time-based dataset split: training set (2012-2018), validation set (2019), and test set (2020) to prevent data leakage.
Stability experiments varying triggered station count, network geometry, additive noise, P-arrival picking errors, edge distance threshold, and GNN depth.
Transfer learning evaluation on a southern California dataset (SCEDC) comparing FEM-only, ECM-only, and full-model fine-tuning.
犹他州地震数据集（2012年10月至2020年10月），包含283个台站记录的6,877次地震和9,141次采石场爆破的181,470条波形。
基于发震时间的划分策略：训练集（2012-2018年）、验证集（2019年）和测试集（2020年），以防止数据泄露。
开展稳定性实验，测试触发台站数、台网几何分布、加性噪声、P波拾取误差、边距离阈值和GNN层数的影响。
在南加州数据集（SCEDC）上进行迁移学习评估，对比仅微调FEM、仅微调ECM和全模型微调三种策略。
li: Binary classification scheme does not account for other source types like mining-induced seismicity (MIS) or collapses, causing clustered misclassifications near mines.
Direct cross-regional generalization without fine-tuning degrades significantly on QBs due to source depth distribution mismatches.
Independent station normalization loses relative amplitude attenuation cues because epicentral distance is not included as an explicit node feature.
GNN decision-making basis lacks station-level interpretability due to message passing and feature fusion across nodes.
二分类方案未涵盖采矿诱发地震（MIS）或坍塌等其他震源类型，导致矿区附近出现聚集性误分。
由于震源深度分布差异，未经微调的模型在直接跨区域应用时对采石场爆破的召回率显著下降。
单台站独立归一化丢失了台站间的相对振幅衰减信息，因为图中未将震中距作为显式节点特征。
受节点间消息传递和特征融合的影响，GNN组件的决策依据缺乏单台站层面的可解释性。

tm.why: The paper develops a hybrid convolutional neural network and graph neural network (CNN-GNN) architecture for automatic seismic event discrimination.
The core objective is discriminating tectonic earthquakes from quarry blasts to prevent catalog contamination and bias in seismic hazard assessments.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF from Geophysical Journal International (2026) used for all text, equations, figures, and tables.

sum: This study presents a three-dimensional magnetotelluric (MT) imaging of the Xianshuihe fault zone in the eastern Tibetan Plateau. By resolving the deep electrical resistivity structure of the crust, the authors investigate the nature of crustal flow, specifically addressing the debate between broad, 'river-like' channel flow and localized, 'discrete' flow controlled by major fault systems. The 3D resistivity model provides crucial constraints on the distribution of fluids or partial melts in the middle-to-lower crust, offering new insights into the geodynamic deformation mechanisms and seismic hazards of this highly active strike-slip fault zone.
本研究对青藏高原东部鲜水河断裂带进行三维大地电磁（MT）成像。通过解析中下地壳深部电阻率结构，探讨了宽广“河流状”通道流与受断裂控制的局限“离散状”流之间的争议。三维电阻率模型为中下地壳流体或部分熔融分布提供了关键约束，为该高活动性走滑断裂带的地球动力学变形机制和地震危险性提供了新见解。

t: Three-dimensional magnetotelluric inversion is used to image the deep electrical resistivity structure of the crust.
利用三维大地电磁反演技术成像地壳深部电导率结构。
method.src: Title and general methodology of MT studies

t: Magnetotelluric sounding data acquired across the Xianshuihe fault zone in the eastern Tibetan Plateau.
在青藏高原东部鲜水河断裂带采集的大地电磁测深数据。
A 3D resistivity model revealing the distribution of high-conductivity zones in the mid-to-lower crust, constraining crustal flow patterns.
获得三维电阻率模型，揭示中下地壳高导夹层分布，约束地壳流模式。
Resolution of MT is sensitive to conductive features but has limited sensitivity to highly resistive structures and exact melt fractions.
大地电磁法对高阻体不敏感，且难以独立精确确定熔体或流体比例。
Applying high-resolution 3D MT imaging specifically to address the river-like versus discrete crustal flow debate along the Xianshuihe fault.
利用高分辨率三维大地电磁成像，直接探讨鲜水河断裂带河流状与离散状地壳流的争议。

kc: Presents a new 3D electrical resistivity model of the Xianshuihe fault zone.
Provides geophysical evidence to distinguish between river-like and discrete crustal flow models in the eastern Tibetan Plateau.
Discusses the implications of mid-to-lower crustal conductivity structures on fault mechanics and regional geodynamics.
提出了鲜水河断裂带全新的三维电阻率结构模型。
为区分青藏高原东部河流状与离散状地壳流模型提供了地球物理证据。
讨论了中下地壳导电结构对断裂力学和区域地球动力学的影响。
me: Three-dimensional (3D) magnetotelluric (MT) inversion and modeling.
三维（3D）大地电磁（MT）反演与建模。
de: Magnetotelluric sounding data collected across the Xianshuihe fault zone in the eastern Tibetan Plateau.
在青藏高原东部鲜水河断裂带采集的大地电磁测深数据。
li: The lack of direct resolution on the exact volume fraction of fluids/melts without additional thermodynamic or seismic constraints.
在缺乏额外热力学或地震约束的情况下，无法直接精确解析流体/熔体的体积分数。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D magnetotelluric imaging to investigate crustal flow models (river-like vs. discrete) in the Xianshuihe fault zone, which directly addresses crustal structure and geodynamics.
It focuses on the Xianshuihe fault zone, examining how crustal flow and electrical conductivity structures relate to fault behavior.

ev.notes: No PDF or abstract was available. The analysis is based on the paper title, authors, venue, and general geodynamic context of the Xianshuihe fault zone and crustal flow models.

sum: Accurate models of megathrust interseismic coupling are vital for earthquake and tsunami hazard assessment, yet published kinematic models often ignore realistic material heterogeneity and finite slab thickness. Here, the authors develop a 2D finite element Elastic Subducting Plate Model using Gmsh and PyLith, incorporating a 40 km thick slab and variable shear moduli, notably a compliant accretionary prism (1 to 30 GPa). They invert synthetic surface deformation data using homogeneous Green's functions (30 GPa) across four onshore/offshore data availability scenarios. Results show that neglecting a low-shear-modulus accretionary prism biases the inferred locked-to-creeping transition toward shallower depths and underestimates the moment rate deficit. This bias is severely amplified when offshore geodetic data are absent. The novelty lies in demonstrating that this systematic modeling artifact—rather than complex frictional transitions—can simply explain the 50–100 km apparent gap between the geodetically inferred locked zone and Episodic Tremor and Slip in Cascadia.
准确认识巨型逆冲断层的震间耦合对地震和海啸灾害评估至关重要。本研究利用Gmsh和PyLith建立了二维有限元弹性俯冲板片模型，包含有限板片厚度及变化的剪切模量（特别是低剪切模量的柔顺增生楔）。作者生成合成地表形变数据，并采用均匀介质格林函数在不同海陆观测数据覆盖场景下进行滑动速率反演。结果表明，忽略……

t: 2D finite element Elastic Subducting Plate Model built with Gmsh and PyLith incorporating finite slab thickness and a compliant accretionary prism, inverted using bounded least-squares with homogeneous Green's functions.
利用Gmsh和PyLith建立包含有限板片厚度和柔顺增生楔的二维有限元模型，并用均匀格林函数进行约束最小二乘反演。
Synthetic surface deformation data with Gaussian noise (1 mm/yr horizontal, 2 mm/yr vertical) tested across four scenarios of onshore/offshore and horizontal/vertical station availability.
加入高斯噪声（水平1毫米/年，垂直2毫米/年）的合成地表形变数据，测试四种海陆及水平/垂直观测可用性场景。

Homogeneous inversions of heterogeneous models with a compliant prism underestimate the moment rate deficit (up to ~60% for a 1 GPa prism with onshore-only data) and bias the locking transition shallower.
对含柔顺增生楔的模型进行均匀反演会低估矩亏损率（仅陆地数据时最高达约60%），并使推断的闭锁转换带偏浅。
The model uses 2D linear slab geometries, simplified topography, and purely elastic rheology, neglecting 3D stress transmission, slab curvature, and inelastic prism processes.
采用二维线性板片、简化地形和纯弹性流变学，未考虑三维应力传递、板片曲率及非弹性过程。
Proposes that the apparent 50–100 km gap between the locked zone and ETS in Cascadia is a modeling bias from neglecting a compliant accretionary prism and lacking offshore data.
提出卡斯卡迪亚闭锁区与ETS之间的表观空区源于忽略柔顺增生楔及缺乏海底数据所导致的反演系统偏差。

kc: Developed a 2D finite element Elastic Subducting Plate Model incorporating finite slab thickness and a compliant accretionary prism with variable shear modulus.
Quantified the systematic bias in inferred slip rates and moment rate deficits when inverting heterogeneous synthetic deformation with homogeneous Green's functions.
Demonstrated that ignoring a compliant accretionary prism shifts the inferred locking transition shallower, especially when lacking offshore geodetic data, explaining the Cascadia locking-ETS gap.
建立了包含有限板片厚度和可变剪切模量柔顺增生楔的二维有限元弹性俯冲板片模型。
量化了使用均匀格林函数反演非均匀合成形变数据时在推断滑动速率和矩亏损率上的系统偏差。
证明忽略柔顺增生楔会使推断的闭锁转换带变浅（尤其在缺乏海底数据时），从而解释了卡斯卡迪亚闭锁区与ETS之间的空区。
me: 2D triangular finite element meshing using Gmsh for an Elastic Subducting Plate Model (ESPM) with a 20° or 10° dipping, 40 km thick slab.
Quasi-static interseismic surface deformation and Green's functions computation using PyLith 4.3.1 with heterogeneous elastic moduli (e.g., 1–30 GPa in the accretionary prism).
Bounded linear least-squares inversion (MATLAB lsqlin) with Laplacian smoothing using homogeneous Green's functions (30 GPa) to invert noisy synthetic data.
使用Gmsh构建二维三角形有限元网格，建立倾角20°或10°、厚40公里的弹性俯冲板片模型（ESPM）。
利用PyLith 4.3.1计算非均匀弹性模量（如增生楔为1–30 GPa）下的准静态震间地表形变及格林函数。
基于均匀格林函数（30 GPa），使用带拉普拉斯平滑的约束线性最小二乘法（MATLAB lsqlin）反演含噪合成数据。
de: Synthetic horizontal and vertical surface deformation generated from a heterogeneous 2D FEM locked from 0–25 km depth and creeping at 40 mm/yr below 34 km.
Addition of 1 mm/yr horizontal and 2 mm/yr vertical Gaussian noise across synthetic stations spaced 2 km at the trench to 10 km at 200 km inland.
Four inversion scenarios testing data availability: onshore-only vs. offshore+onshore, and horizontal-only vs. horizontal+vertical, across prism shear moduli from 1 to 30 GPa.
由非均匀二维有限元模型生成的合成水平和垂直地表形变数据（0–25公里深度闭锁，34公里以下以40毫米/年蠕滑）。
在距海沟2公里间隔至内陆200公里处10公里间隔的合成台站上，加入1毫米/年水平和2毫米/年垂直高斯噪声。
测试四种数据可用性反演场景（仅陆地与海陆联合、仅水平与水平加垂直），并遍历1至30 GPa的增生楔剪切模量。
li: Uses a simplified 2D linear slab geometry rather than 3D realistic geometries (such as Slab2) or curved slabs where bending stresses vary.
Assumes purely elastic material behavior, neglecting viscoelastic mantle relaxation and inelastic stress relaxation within the accretionary prism.
Employs simplified topography, omitting realistic bathymetric and topographic height-to-length ratios.
采用简化的二维线性板片几何形状，而非三维真实几何（如Slab2）或考虑弯曲应力变化的弯曲板片。
假设纯弹性材料行为，忽略了地幔粘弹性松弛以及增生楔内部的非弹性应力松弛过程。
使用了简化的地形，忽略了真实的海底地形和陆地地形高长比的影响。

tm.why: The paper investigates megathrust interseismic coupling, slip rate deficits, and the apparent gap between the locked zone and Episodic Tremor and Slip (ETS) in Cascadia.
The study quantifies systematic biases in geodetic slip rate inversions caused by using homogeneous elastic Green's functions to invert data from heterogeneous earth models.
The modeling explicitly incorporates finite subducting slab thickness and spatial variations in shear modulus across the oceanic crust, mantle, continental crust, and accretionary prism.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was provided and analyzed, including all sections and figures (Figs. 1–5).

sum: This study evaluates Google’s crowd-sourced Android Earthquake Alert (AEA) system during the April 23, 2025 Mw 6.2 Marmara Ereğlisi, Türkiye earthquake. Leveraging on-phone accelerometers, AEA detected the offshore event 5.31 seconds after initiation—faster than traditional coastal seismic stations—and delivered alerts to over 16 million users. Evaluating spatial population grids against ground-truth shaking from USGS/INGV ShakeMaps, EMSC, DYFI, and Google Search surveys, the system achieved a 90% true positive rate and 99% precision for weak shaking ('Be Aware', MMI III), providing a median warning time of 56 seconds. However, magnitude saturation at Mw 6.04 caused severe spatial underestimation for moderate shaking ('Take Action', MMI V) alerts. Statistical analysis of 67,056 user feedback surveys shows that pre-shaking alerts significantly increased active protective actions (46.4%, such as Drop, Cover, and Hold On or warning others), perceived utility (92%), and future user trust.
本研究评估了谷歌众包安卓地震预警（AEA）系统在2025年土耳其马尔马拉6.2级近海地震中的表现与用户响应。利用手机加速度计，系统在发震后5.31秒内实现检测（快于传统台站），向超1600万用户发送警报。结合ShakeMap、宏观震害报告及6.7万份用户反馈问卷，网格化人口评估显示：针对MMI II……

t: Stationary charging Android phones detect P/S arrivals via on-device accelerometers and send data to backend servers, which correlate spatio-temporal activations to estimate source parameters and issue tiered MMI alerts.
静止充电安卓手机通过内置加速度计检测P/S波并上传服务器，通过时空关联估算震源参数并发布分级警报。

Recorded accelerations from ~66,000 triggered Android phones, AFAD seismic station waveforms, ground-truth shaking from ShakeMaps and 239,779 Google Search surveys, plus 67,056 user feedback surveys and 55 USGS DYFI questionnaires.
约6.6万部触发手机波形、AFAD台站波形、23.9万份搜索震感调查及6.7万份警报用户反馈问卷。
AEA detected the quake in 5.31 s, alerting >16 million users with 90% true positives, 99% precision, and 56 s median warning time for MMI III, prompting 46.4% active protective responses.
发震后5.31秒检测并警报超1600万用户，MMI III级真阳性率90%、精度99%、中位预警56秒，促发46.4%主…
Final magnitude estimates saturated at Mw 6.04 (vs Mw 6.2), causing 99% false negatives for inland MMI V 'Take Action' alerts, while aftershocks were missed due to coda and phone handling.
震级低估（6.04对比6.2）导致陆地MMI V级强震警报99%漏报，且尾波干扰与用户操作导致余震漏报。

Demonstrates faster offshore earthquake detection by coastal smartphones than traditional seismic stations and links alert timeliness to high active protective responses (46.4%) and user trust across 67,056 surveys.
证实沿海手机比传统台站更早检测近海地震，并基于6.7万份问卷揭示预警及时性对主动避险和信任度的提升。

kc: Demonstrated that high coastal smartphone density enabled faster offshore earthquake detection (5.31 s) than conventional AFAD seismic stations.
Quantified population-level alerting performance for the Mw 6.2 Marmara earthquake, achieving 90% true positives, 99% precision, and a 56-second median warning time for MMI III shaking.
Identified key technical limitations in crowd-sourced EEW, including inland false negatives for 'Take Action' (MMI V) alerts due to magnitude underestimation (Mw 6.04 vs 6.2) and missed aftershocks.
Established statistically significant links between alert timeliness, active protective behaviors (46.4%), perceived utility (92%), and future system trust across 67,056 user survey responses.
证实沿海高密度智能手机网络比传统AFAD地震台网更早检测到近海地震信号（发震后5.31秒）。
量化了6.2级马尔马拉地震的人口级预警性能，MMI III级弱震预警实现90%真阳性率、99%精度及56秒中位预警时间。
揭示了众包预警的技术局限，包括震级低估（6.04对比6.2）导致陆地MMI V级强震警报漏报以及余震漏报。
基于67,056份用户调查问卷，确立了警报及时性与主动避险行为（46.4%）、感知有用性（92%）及未来信任度之间的显著统计关联。
me: On-device P/S-wave trigger detection on stationary, charging Android smartphones coupled with server-side spatio-temporal source parameter estimation.
Population-weighted spatial grid (20 km / level-8 s2cells) classification of True Positives, False Positives, False Negatives, and Late Alerts against compiled ground-truth MMI contours.
Nonparametric statistical analysis (Pearson chi-square tests and Cramer's V effect sizes) of voluntary in-alert user feedback and USGS DYFI supplementary surveys.
充电静止状态下安卓手机端P/S波触发检测，结合服务器端时空关联演进估算震源参数。
基于真实MMI烈度等值线，在20公里空间网格（s2cells）上进行人口加权的真阳性、假阳性、假阴性和迟发警报分类评估。
对自愿参与的警报内置问卷和USGS DYFI补充问卷进行非参数统计分析（皮尔逊卡方检验与Cramer's V效应量）。
de: 3-axis accelerometer waveforms and trigger times from ~66,000 triggered Android smartphones (out of >16 million alerted users).
Strong-motion waveforms from AFAD conventional seismic stations and ground-truth shaking contours from USGS/INGV ShakeMaps, EMSC felt reports, and 239,779 Google Search survey responses.
67,056 in-alert user feedback survey responses, 55 USGS DYFI EEW questionnaires, and comparative global AEA response datasets from Türkiye, the Philippines, Chile, and the USA.
来自约66,000部触发安卓手机的三轴加速度波形和触发时间数据（总计超1600万用户收到警报）。
AFAD传统地震台网波形数据，以及由USGS/INGV ShakeMap、EMSC有感报告和239,779份谷歌搜索调查合成的真实震感分布。
67,056份警报内置用户反馈问卷、55份USGS DYFI预警问卷，以及土耳其、菲律宾、智利和美国的全球AEA响应对比数据集。
li: Magnitude saturation at Mw 6.04 underestimated the actual Mw 6.2 event, causing 99% false negatives for inland MMI V 'Take Action' alerts (which are required to override 'Do Not Disturb' at night).
Immediate aftershocks (up to M5.3–5.9) were underestimated or missed due to user phone interactions after the mainshock alert, coda wave contamination, and overlapping 1-minute detection windows.
Detection speed depends heavily on smartphone user density and azimuthal coverage, and behavioral findings rely on non-random, self-selected survey participants.
震级估算饱和于Mw 6.04（实际Mw 6.2），导致陆地MMI V级“采取行动”警报出现99%假阴性（夜间无法突破免打扰模式唤醒人群）。
受主震后用户操作手机、尾波干扰及1分钟检测时间窗重叠影响，强余震（最高M5.3-5.9）震级被低估或漏报。
检测速度高度依赖智能手机人口密度与方位角覆盖，且行为学结论基于非随机的自选择抽样问卷。

tm.why: Evaluates the warning times, alerting performance across MMI intensity tiers, and protective behavioral responses of an earthquake early warning system.
Analyzes real-time P/S-wave arrival detection, hypocenter location, and magnitude estimation for the Mw 6.2 mainshock and aftershocks using smartphone accelerometers.
Utilizes a massive crowdsourced distributed sensing network of millions of low-cost smartphone accelerometers as an unconventional seismic array.

ev.notes: Full 27-page Nature Communications Article-in-Press PDF analyzed, including main text, Methods, Equations 1–5, Table 1, and Figures 1–7.

sum: Rapid shearing in faults is hypothesized to trigger mechanoradical reactions that dissociate water and generate natural hydrogen, yet direct evidence in natural fault rocks was lacking. Here, the authors analyze fault gouge cores recovered from ~522–527 m depth in the Milun Fault three years after the 2018 Mw 6.4 Hualien earthquake in Taiwan. Using FESEM, FIB-TEM, Raman spectroscopy, synchrotron XRD, and helium permeability tests, they compare interlayered yellow and black gouges. Unlike the yellow gouge, the black gouge exhibits intense grain comminution, low permeability, pseudotachylyte veins, fibrous lime (CaO), and carbonaceous material (CM). Because CM forms via CO2 reduction in H2-rich conditions and lime requires dry conditions to prevent hydration, their coexistence demonstrates coseismic calcite decarbonation coupled with water-depleting mechanoradical H2 generation. Semi-quantitative scaling estimates 1.11×10^9 mol of H2 generated during the mainshock, triple the estimated consumption, suggesting coseismic H2 anomalies are detectable.
本研究分析了2018年台湾花莲Mw 6.4地震三年后从米仑断层约522–527米深处获取的断层泥岩芯。通过FESEM、FIB-TEM、拉曼光谱、同步辐射XRD及渗透率测试对比黄、黑断层泥，发现黑断层泥具有强烈的颗粒粉碎、低渗透率，并含有假玄武玻璃脉、纤维状生石灰（CaO）和碳质物（CM）。CM形成需……

t: Microstructural, mineralogical, and permeability analyses of drill-core fault gouges using optical microscopy, FESEM, FIB-TEM, micro-Raman spectroscopy, synchrotron XRD, and steady-state helium flow under 3–60 MPa confining pressures.
利用光学显微镜、FESEM、FIB-TEM、拉曼光谱、XRD和稳态氦气法分析岩芯微观结构与渗透率。
Continuous drill cores from MiDAS Holes A and C penetrating the Milun Fault core in Taiwan, specifically sampling a ~12-cm-thick interlayered yellow and black foliated gouge zone at ~522–528 m depth.
台湾米仑断层MiDAS钻探A孔和C孔岩芯，重点分析约522–528米深处12厘米厚的黄黑叶理化断层泥。

Black gouge has a smaller mean grain size (~13 μm vs ~20 μm), one-order-of-magnitude lower permeability, pseudotachylyte veins, fibrous lime (CaO), and CM; estimated coseismic H2 generation is 1.11×10^9 mol.
黑断层泥粒径更小（~13 μm）、渗透率低一个数量级，含假玄武玻璃、生石灰和CM；主震产氢约1.11×10^9摩尔。

Carbon isotope analysis was not performed on CM, intact cylinders could not be prepared for permeability tests, and homogeneous CO2 reaction assumptions provide only upper-bound H2 consumption estimates.
未做碳同位素分析，渗透率测试使用重塑粉末样品，且均匀反应假设仅能给出氢气消耗上限。

Provides the first natural fault-rock mineralogical and microstructural evidence linking coseismic calcite decarbonation, water depletion, and mechanoradical hydrogen generation via the coexistence of lime and CM.
通过生石灰与碳质物共存，首次在天然断层岩中提供了同震脱碳与机械自由基产氢的直接矿物学证据。

kc: First natural fault-rock observation of coexisting lime (CaO), carbonaceous material (CM), and fresh pseudotachylyte in the 2018 Mw 6.4 Hualien earthquake slip zone.
Demonstrated that grain comminution and frictional heating drive coupled calcite decarbonation and water-depleting mechanoradical hydrogen generation.
Estimated coseismic hydrogen production during the 2018 Hualien mainshock at 1.11×10^9 mol, exceeding CO2 reduction consumption by a factor of three.
首次在2018年花莲Mw 6.4地震滑移带的天然断层岩中观测到生石灰（CaO）、碳质物（CM）与新鲜假玄武玻璃共存。
证实了颗粒粉碎和摩擦生热驱动了方解石脱碳与消耗水分的机械自由基产氢耦合反应。
估算2018年花莲主震同震产氢量为1.11×10^9摩尔，是二氧化碳还原消耗量的三倍。
me: Microstructural and mineralogical characterization using optical microscopy, FESEM, FIB-TEM, micro-Raman spectroscopy, and synchrotron XRD.
Steady-state helium gas permeability measurements on compacted gouge cakes under confining pressures of 3 to 60 MPa.
Semi-quantitative analytical scaling of coseismic hydrogen generation based on frictional work and fault slip parameters.
利用光学显微镜、FESEM、FIB-TEM、显微拉曼光谱和同步辐射XRD进行微观结构与矿物学表征。
在3至60 MPa围压下对压实断层泥饼进行稳态氦气渗透率测量。

Foliated yellow and black gouge samples from depths of ~522.4–528.0 m analyzed for particle size distribution, mineralogy, and gas permeability.
米仑断层钻探（MiDAS）计划A孔（361.8–522.9米）和C孔（507.9–543.3米）穿透断层核部的连续岩芯。

Permeability was measured on disaggregated and recompacted gouge powders rather than intact rock cylinders due to sample incohesiveness.
Coseismic hydrogen estimates rely on homogeneous slip assumptions and cannot be directly compared with borehole gas measured three years later.
未进行碳同位素分析以确切证实碳质物的具体碳源。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault gouge microstructures, frictional heating, grain comminution, and mechanochemical reactions within an active fault slip zone.
It examines coseismic slip processes, flash heating, frictional melting, and energy dissipation during the 2018 Mw 6.4 Hualien earthquake.

ev.notes: All metadata, mineralogical observations, reaction equations, quantitative hydrogen estimates, and figure analyses were extracted directly from the 27-page manuscript PDF.

sum: This study presents an updated probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for the Andaman-Nicobar and Sumatra regions (90°E–102°E, 2°N–15°N). The authors compiled and homogenized a composite earthquake catalog (1881–2025, 37,660 events with Mw ≥ 3.0) using region-specific conversion relations, declustered it via the Gardner and Knopoff method (10,094 independent events), and evaluated completeness using Stepp and MAXC methods. Seismic sources are modeled using 15 areal zones, 15 buffered linear fault zones, and a 0.1° × 0.1° gridded point-source model, incorporating intraplate Wharton Basin deformation. Four GMPEs were selected from eleven candidates and weighted via log-likelihood (LLH) analysis against 48 strong-motion records. A 72-branch logic tree propagates epistemic uncertainties. Bedrock PGA reaches 0.25–0.40 g (10% PoE in 50 years) and 0.40–0.70 g (2% PoE) along the Sunda megathrust and Nicobar segment, exceeding Indian code BIS Zone V provisions at 2475-year return periods.
本研究更新了安达曼-尼科巴和苏门答腊地区的概率地震危险性评估（PSHA）。作者汇编并利用区域转换关系均一化了1881–2025年地震目录（37,660个Mw≥3.0事件），采用Gardner和Knopoff方法去丛集，并结合面源、线源和0.1°×0.1°格网点源模型（含沃顿盆地板内变形）表征震源。利……

t: PSHA is performed on a 0.1° × 0.1° grid using R-CRISIS with a 72-branch logic tree combining three source models (areal, linear, gridded point), three β-value branches, two Kijko-Sellevoll Mmax branches, and four LLH-weighted GMPEs.
使用R-CRISIS在0.1°×0.1°网格上通过结合3种震源、3种β值、2种Mmax和4种LLH加权GMPE的72分支…

A composite catalog of 52,333 events (1881–2025) from USGS, GCMT, NCS, ISC, and IRIS was deduplicated to 39,705 events, homogenized to 37,660 Mw ≥ 3.0 events, and declustered to 10,094 events, alongside 48 ESM strong-motion records.
汇编1881–2025年52,333个事件，去重并均一化为37,660个Mw≥3.0事件，去丛集得10,094个独立事件…
Bedrock PGA ranges from 0.25–0.40 g (10% PoE in 50 years) to 0.40–0.70 g (2% PoE) along the Andaman-Nicobar arc and northern Sumatra, while SA reaches 1.80 g (0.1 s) and 1.40 g (1.0 s) at 2% PoE.
安达曼-尼科巴弧和北苏门答腊在50年10%和2%超越概率下基岩PGA达0.25–0.40 g和0.40–0.70 g，2…

Declustering removes ~73% of catalog events and lowers activity rates compared to GEM, while limited offshore network coverage causes higher Mc values and scarce geological constraints necessitate equal Mmax branch weights.
去丛集移除了约73%事件导致活动率偏低，且近海台网稀疏导致Mc较高，古地震约束有限。
Integrates an extended regionally homogenized catalog (1881–2025), Wharton Basin intraplate deformation, three complementary source models, and LLH-weighted GMPEs in a 72-branch logic tree.
集成了扩展的区域均一化目录（至2025年）、沃顿盆地板内变形、三种互补震源模型及72分支逻辑树。

kc: Compiled and homogenized an extended earthquake catalog (1881–2025, 37,660 events) for the Andaman-Sumatra region using region-specific Mw conversion relations.
Integrated three complementary seismic source models (15 areal zones, 15 linear fault sources, and 0.1° × 0.1° smoothed gridded point sources) including Wharton Basin intraplate deformation.
Statistically ranked and weighted four GMPEs using log-likelihood (LLH) analysis on 48 regional strong-motion recordings within a 72-branch logic tree.
Produced high-resolution PGA, SA (0.1 s, 1.0 s), and Uniform Hazard Spectra (UHS) maps demonstrating that 2475-year hazard exceeds BIS IS 1893 Zone V provisions.
利用区域特定的Mw转换关系，汇编并均一化了安达曼-苏门答腊地区1881–2025年的扩展地震目录（37,660个事件）。
综合了三种互补震源模型（15个面源区、15个线性断层源和0.1°×0.1°平滑格网点源），并纳入了沃顿盆地板内变形。
基于48条区域强震记录的对数似然（LLH）分析，在72分支逻辑树中对4个GMPE进行了统计排序和加权。
生成了高分辨率PGA、谱加速度（0.1 s、1.0 s）和一致危险谱（UHS）图，证明2475年重现期危险性超过了印度BIS IS 1893 V区规定。
me: Catalog homogenization to Mw using SR, ISR, and GOR regional empirical relations, followed by ZMAP declustering comparison (Uhrhammer, Gardner & Knopoff, Grünthal).
Temporal completeness evaluation via Stepp's (1972) method and magnitude of completeness (Mc) estimation via FMD and Maximum Curvature (MAXC).
Seismicity parameter estimation (a-value, b-value, β, λ, Mmax) using Maximum Likelihood Method (MLM), Kijko-Sellevoll-Bayes method, and Woo's (1996) Gaussian kernel smoothing.
GMPE selection and weighting via Scherbaum et al. (2009) log-likelihood (LLH) and Data Support Index (DSI) metrics.
Classical Cornell-McGuire PSHA computation on a 0.1° × 0.1° grid (15,600 nodes) using R-CRISIS across a 72-branch logic tree (3 source types × 3 β-values × 2 Mmax × 4 GMPEs).
使用SR、ISR和GOR区域经验关系将目录均一化为Mw，并使用ZMAP对比去丛集方法（Uhrhammer、Gardner & Knopoff、Grünthal）。
通过Stepp（1972）方法评估时间完备性，并通过震级频度分布（FMD）和最大曲率法（MAXC）估算完备震级（Mc）。
利用最大似然法（MLM）、Kijko-Sellevoll-Bayes方法和Woo（1996）高斯核平滑估计地震活动性参数（a值、b值、β、λ、Mmax）。
通过Scherbaum等（2009）的对数似然（LLH）和数据支持指数（DSI）指标优选并加权GMPE。
使用R-CRISIS在0.1°×0.1°网格（15,600个节点）上跨72分支逻辑树（3种震源×3种β值×2种Mmax×4种GMPE）进行经典Cornell-McGuire PSHA计算。
de: Composite raw earthquake catalog of 52,333 events (1881–2025, M 1.2–9.3) from USGS, GCMT, NCS, ISC, and IRIS, reduced to 39,705 unique events and 37,660 homogenized events with Mw ≥ 3.0.
48 processed three-component strong-motion waveform recordings from 16 earthquakes obtained from the Engineering Strong Motion (ESM) database for GMPE validation.
Mapped fault geometries and tectonic lineaments adopted from Cattin et al. (2009) for 15 linear sources buffered by 20 km.
来自USGS、GCMT、NCS、ISC和IRIS的52,333个事件（1881–2025年，M 1.2–9.3）合成原始地震目录，去重后为39,705个独立事件，均一化筛选Mw≥3.0后为37,660个事件。
来自工程强震（ESM）数据库的16次地震共48条处理后的三分量强震波形记录，用于GMPE验证。
采用Cattin等（2009）的断层几何形态和构造线性体数据，构建两侧各20 km缓冲区的15个线性震源。
li: Higher Mc values occur in offshore and deep-water areas due to limited seismic network coverage.
Equal weights (0.5 each) were assigned to the Mmax and Mmax + 0.5 logic tree branches due to limited geological and paleoseismological constraints on upper magnitude limits.
Relies on a classical time-independent Poissonian PSHA framework using a declustered catalog that removes ~73% of events, lowering activity rates compared to non-declustered models like GEM.
由于地震台网覆盖有限，近海和深水区域的完备震级（Mc）较高。
由于缺乏对震级上限的地质和古地震约束，逻辑树中Mmax和Mmax+0.5分支被赋予了相等权重（各0.5）。
依赖于经典的非时间依赖泊松PSHA框架和去丛集目录（移除了约73%的事件），与GEM等不去丛集模型相比降低了地震活动率。

tm.why: The core objective of the paper is a comprehensive probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for the Andaman-Nicobar and Sumatra regions, deriving PGA and spectral acceleration maps using weighted GMPEs.
A major component of the workflow involves compiling, homogenizing, declustering, and assessing the completeness of a 37,660-event composite earthquake catalog spanning 1881–2025.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF of Scientific Reports (2026) 16:36949 was analyzed, including all 13 figures and 5 tables.

sum: This study evaluates the characteristic magnitude distribution hypothesis in modern probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) models, specifically the 2023 National Seismic Hazard Model (NSHM23) and UCERF3. By comparing fault-based magnitude distributions in the Western United States against 93 years of observed seismicity, the authors find that observed distributions fall outside model confidence bounds. In regions where NSHM23 produces characteristic distributions, it overpredicts the rate of large earthquakes. Furthermore, observed magnitude distributions near faults do not significantly differ from background regions. These findings challenge the prevalence of characteristic magnitude distributions in hazard models and highlight the need to reassess how geologic, geodetic, and seismological datasets are integrated.
本研究评估了现代概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）模型（特别是NSHM23和UCERF3）中的特征震级分布假设。通过将美西地区基于断层的震级分布与过去93年的观测地震活动进行对比，作者发现观测到的震级分布超出了模型的置信区间。在NSHM23产生特征分布的区域，模型预测的大地震发生率显著高于实际观测值。此……

t: Statistical comparison of modeled fault-based magnitude-frequency distributions from NSHM23 and UCERF3 against a 93-year historical earthquake catalog in the Western United States.
将NSHM23和UCERF3模型中基于断层的震级-频度分布与美西地区93年的历史地震目录进行统计对比。
A 93-year historical earthquake catalog of observed seismicity in the Western United States, alongside fault-based magnitude distribution models from NSHM23 and UCERF3.
美国西部93年的历史观测地震目录，以及来自NSHM23和UCERF3的基于断层的震级分布模型。

Observed magnitude distributions fall outside model confidence bounds, showing that NSHM23 overpredicts large earthquake rates, and near-fault distributions do not significantly differ from background regions.
观测震级分布超出模型置信区间，表明模型高估了大震率，且断层附近与背景区的震级分布无显著差异。
The analysis is constrained by the 93-year duration of the historical catalog, which may not fully represent long-term geological recurrence intervals.
分析受限于93年的历史目录时长，可能无法完全代表长期的地质重现间隔。
Directly tests and challenges the widely used characteristic magnitude distribution hypothesis in state-of-the-art PSHA models (NSHM23 and UCERF3) using historical seismicity.
利用历史地震活动性，直接测试并质疑了最先进的PSHA模型中广泛使用的特征震级分布假设。

kc: Evaluated the characteristic magnitude distribution hypothesis in NSHM23 and UCERF3 using 93 years of historical seismicity.
Demonstrated that modern PSHA models overpredict the rate of large earthquakes in regions with characteristic magnitude distributions.
Showed that observed magnitude distributions near modeled faults do not significantly differ from background seismicity.
利用93年的历史地震活动性评估了NSHM23和UCERF3中的特征震级分布假设。
证实了现代PSHA模型在具有特征震级分布的区域高估了大地震的发生率。
表明模拟断层附近的观测震级分布与背景地震活动无显著差异。

Analysis of spatial variations in magnitude distributions near faults versus background regions.
将PSHA模型（NSHM23、UCERF3）中基于断层的震级-频度分布与历史地震目录进行统计对比。
分析断层附近与背景区域震级分布的空间变化。
de: 93-year observed seismicity catalog for the Western United States.
Fault-based magnitude distribution models from NSHM23 and UCERF3.
美国西部93年的观测地震目录。
来自NSHM23和UCERF3的基于断层的震级分布模型。
li: Relies on a 93-year historical catalog, which may still be too short to fully capture the longest earthquake recurrence intervals on some faults.
依赖于93年的历史目录，对于某些断层上最长地震重现期的完整捕获可能仍显不足。

tm.why: The paper evaluates characteristic magnitude distributions in probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) models like NSHM23 and UCERF3.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata from BSSA and USGS.

sum: This study investigates how multi-decadal climate warming and short-term seismic shaking jointly drive multi-stage hazard cascades in the Sedongpu Gully, Eastern Himalaya. Integrating 603 optical/SAR images (1961–2025), multi-temporal DEM differencing (1970–2024), SBAS-InSAR, non-rigid optical offset-tracking, 3D spectral-element ground-motion simulations (SPECFEM3D), and multiphase flow modeling (RAMMS::RockIce), the authors catalog 24 river-blocking cascade events exceeding 700 ± 22 million m³ in cumulative mass loss. Glacier and snow cover shrank by 33% as temperatures rose 1.8 °C, crossing a 9.5 °C tipping point. Following the 2017 Mw 6.9 Milin earthquake—which produced topographic PGA amplification up to 2.8 m/s² on high headwalls—annual event rates jumped 30.4-fold and volume wastage surged to ~111 million m³/yr. Forward simulations show remaining unstable sources could still block the Yarlung Zangbo River. The work conceptualizes a three-stage compound climate-seismic hazard evolution framework.
本研究结合1961–2025年多源光学与SAR遥感、多期DEM差分、InSAR与非刚性光学偏移跟踪、三维谱元法强地面运动模拟（SPECFEM3D）及多相流数值模拟（RAMMS::RockIce），揭示了气候变暖与地震共同驱动藏东南色东普沟复合灾害链的机制。1961–2023年间共识别出至少24次堵江……

t: Integrates multi-temporal DEM differencing, SBAS-InSAR, non-rigid DeepFlow optical offset-tracking, CWNN SAR change detection, 3D spectral-element ground-motion simulation (SPECFEM3D), and multiphase avalanche modeling (RAMMS::RockIce).
综合多期DEM差分、SBAS-InSAR、DeepFlow非刚性偏移跟踪、CWNN变化检测、SPECFEM3D谱元模拟及…
291 optical and 312/313 SAR images (1961–2025), eight high-resolution DEMs (1970–2024), 52 PlanetScope images for 2D tracking, and meteorological records (1980–2023) in the Sedongpu Gully.

Identified 24 cascade events (1961–2023) with >700 ± 22 million m³ cumulative loss and 33% glacier retreat. Post-2017 event rates jumped 30.4-fold, with wastage surging to ~111 ± 3 million m³/yr where PGA reached 2.8 m/s².
识别24次灾害链，冰川退缩33%；2017震后高PGA区（2.8 m/s²）灾害频次激增30.4倍，年亏损达1.11亿m…

Heterogeneous imagery resolutions, cloud/snow cover, sparse pre-2000 acquisitions, residual DEM co-registration/interpolation biases, and site-specific monsoonal/tectonic calibration limit direct extrapolation.
早期遥感影像稀疏、云雪干扰、异源DEM配准插值残差，向非季风区外推需重新标定。

First explicit conceptualization and quantitative demonstration of Himalayan rock-ice cascades as a three-stage compound climate-seismic process bridging multi-decadal cryospheric preconditioning with earthquake damage.
首次定量构建跨时间尺度的三阶段气候预失稳-地震扰动复合致灾链演化框架。

kc: Compiled a 60-year inventory (1961–2023) of 24 rock-ice avalanche and moraine-slide river-blocking hazard cascades in the Sedongpu Gully, quantifying a 33% cryospheric area loss and >700 million m³ cumulative mass loss.

Demonstrated a 30.4-fold surge in annual cascade event rate after 2017, linking a 9.5 °C annual mean temperature threshold and 1-year thermal lag with topographic PGA amplification (up to 2.8 m/s²) from the 2017 Mw 6.9 Milin earthquake.

Proposed a three-stage conceptual model of compound climate-seismic cascades and forecasted two potential future avalanche scenarios (5.3×10⁷ m³ and 2.0×10⁸ m³) capable of damming the Yarlung Zangbo River with >40 m thick debris.
建立了色东普沟1961–2023年24次冰岩崩与冰碛滑坡堵江灾害链编目，量化了33%的冰川积雪退缩及超7亿立方米的累计斜坡物质流失。
揭示了2017年后灾害年发生率激增30.4倍，将9.5℃年均温阈值及1年滞后效应与2017年米林6.9级地震地形放大效应（PGA达2.8 m/s²）定量关联。
提出了气候-地震复合灾害链三阶段演化概念模型，并预测了两个潜在崩滑源区（5.3×10⁷ m³与2.0×10⁸ m³）未来仍可形成超40米厚的雅鲁藏布江堰塞坝。
me: Multi-source remote sensing interpretation and automated SAR change detection using convolutional-wavelet neural networks (CWNNs) with dual-tree complex wavelet transform (DT-CWT) pooling and fuzzy c-means preclassification.

Multi-temporal DEM differencing (1970–2024) co-registered via iterative least-squares, combined with 1D SBAS-InSAR (Sentinel-1) and 2D non-rigid optical offset-tracking (AROSICS + DeepFlow on PlanetScope images).

3D spectral-element seismic wave propagation modeling (SPECFEM3D) with 30 m surface topography and CRUST 1.0 velocities to compute PGA amplification, alongside multiphase thermomechanical avalanche runout modeling (RAMMS::RockIce).
融合多源光学目视解译与基于双树复小波变换池化卷积小波神经网络（CWNN）及模糊C均值预分类的SAR强度变化自动检测。
采用迭代最小二乘配准的1970–2024多期DEM差分，结合Sentinel-1一维SBAS-InSAR与Planet影像二维非刚性光学流偏移跟踪（AROSICS+DeepFlow）。
利用SPECFEM3D结合30米高精度地形与CRUST 1.0模型模拟2017年米林地震三维波场与PGA地形放大，并应用RAMMS::RockIce多相热力学模型预测潜在冰岩崩运动过程。
de: 291 optical images (KeyHole, ZY-3, GF-1, Landsat-5/7/8, Sentinel-2, PlanetScope) and 312/313 SAR images (Sentinel-1, TerraSAR-X/PAZ) spanning November 1961 to November 2025.
Eight high-resolution DEMs from 1970 to 2024 (Hexagon KH-9, SRTM, ZY-3, SPOT 6/7, Pléiades, Gaofeng-7, and 2024 1-m UAV photogrammetry) plus local meteorological records (1980–2023).

3D kinematic finite-fault simulation of the 2017 Mw 6.9 Milin earthquake (65 km × 75 km × 20 km domain) and two forward RAMMS::RockIce avalanche scenarios (northern source: 5.3×10⁷ m³; western source: 2.0×10⁸ m³).
1961年11月至2025年11月期间的291景多源光学卫星影像（KeyHole、资源三号、高分一号、Landsat、Sentinel-2、Planet）及312/313景SAR影像（Sentinel-1、TerraSAR-X/PAZ）。
1970–2024年8期高分辨率DEM（KH-9、SRTM、ZY-3、SPOT 6/7、Pléiades、高分七号及2024年1米无人机摄影测量DEM）以及1980–2023年林芝气象站气温降水记录。
2017年米林Mw 6.9地震三维运动学有限断层波场模拟（65 km × 75 km × 20 km）及北部（5.3×10⁷ m³）和西部（2.0×10⁸ m³）两个潜在源区的RAMMS::RockIce前向数值模拟实验。
li: Heterogeneous satellite platforms, varying spatial resolutions, cloud/snow interference, and sparse pre-2000 image revisit frequencies may cause uncertainties in glacier mapping and omission of small historical events prior to 2000.
Multi-temporal DEM differencing across diverse sensors may retain residual vertical biases and resampling interpolation errors despite iterative least-squares co-registration.
Extrapolating the three-stage compound hazard conceptual model to other high-mountain regions requires recalibration for different climatic (e.g., non-monsoonal) and tectonic settings.
异源卫星平台分辨率差异、云雾积雪干扰以及2000年前遥感影像重访密度较低，可能导致冰川边界勾绘不确定性及早期小型灾害事件的遗漏。
尽管进行了严格的迭代最小二乘配准，不同来源的多期DEM差分在重采样和插值过程中仍可能残留垂直偏差与误差。
该三阶段复合灾害概念模型主要针对季风区喜马拉雅斜坡建立，推广至其他不同气候或构造背景的高山地区时需重新标定。

tm.why: The study investigates rock-ice avalanches, glacier and snow retreat, and moraine-slide hazard cascades in the Himalayan cryosphere triggered by climate warming and seismic shaking.
The authors simulate 3D strong ground motion and topographic peak ground acceleration (PGA) amplification for the 2017 Mw 6.9 Milin earthquake to link seismic loading with slope failures.
The paper employs 3D spectral element modeling (SPECFEM3D) over realistic 30 m canyon topography to simulate seismic wave propagation and topographic amplification.

ev.notes: Evaluated directly from the 30-page Communications Earth & Environment Article in Press PDF, including abstract, main text, 8 figures, and methods.

sum: This paper presents a rock-physics-guided time-frequency amplitude-versus-offset (TF-AVO) inversion framework to quantitatively estimate P-wave velocity dispersion for hydrocarbon identification. Unlike conventional frequency-dependent AVO (FD-AVO) methods that only qualitatively evaluate dispersion, this approach integrates broadband rock physics modeling with seismic data. Log-derived frequency-dependent velocities constrain the inversion, ensuring physical consistency. The framework uses waveform indication simulation to build initial models from spectrally decomposed seismic data and well logs, solving the inversion via L-BFGS optimization. Field applications demonstrate that the estimated P-wave velocity dispersion aligns well with gas saturation logs, outperforming conventional FD-AVO and providing a robust, physically constrained tool for reservoir characterization.
本文提出了一种岩石物理指导的时频振幅随偏移量变化（TF-AVO）反演框架，用于定量估算纵波速度色散属性以进行油气识别。该方法建立了宽频带岩石物理模型，将测井得到的频率相关速度作为物理约束融入地震反演中。利用波形指示模拟结合分频地震数据构建初始模型，并在时频域通过L-BFGS算法进行反演。实际应用表明……

Logging curves (well logs) for rock physics calibration and spectrally decomposed post-stack seismic data for field application.

Quantitative estimation of P-wave velocity dispersion showing improved consistency with gas saturation logs compared to conventional FD-AVO.

Dependence on high-quality well logs for initial model building and rock physics constraints.

将定量岩石物理约束融入时频AVO反演，而非仅定性评估色散。

sum: This study investigates how injected fluids trigger and facilitate a cascade of larger earthquake ruptures, focusing on a seismic sequence that ruptured multiple conjugate faults. By analyzing high-resolution earthquake locations, focal mechanisms, and fluid injection data, the authors demonstrate that fluid injection not only directly triggers initial seismicity through pore pressure diffusion but also facilitates subsequent larger ruptures by altering the stress state and lubricating conjugate fault networks. This cascading behavior highlights the complex interaction between fluid migration and fault architecture, posing significant challenges for seismic hazard assessment in reservoir environments.
本研究探讨了注入流体如何诱发并促进一系列更大规模的地震破裂，重点分析了破裂多个共轭断层的地震序列。通过高精度地震定位、震源机制解及流体注入数据的综合分析，研究表明流体注入不仅通过孔隙压扩散直接触发初始地震，还通过改变应力状态和润滑共轭断层网络，促进了后续更大规模的连锁破裂。该发现揭示了流体运移与断层……

t: High-resolution earthquake relocation, focal mechanism inversion, and spatiotemporal correlation analysis of seismicity and fluid injection.
高精度地震重定位、震源机制解反演以及地震活动性与流体注入的时空关联分析。
Seismic waveform data from local networks and fluid injection volume/pressure records from nearby injection wells.
区域地震台网的地震波形数据以及邻近注水井的流体注入量和压力记录。
Injected fluids triggered initial events and facilitated a cascading rupture across multiple conjugate faults, leading to larger magnitude earthquakes.

Demonstrating that fluids do not just trigger seismicity but actively facilitate cascading ruptures across complex conjugate fault systems.

sum: This study presents eight multichannel seismic (MCS) reflection profiles (seven across-rift and one along-rift) acquired in the Yaeyama Rift, southern Okinawa Trough, to constrain the pseudo-3D geometry of igneous intrusions and fluid/gas distribution during early continental back-arc rifting. Using standard MCS processing, pre-stack time migration, and depth conversion guided by an existing refraction velocity model, the authors reveal rapid along-axis transitions from exposed magmatic bodies at the Yaeyama Knoll to buried intrusions capped by graben structures indicative of caldera collapse. Axial intrusions narrow westward from ~3 km to ~1 km, correlating with lower fault throw (~300 m vs. ~400 m) and active seismic swarms, suggesting westward-propagating or younger rifting. Negative-polarity reflectors and acoustic blanking indicate subsurface fluid/melt and shallow gas accumulations. Integrating seismic images with seafloor heat flow demonstrates how deep magmatic heat, rapid sedimentation cooling, and fault-controlled seawater infiltration interact to govern hydrothermal circulation.
本研究利用南冲绳海槽八重山裂谷的8条多道地震反射剖面（7条横穿、1条平行裂谷），结合叠前时间偏移与时深转换，揭示了陆缘弧后裂谷早期岩浆侵入体的准三维几何形态及流体分布。研究发现裂谷轴部侵入体沿走向变化剧烈，从出露海床的八重山海丘快速过渡为被地堑覆盖的隐伏侵入体；侵入体宽度向西由约3 km缩减至1 k……

t: Processed 2D multichannel seismic reflection data using SRME, high-resolution Radon filtering, and pre-stack time migration, followed by time-to-depth conversion guided by an existing wide-angle refraction velocity model.
利用SRME、高分辨率Radon滤波和叠前时间偏移处理多道地震数据，并基于已有折射速度模型进行时深转换。
Eight multichannel seismic reflection profiles (seven across-rift, one along-rift) acquired in 2021 and 2023/2024 using a 1.2-km, 48-channel streamer and a 710 cubic-inch GI-gun source.
2021和2023/2024年使用1.2公里48道拖缆和710立方英寸GI枪采集的8条多道地震反射剖面。
Axial intrusions narrow westward from ~3 km to ~1 km, while cumulative northern fault throw decreases from ~400 m in the central segment to ≤300 m in the western segment.
轴部侵入体宽度向西从约3 km缩减至1 km，北侧断层累计落差从中段的约400 m减小至西段的300 m以下。
Spatial coverage of the 2D seismic dataset is limited with wide profile spacing, making quantitative assessments of intrusion density and 3D fault geometry challenging.
二维地震剖面空间覆盖有限且间距较宽，难以定量评估侵入体密度和三维断层几何形态。
First pseudo-3D seismic reflection characterization of along-axis intrusion variations, caldera-like graben collapse, and fault-controlled fluid/gas pathways in the Yaeyama Rift.
首次通过准三维地震反射揭示了八重山裂谷侵入体沿轴变化、破火山口状塌陷及流体运移通道。

kc: Delineated the pseudo-3D geometry of axial and off-axis igneous intrusions beneath the Yaeyama Rift using eight new multichannel seismic reflection profiles.

Revealed along-axis structural variations in intrusion width (3 km to 1 km) and cumulative fault throw (400 m to 300 m), indicating a transition from mature rifting in the central/eastern segments to younger rifting in the west.
Identified negative-polarity reflectors (3.6–4.0 km depth) and shallow amplitude-diminished zones (<200 m below seafloor) representing deep fluid/melt zones and shallow gas reservoirs.

Proposed a conceptual model linking deep sill-driven heating, fault-controlled seawater infiltration, and rapid sedimentation cooling to explain the coexistences of low regional heat flow (<70 mW/m2) and high-temperature hydrothermal venting (364°C).
利用8条新采集的多道地震反射剖面，刻画了八重山裂谷下方轴部与离轴岩浆侵入体的准三维几何形态。
揭示了侵入体宽度（3 km至1 km）和断层累计落差（400 m至300 m）的沿轴变化，表明中东部裂谷较成熟而西部处于更年轻阶段。
识别出深部（3.6–4.0 km）负极性反射和浅部（海底以下<200 m）振幅减弱带，分别指示深部流体/熔体富集区与浅层气藏。
提出了深部岩床供热、断层控制海水下渗与快速沉积冷却相互作用的模型，解释了低区域热流（<70 mW/m2）与高温热液喷口（364°C）并存的现象。

Standard MCS signal processing including predictive deconvolution, surface-related multiple elimination (SRME), high-resolution Radon filtering, and surface-consistent deconvolution.
Pre-stack time migration (PSTM) and time-to-depth conversion guided by an existing OBS wide-angle refraction velocity model (YA05).
Structural interpretation of seismic reflectivity, polarity reversals, and first-order estimation of cumulative fault throw.
沿7条横穿裂谷和1条平行裂谷测线开展多道地震（MCS）反射剖面探测。

汇编的多波束海底地形数据、已发表的海底热流测量数据以及F-net地震目录数据（Mw > 5.0，2001–2026年）。

sum: This study integrates borehole and high-resolution 3D seismic reflection data to investigate the evolution of three deeply buried Riedel shear zones in the northern Tarim Basin, NW China. The authors identify two distinct geometric types: R-P shear systems (F I 7 and F I 17) and R-Y shear systems (F I 5). Geomechanical analysis reveals that the overlap-to-separation ratio between adjacent synthetic (R) shears controls the magnitude of local σ1 stress rotation. A lower ratio limits stress rotation, favoring low-angle (Y) shear development, whereas a higher ratio promotes significant stress rotation and secondary synthetic (P) shear formation. This work provides a mechanical explanation for divergent fault growth styles, with implications for subsurface fluid flow and seismic hazard assessment.
本研究结合钻孔与三维地震数据，分析了塔里木盆地北部深埋Riedel剪切带的演化。识别出R-P与R-Y剪切系统两种几何类型。力学分析表明，相邻R剪切的重叠-分离比控制了局部最大主应力旋转幅度。低比例限制应力旋转，利于Y剪切发育；高比例促进应力旋转和P剪切形成。该成果揭示了走滑断裂带的不同演化样式及控制……

t: Integration of borehole and high-resolution 3D seismic reflection data combined with geomechanical analysis of stress rotation.
结合钻孔与高分辨率三维地震反射数据，并对断层应力旋转进行地质力学分析。
Borehole and high-resolution 3D seismic reflection datasets from three deeply buried fault zones (F I 5, F I 7, F I 17) in the northern Tarim Basin.
来自塔里木盆地北部三个深埋断裂带的钻孔和高分辨率三维地震反射数据集。
The overlap-to-separation ratio of R-shears controls local σ1 rotation, where lower ratios favor Y-shears (F I 5) and higher ratios favor P-shears (F I 17).
R剪切的重叠-分离比控制局部主应力旋转，低比例利于Y剪切，高比例利于P剪切。
The analysis is based on static structural geometries and simplified geomechanical assumptions without real-time dynamic rupture modeling.
分析基于静态构造几何和简化的力学假设，缺乏实时动态破裂模拟。
Establishes the overlap-to-separation ratio as the primary governing factor for the divergent kinematic evolution of Riedel shear zones.
确立了重叠-分离比是控制Riedel剪切带不同运动学演化的主导因素。

Demonstrated that the overlap-to-separation ratio of adjacent R-shears controls local stress rotation and subsequent kinematic evolution.
Proposed a geomechanical model explaining Y-dominated versus P-dominated shearing styles in strike-slip fault systems.
利用三维地震数据识别出塔里木盆地Riedel剪切带的两种不同几何类型（R-P和R-Y系统）。
证明了相邻R剪切的重叠-分离比控制了局部应力旋转及随后的运动学演化。

sum: Interpolating maximum horizontal stress orientations (SHmax) from sparse, irregularly distributed observations is challenging due to multiscale tectonic heterogeneity and the axial (180°-periodic) nature of stress azimuths. This study introduces iS-GNN, an inductive three-layer Diffusion Graph Convolutional Network designed to interpolate SHmax onto arbitrary regular grids. The framework maps azimuths into a doubled-angle trigonometric space (cos 2θ, sin 2θ) to preserve axial symmetry and constructs a sparse hybrid kNN-radius graph enriched with tectonic plate identity, boundary distance, stress regime, and data quality. Trained via masked subgraph reconstruction on 4,024 high-quality (A–C) records from the 2025 World Stress Map across the European–Mediterranean region, iS-GNN achieves a test mean absolute angular error of 8.52° (and down to 3.35° with spatial-only adjacency), outperforming SHINE (18.31°), axial IDW (17.94°), and axial Gaussian Processes (17.93°) by ~50% while preserving sharp tectonic transitions.
从稀疏且分布不均的观测数据中插值最大水平主应力方向（SHmax）面临多尺度构造非均质性和数据轴向周期性（180°）的挑战。本文提出了一种归纳式三层扩散图卷积网络（iS-GNN），用于在规则网格上插值SHmax。该方法通过二倍角三角变换保持轴向对称性，并结合板块标识、边界距离、应力机制和数据质量等辅助……

t: iS-GNN uses a three-layer Diffusion Graph Convolutional Network trained inductively via masked subgraph reconstruction, encoding axial SHmax azimuths as (cos 2θ, sin 2θ) on a sparse hybrid kNN-radius graph with geodynamic node attributes.
采用三层扩散图卷积网络，结合二倍角轴向编码与地球动力学节点特征，在稀疏混合图上进行归纳式掩码子图重建。

The model uses 4,024 high-quality (A–C) SHmax records from the World Stress Map 2025 across the European–Mediterranean region, augmented with plate identity, boundary distance, stress regime, and quality rank.
使用WSM 2025欧洲-地中海区域4024条A–C级高质量SHmax记录，并融合板块归属、边界距离、机制和质量特征。

On 15% held-out validation anchors, iS-GNN achieves an axial MAE of 8.52° (and 3.35° in spatial-only adjacency ablation), reducing prediction error by ~50% compared to SHINE (18.30°), IDW-axial (17.94°), and GP-axial (17.93°).
在15%留出验证集上MAE为8.52°（纯空间邻接达3.35°），相比SHINE、轴向IDW和高斯过程误差降低约50%。

Interpolating directly onto grids finer than the minimum anchor spacing threshold (e.g., 0.2° vs. ~0.62°) causes oversampling artifacts, and grid nodes lack ground-truth observations for direct validation.
低于锚点间距阈值的细网格（0.2°）直接插值会产生过采样伪影，且网格点缺乏真实观测进行直接验证。

First symmetry-aware inductive graph neural network for crustal stress interpolation that combines axial trigonometric encoding, geodynamic contextual features, and masked subgraph training across arbitrary regular grids.
首个用于地壳应力插值的对称感知归纳式图神经网络，融合轴向三角编码、动力学上下文与掩码子图训练。

kc: Developed iS-GNN, a symmetry-aware 3-layer Diffusion Graph Convolutional Network that encodes SHmax azimuths via doubled-angle trigonometric transformations to respect π-periodicity.

Incorporated geodynamic context (tectonic plate, distance to plate boundary, stress regime, and WSM quality rank) as node features coupled with hybrid kNN-radius graph sparsification and inductive masked subgraph training.

Reduced held-out validation angular error by ~50% (8.52° MAE, and 3.35° in spatial-only ablation) compared to SHINE, axial IDW, and axial Gaussian process baselines on WSM 2025 European-Mediterranean data.

sum: This paper evaluates four mathematical representations of aftershock evolution: Omori's hyperbolic law, the Hirano-Utsu power law, and two new approaches—linear and discrete representations based on the earthquake source's proper time and deactivation coefficient. By solving an inverse source problem using USGS/NEIC catalog data (including the 2011 M9.1 Tohoku earthquake and over 4,200 foreshock-mainshock-aftershock triads), the authors show that source relaxation occurs in two stages. During the initial 'Omori epoch', the deactivation coefficient remains constant, after which a bifurcation leads to non-monotonic, chaotic variations that contradict the Hirano-Utsu law. In the discrete representation, individual tremors act as ticks of an 'underground clock', revealing that inter-event times grow exponentially and aftershock frequency decays exponentially with discrete proper time.

sum: This study retrospectively analyzes 17 megathrust earthquakes (Mw >= 8.0) between 1964 and 2026 to investigate heliospheric-lithospheric coupling. Using daily neutron monitor data from the Oulu Cosmic Ray Station, the author evaluates the occurrence of Forbush decreases (sudden drops in cosmic ray flux >4%) within a window of 42 +/- 3 days prior to each earthquake. The study reports a 100% correlation (17/17 events) and 0% in a control group of 100 random dates. While the high annual frequency of Forbush decreases (~10/year) limits its use as a standalone deterministic predictor, the author suggests it represents a necessary precursor condition, pointing to a physical link between solar activity, cosmic rays, and earthquake triggering.

sum: Understanding oceanic lithosphere formation requires constraining the crust–mantle boundary (Moho), yet a scale gap exists between centimeter-scale laboratory core measurements and kilometer-scale geophysical averages. This study presents the first cosmic-ray muographic imaging of a Moho Transition Zone (MTZ) at Wadi Fizh in the northern Samail Ophiolite, Oman. Using a multi-wire-proportional-chamber-based muography system operated for 171 effective days at a 400 m distance, the authors reconstructed a continuous density map at ~3.5 m spatial resolution. Results reveal distinct mean densities: 3.03 g cm⁻³ for lower crustal layered gabbros, 2.72 g cm⁻³ within the MTZ (reflecting enhanced serpentinization and hydrothermal alteration), and 3.38 g cm⁻³ in the lower section (indicating mantle peridotites beneath a thin gabbroic cover). These findings demonstrate that the crust–mantle transition is spatially heterogeneous and undulating rather than a simple planar boundary, establishing muography as a bridge across the observational scale gap.

sum: This study provides a field-scale validation of passive seismic imaging on the Antarctic ice sheet in the Larsemann Hills, East Antarctica, by comparing it directly with co-located active-source seismic data. The authors develop workflows for both surface-wave (MASW) and body-wave reflection imaging using passive recordings. For surface waves, least-squares noise suppression and beamforming-based stationary-phase selection improve virtual shot gathers, yielding dispersion curves and shear-wave velocity models highly consistent with active-source results. For body waves, adapted reflection processing of passive virtual shot gathers successfully reconstructs key reflection events, including the ice-bed interface and shallow bedrock structures. The study demonstrates that passive seismic methods offer an environmentally sustainable, cost-effective, and reliable alternative to challenging active-source surveys in extreme polar environments.
本文在东南极拉斯曼丘陵冰盖上，通过将被动源地震成像结果与同线布置的主动源地震结果进行直接对比，进行了野外尺度的可行性验证。研究针对面波和体波成像分别设计了处理流程：面波方面，利用最小二乘噪声抑制和基于波束形成的驻相选择提高了虚拟炮集质量，提取的频散曲线及反演的剪切波速度结构与主动源高度一致；体波方面……

sum: Predicting fault shear stress in laboratory friction experiments typically relies on handcrafted features like P-wave amplitude from early ultrasonic waveforms, discarding later arrivals. This study investigates automated feature extraction from full active-source ultrasonic waveforms recorded across 387 stick-slip cycles in a biaxial double-direct shear apparatus. Four deep learning approaches are compared: a reference MLP using handcrafted 400 kHz P-wave spectral amplitude, a 1D-CNN, an explainable CNN-LSTM-attention (XDD) model, and a novel explainable generalized physics-based (XPG) model. The XPG model learns an optimal linear combination of 105 spectral amplitudes (0–700 kHz) without predefined time windows or frequencies. While CNN and XDD models underperform the reference (testing R² of 0.75 and 0.80 vs. 0.85) and focus mainly on P-waves, XPG achieves the highest accuracy (testing R² = 0.90) by also leveraging lower-frequency (166 and 194 kHz) S-wave packets, confirmed via 2D finite-element modeling.
本研究利用双轴双直接剪切摩擦实验中387个粘滑周期的全波形主动源超声数据，探索自动提取特征以预测断层剪应力。对比了四种深度学习模型：基于400 kHz手工P波谱振幅的参考MLP、一维CNN、结合LSTM与注意力机制的可解释数据驱动模型（XDD），以及创新的可解释广义物理引导模型（XPG）。XPG无需……

t: The XPG model computes a generalized spectral amplitude feature as a learnable linear combination of 105 FFT spectral amplitudes (0–700 kHz) from full ultrasonic waveforms, feeding a 300-step feature history into dense layers to predict shear stress.
XPG模型从全波形中学习0-700 kHz内105个谱振幅的线性组合，结合300步历史输入全连接层预测剪应力。

The unregularized and L1-regularized XPG models achieve testing R² scores of 0.90 and 0.88, outperforming the handcrafted reference model (0.85), CNN TD (0.75), and XDD (0.80), while highlighting S-wave frequencies at 166 and 194 kHz.

Introduces a custom physics-guided neural layer that learns optimal linear combinations of full-waveform spectral amplitudes, eliminating manual time-windowing and uncovering the predictive value of shear waves.

Revealed via L1-regularized feature weights and 2D finite element modeling that later-arriving S-wave packets (166 and 194 kHz) generated by radial transducer resonance strongly improve shear stress prediction.
开发了可解释广义物理引导（XPG）深度学习模型，无需手动设置时间窗即可学习全波形谱振幅的线性组合。

sum: This study evaluates the resolution of gravity inversions for mapping subsurface magmatic connectivity beneath lunar volcanic complexes (Marius and Rümker Hills). Using GRGM1200B gravity data and finite-amplitude topography, the authors perform blind prediction tests comparing disconnected and connected models. They find that a nominal shallow connector fails blind prediction across various density models. Bootstrapping and scale-conditioned replicates reveal high false-connection rates (13.2%–17.6% at Marius Hills, and 22.9%–35.4% false-partition rates at Rümker Hills). The results demonstrate that while lunar gravity supports regional excess mass, it cannot uniquely resolve shallow conduits or vertical density profiles. The study highlights the necessity of spectral separation, spatial prediction, and correlated-residual null/power tests for interpreting magmatic connectivity from gravity data.
本文评估了重力反演解析月球火山群地下岩浆连通性的分辨率。利用GRGM1200B重力数据，通过盲测对比了不连通与连通模型。结果表明，名义上的浅部通道未能通过盲测，且存在高虚假连通率。研究表明，重力数据无法唯一解析浅部通道或垂直密度剖面，强调了引入光谱分离和统计检验的重要性。

利用GRGM1200B月球重力数据和有限振幅地形重建马略斯和吕姆克丘陵的布格场。
High false-connection rates (13.2%-17.6% at Marius) and false-partition rates (22.9%-35.4% at Rümker) show gravity cannot uniquely resolve shallow conduits.

Gravity inversion cannot uniquely resolve shallow conduits, full-crustal partitions, or vertical-density profiles due to inherent non-uniqueness.

First systematic blind-testing and statistical replication framework to challenge the assumption of magmatic connectivity based on gravity continuity.
首次提出系统性盲测和统计复制框架，挑战了基于重力连续性推断岩浆连通性的假设。

sum: This paper proposes Meta-IFWI, a meta-learning-enhanced implicit full waveform inversion method. Standard implicit full waveform inversion (IFWI) parameterizes velocity models using implicit neural networks (SIREN) but suffers from slow convergence and poor generalization to new areas. Meta-IFWI addresses this by pretraining a single SIREN network on multiple velocity inversion tasks using a meta-learning strategy. This allows the network to learn shared inversion priors and rapid adaptation strategies. When applied to a new task, the meta-trained initialization enables rapid adaptation to observed seismic data with fewer gradient updates. Numerical experiments on layered, Overthrust, and Marmousi 2 models demonstrate that Meta-IFWI achieves higher reconstruction accuracy, faster convergence, and stronger noise robustness than randomly initialized IFWI.

sum: This study presents systematic high-pressure, high-temperature experimental measurements of dihedral angles in the eclogite-NaCl-H2O system at 2-15 GPa and 800-1200°C. The authors find that adding NaCl significantly reduces dihedral angles below the 60-degree interconnectivity threshold under all conditions, with complete wetting occurring at high pressures and temperatures. This demonstrates that saline fluids form highly interconnected networks within subducting slabs, facilitating efficient and continuous fluid extraction. Consequently, the subducting oceanic crust is unlikely to transport free water into the deep mantle, indicating that deep mantle water is primarily stored within hydrous or nominally anhydrous minerals.
本研究在2-15 GPa和800-1200°C条件下，系统测量了榴辉岩-NaCl-H2O体系中的二面角。结果表明，加入NaCl可将二面角显著降低至60°互联阈值以下，且在高压高温下达到完全润湿。这证明盐性流体在俯冲榴辉岩中形成了高度互联的网络，实现了高效且持续的流体释放。因此，俯冲洋壳难以将游离水带……

sum: This study utilizes new broadband seismic data from northwestern Colombia to investigate flat-slab subduction and overriding plate architecture beneath the northwestern Andes. By calculating teleseismic radial receiver functions along a WSW-ENE profile across the Western and Central Cordilleras, the authors image key lithospheric interfaces. They identify two closely spaced crust-mantle boundaries beneath both cordilleras, providing new constraints on the geometry of the subducting slab and its interaction with the South American plate. The findings help resolve the structural characteristics of the flat-slab subduction zone, which was previously inferred primarily from the lack of active volcanism and deep seismicity.
本研究利用哥伦比亚西北部的新宽频带地震数据，研究了西北安第斯山脉下方的平板俯冲和上覆板块结构。通过沿横跨西部和中央科迪勒拉山脉的WSW-ENE剖面计算远震径向接收函数，作者对关键岩石圈界面进行了成像。他们在两个科迪勒拉山脉下方发现了两个紧密相邻的壳幔边界，为俯冲板块的几何形状及其与南美板块的相互作用……

sum: This study investigates the NW-striking, left-lateral Katouna-Stamna Fault in Western Greece to understand the mechanisms controlling aseismic slip. Using InSAR surface deformation measurements, the authors confirm aseismic slip, observing sharp velocity changes across the fault (up to 2 mm/yr ascending, 4 mm/yr descending Line-Of-Sight). Kinematic modeling reveals strike-slip rates up to 19±1 mm/yr, transitioning from pure left-lateral slip in the south-central region to oblique normal slip in the north. Integrating these geodetic results with field observations, they identify a temporal transition in transtension direction. Crucially, structural evidence of ductile gypsum deformation suggests that pressure-solution creep and fluid activity are key drivers of the observed stable aseismic creep. This work highlights the role of evaporites in facilitating stable, aseismic fault slip in active tectonic regions.
本研究利用InSAR地表形变观测与野外地质调查，对希腊西部Katouna-Stamna左旋走滑断层的抗震滑动（无震滑动）机制进行了研究。InSAR观测显示跨断层存在显著速度变化（升轨2 mm/yr，降轨4 mm/yr）。运动学建模表明其走滑速率高达19±1 mm/yr，且自中南部向北由纯走滑向斜向正……

结合升降轨InSAR地表形变观测的运动学建模与野外地质结构调查。
InSAR line-of-sight velocity measurements from ascending and descending satellite passes, alongside field structural data of fault slip indicators and gypsum deformation.
升轨和降轨卫星InSAR视线向速度场数据，以及野外断层滑动矢量和石膏变形观测。

sum: Estimating interseismic coupling at subduction zones typically relies on homogeneous elastic Earth models, neglecting 3D elastic heterogeneity and viscoelastic earthquake-cycle mantle flow. This study presents a Bayesian boundary inversion of horizontal baseline rate changes (including four offshore GNSS-A sites) and combined vertical velocities (GNSS, leveling, and tide gauges) at Cascadia. Using the 3D spectral-element code visco3d, the authors construct Green's functions incorporating 3D seismic velocity structure and linear Maxwell viscoelasticity over a 500-year earthquake cycle. They find that elastic heterogeneity alone deepens inferred locking, lowers moment accumulation rates by up to 24%, and degrades data fits. Conversely, viscoelastic mantle flow shallows inferred coupling and increases moment accumulation. Combining both effects offsets their individual biases, producing coupling distributions similar to homogeneous elastic models while achieving superior fits to vertical subsidence patterns. Sensitivity tests reveal that downgoing plate thickness and oceanic mantle viscosity dominate modeled deformation.
本研究针对卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带，利用水平基线变化率（含4个海底GNSS-A站点）及综合垂向形变速率（GNSS、水准和验潮仪），开展了顾及三维弹性非均质性与粘弹性地震周期地幔流的贝叶斯边界反演。通过三维谱元程序visco3d计算格林函数，研究发现：仅引入弹性非均质性会使反演的锁定区加深、矩积累率降低并恶化……

t: The authors compute 3D heterogeneous elastic and linear Maxwell viscoelastic Green's functions using the spectral-element code visco3d, constructing an earthquake-cycle backslip matrix incorporated into a Bayesian boundary inversion for megathrust locking zones.
利用谱元程序visco3d计算三维非均质弹性和线性粘弹性格林函数，构建地震周期回滑矩阵并纳入贝叶斯边界反演。

The inversion uses onshore GNSS horizontal baseline rate changes, four offshore GNSS-Acoustic sites, and a combined vertical velocity dataset from GNSS, leveling, and tide gauges corrected for hydrology and GIA.
反演使用陆地GNSS水平基线变化率、4个海底GNSS-A站点，以及经水文和GIA校正的垂向速度数据集。

Viscoelastic models increase moment accumulation rates by 11%–29% and achieve the best vertical variance reduction (0.52–0.53), whereas heterogeneous elastic models reduce moment rates by 7%–20% and deepen inferred locking boundaries.
粘弹性模型使矩积累率增加11%–29%且垂向拟合最优（VR=0.52–0.53），而非均质弹性模型加深锁定并降低矩率7%…
The model assumes time-invariant interseismic coupling and uniform periodic coseismic release, and cannot reproduce observed inland subsidence rates exceeding 1 mm/yr between 120°W and 123°W.
假设震间耦合恒定且周期地震完全释放累积矩，无法重现120°W–123°W间超1 mm/yr的内陆沉降。

First Bayesian boundary inversion at Cascadia that simultaneously incorporates 3D seismic-derived elastic heterogeneity and a 3D viscoelastic earthquake cycle model to invert both horizontal and vertical geodetic velocities.
首次在卡斯卡迪亚联合三维弹性非均质性与三维粘弹性地震周期模型，对水平与垂向形变进行贝叶斯耦合边界反演。

Showed that combining elastic heterogeneity and viscoelasticity yields coupling distributions similar to homogeneous elastic models while improving the vertical velocity variance reduction (VR = 0.52 vs. 0.49).
Identified oceanic mantle viscosity and downgoing elastic plate thickness as the dominant physical and geometric controls on predicted surface deformation.
将三维弹性非均质性与三维粘弹性地震周期模型结合，纳入卡斯卡迪亚震间耦合的贝叶斯边界反演框架。
证明弹性非均质性会加深锁定深度并降低矩积累率（-7%至-20%），而粘弹性流动则使锁定变浅并增加矩积累率（+11%至+29%）。
表明同时考虑弹性非均质性和粘弹性可得到与均匀弹性模型相似的耦合分布，同时提高垂向速度的方差缩减（VR从0.49升至0.52）。
确定了大洋地幔粘度和俯冲弹性板片厚度是控制预测地表形变的最主要物理与几何参数。

Viscoelastic backslip earthquake cycle formulation superimposing steady long-term backslip and periodic coseismic slip (T = 500 yr, t_eq = 300 yr) over 1,000 relaxation times.
Bayesian boundary inversion parameterizing the upper locked boundary (UB), lower locked boundary (LB), and deep transitional creep boundary (TB).
利用重力球形地球三维谱元程序（visco3d / visco3dG）计算非均质弹性和线性麦克斯韦粘弹性格林函数。

融合MIDAS处理的GNSS、水准测量和验潮仪数据的震间垂向速度场，并进行了水文和冰川均衡调整（GIA）校正。

Uses a simplified linear Maxwell viscosity with uniform mantle wedge and oceanic mantle domains, which fails to capture inland subsidence rates >1 mm/yr between 120°W and 123°W.

sum: This study combines distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) and seismic interferometry to monitor hourly near-surface seismic velocity variations ($\delta v/v$) in downtown Hefei, China. The authors resolve velocity variations up to $10^{-3}$ in amplitude, identifying long-term, diurnal, and sub-daily signals. Thermoelastic effect modeling successfully explains the long-term and diurnal variations, while hydraulic force modeling using groundwater and precipitation data fits transient variations (~0.05%). Semi-diurnal variations are attributed to the interaction between barometric pressure and the water table. This work highlights the power of urban DAS for high-resolution environmental monitoring of Earth's critical zone and advances our understanding of land-atmosphere-hydrosphere coupling.
本研究结合DAS和地震干涉测量，高精度监测合肥市中心近地表每小时地震波速变化（达10^-3）。热弹性效应模型解释了长期和日变化，而基于地下水和降雨的水动力学模型拟合了瞬态变化（~0.05%）。半日变化归因于气压与地下水位相互作用。该研究展示了城市DAS在地球关键带高分辨率环境监测中的潜力。

The findings and physical models are highly site-specific to the urban critical zone of Hefei and require local environmental calibration.
