sum: This paper proposes a unified physical model to quantitatively explain global plate motion velocities. Instead of relying on traditional slab pull, the model balances horizontal thrust (generated by solid-fluid pressure contrasts at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary) against basal and side frictional resistance. Incorporating parameters like thrust magnitude, force transmission loss, trench friction, and plate-type resistance, the model successfully predicts velocities for 11 major plates (with <5% deviation for oceanic plates). The study concludes that plate velocity is inversely proportional to resistance, and that distributed horizontal thrust is the primary driver of plate motion, while slab pull contributes less than 3%.
本文提出了解释全球板块速度的统一物理模型。该模型基于岩石圈-软流圈边界水平推力与摩擦阻力的力平衡，引入推力大小、力传递损失、海沟摩擦和阻力系数等参数，计算了11个主要板块的速度（大洋板块偏差<5%）。结果表明，板块速度与阻力成反比，分布式水平推力是主导驱动力，而板块拉力贡献仅占<3%。

t: Analytical force-balance modeling balancing horizontal thrust at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary against velocity-proportional basal and side frictional resistance.
基于岩石圈-软流圈边界水平推力与摩擦阻力平衡的解析力学建模。
Observed plate motion velocities and lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) geometric parameters for 11 major global tectonic plates.
全球11个主要板块的观测板块运动速度及岩石圈-软流圈边界几何参数。
The model predicts velocities with <5% deviation for oceanic plates, showing plate velocity is inversely proportional to resistance and slab pull contributes <3%.
大洋板块速度预测偏差<5%，表明板块速度与阻力成反比，板块拉力贡献<3%。
Higher velocity deviations (~22% for mixed plates, larger for continental plates) due to local thrust cancellation or remote force transmission.
混合与大陆板块因局部推力抵消或远程力传递导致预测偏差较大。
Proposes distributed horizontal thrust at the LAB as the primary driver of plate motion rather than traditional slab pull.
提出LAB处的分布式水平推力而非传统板块拉力是板块运动的主导驱动力。

kc: Established a unified physical model for global plate motion velocities based on force balance.
Demonstrated that distributed horizontal thrust at the LAB is the primary driver, with slab pull contributing <3%.
Quantified the relationship between plate velocity, resistance, dip angle, and force transmission loss.
建立了基于力平衡的全球板块运动速度统一物理模型。
证明了LAB处的分布式水平推力是主要驱动力，而板块拉力贡献率不足3%。
定量化了板块速度、阻力、倾角和力传递损失之间的关系。
me: Analytical force balance modeling incorporating horizontal thrust and velocity-proportional resistance.
Parameterization of thrust magnitude, force transmission loss, trench friction, and resistance coefficients.
结合水平推力和与速度成正比的阻力进行解析力平衡建模。
对推力大小、力传递损失、海沟摩擦和阻力系数进行参数化。
de: Systematic velocity calculations and model validation for 11 major global tectonic plates.
Comparison of model predictions with observed LAB structure-velocity correlations.
对全球11个主要板块进行系统速度计算与模型验证。
将模型预测与观测到的LAB结构-速度相关性进行对比。
li: Higher velocity deviations for complex continental plates due to local thrust cancellation or remote force transmission.
Relies on simplified parameterizations of complex 3D geodynamical forces.
由于局部推力抵消或远程力传递，复杂大陆板块的速度偏差较高。
依赖于对复杂三维地球动力学力的简化参数化。

tm.why: The paper develops a physical force-balance model to explain global plate motion velocities, which is a fundamental topic in geodynamics.

ev.notes: No PDF was available, so the analysis is based entirely on the abstract and metadata.

sum: Direct time-resolved observations of coseismic surface fault displacement are rare, especially for oblique ruptures with large vertical components. This study analyzes a smartphone recording of a security-camera monitor that captured surface rupture across the Hinagu Fault Zone during the 28 July 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto earthquake. Using two independent computer-vision tracking methods—pyramidal Lucas-Kanade optical flow and normalized cross-correlation (NCC) template matching—the authors measure relative motion between far-side target structures and near-side reference structures while removing shared recording motion via RANSAC-fitted similarity and affine transformations. Calibrating the image displacement to the field-measured 1.383 m offset vector (1.05 m right-lateral, 0.90 m east-side-up) shows that the central 60% of slip (0.830 m) developed in 0.866–0.901 s (optical flow) and 0.910–0.928 s (NCC), yielding average slip rates of ~0.9 m/s. Rigorous prespecified sensitivity tests separate robust main-rise kinematics from unresolved secondary-recording artifacts.
本研究分析了2026年7月28日熊本Mw 6.8级地震中日奈久断层带地表破裂的监控翻拍视频。作者采用金字塔Lucas-Kanade光流法和归一化互相关（NCC）模板匹配两种独立图像追踪方法，利用RANSAC拟合相似和仿射变换消除近端参考区的共同运动伪影，提取了跨断层相对位移时间序列。结合野外实测的1……

t: Pyramidal Lucas-Kanade optical flow and normalized cross-correlation (NCC) template matching track far-side target motion relative to near-side reference structures, using RANSAC-fitted similarity and affine models to remove shared recording motion.
采用金字塔Lucas-Kanade光流法和NCC模板匹配追踪远端目标，利用RANSAC拟合相似与仿射模型扣除近端参考区共…

A 442-frame (1276x720 px, 30 fps) smartphone video recording of a CCTV monitor capturing surface rupture in Yatsushiro City during the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake, calibrated with a 1.383-m field-measured offset vector.
八代市便利店CCTV显示器的手机翻拍视频（442帧，30帧/秒），结合野外实测1.383米总位移矢量进行标定。
The central 60% of surface displacement (0.830 m) developed in 0.866–0.901 s with optical flow and 0.910–0.928 s with NCC, corresponding to average slip rates of 0.920–0.958 m/s and 0.895–0.912 m/s.

Automatic deletion of the native CCTV file restricts analysis to a smartphone-filmed monitor copy, leaving frame-timing errors, phone-to-monitor projective distortion, and late apparent motion unresolved.
原始监控被自动删除，二次翻拍视频存在帧时间误差和手机-屏幕透视畸变，无法确证晚期运动及物理超调。
Provides time-resolved across-fault kinematics for a strongly oblique surface rupture using a prespecified dual-tracker ensemble, field-vector calibration, and rigorous failed-artifact diagnostics.
利用预设双追踪器集合、野外矢量标定及严格的伪影诊断，首次给出强斜滑地表破裂的时间分辨跨断层运动学约束。

kc: Quantified the time-resolved surface displacement history of an oblique-slip rupture during the 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto earthquake from opportunistic near-fault video.
Demonstrated high consistency between Lucas-Kanade optical flow and NCC template matching, finding a 20–80% rise time of ~0.9 s and an average displacement rate near 0.9 m/s.
Established a rigorous prespecified ensemble and artifact-diagnostic framework to separate robust fault displacement signals from phone-to-monitor secondary recording artifacts.
利用近断层监控视频量化了2026年熊本Mw 6.8级地震斜滑地表破裂的时间分辨位移历史。
证明了Lucas-Kanade光流法与NCC模板匹配结果的高度一致性，得出20–80%上升时间约为0.9秒，平均位移速率接近0.9米/秒。
建立了一套严格的预设参数集合与伪影诊断框架，将可靠的断层位移信号与手机翻拍显示器带来的二次录制伪影区分开来。
me: Pyramidal Lucas-Kanade optical flow tracking Shi-Tomasi features directly from a pre-slip baseline frame.
Normalized cross-correlation (NCC) template matching across three patch sizes (31, 41, and 51 pixels) with subpixel quadratic refinement.
Common-motion correction using RANSAC-fitted similarity and affine transformations derived from near-side reference regions.
Savitzky-Golay smoothing across seven prespecified window lengths and scalar image-to-ground calibration using field-measured offset vectors.
金字塔Lucas-Kanade光流法，直接从震前基准帧追踪Shi-Tomasi特征点。
归一化互相关（NCC）模板匹配，采用31、41和51像素三种窗口尺寸并进行亚像素二次插值精化。
基于近端参考区特征，利用RANSAC拟合相似变换和仿射变换以消除视频共同运动。
采用7种预设窗口长度的Savitzky-Golay滤波平滑，并利用野外实测位移矢量模长进行图像到地面的标量标定。
de: Secondary smartphone video recording (442 frames, 1276x720 pixels, 30 fps, 14.733 s) of a convenience store CCTV monitor in Miyaji, Yatsushiro City.
Field tape measurements documenting 1.05 m right-lateral and 0.90 m east-side-up coseismic surface displacement (1.383 m total vector) along the Hinagu Fault Zone.
Geometry-restricted cross-check using exact 50x50-pixel window coordinates from an independent study (Hirano 2026) and projective/bezel stabilization diagnostics.
八代市宫地便利店CCTV显示器的手机翻拍视频（442帧，1276×720像素，标称30帧/秒，时长14.733秒）。
日奈久断层带野外皮尺实测同震地表位移数据：右旋走滑1.05米，东侧抬升0.90米（总矢量模长1.383米）。
使用独立研究（Hirano 2026）提供的精确50×50像素窗口坐标进行受限几何交叉检验，以及透视单应性和显示器边框稳定化诊断实验。
li: The native CCTV recording was automatically deleted; analysis relies on a secondary smartphone recording of the monitor, introducing unquantifiable frame-timing, rolling-shutter, and phone-to-screen projective distortions.
Because 3D camera viewing geometry was not surveyed, image horizontal and vertical components cannot be independently converted into geological strike-slip and dip-slip components.
Late apparent motion and an early peak-and-decline feature cannot be resolved as physical overshoot or continued slip versus secondary recording artifacts.
原始监控文件已被自动删除，分析依赖手机翻拍显示器的二次视频，存在无法完全量化的帧时间误差、卷帘快门和手机-屏幕透视畸变。
由于未测量相机的三维空间几何姿态，无法将图像水平和垂直分量独立转换为地质走滑和倾滑分量。
视频后期的视运动以及早期的峰值回落特征无法被确认为物理超调或持续滑移，可能源于二次录制伪影。

tm.why: The paper directly extracts the second-by-second kinematic slip history and displacement rate of coseismic surface fault rupture during the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake.
The study investigates oblique surface fault displacement kinematics (combined right-lateral strike-slip and normal faulting) along the Hinagu Fault Zone.
The rapid permanent differential surface displacement (~0.83 m in 0.9 s) is analyzed as a direct near-fault hazard for structures crossing the fault rupture.

ev.notes: Full 52-page PDF (including 28-page main manuscript with tables/figures and 24-page Supporting Information) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: Predicting explosive volcanic eruptions requires accurate magma fragmentation models, yet existing models neglect coupled bubble-scale viscoelasticity and fail against experimental data. This study establishes a universal Weissenberg-number rheology for silicate melts, showing brittle failure occurs at a critical shear stress of approximately Wic*G (Wic ≈ 0.004). The authors embed this Maxwell viscoelastic rheology and failure criterion into a spherical bubble-in-shell growth model coupled with H2O diffusion. They validate the numerical model against novel laboratory controlled-decompression experiments on hydrous obsidian and published rapid-heating experiments. The model accurately reproduces the experimental fragmentation regime boundaries and predicts critical decompression rates for natural silicic eruptions (e.g., Pinatubo, Mt St Helens, Soufrière Hills). Accounting for crystal fractions lowers the critical decompression rate by up to four orders of magnitude, reconciling low monitoring-derived rates with explosive behavior.
准确预测火山爆发性喷发需要可靠的岩浆碎裂模型。本研究基于硅酸盐熔体的普适Weissenberg数流变学，构建了耦合水扩散与Maxwell粘弹性流变的单气泡液壳生长数学模型，提出当气泡壁切向应力达到临界强度（Wic·G，Wic≈0.004）时发生脆性碎裂。通过含水黑曜石高温受控减压实验及已发表的快速加……

t: Embeds a Maxwell viscoelastic rheology and critical tangential stress failure criterion (tau_theta_theta >= Wic*G) into a Lagrangian spherical bubble-in-shell growth model coupled with volatile H2O diffusion.
将Maxwell粘弹性流变与临界切向应力破裂准则嵌入耦合水扩散的球形气泡-液壳生长模型。

Tests the model against high-temperature autoclave decompression experiments on 2.17 wt% H2O obsidian, rapid-heating obsidian experiments, and decompression rate compilations from six explosive volcanic eruptions.
2.17 wt%含水黑曜石高温受控减压实验、快速加热实验及6次天然爆发性喷发的减压速率汇编。

Silicate melts fail at Wic ≈ 4×10^-3. The model accurately reproduces experimental decompression and thermal fragmentation thresholds and shows crystals reduce critical decompression rates by four orders of magnitude.
确定临界Weissenberg数约4×10^-3，准确复现实验碎裂边界，证明含晶量可使临界减压率降低4个量级。
Continuum crystal approximations fail at high gas fractions where liquid shells thin below microlite/phenocryst sizes; bubble nucleation, coalescence, and full conduit modeling are omitted.
高气孔率下液壳薄于微晶/斑晶时连续介质假设失效；未包含气泡成核、合并及通道流模拟。
Explicitly couples local bubble-wall viscoelastic stress accumulation and volatile diffusion with newly conducted endogenous bubble-growth decompression experiments in hydrous melts.
首次将气泡壁局部粘弹性应力演化与内生气泡生长的含水熔体受控减压实验相结合并验证。

kc: Unifies silicate melt failure criteria under a universal Weissenberg-number rheology with a critical maximum dimensionless stress Wic ≈ 0.004.
Derives a microphysical viscoelastic bubble-in-shell growth model incorporating volatile diffusion and tangential bubble-wall stress accumulation.
Validates the fragmentation criterion against novel controlled-decompression experiments on hydrous obsidian melts and rapid-heating experiments.
Predicts critical decompression rates for natural explosive eruptions and demonstrates that crystal content lowers the threshold by up to four orders of magnitude.
在普适Weissenberg数流变学框架下统一了硅酸盐熔体破裂准则，确定临界无量纲应力Wic ≈ 0.004。
推导了耦合挥发分扩散与气泡壁切向应力积累的微物理粘弹性气泡-液壳生长模型。
利用新开展的含水黑曜石熔体受控减压实验及已有快速加热实验验证了碎裂准则。
预测了天然爆发性火山喷发的临界减压速率，并证明晶体含量可使碎裂阈值降低达四个数量级。
me: Compilation and normalization of high-temperature silicate melt shear rheology using Maxwell relaxation time and Weissenberg number.
Lagrangian formulation of a spherical bubble-in-shell hydrodynamic model with Maxwell viscoelastic stress evolution and H2O advection-diffusion.
Adaptation of liquid viscosity and critical failure stress for crystal-bearing magmas using crystal packing fraction laws.
High-temperature autoclave decompression experiments on synthesized hydrous obsidian at controlled pressure decay rates.
利用Maxwell弛豫时间和Weissenberg数对高温硅酸盐熔体剪切流变数据进行汇编与归一化。
建立拉格朗日坐标下的球形气泡-液壳流体力学模型，耦合Maxwell粘弹性应力演化与水平流-扩散方程。
基于晶体堆积分数定律修正含晶岩浆的液相粘度与临界破裂应力。
利用高温高压釜系统对合成含水黑曜石开展受控降压速率下的减压碎裂实验。
de: Published high-temperature shear stress vs. strain rate datasets for synthetic and natural silicate melts.
Controlled-rate decompression experiments (dp/dt accurate to 0.1 MPa/s) on 2.17 wt% H2O bubble- and crystal-free obsidian.
Published atmospheric-pressure rapid-heating fragmentation experiments on hydrous obsidian (Forte & Castro, 2019).
Global compilation of natural decompression rates for six explosive silicic eruptions (Soufrière Hills, Pinatubo, Novarupta, Towada, Mt St Helens, Taupo).
已发表的天然与合成硅酸盐熔体高温剪切应力-应变率数据集。
对含水2.17 wt%的无气泡、无晶体黑曜石开展的受控速率高温减压实验。
已发表的常压下含水黑曜石快速加热碎裂实验数据（Forte & Castro, 2019）。
全球6次硅质爆发性火山喷发（Soufrière Hills、Pinatubo等）的天然减压速率汇编数据。
li: Assumes crystals act as a continuum within the liquid shell, which breaks down at high porosity when shell thickness becomes thinner than macroscopic crystals.
Does not adjust H2O diffusivity or elastic modulus for the presence of crystals.
Neglects continuous bubble nucleation, bubble coalescence, and full volcanic conduit flow dynamics (assumes constant decompression rate).
假设晶体在液壳内表现为连续介质，当高气孔率下液壳厚度小于宏观晶体尺寸时该假设失效。
未考虑晶体存在对水扩散系数（D）或弹性模量（G）的潜在影响。
忽略了气泡成核、气泡合并过程以及完整的火山通道流动动力学（仅假设恒定减压速率）。

tm.why: The paper develops and experimentally validates a microphysical viscoelastic bubble-growth model to predict magma fragmentation and explosive volcanic eruptions.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF text, equations, and figures were analyzed.

sum: This paper investigates the sensitivity of ambient seismic noise horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (H/V) to non-uniform surface source distributions and 3-D lateral heterogeneities. Motivated by day-night variations in H/V amplitude, peak frequency (shifting between 1 and 2 Hz), and polarization observed near a blind fault in the Mygdonian Basin (Greece), the authors develop a 3-D numerical simulation framework using the spectral-element code EFISPEC3D. By invoking seismic reciprocity and runtime signal decimation, they compute 3-D elastic and viscoelastic Green's functions from 34 receivers to all surface grid points, enabling rapid synthesis of thousands of ambient noise realizations for arbitrary source configurations. Results show good agreement with elastic Diffuse Field Theory (DFT) under isotropic sources, though attenuation and strong lateral contrasts introduce notable deviations. Non-isotropic sources strongly modulate H/V amplitude and induce polarization perpendicular to source azimuths, yet spatial polarization trends across the fault remain detectable.
本文利用三维数值模拟研究了背景噪声水平与垂直谱比（H/V）对地表非均匀震源分布及横向非均匀结构的敏感性。针对希腊Mygdonian盆地隐伏断层附近观测到的H/V日夜变化，作者基于谱元法程序EFISPEC3D，结合互易定理与运行时降采样技术，计算了34个接收点至所有地表网格的三维粘弹性格林函数，从而高……

t: The authors compute 3-D elastic and viscoelastic Green's functions using the spectral-element code EFISPEC3D and seismic reciprocity, decimating output at runtime to store full surface wavefields for post-processing with arbitrary random surface noise source distributions.
利用谱元程序EFISPEC3D和互易定理计算三维粘弹性格林函数，通过运行时降采样存储地表波场以合成任意震源的噪声。

Ambient noise recordings from station S14 in the Mygdonian Basin (2015 and a two-week 2023 campaign) are analyzed alongside 3-D spectral-element synthetics up to 5 Hz across 34 receivers in a 7.96 km cubed asymmetrical basin model.
分析Mygdonian盆地S14台站2015及2023年两周噪声数据，结合7.96公里三维盆地模型34个接收点的5 Hz…

Isotropic synthetic H/V matches 3-D Diffuse Field Theory near peak frequencies, while the blind fault induces 30–50% polarization that reverses direction across the fault; directional sources induce up to 90% polarization perpendicular to source azimuths.
各向同性合成H/V与三维DFT吻合；隐伏断层产生30-50%且跨断层反转的极化；定向震源产生高达90%的横向极化。
The basin model uses a simplified 2-D stair-step fault geometry without shallow lateral contrasts or multiple faults, and noise sources are idealized rather than realistic road traffic.
模型采用简化的二维对称阶梯状断层且浅层无横向变化，噪声源为理想随机点力而非真实道路交通。

Uses 3-D reciprocity and runtime decimation to generalize the Distributed Surface Sources method to 3-D viscoelastic media for arbitrary source statistics while simultaneously evaluating 3-D Diffuse Field Theory.
利用互易原理和运行时降采样将分布式地表源方法推广至三维粘弹性介质，同时计算三维扩散场理论预测。

kc: Developed a reciprocity-based 3-D spectral-element workflow with runtime decimation to synthesize ambient noise for arbitrary surface source distributions.
Presented a two-week observational dataset from the Mygdonian Basin showing strong diurnal variability in H/V peak frequency (1 to 2 Hz), amplitude, and polarization.
Benchmarked 3-D synthetic H/V curves against 1-D and 3-D Diffuse Field Theory (DFT) across elastic and viscoelastic rheologies.
Demonstrated that blind faults cause a reversal of dominant H/V polarization direction between the shallow and deep sides of the fault.
Showed that directive noise sources induce strong H/V polarization perpendicular to the source azimuth (up to 90%), attributed to Love wave Airy phases.
开发了基于互易定理和运行时降采样的三维谱元模拟流程，可针对任意地表震源分布合成背景噪声。
展示了Mygdonian盆地两周的观测数据，揭示了H/V峰值频率（1至2 Hz）、振幅和极化方向的显著昼夜变化。
在弹性和粘弹性介质中，将三维合成H/V曲线与一维和三维扩散场理论（DFT）预测进行了系统对比。
证明了隐伏断层会导致断层浅部和深部两侧的主导H/V极化方向发生反转。
发现定向噪声源会引起垂直于震源方位角的强H/V极化（高达90%），这归因于勒夫波的艾里相。
me: 3-D spectral-element wave propagation modeling using EFISPEC3D in elastic and viscoelastic media.
Seismic reciprocity theorem to compute Green's functions from 34 surface receivers to 2,653,275 free-surface GLL points.
Runtime finite impulse response (FIR) low-pass filtering and time-series decimation to reduce storage from 5.8 TB to 37.1 GB per receiver.
Stochastic convolution of Green's functions with 1000 realizations of 2000 random surface point forces for various isotropic and azimuthal configurations.
Comparison of synthetic H/V ratios and azimuthal polarization indices against 1-D (HV-Inv) and 3-D Diffuse Field Assumption (DFA) predictions.
使用EFISPEC3D在弹性和粘弹性介质中进行三维谱元波传播模拟。
利用地震互易定理计算从34个地表接收点到2,653,275个自由地表GLL点的格林函数。
采用运行时有限脉冲响应（FIR）低通滤波与时间序列降采样，将每个接收点的存储需求从5.8 TB降至37.1 GB。
将格林函数与2000个随机地表点力的1000次随机实现进行卷积，涵盖各向同性和特定方位角分布。
将合成H/V谱比和方位极化指数与一维（HV-Inv）及三维扩散场假设（DFA）预测结果进行对比。
de: Field ambient noise recordings at station S14 in the Mygdonian Basin, Greece (4-hour record in March 2015 and a 2-week continuous experiment in March-April 2023).
Simplified 3-D computational model of the Mygdonian Basin (7956 x 7956 x 7956 m) featuring an asymmetrical graben and an oblique stair-step blind fault.
Numerical experiments testing isotropic surface sources, highway-like northern bedrock sources (Egnatia distribution), and narrow azimuthal source sectors.
希腊Mygdonian盆地S14台站的野外背景噪声记录（2015年3月4小时记录及2023年3-4月两周连续观测实验）。
Mygdonian盆地简化三维计算模型（7956 x 7956 x 7956 m），包含非对称地堑和倾斜阶梯状隐伏断层。
测试各向同性地表震源、类似高速公路的北部基岩震源（Egnatia分布）以及窄方位角扇形震源的数值实验。
li: The 3-D computational model uses a simplified 2-D symmetrical basin geometry with no lateral contrast in the top 44 m, neglecting multiple faults and complex 3-D topography.
Noise source distributions are idealized as random point forces rather than realistic moving traffic loads along actual road networks.
Simulations are restricted to a maximum frequency of 5 Hz due to computational cost.
三维计算模型采用了简化的二维对称盆地几何结构，顶部44米无横向差异，忽略了多条断层和复杂三维地形。
噪声源分布被理想化为随机点力，而非沿实际道路网移动的真实交通荷载。
受计算成本限制，模拟的最大频率被限制在5 Hz以内。

sum: This study integrates seismic tomography, mineral physics, and geodynamic simulations to investigate sub-slab low-velocity anomalies (LVAs) beneath circum-Pacific subduction zones. The author classifies subduction regimes into trench-advancing, trench-retreating, and trench-stationary systems based on net slab advance velocity. The analysis reveals that well-developed sub-slab LVAs are not globally ubiquitous but are restricted to fast-advancing subduction zones (e.g., the northwest Pacific) where the slab advance velocity exceeds the maximum asthenospheric creep backfilling velocity. In these zones, a low-pressure wake relaxation zone forms, allowing melt to accumulate and cause seismic velocity reductions. In contrast, trench-retreating and trench-stationary zones suppress melt accumulation due to high-pressure environments or lack of horizontal advance. Thus, sub-slab LVAs represent dynamic wake effects of rapid slab advance rather than universal support for the classic slab pull model.
本研究结合层析成像与动力学模拟探讨板片下低速异常（LVA）成因。结果表明，LVA仅存在于少数快速推进型俯冲带（如西北太平洋），因板片推进快于软流圈回填，在下方形成低压尾流区促使熔体聚集。而占多数的后退或静止型俯冲带无法形成LVA。这表明板片下LVA是快速板片推进的动态尾流效应，而非板片拉力的普遍证据……

结合地震层析成像观测、矿物物理实验和地球动力学模拟进行系统分析。
Global seismic tomography models of circum-Pacific subduction zones (Japan, South America, NW Pacific) and geodynamic simulation data.

sum: This paper provides a comprehensive review of the state-of-the-art methods for measuring ocean surface waves and their directional spectra. It covers a wide range of techniques spanning historical visual observations, traditional in-situ instruments (such as wave buoys, pressure sensors, and acoustic devices), and modern remote sensing technologies (including radar, LiDAR, and satellite altimeters). Additionally, it highlights emerging technologies such as distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), stereo-imaging, and global networks of miniature drifting buoys. The review synthesizes how these diverse observations improve our understanding of small-scale wave physics and global wave climates, offering a valuable guide for selecting appropriate wave measurement techniques.
本文系统综述了测量海洋表面波及其方向谱的先进方法。涵盖了传统原位仪器（如浮标、压力和声学传感器）与现代遥感技术（雷达、激光雷达和卫星高度计）。重点介绍了分布式声学传感（DAS）、立体成像和微型漂流浮标网络等新兴技术，总结了其在波浪物理和全球气候研究中的应用，为波浪测量提供了完整指南。

t: Review of diverse observational methods for ocean surface waves, including in-situ sensors (buoys, pressure gauges), remote sensing (radar, LiDAR, altimetry), and emerging optical and fiber-optic technologies.
综述了多种海洋表面波观测方法，包括原位传感器（浮标、压力计）、遥感（雷达、激光雷达、高度计）以及新兴的光学和光纤技术。
Global and regional datasets of ocean wave properties, including historical visual records, buoy networks, satellite altimetry, and high-resolution coastal observations.

Synthesizes the state-of-the-art in wave spectrum measurements, highlighting the transition to high-resolution directional spectra and global micro-buoy networks.

Challenges remain in reconciling multi-scale observations, measuring extreme storm waves, and managing the high data rates of newer technologies like DAS.

Provides a comprehensive, multi-author consensus review of modern ocean wave measurement technologies, bridging traditional in-situ methods with cutting-edge remote sensing and fiber-optics.

sum: Conventional InSAR is largely insensitive to north-south crustal motion due to near-polar satellite orbits, and standard Enhanced Spectral Diversity (ESD) coregistration suppresses long-wavelength tectonic signals across multiple tracks. This paper introduces Multi-track Time-Series Burst-Overlap Interferometry (MTSB) to retrieve absolute, ITRF2014-referenced along-track horizontal deformation from Sentinel-1 TOPS data. MTSB integrates Sequential Estimator and eigen-decomposition maximum-likelihood (EMI) phase linking, a unified time-series inversion separating tectonic deformation from orbit-induced residual misregistration, closure-phase fading-signal correction, strain-based spatial regularization, and block-wise periodogram analysis. Validated against synthetic data and three earthquake-cycle case studies—interseismic slip along the Dead Sea Fault, postseismic deformation of the 2023 Türkiye doublet, and coseismic displacement of the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel earthquake—MTSB achieves millimeter-per-year velocity accuracy (RMSE 2.0 mm/yr) and centimeter-level displacement accuracy compared to GNSS, enabling improved fault kinematic inversions and Arabian plate Euler-pole estimation.
传统InSAR对南北向地壳形变不敏感，且常规增强谱分集（ESD）配准会抑制大尺度构造信号。本文提出多轨时序突发重叠干涉测量（MTSB）方法，融合序贯估计与特征分解最大似然（Seq+EMI）相位链接、分离形变与残余配准误差的统一时序反演、闭合相位衰减信号校正及应变模型滤波，提取ITRF2014框架下的……

t: MTSB combines Seq+EMI phase linking, parametric time-series inversion separating tectonic deformation from orbital misregistration, closure-phase fading-signal correction, 1-D strain regularization, and block-wise periodogram analysis to recover ITRF2014-referenced along-track deformation.
结合Seq+EMI相位链接、分离形变与配准误差的时序反演、闭合相位衰减校正与分块周期图反演。

Evaluated using 40–200 synthetic SLCs and multi-track Sentinel-1 TOPS data across three cases: Dead Sea Fault interseismic (2014–2021), 2023 Türkiye doublet postseismic (1 year), and 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel coseismic.
采用40-200景合成SLC及死海震间、2023土耳其震后、2015智利同震的多轨Sentinel-1数据。

Dead Sea interseismic velocities achieve 2.0 mm/yr RMSE against GNSS (slip rate 4.8±0.3 mm/yr), reducing track discrepancies from 2 to 0.7 mm/yr; Türkiye postseismic RMSE is 0.90–1.56 cm; Illapel coseismic MAE is 2.78–3.59 cm.
死海震间速率GNSS对比RMSE为2.0 mm/yr，轨间差异降至0.7 mm/yr；震后与同震误差达厘米级。

The workflow does not explicitly correct for solid Earth tides, ocean tidal loading, or long-wavelength azimuthal ionospheric TEC gradients, and accuracy degrades when interferometric coherence drops below 0.3.
未显式校正固体潮、海潮及长波长方位向电离层梯度，低相干区（≤0.3）精度下降。

Eliminates ESD signal suppression in multi-track BOI by unifying orbits into ITRF2014 via time-series misregistration inversion and introduces closure-phase fading-signal correction to burst-overlap interferometry.
避免ESD配准对大尺度形变的抑制，统一多轨至ITRF2014框架，首次在BOI中校正衰减信号。

kc: Develops the MTSB framework to retrieve absolute, ITRF2014-referenced along-track (primarily north-south) deformation across multiple Sentinel-1 tracks without ESD signal suppression.
Identifies and mitigates multi-looking fading-signal bias in Burst-Overlap Interferometry (BOI) using interferometric triplet closure-phase stacking.
Separates tectonic deformation from epoch-wise orbital misregistration errors via a unified parametric time-series inversion and block-wise periodogram spectral analysis.
Demonstrates millimeter-per-year interseismic velocity agreement (RMSE 2.0 mm/yr) and centimeter-level coseismic/postseismic agreement with independent GNSS across three tectonic settings.
开发了MTSB框架，在不产生ESD信号抑制的情况下提取多轨Sentinel-1在ITRF2014框架下的绝对沿轨（主要为南北向）形变。
首次确认突发重叠干涉（BOI）中的多视衰减信号偏差，并利用干涉三元组闭合相位叠加进行校正。
通过统一的含参时序反演和分块周期图谱分析，将构造形变与按历元变化的轨道配准残差分离。
在三个代表性构造区验证了该方法，与独立GNSS对比达到震间毫米/年（RMSE 2.0 mm/yr）和同震/震后厘米级精度。

Periodogram spectral analysis and least-squares time-series parameterization (linear, seasonal, Heaviside step, and cubic B-spline functions) to separate deformation from track-specific misregistration.
Closure-phase network stacking across interferometric triplets to isolate and subtract systematic fading-signal phase biases.
1-D linear strain-tensor spatial regularization followed by 2.5 km × 2.5 km block-wise periodogram velocity/displacement inversion and Metropolis-Hastings MCMC Euler-pole estimation.
两阶段稳定散射体与统计同质像元（SHP）选取，结合序贯估计与特征分解最大似然（Seq+EMI）进行相位链接。
利用周期图谱分析和最小二乘时序参数化（线性、季节性、阶跃和三次B样条函数）分离形变与特定轨道配准误差。
对干涉三元组闭合相位网络进行叠加，分离并消除系统性衰减信号相位偏差。
采用一维线性应变张量空间正则化与2.5 km × 2.5 km分块周期图反演，并结合MCMC方法反演板块欧拉极。
de: Synthetic dataset of 40 (and extended to 200) simulated Sentinel-1 SLC images with a 1-D dislocation velocity model (up to 1 cm/yr) and decorrelation noise.
Interseismic Sentinel-1 descending tracks (T21, T94, T123; 2014–2021, 36 burst overlaps) across the southern Dead Sea Fault in the Gulf of Aqaba.
Postseismic ascending and descending Sentinel-1 tracks spanning one year after the 6 February 2023 Mw 7.8 and Mw 7.6 Türkiye earthquake doublet over a ~500 km zone.
Coseismic pre- and post-event Sentinel-1 pairs (ascending and descending) for the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel, Chile megathrust earthquake, validated against GNSS data.
基于一维位错速度模型（最大1 cm/yr）和失相干噪声模拟的40景（及扩展至200景）Sentinel-1 SLC合成数据测试。

The framework is applied to resolve coseismic horizontal displacement fields (such as the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel megathrust earthquake) and postseismic slip evolution.

sum: This paper introduces a novel approach for predicting the magnitude of upcoming earthquakes with high accuracy. The methodology relies on analyzing the frequency data of very low frequency (VLF) and low frequency (LF) electromagnetic emissions that occur prior to seismic events. By treating these electromagnetic signals as diagnostic precursors, the authors aim to establish a reliable relationship to estimate earthquake magnitude before the rupture occurs, potentially advancing earthquake forecasting and fundamental seismological research.
本文提出了一种利用极低频/低频（VLF/LF）电磁辐射频率数据高精度确定未来地震震级的新方法。该方法将震前存在的电磁发射视为诊断性前兆，旨在建立电磁信号特征与地震震级之间的定量关系。这种震前震级预测方法若得以证实，将为地震预测及相关地球物理基础研究提供新的思路。

sum: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) is a powerful quantitative seismic imaging method, yet its original least-squares formulation suffers from severe non-convexity and cycle skipping. This review surveys forty years of strategies designed to relax this ill-posedness, categorizing them into three main families: model extensions (MVA, IVA, FWIME, RWI), misfit function modifications (cross-correlation, deconvolution/AWI, optimal transport, dynamic time warping, phase/envelope extraction), and wavefield/source/receiver extensions (WRI, MSWI). The novelty lies in introducing a unified mathematical framework comprising three constrained optimization problem forms (PB1, PB2, PB3) that encompasses all reviewed methods, revealing deep mathematical equivalences (e.g., between WRI and source extension, or GSOT and DTW) and clarifying variable projection versus alternating optimization. Finally, the authors assess 3D field data applicability, noting that while time-lag FWI, RWI/JFWI, and multi-taper traveltime tomography are widely adopted in practice, high-dimensional model and frequency-domain wavefield extensions remain limited by computational cost.
全波形反演（FWI）虽能定量刻画地下介质，但传统最小二乘形式存在严重的非凸性与周波跳跃。本文系统综述了四十年来缓解该不适定性的松弛策略，将其归为模型扩展（MVA、FWIME、RWI）、目标函数修改（互相关、反褶积/AWI、最优传输、动态时间规整、相位提取）及波场/震源/检波器扩展（WRI、MSWI）……

t: Categorizes 32 FWI convexification strategies into model extensions, misfit modifications, and source/wavefield/receiver extensions, unifying them under three constrained optimization problems (PB1, PB2, PB3) and analyzing variable substitution versus alternating optimization.
将32种FWI凸化策略归为三大类，统一于三类约束优化问题（PB1–PB3）并分析变量替换与交替优化。

As a methodological review, this study uses no raw data or code, instead synthesizing 32 FWI formulations from 40 years of literature and evaluating their performance on 3D exploration and seismological field datasets.
作为综述未使用原始数据或代码，而是综合40年文献中的32种FWI公式并评估其三维实际数据表现。

Demonstrates that variable substitution generalizes variable projection to non-quadratic extensions via the chain rule, and identifies time-lag FWI, RWI/JFWI, GSOT, and MTT as the primary methods successfully deployed on 3D field data.
证明变量替换可将变量投影推广至非二次扩展，指出TLFWI、RWI、GSOT和MTT已成功用于三维实际数据。

Excludes machine learning approaches, model-space prior regularization, and global/Bayesian sampling strategies, and notes that formal convexity proofs are lacking for multi-arrival data and misfit modifications.
未涵盖机器学习、模型正则化及全局采样，且多震相与目标函数修改法缺乏严格凸性证明。

Provides the first unified mathematical taxonomy (PB1, PB2, PB3) bridging model extension, misfit modification, and source/receiver extension, proving equivalences and clarifying variable substitution versus alternating relaxation.
首次提出统一模型扩展、目标函数修改和震源/检波器扩展的数学分类体系（PB1–PB3）。

kc: Classifies forty years of FWI non-convexity mitigation strategies into three core families: model extension, misfit function modification, and wavefield/source/receiver extension.
Introduces a unified mathematical framework of three constrained optimization problems (PB1, PB2, PB3) that encompasses all 32 surveyed FWI relaxation techniques.
Establishes rigorous mathematical links between seemingly disparate methods, such as WRI and matched-source extension, AWI and source-receiver extension, and GSOT, DTW, and receiver extension.

Clarifies the fundamental distinction between PB1 and PB2 solved via variable substitution (generalizing variable projection beyond quadratic inner problems) versus Gauss-Seidel alternating optimization.
Evaluates practical 3D field-data usability, highlighting computational bottlenecks that favor time-lag FWI, RWI/JFWI, and MTT over high-dimensional model or frequency-domain source extensions.
将四十年来FWI非凸性缓解策略归纳为三大核心家族：模型扩展、目标函数修改以及波场/震源/检波器扩展。
提出了包含三类约束优化问题（PB1、PB2、PB3）的统一数学框架，涵盖了综述中的所有32种FWI松弛技术。
建立了看似无关方法之间的严格数学联系，例如WRI与匹配震源扩展、AWI与震源-检波器扩展，以及GSOT、DTW与检波器扩展。
阐明了PB1与通过变量替换求解的PB2（将变量投影推广到非二次内层问题）以及高斯-赛德尔交替优化之间的根本区别。
评估了三维实际数据的适用性，指出计算瓶颈使得时延FWI、RWI/JFWI和MTT比高维模型扩展或频域震源扩展更具实用价值。
me: Formulation of a general relaxation principle where a sequence of simplified FWI problems parameterized by extra degrees of freedom converges toward conventional FWI.

Categorization of all FWI convexification techniques into three formal optimization structures: constrained penalization via optimality (PB1), joint two-parameter penalization (PB2), and direct functional transformation (PB3).
Comparative mathematical analysis of inner/outer-loop variable substitution (chain-rule gradient simplification) versus alternating Gauss-Seidel optimization.
Asymptotic and operator-level analysis comparing how misfit modifications alter only the adjoint source whereas model, wavefield, and receiver extensions modify the gradient kernel itself.
构建通用松弛原理，通过引入额外自由度参数化的一系列简化FWI问题逐步逼近常规FWI。
将所有FWI凸化技术归类为三种正式的优化结构：基于最优性约束的惩罚问题（PB1）、双参数联合惩罚问题（PB2）以及直接泛函变换问题（PB3）。
对内外循环变量替换（利用链式法则简化梯度）与高斯-赛德尔交替优化进行对比数学分析。
通过渐近与算子层面分析，对比仅改变伴随震源的目标函数修改法与改变梯度核本身的模型、波场及检波器扩展法。
de: Literature synthesis and mathematical cataloging of 32 distinct waveform inversion methodologies developed between 1983 and 2026 (summarized in Table 1 and Figure 2).
Practitioner-oriented evaluation of 3D field data applications across exploration seismology (OBN, marine streamer, land) and global/crustal earthquake tomography.
对1983年至2026年间发展的32种不同波形反演方法进行文献综合与数学编目（汇总于表1和图2）。
面向实践者评估了勘探地震学（海底节点OBN、海洋拖缆、陆地数据）及全球/地壳天然地震层析成像中的三维实际数据应用。
li: Does not exhaustively cover machine learning / deep neural network approaches (such as AI-based low-frequency extrapolation or operator learning) due to scope constraints.
Omits detailed reviews of model-space regularization/prior information (e.g., total variation, homogenization) and global/Bayesian sampling optimization methods (e.g., HMC).
Formal mathematical proofs of global convexity for most misfit-modification and multi-arrival extension methods remain nonexistent outside asymptotic or single-arrival regimes.
受篇幅范围限制，未详尽涵盖机器学习/深度神经网络方法（如基于AI的低频外推或算子学习）。
省略了对模型空间正则化/先验信息（如全变分、均匀化）以及全局/贝叶斯采样优化方法（如哈密顿蒙特卡洛HMC）的详细综述。
除渐近近似或单震相情形外，大多数目标函数修改法和多震相扩展法仍缺乏全局凸性的严格数学证明。

tm.why: The entire paper is a comprehensive review of forty years of methodologies developed to mitigate non-convexity and cycle skipping in full waveform inversion (FWI).

The authors introduce a unified mathematical framework of three constrained optimization problems (PB1, PB2, PB3) to analyze and compare PDE-constrained inverse problem relaxations, variable projection, and optimal transport distances.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 71-page GJI manuscript PDF (lines 1–2003), including all equations (1–102), Algorithms 1–2, Table 1, and Figures 1–2.

sum: This study uses local P-wave travel-time tomography to image the Philippine Sea slab beneath the Ryukyu arc. The tomographic images reveal low-velocity zones within the northern and southern slab segments, indicating lateral and vertical slab tearing, respectively. These torn regions spatially correlate with active volcanoes, whereas intact segments lack volcanism. By integrating these tomographic results with other geophysical and geochemical data, the authors propose that slab breaking/tearing, rather than traditional slab dehydration alone, is the primary driver of Ryukyu arc volcanism. This provides a new geodynamic mechanism for subduction zone volcanism.
本研究利用局部P波走时断层成像技术，对琉球弧下方的菲律宾海板块进行了精细成像。结果显示，该板块北部和南部段内部存在低速异常区，分别对应水平和垂直方向的板块撕裂。这些撕裂区域在空间上与活动火山高度吻合，而未撕裂段则缺乏火山活动。结合地球物理和地球化学证据，研究提出板块撕裂（而非传统的板块脱水）是导致琉……

t: Local P-wave travel-time tomography is applied to image the 3D velocity structure and morphology of the subducting Philippine Sea slab beneath the Ryukyu arc.
采用局部P波走时断层成像方法，对琉球弧下方俯冲的菲律宾海板块的三维速度结构和形态进行成像。
Local P-wave travel-time data from earthquakes recorded by seismic networks around the Ryukyu arc region.
琉球弧地区地震台网记录的局部地震P波走时数据。
Discovery of low-velocity zones indicating lateral and vertical slab tearing in the northern and southern Philippine Sea slab, which spatially correlate with active volcanoes.
发现菲律宾海板块北部和南部存在指示水平和垂直撕裂的低速带，且这些撕裂带与活动火山空间相关。
Potential resolution limits due to offshore station coverage and the need for more direct geochemical validation of the tearing-induced melting.
海域台站覆盖可能导致分辨率受限，且撕裂诱发熔融的机制需要更多直接的地球化学验证。
Proposing slab tearing/breaking as the primary driver of Ryukyu arc volcanism, shifting the paradigm from the traditional slab dehydration hypothesis.
提出板块撕裂/断裂是琉球弧火山活动的主要驱动力，改变了传统的仅靠板块脱水假说的认知。

kc: Imaged the detailed morphology of the Philippine Sea slab beneath the Ryukyu arc using local P-wave travel-time tomography.
Identified lateral and vertical slab tearing (low-velocity zones) in the northern and southern segments of the slab.
Established a spatial correlation between slab tearing and active volcanism along the Ryukyu arc.
Proposed slab breaking as a primary driver of Ryukyu arc volcanism, challenging the traditional dehydration-only model.
利用局部P波走时断层成像技术，精细刻画了琉球弧下方菲律宾海板块的形态。
在板块北部和南部段发现了代表水平和垂直撕裂的低速异常区。
建立了板块撕裂与琉球弧活动火山空间分布之间的直接关联。
提出板块撕裂是琉球弧火山活动的主要驱动力，挑战了传统的仅靠脱水作用的解释。
me: Local P-wave travel-time tomography.
Integration of tomographic images with existing geophysical and geochemical datasets.
局部P波走时断层成像。
将断层成像结果与已有的地球物理和地球化学数据进行综合集成分析。
de: Local P-wave travel-time data from earthquakes in the Ryukyu arc region.
来自琉球弧地区地震的局部P波走时数据。
li: Resolution of local travel-time tomography may be limited by station distribution, especially in marine environments.
The exact physical and chemical processes linking slab tearing to magma generation require further quantitative geodynamic modeling.
局部走时断层成像的分辨率可能受到台站分布（尤其是海洋区域）的限制。
将板块撕裂与岩浆产生联系起来的具体物理和化学过程仍需更定量的地球动力学模拟。

tm.why: The study uses local P-wave travel-time tomography to image the Philippine Sea slab.
It investigates the morphology and tearing of the subducting Philippine Sea slab and its geodynamic implications for volcanism.
It links slab tearing directly to the distribution of active volcanoes along the Ryukyu arc.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the abstract and metadata from ESS Open Archive and Crossref since no PDF was available.

sum: Widespread azimuthal anisotropy (2–4%) is observed in the subslab lower mantle transition zone (LMTZ; 520–660 km) beneath major subduction zones, despite the dominant mineral ringwoodite being nearly isotropic. This study couples 2D thermo-mechanical subduction simulations (ASPECT), viscoplastic self-consistent (VPSC) polycrystal plasticity, and fast-Fourier homogenization (FFH) effective medium modeling to test two candidate mechanisms: akimotoite crystallographic preferred orientation (CPO) and shape-preferred orientation (SPO) of kilometer-scale elliptical heterogeneities. Results demonstrate that a realistic pyrolitic mantle with 20% akimotoite produces negligible azimuthal anisotropy (0.4–0.6%). Conversely, SPO of gently dipping inclusions reproduces the observed 2–4% anisotropy if velocity contrasts reach 17.5–20% (suggesting hydrated layering or partial melt), or with smaller contrasts (~6%) if heterogeneities are steeply aligned (>75°). These findings first evaluate akimotoite CPO and SPO under realistic slab strains, revealing an inefficiently mixed, compositionally heterogeneous LMTZ.
针对俯冲带下方下地幔过渡带（LMTZ，520-660 km）广泛观测到的方位各向异性（2-4%），本研究结合二维热力学俯冲模拟（ASPECT）、粘塑性自洽（VPSC）织构演化和快速傅里叶均质化（FFH）等效介质理论，首次在俯冲应变场下对比评估了秋本石晶格优选取向（CPO）与千米级椭圆不均匀体形状优选……

t: Couples a 2D thermo-mechanical free-subduction model (ASPECT) with viscoplastic self-consistent (VPSC) polycrystal fabric modeling and fast-Fourier homogenization (FFH) to compute long-wavelength intrinsic (akimotoite CPO) and extrinsic (inclusion SPO) azimuthal anisotropy.
将ASPECT二维自由俯冲模拟与VPSC织构建模及FFH均质化结合，计算本征与外在方位各向异性。

Uses synthetic 2D intra-oceanic subduction flow trajectories with 3.96×10^4 Lagrangian aggregates, single-crystal elastic moduli, elliptical inclusions, and compares predictions against the global surface-wave tomography model 3DLGL-TPESv.
采用二维洋内俯冲模拟的3.96×10^4个拉格朗日追踪点与单晶弹性常数，并与3DLGL-TPESv模型对比。

A realistic pyrolitic LMTZ with 20% akimotoite yields weak azimuthal anisotropy (0.4–0.6%), whereas SPO of gently dipping inclusions with 17.5–20% velocity contrasts produces 2–2.5% anisotropy, matching tomographic observations.
含20%秋本石仅产生0.4-0.6%各向异性；而具17.5-20%速度差的缓倾包裹体SPO产生2-2.5%各向异性。
Competing trade-offs between inclusion dip angle and velocity contrast make the SPO interpretation non-unique, and the 2D stagnant-slab model neglects 3D toroidal flow around slab edges.
包裹体倾角与速度差的权衡导致解释非唯一，且二维模型忽略了板片边缘三维环向流。
First study to evaluate experiment-informed akimotoite CPO fabric evolution and kilometer-scale SPO under realistic slab-induced mantle strains in a geodynamic subduction model.
首次在动力学俯冲应变场下耦合评估了秋本石CPO织构演化与千米级包裹体SPO效应。

kc: Coupled 2D free-subduction geodynamic modeling with VPSC fabric calculations and fast-Fourier homogenization to test origins of LMTZ azimuthal anisotropy.
Demonstrated that realistic pyrolitic assemblages containing 20% vol. akimotoite generate too weak azimuthal anisotropy (0.4–0.6%) to match tomographic observations (2–4%).
Showed that shape-preferred orientation (SPO) of kilometer-scale inclusions can explain observed anisotropy with 17.5–20% velocity contrasts for gentle dips, or >6% contrasts for steep dips (>75°).
Proposed that subslab LMTZ azimuthal anisotropy serves as a proxy for deep slab morphology and indicates an inefficiently mixed, chemically heterogeneous transition zone.
将二维自由俯冲地球动力学模拟与VPSC织构计算及快速傅里叶均质化相结合，检验了下地幔过渡带方位各向异性的成因。
证明了含20%体积分数秋本石的真实地幔岩组合仅产生微弱的方位各向异性（0.4-0.6%），不足以匹配层析成像观测值（2-4%）。
表明千米级包裹体的形状优选取向（SPO）在缓倾且速度差为17.5-20%时，或陡倾（>75°）且速度差>6%时，可解释观测到的各向异性。
提出俯冲板片下方LMTZ的方位各向异性可作为深部板片形态的指标，并指示地幔过渡带混合不充分且存在化学不均匀性。
me: 2D thermo-mechanical modeling of intra-oceanic free subduction using ASPECT 2.5.0 with viscoplastic rheology and phase transitions.
Lagrangian-tracer polycrystal plasticity modeling using the viscoplastic self-consistent (VPSC) method for olivine, wadsleyite, and akimotoite CPO evolution.
Kinematic tracking and deformation of kilometer-scale elliptical inclusions along mantle flow trajectories to model shape-preferred orientation (SPO).
Long-wavelength effective medium calculation via fast-Fourier homogenization (FFH) at a 164 km homogenization wavelength.
利用ASPECT 2.5.0结合粘塑性流变学和相变进行洋内自由俯冲的二维热-力学模拟。
使用粘塑性自洽（VPSC）方法对拉格朗日追踪集合体进行多晶塑性建模，计算橄榄石、瓦兹利石和秋本石的CPO演化。
沿地幔流轨迹运动学追踪千米级椭圆包裹体的变形，以模拟形状优选取向（SPO）。
采用快速傅里叶均质化（FFH）方法在164 km均质化波长下计算长波长等效介质。
de: Global surface-wave azimuthal anisotropy tomography model 3DLGL-TPESv (updated Nov. 2022) inspected at 550 km depth across Kurile, Honshu, Bonin, and Chile subduction zones.
Suite of LMTZ CPO numerical experiments testing 20%, 50%, and 100% akimotoite volume fractions.
Suite of LMTZ SPO numerical experiments testing elliptical inclusion velocity reductions of 10%, 12.5%, 15%, 17.5%, and 20%.
2D periodic layering homogenization experiments testing dip angles from 0° to 90° and velocity contrasts from 1% to 10%.
全球面波方位各向异性层析成像模型3DLGL-TPESv（2022年11月更新），重点考察千岛、本州、小笠原和智利俯冲带550 km深度。
测试秋本石体积分数分别为20%、50%和100%的一系列LMTZ CPO数值实验。
测试椭圆包裹体速度降低分别为10%、12.5%、15%、17.5%和20%的一系列LMTZ SPO数值实验。
测试倾角从0°到90°以及速度对比从1%到10%的二维周期性层状介质均质化实验。
li: Competing controls of heterogeneity orientation and seismic velocity contrast make the SPO interpretation inherently non-unique.
Simulations are restricted to 2D intra-oceanic stagnant slab subduction, omitting 3D toroidal flow around slab edges and other slab penetration regimes.
Pre-existing crystallographic textures are completely reset across phase transition density boundaries rather than allowing partial texture inheritance.
不均匀体取向与地震波速度对比的竞争控制使得SPO解释在很大程度上具有非唯一性。
模拟局限于二维洋内停滞板片俯冲，忽略了板片边缘的三维环向流及其他板片穿透机制。
跨越相变密度边界时完全重置了原有的晶体织构，而未考虑部分织构继承。

tm.why: The paper explicitly models and evaluates intrinsic (akimotoite CPO) versus extrinsic (SPO) azimuthal anisotropy in the lower mantle transition zone.
The study couples geodynamic models of free subduction in ASPECT with mineral fabric evolution to infer compositional heterogeneity and slab morphology in the mantle transition zone.

ev.notes: All metadata, methodology, numerical results, figure analyses, and verbatim quotes were extracted directly from the 29-page preprint PDF.

sum: This document presents a formal correction to the previously published article 'Data-space cross-validation of mantle structure in global tomographic models underneath the Pacific Ocean'. The original study evaluated and cross-validated global seismic tomographic models of the mantle beneath the Pacific Ocean using data-space methods to assess model consistency and uncertainty. This correction addresses specific errors in the original publication (such as typos, figure labeling, or minor calculation errors) to ensure scientific accuracy.
本文是对已发表论文《太平洋下方全球地幔断层成像模型数据空间交叉验证》的正式勘误。原研究利用数据空间交叉验证方法评估了太平洋下方全球地震断层成像模型的地幔结构，以分析模型的一致性与不确定性。本勘误旨在修正原文献中的特定错误（如排版、图表标注或计算细节），以确保学术研究的准确性。

t: Data-space cross-validation of global seismic tomographic models to evaluate mantle structure consistency.
利用全球地震断层成像模型的数据空间交叉验证来评估地幔结构的一致性。
Global seismic travel-time or waveform datasets used in tomographic models of the Pacific mantle.
用于太平洋地幔断层成像模型的全球地震走时或波形数据集。
Correction of specific errors in the original evaluation of Pacific mantle tomographic models.
纠正了原太平洋地幔断层成像模型评估中的特定错误。
As a correction note, it only addresses specific errata rather than presenting new methodological developments.
作为勘误，仅解决特定的错误，不包含新的方法学进展。
Provides the necessary corrections to maintain the integrity and accuracy of the original cross-validation study.
提供了必要的修正，以维护原始交叉验证研究的完整性与准确性。

纠正了关于太平洋地幔断层成像模型数据空间交叉验证原论文中的错误。

全球地震断层成像模型的数据空间交叉验证（原研究方法）。

用于太平洋地幔断层成像模型的全球地震走时或波形数据集（原研究数据）。

sum: Debate persists over whether subduction interface roughness promotes or inhibits great megathrust earthquakes, largely due to reliance on indirect bathymetric proxies, single-margin studies, and short historical earthquake catalogs. This study directly measures plate boundary fault roughness at 1–10 km length scales using 35 depth-migrated active-source seismic reflection profiles across 15 global subduction zones. The authors compute three roughness metrics—maximum residual (R_MR), root-mean-square residual (R_RMSR), and fractal amplitude parameter (R_FAP)—and compare them with historical/instrumental maximum earthquake magnitudes and geodetically constrained interseismic coupling. Results demonstrate a strong positive correlation (R^2 = 0.65) between maximum earthquake magnitude and interface coupling, establishing coupling as a viable proxy for seismic potential. Conversely, none of the roughness metrics correlate with either maximum magnitude or interface coupling (R = -0.14). This challenges the prevailing hypothesis that 1–10 km interface roughness governs megathrust seismogenesis and suggests marine geodesy is far more valuable for hazard assessment.
本研究利用全球15个俯冲带的35条深度偏移主动源地震反射剖面，直接量化了1–10公里尺度的板块边界断层粗糙度（最大残差、均方根残差和分形振幅参数），并将其与历史最大地震震级及大地测量约束的震间耦合度进行对比。结果表明，最大地震震级与界面耦合呈强正相关（R²=0.65），证明耦合度是评估地震潜力的有效……

t: Quantifies plate interface roughness across 1–10 km windows on 35 depth-migrated seismic reflection profiles using maximum residual (R_MR), root-mean-square residual (R_RMSR), and fractal amplitude parameter (R_FAP) via the roughness-length method.
利用粗糙度-长度法在35条深度偏移地震剖面上计算1–10公里尺度的最大残差、均方根残差和分形振幅参数。

35 depth-migrated active-source 2D seismic reflection profiles (>20 km long) and two 3D volumes across 15 subduction margins, paired with USGS earthquake catalogs and published geodetic interseismic coupling models.
全球15个俯冲带的35条二维和2个三维深度偏移地震反射剖面、USGS地震目录及大地测量震间耦合模型。

Maximum earthquake magnitude strongly correlates with maximum interseismic coupling (R^2 = 0.65), whereas 1–10 km interface roughness indicators show no correlation with maximum magnitude or coupling (R = -0.14).
最大震级与最大震间耦合呈强正相关（R²=0.65），而1–10公里界面粗糙度与最大震级或耦合度均无相关性（R=-0.14…
Seismic reflection profiles are predominantly 2D and sample only a small fraction of the >50,000 km global subduction zones, requiring future 3D interface imaging.
地震剖面主要为二维且仅抽样了全球超5万公里俯冲带的一小部分，未来需更多三维观测。
First global multi-margin study directly measuring subsurface plate interface roughness from depth-migrated seismic reflection profiles rather than indirect seafloor bathymetry or gravity proxies.
首次在全球多俯冲带直接利用深度偏移地震反射剖面测量地下板块界面粗糙度，而非依赖海底地形或重力代理指标。

kc: Compiled a global dataset of 35 depth-migrated seismic reflection profiles (>20 km length) across 15 subduction margins to directly measure plate interface geometry.
Quantified interface roughness across 1–10 km scales using three distinct metrics (R_MR, R_RMSR, R_FAP) and demonstrated that relative margin roughness varies with metric and scale.
Established a strong positive linear correlation (R^2 = 0.65) between maximum interseismic geodetic coupling and maximum observed earthquake magnitude.

Demonstrated that 1–10 km plate interface roughness has no statistically significant correlation with either maximum earthquake magnitude or interseismic coupling, refuting its use as a seismic hazard proxy.
汇编了全球15个俯冲带35条长度大于20公里的深度偏移地震反射剖面，直接测量了板块界面几何形态。
利用三种不同指标量化了1–10公里尺度的界面粗糙度，证明各俯冲带相对粗糙度随计算方法和观测尺度而显著变化。
确立了最大震间大地测量耦合度与观测到的最大地震震级之间的强正线性相关关系（R² = 0.65）。
证明1–10公里尺度的板块界面粗糙度与最大地震震级或震间耦合均无统计学相关性，否定了将其作为地震危险性评估指标的做法。
me: Interpretation of plate boundary fault geometries from depth-migrated 2D and 3D active-source seismic reflection profiles.
Calculation of elevation residuals around least-squares linear trends across sliding window lengths from 1 to 10 km to derive maximum residual (R_MR) and root-mean-square residual (R_RMSR).
Application of the self-affine fractal roughness-length method (RLM) to compute the Hurst exponent, fractal dimension, and fractal amplitude parameter (R_FAP).

Statistical cross-correlation of roughness metrics against USGS/historical maximum earthquake magnitudes and geodetic interseismic coupling ratios within 100 km along-strike and 10–50 km depth windows.
从深度偏移的二维和三维主动源地震反射剖面中解释板块边界断层几何形态。
在1至10公里的滑动窗口内计算相对于最小二乘线性趋势的高程残差，以导出最大残差（R_MR）和均方根残差（R_RMSR）。
应用自仿射分形粗糙度-长度法（RLM）计算赫斯特指数、分形维数和分形振幅参数（R_FAP）。
在沿走向100公里、深度10–50公里的区域内，对粗糙度指标与最大地震震级及大地测量震间耦合率进行统计交叉相关分析。
de: 35 depth-migrated 2D active-source seismic reflection profiles (>20 km long) across 15 global subduction zones compiled from peer-reviewed literature.
Two 3D prestack depth-migrated seismic reflection volumes from Costa Rica and North Hikurangi (10–15 km along-strike) used to validate 2D roughness representativeness.
USGS earthquake catalog (1900–2026) and published historical rupture maps (e.g., 1700 Cascadia, 1843 Barbados).
Published peer-reviewed geodetic interseismic coupling models for all 15 subduction margins.
从同行评审文献中汇编的跨越全球15个俯冲带的35条深度偏移二维主动源地震反射剖面（长度>20公里）。
来自哥斯达黎加和北希库朗伊的两个三维叠前深度偏移地震反射数据体（沿走向10–15公里），用于验证二维粗糙度的代表性。
美国地质调查局（USGS）地震目录（1900–2026年）及已发表的历史破裂图（如1700年卡斯卡迪亚、1843年巴巴多斯地震）。
已发表的覆盖全部15个俯冲带的同行评审大地测量震间耦合模型。
li: Available active-source seismic reflection data are sparse, predominantly 2D, and cover only a tiny fraction of the >50,000 km global subduction zone length.
Roughness analysis is restricted to length scales of 1–10 km due to profile lengths, leaving potential effects of broader 80–100 km scale features unexamined by direct reflection imaging.
Assuming a single 2D profile represents a 100 km along-strike megathrust segment simplifies 3D structural variations.
可用的主动源地震反射数据稀疏且主要为二维，仅覆盖全球超过50,000公里俯冲带总长度的极小部分。
受剖面长度限制，粗糙度分析仅限于1–10公里尺度，未直接检验80–100公里更大尺度地形特征的潜在影响。
假设单条二维剖面代表沿走向100公里的巨型逆冲断层段简化了三维结构变化。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates how plate boundary fault geometry, interface roughness, and interseismic geodetic coupling control megathrust seismogenic behavior across global subduction zones.
The study evaluates whether subduction interface roughness and interplate coupling can serve as reliable indicators for maximum earthquake magnitude and seismic hazard assessment.
The authors compile and analyze 35 depth-migrated active-source seismic reflection profiles across 15 subduction margins to characterize plate boundary structural geometry.

ev.notes: Full 21-page PDF analyzed, including main text, Methods, 5 main figures, and 10 Extended Data figures.

sum: Ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) continuously record low-frequency ocean sound, offering an untapped resource for passive acoustic monitoring of baleen whales. This study presents a deep learning semantic segmentation framework (ResNet-18 encoder with a U-Net decoder and seeded region-growing post-processing) to detect fin whale 20-Hz notes in OBS spectrograms. Trained on hydrophone recordings from one OBS station in the São Jorge array, the model was applied without retraining to vertical-component seismometer recordings across the regional UPFLOW array in the Azores-Madeira-Canaries region. Across 378,912 hours of data from 46 OBS sites, the detector identified 6.3 million calls with ~97% precision, assembling the largest fin whale call catalogue to date. The temporally and spectrally resolved detections reveal seasonal calling peaks from October to February and coherent seasonal shifts among three inter-note interval (INI) groups (~12 s, 16 s, and 20 s), demonstrating scalable basin-wide bioacoustic monitoring using geophysical infrastructure.
本研究提出一种基于ResNet-18和U-Net的深度学习语义分割与区域生长后处理框架，用于在海底地震仪（OBS）时频谱图中检测长须鲸20Hz脉冲信号。模型仅使用圣若热台阵单台水听器数据训练，无需重新训练即泛化至亚速尔-马德拉-加那利地区UPFLOW台阵的垂直分量地震计记录。通过对46个台站共378……

t: Spectrograms of 5-minute OBS windows are segmented pixel-wise using a ResNet-18 encoder and U-Net decoder, followed by seeded region-growing and non-maximum suppression to extract time-frequency bounding boxes of 20-Hz fin whale calls.
使用ResNet-18编码器与U-Net解码器对5分钟OBS时频谱图进行像素分割，结合种子区域生长提取20Hz鲸鸣时频边…

378,912 hours of continuous OBS recordings from 46 stations across two North Atlantic deployments: 6 hydrophones from the São Jorge array (2022–2023) and 40 vertical-component seismometers from the UPFLOW array (2021–2022).
北大西洋São Jorge（6台水听器）与UPFLOW（40台垂直地震计）共46个OBS台站378,912小时连续记录。

The detector identified 6,291,626 fin whale calls, achieving 94% precision and 80% recall on São Jorge hydrophones and 97% precision (33% recall) on UPFLOW seismometers, revealing three seasonal INI groups at ~12 s, 16 s, and 20 s.
检出6,291,626次鲸鸣，São Jorge与UPFLOW精确率达94%与97%，揭示12s、16s和20s三组季节…
Recall on UPFLOW seismometers is low and variable (9–53%) due to varying seafloor coupling, high noise floors, earthquake and shipping masking, and overlapping calls during dense chorusing.
受海底耦合差异、高背景噪声及密集合唱掩蔽影响，UPFLOW垂直地震计召回率较低且波动大（9–53%）。

Demonstrates zero-shot transfer of a pixel-level spectrogram segmentation detector from OBS hydrophones to regional vertical-component seismometers, producing the largest fin whale call catalogue (6.3M calls) to date.
实现从水听器到区域垂直地震计的像素级分割模型零样本迁移，构建了迄今最大的630万次长须鲸鸣叫目录。

kc: Developed a pixel-level semantic segmentation and region-growing post-processing pipeline for detecting fin whale 20-Hz calls in OBS spectrograms.
Demonstrated zero-shot cross-sensor generalization from OBS hydrophone recordings to vertical-component seismometer recordings across distinct ocean environments with ~97% precision.
Assembled and released the largest fin whale call catalogue to date (6.29 million calls from 378,912 hours across 46 OBS stations in the eastern North Atlantic).
Characterized basin-scale spatiotemporal calling patterns and intra-seasonal shifts across three persistent inter-note interval (INI) groups (~12 s, 16 s, and 20 s).
开发了结合像素级语义分割与区域生长后处理的流程，用于在OBS时频谱图中检测长须鲸20Hz鸣叫。
验证了模型从OBS水听器到不同海域垂直分量地震计记录的零样本跨传感器泛化能力，精确率达97%。
构建并公开了迄今最大的长须鲸鸣叫目录（涵盖东北大西洋46个OBS台站378,912小时记录中的629万次鸣叫）。
揭示了海盆尺度的时空鸣叫分布规律以及三种持续脉冲间隔（约12s、16s和20s）在鸣唱季内的动态转换。
me: Short-time Fourier transform (2.0 s Hanning window, 75% overlap) on 5-minute waveform segments band-limited to 12–35 Hz and rescaled to 480x640 greyscale images.
Encoder-decoder semantic segmentation network using an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 backbone and a U-Net decoder trained with binary cross-entropy loss.
Post-segmentation processing using template convolution, seeded region growing from local probability maxima, non-maximum suppression (IoU > 0.15), and spectral-temporal domain filtering.
Inter-note interval (INI) distribution and seasonal time-series analysis across the sensor network.
对5分钟波形片段进行短时傅里叶变换（2.0秒汉宁窗，75%重叠），限制在12–35 Hz频带并缩放为480x640灰度图像。
采用ImageNet预训练ResNet-18骨干网和U-Net解码器构建编码器-解码器语义分割网络，使用二元交叉熵损失训练。
结合模板卷积、基于局部概率极大值的种子区域生长、非极大值抑制（IoU > 0.15）及时频域滤波进行后处理。
在传感器台网尺度上进行脉冲间隔（INI）分布统计与季节性时间序列分析。
de: 378,912 hours of continuous OBS recordings from 46 stations across two deployments in the Azores-Madeira-Canaries region: São Jorge (6 short-period OBS hydrophones, Aug 2022–Feb 2023) and UPFLOW (40 broadband OBS vertical seismometers, Jun 2021–Aug 2022).

Training, validation, and testing dataset of ~4,200 five-minute spectrograms (~350 hours) containing nearly 40,000 manually annotated 20-Hz calls from station SJO03 plus background noise samples from SJO03, UP36, and UP41.
Independent cross-sensor evaluation dataset from 16 spatially and temporally balanced UPFLOW stations annotated by a separate analyst.
亚速尔-马德拉-加那利地区两个OBS台阵共46个台站378,912小时的连续记录：São Jorge（6台短周期OBS水听器，2022年8月至2023年2月）和UPFLOW（40台宽频带OBS垂直分量地震计，2021年6月至2022年8月）。
包含约4,200张5分钟时频谱图（约350小时）的训练、验证与测试集，含SJO03台站近40,000个手动标注的20Hz鸣叫样本及SJO03、UP36和UP41的背景噪声样本。
由独立标注员标注的16个时空均衡分布的UPFLOW台站跨传感器评估数据集。
li: Substantially lower and variable recall on UPFLOW vertical seismometers (33% overall, range 9–53%) due to low SNR, variable seafloor coupling, ambient/shipping noise masking, and dense whale chorusing.
Catalogue only captures 20-Hz notes and excludes other fin whale vocalizations such as less abundant backbeat calls or higher-frequency components.
Apparent spatial differences in call counts across stations remain partially confounded by site-specific detectability and propagation environment variations.
受低信噪比、海底耦合差异、环境与航运噪声掩蔽以及密集合唱重叠影响，UPFLOW垂直地震计上的召回率较低且波动较大（总体33%，范围9–53%）。
目录仅捕获20Hz脉冲音，未包含长须鲸的其他叫声类型（如伴奏音backbeat或高频成分）。
不同台站表观鸣叫计数的空间差异在一定程度上仍受台站特定可检测性与传播环境差异的混淆。

tm.why: The paper applies deep learning to ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) recordings for marine bioacoustics and ecological monitoring of fin whales.
It develops a semantic segmentation deep learning framework (ResNet-18 + U-Net) applied to spectrograms from seismic and hydrophone channels.
The study repurposes 46 ocean-bottom seismometers across two regional OBS arrays (São Jorge and UPFLOW) in the North Atlantic.

ev.notes: Full 35-page PDF (including supplementary material) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study revisits the 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto earthquake sequence in Kyushu, Japan, by applying an integrated spatio-temporal statistical framework to the JMA earthquake catalog (2014–2018, Mc ≈ 2.15–2.25). The authors jointly evaluate the Gutenberg-Richter b-value, 3D hypocentral fractal dimension (Dc), and standardized seismicity-rate anomaly (Z-value). During the 1–2 year preparatory phase, the regional b-value declined from 1.35 to 0.59 and Dc contracted from 0.85 to 0.70–0.80, accompanied by a negative Z-value quiescence anomaly (-1.6 to -2.0). Three-dimensional depth slices and 4-month temporal stacks reveal a vertically stratified low-b locked core at 10–12.5 km depth that sharpened acutely in the final four months before failure. Coseismic rupture rapidly reversed these signals (b surging to 1.25–1.35, Dc expanding to >2.0), followed by a 2.5-year Omori-like recovery and persistent low-b residual asperities near the Hinagu fault termination and Mount Aso.
本研究利用日本气象厅（JMA）2014–2018年地震目录（完备震级约2.15–2.25），通过联合分析古登堡-里克特b值、三维震源分形维数（Dc）和地震活动率异常（Z值），重新审视了2016年日本熊本Mw 7.0地震序列。震前1–2年准备期内，b值从1.35降至0.59，Dc收缩至0.70–0.8……

t: Joint spatio-temporal mapping and 3D depth-slicing of Gutenberg-Richter b-value, 3D hypocentral fractal dimension (Dc), and seismicity-rate anomaly (Z-value) using dynamic completeness estimation and bootstrap uncertainty analysis.
利用动态完备震级估计与自助法不确定性分析，对b值、三维分形维数Dc和Z值进行联合时空成图与三维切片。

JMA unified earthquake catalog from 2014 to 2018 within a 1.2° × 1.2° spatial aperture centered on the 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto mainshock (32.75°N, 130.76°E), comprising 13,083 pre-mainshock and 136,487 post-mainshock events.
以熊本主震为中心的1.2°×1.2°窗口内2014–2018年JMA地震目录（含震前13,083次和震后136,487次…

Precursory b-value dropped from 1.35 to 0.59 and Dc contracted to 0.70–0.80, forming a locked core (b <= 0.65) at 10–12.5 km depth in the final four months; coseismic rupture surged b to 1.25–1.35 and Dc to 2.04–2.11.
震前b从1.35降至0.59，Dc缩至0.70–0.80，震前四个月在10–12.5 km形成低b核；同震使b升至1.2…
The anomalies were identified retrospectively with foreknowledge of the mainshock location, timing, and magnitude, so the framework is not yet a validated operational forecasting tool.
异常均基于主震先验信息回顾性识别，尚未经受前瞻性业务预测检验。
First high-resolution joint 3D spatio-temporal characterization of b-value, Dc, and Z-value across the complete foreshock-mainshock-aftershock cycle of the 2016 Kumamoto sequence.
首次对2016年熊本地震全周期的b值、Dc和Z值进行高分辨率联合三维时空刻画。

kc: Joint spatio-temporal mapping of b-value, 3D fractal dimension (Dc), and Z-value across the complete 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto earthquake cycle.
Identification of an acute precursory low-b locked core (b <= 0.65) at 10–12.5 km depth that developed primarily within the final four months before mainshock failure.
Delineation of two post-seismic unrelaxed residual asperities (b ≈ 0.80–0.95) at the southwestern Hinagu fault termination and near Mount Aso.
对2016年熊本Mw 7.0地震完整周期进行了b值、三维分形维数（Dc）和Z值的联合时空成图。
识别出10–12.5 km深度处主要在主震前最后四个月内急剧发育的震前低b值闭锁核（b <= 0.65）。
圈定了日奈久断层西南端和阿苏山火山通道附近两个震后未松弛的残余凹凸体（b ≈ 0.80–0.95）。
me: Dynamic completeness magnitude (Mc) estimation and Gutenberg-Richter b-value mapping (including Bayesian b-value cross-sections and bootstrap uncertainty quantification).
Three-dimensional hypocentral fractal dimension (Dc) computation using Euclidean inter-event distances of nearest-neighbor earthquakes.
Standardized seismicity-rate anomaly (Z-value) analysis across multiple test window lengths (1, 3, and 5 months) and 3D spatio-temporal stacking.
动态完备震级（Mc）估计与古登堡-里克特b值成图（含贝叶斯b值剖面与自助法不确定性量化）。
利用最近邻地震的三维欧氏震源间距计算三维震源分形维数（Dc）。
跨多测试时间窗（1、3和5个月）的标准化地震活动率异常（Z值）分析及三维时空层叠分析。
de: Unified earthquake catalog from the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) spanning 2014–2018 (and up to early 2019 for 4-month stacks) within a 1.2° × 1.2° spatial window centered on the Kumamoto mainshock.
Pre-mainshock sub-catalog (N = 13,083) and post-mainshock aftershock catalog (N = 136,487) projected onto 3D depth slices and three fault-parallel/transverse cross-sections.
日本气象厅（JMA）2014–2018年（四个月叠加延至2019年初）以熊本主震为中心的1.2° × 1.2°空间窗内的统一地震目录。
投影至三维深度切片及三条顺断层/横穿断层剖面的震前子目录（N = 13,083）与震后余震目录（N = 136,487）。
li: The anomalies were identified retrospectively with foreknowledge of the mainshock location, timing, and magnitude, and thus do not constitute a validated operational forecasting tool.
The catalog duration examined (up to 2018/2019) is insufficient to track the multi-year to decadal fault strength recovery process to completion.
所报告的异常是在已知主震位置、时间和震级的前提下回顾性识别的，因此不能直接作为经过验证的业务预测工具。
所分析的地震目录时长（至2018/2019年）不足以完整追踪长达数年至数十年的断层强度完全恢复过程。

tm.why: The study uses the dense JMA earthquake catalog (2014–2018) with dynamic completeness estimation to perform spatio-temporal statistical analysis of seismicity parameters.
The paper investigates crustal fault strain accumulation, asperity locking, rupture nucleation, and post-seismic stress redistribution along the Futagawa-Hinagu fault zone.
The multi-parameter statistical framework is evaluated as a diagnostic probe for monitoring differential stress and seismic hazard on active crustal faults.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the title, abstract, and extracted PDF text (pages 1–6 and 13–30; pages 8–12 containing Figs. 3–4 were omitted in the provided extract).

sum: Estimating seismic attenuation (inverse quality factor) from reflection data requires a physically consistent reflection coefficient equation and stable inversion. Within isotropic linear viscoelastic media, this study applies the local Kramers-Kronig relations (KKR) to express complex stiffness moduli as functions of seismic attenuation. Using the Born integral and stationary phase approximation under weak attenuation and small contrast assumptions, the authors derive a causal, frequency-dependent PP-wave reflection coefficient explicitly containing P- and S-wave attenuation terms. This equation is integrated into a frequency-dependent AVO (FDAVO) inversion framework utilizing an adaptive generalized S-transform and an L1-L2 mixed-norm regularization solved via the Split Bregman algorithm. Synthetic tests using a patchy-saturated sandstone model and 3D field seismic data applications demonstrate that the inverted P-wave attenuation attribute accurately delineates high gas saturation reservoirs with enhanced vertical resolution and suppressed background interference.
本研究在各向同性线性粘弹性介质框架下，结合Kramers-Kronig关系与散射理论，推导了满足因果约束且显式包含纵横波衰减项的频变PP波反射系数方程。基于该方程，在频变AVO（FDAVO）反演框架下引入自适应广义S变换和L1-L2混合范数正则化，利用Split Bregman算法反演纵波衰减属性。……

t: Combines local Kramers-Kronig relations with Born scattering theory to derive a causal frequency-dependent PP-wave reflection coefficient, then estimates P-wave attenuation via FDAVO inversion with L1-L2 mixed-norm regularization.
结合局部Kramers-Kronig关系与Born散射理论推导因果频变PP波反射系数，并利用L1-L2混合范数正则化FD…
Evaluated on synthetic pre-stack gathers from a three-layer patchy-saturated sandstone model (gas saturations 0.1, 0.4, 0.7) and 3D field pre-stack seismic data tied to Well A logs.
采用三层斑块饱和砂岩模型（含气饱和度0.1、0.4、0.7）合成叠前道集及三维实际叠前地震与测井数据。

Inverted P-wave attenuation anomalies increase with gas saturation, and increasing the L1 regularization parameter suppresses non-reservoir reflections, accurately delineating high gas saturation zones in both synthetic and 3D field data.
纵波衰减属性异常随含气饱和度增加而增强，L1正则化有效压制非储层干扰，精准刻画了高含气储层分布。
Restricted to isotropic linear viscoelastic media under weak attenuation and Born approximation; inverted attributes represent band-limited equivalent attenuation rather than absolute Q^-1.
受限于各向同性弱衰减及Born近似假设，不适用于强裂缝各向异性，且反演值为等效相对衰减。

Explicitly enforces physical causality between dispersion and attenuation in linearized viscoelastic reflection coefficients via Kramers-Kronig relations, paired with sparse mixed-norm FDAVO inversion.
通过Kramers-Kronig关系在反射系数中显式引入频散与衰减的因果约束，并结合混合范数提高反演分辨率。

kc: Derived a causal frequency-dependent PP-wave reflection coefficient equation explicitly incorporating seismic attenuation via Kramers-Kronig relations and weak scattering theory.
Established a frequency-dependent AVO (FDAVO) inversion framework using an L1-L2 mixed-norm constraint solved by the Split Bregman algorithm to improve resolution.
Demonstrated on synthetic and 3D field seismic data that the inverted P-wave attenuation attribute reliably identifies high gas saturation sandstone reservoirs.
结合Kramers-Kronig关系和弱散射理论，推导了满足因果约束且显式包含地震衰减的频变PP波反射系数方程。
构建了引入L1-L2混合范数约束的频变AVO反演框架，并采用Split Bregman算法求解以提高反演分辨率。
通过合成数据和三维实际地震数据验证了反演的纵波衰减属性能够可靠地识别高含气饱和度砂岩储层。
me: Local approximation of Kramers-Kronig relations linking storage modulus dispersion to inverse quality factor.
Born integral and stationary phase approximation in isotropic viscoelastic media for linearized PP-wave reflection coefficients.
Frequency-dependent AVO inversion using adaptive generalized S-transform time-frequency spectra and L1-L2 mixed-norm regularization.
利用局部近似Kramers-Kronig关系建立储能模量频散与逆品质因子之间的解析联系。
基于各向同性粘弹性介质中的Born积分与稳相近似推导线性化PP波反射系数。
结合自适应广义S变换时频谱与L1-L2混合范数正则化进行频变AVO反演。
de: Synthetic three-layer model (mudstone-sandstone-mudstone) using Johnson's mesoscopic patchy saturation model at gas saturations of 0.1, 0.4, and 0.7.
Pre-stack synthetic seismic gathers generated via the acoustic wave equation phase shift method with a 25 Hz Ricker wavelet.
3D field pre-stack angle gathers (8°, 18°, 29°) and well log data (Well A) across a gas-bearing sandstone reservoir.
基于Johnson介观斑块饱和模型构建的三层介质合成模型（含气饱和度分别为0.1、0.4和0.7）。
采用主频25 Hz雷克子波和声波方程相移法模拟的叠前合成地震道集。
含气砂岩储层工区的三维实际叠前部分叠加角道集（8°、18°、29°）及A井测井数据。
li: Assumes isotropic linear viscoelastic media, making it less accurate for reservoirs with significant fracture-induced anisotropy.
Relies on weak attenuation and Born scattering approximations, which break down under strong attenuation, strong scattering, or complex fault structures.
Inverted P-wave attenuation attributes represent equivalent band-limited responses rather than strictly absolute inverse quality factor values.
假设介质为各向同性线性粘弹性介质，不适用于具有显著裂缝诱导各向异性的储层。
依赖弱衰减和Born散射近似，在强衰减、强散射或复杂断层构造条件下精度会降低。
反演得到的纵波衰减属性代表有效频带内的等效衰减响应，而非严格绝对的逆品质因子值。

tm.why: The paper derives a frequency-dependent PP-wave reflection coefficient equation explicitly containing seismic attenuation (inverse quality factor Q^-1) using Kramers-Kronig relations and scattering theory.
The study formulates a frequency-dependent AVO inversion with L1-L2 mixed-norm regularization solved via the Split Bregman method to estimate P-wave attenuation.

ev.notes: Full 37-page PDF analyzed, including mathematical derivations in Methodology and Appendices A & B, synthetic patchy-saturation experiments, and 3D field data application.

sum: This paper analyzes crustal seismic anisotropy along the Sumatran subduction zone in Indonesia using local earthquake waveforms. By measuring shear-wave splitting parameters (fast polarization directions and delay times) from local events, the authors characterize the upper crustal stress field and structural fabric. The results reveal spatial variations in anisotropy that correlate with major geological features, such as the Great Sumatran Fault and the subducting Indo-Australian plate, providing insights into the regional tectonic stress and deformation patterns.
本研究利用地方地震波形分析了印尼苏门答腊俯冲带的地壳地震各向异性。通过测量剪切波分裂参数（快波偏振方向和慢波延迟时间），研究人员表征了上地壳应力场和结构特征。结果显示，各向异性存在显著的空间变化，且与苏门答腊大断裂及俯冲的印度-澳大利亚板块等主要地质特征密切相关，为理解该区域的构造应力和形变模式提供……

t: Shear-wave splitting analysis of local earthquake shear waves to estimate fast polarization directions and delay times.
利用地方地震剪切波进行剪切波分裂分析，估算快波偏振方向和延迟时间。
Local earthquake waveforms recorded by seismic networks along the Sumatran subduction zone, Indonesia.
印尼苏门答腊俯冲带沿线地震台网记录的地方地震波形。
Spatial variations in crustal anisotropy parameters reflecting the local stress field and tectonic structures like the Great Sumatran Fault.
地壳各向异性参数的空间变化反映了局部应力场和苏门答腊大断裂等构造特征。
Resolution is constrained by the distribution of local earthquakes and seismic station coverage.
分辨率受限于地方地震的分布和地震台站的覆盖范围。
Provides a detailed, localized characterization of crustal anisotropy along the active Sumatran subduction margin.
提供了活跃的苏门答腊俯冲带沿线地壳各向异性的详细局部表征。

kc: Characterizes crustal seismic anisotropy along the Sumatran subduction zone using local earthquake data.
Reveals spatial variations in shear-wave splitting parameters and their correlation with regional tectonic features.
利用地方地震数据表征了苏门答腊俯冲带的地壳地震各向异性。
揭示了剪切波分裂参数的空间变化及其与区域构造特征的关联。
me: Shear-wave splitting analysis of local earthquake waveforms to determine fast polarization directions and delay times.
对地方地震波形进行剪切波分裂分析，以确定快波偏振方向和延迟时间。

由印尼苏门答腊俯冲带沿线地震台站记录的地方地震波形数据。

It analyzes the crustal structure and tectonic deformation along the Sumatran subduction zone.

sum: Estimating shallow acoustic source depth using a deep-ocean near-bottom vertical line array relies on depth-sensitive interference patterns in broadband matched beam-intensity processing (MBIP). However, at low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), nonlinear feature extraction transforms array noise into feature-domain distortions, degrading snapshot-based estimators. To overcome this, the authors propose a tensor evolution-based depth estimation (TEDS) method inspired by dynamic mode decomposition (DMD). TEDS models a time sequence of broadband MBIP frequency-angle surfaces using a time-varying autoregressive operator constrained by a low-rank Tucker decomposition and total variation regularization. This separates coherent spectral-angular feature modes and their smooth temporal evolution from incoherent noise. Source depth is then inferred by applying Fourier summation to the dominant interference feature mode. Numerical simulations using KRAKEN in a Munk deep-ocean profile demonstrate that TEDS achieves a 6.3 m mean absolute error at -15 dB SNR, substantially outperforming mismatched matched-field processing and conventional broadband MBIP.
针对低信噪比下深海近海底垂直线列阵浅源深度估计易受噪声畸变影响的问题，本文受动态模态分解（DMD）启发，提出了一种基于张量演化的深度估计方法（TEDS）。该方法将宽带匹配波束强度处理（MBIP）的频角特征序列建模为受低秩Tucker分解和全变分正则化约束的时变自回归系统，从而将相干的深度敏感干涉模态……

t: Models sequential broadband MBIP frequency-angle surfaces via a time-varying autoregressive operator factorized by a rank-3 Tucker decomposition with total variation regularization on temporal modes, solved via block coordinate descent before Fourier summation.
利用低秩Tucker分解与时间全变分正则化的时变自回归算子建模MBIP特征序列，经块坐标下降求解后由傅里叶求和估计深度。
Synthetic acoustic pressure fields generated by KRAKEN in a deep-ocean Munk profile for a 32-element VLA at 4900 m depth, tracking a 100–300 Hz source at 60–200 m depths over 1–5 km.
基于KRAKEN在Munk剖面下模拟4900米深32元垂直阵接收声场，跟踪60–200米深、100–300 Hz移动声源…
For a 100 m-deep source at -15 dB SNR, TEDS achieves a mean absolute error of 6.3 m, outperforming mismatched MFP (21.0 m) and conventional broadband MBIP (44.2 m), running in 25 s.
在-15 dB信噪比下对100米深声源估计的平均绝对误差为6.3米，远优于失配MFP（21.0米）和MBIP（44.2米…
The linear time-varying model degrades during long tracks with strong bearing migration, for deeper sources violating the simplified RAP model, and under vertical array tilt.
长轨迹强方位迁移、较深声源偏离简化RAP模型以及垂直阵列倾斜会导致该线性时变模型精度下降。
Extends DMD to a time-varying tensor-structured autoregressive operator that regularizes dynamic feature evolution rather than static acoustic fields, isolating depth interference from noise.
将DMD扩展为时变张量自回归算子，对动态特征演化过程而非静态声场施加低秩张量正则化以分离深度干涉特征。

kc: Formulates sequential broadband MBIP surfaces as a time-varying autoregressive dynamical system regularized by a low-rank Tucker tensor decomposition.
Separates mean spectral-angular energy, target-motion bearing migration, and depth-sensitive periodic interference into distinct latent tensor modes.
Demonstrates superior source depth estimation robustness at -15 dB SNR compared to mismatched matched-field processing and snapshot-based MBIP.
将序列宽带MBIP特征表面建模为受低秩Tucker张量分解正则化的时变自回归动态系统。
将平均谱角能量、目标运动引起的方位迁移以及深度敏感的周期性干涉分离到不同的潜在张量模态中。
证明了在-15 dB低信噪比下，该方法相比环境失配的匹配场处理和单快拍MBIP具有更优越的深度估计稳健性。
me: Broadband matched beam-intensity processing (MBIP) under deep-ocean reliable acoustic path (RAP) geometry.
Time-varying first-order autoregression parameterized by a 3rd-order low-rank Tucker tensor decomposition.
Block coordinate descent alternating among least-squares core update, orthogonal Procrustes update, conjugate gradient, and Adam for total variation regularization.
One-dimensional Fourier summation over the extracted dominant spectral-angular interference mode to estimate source depth.
深海可靠声路径（RAP）几何下的宽带匹配波束强度处理（MBIP）。
由三阶低秩Tucker张量分解参数化的时变一阶自回归模型。
结合最小二乘核更新、正交Procrustes更新、共轭梯度法和Adam全变分正则化的块坐标下降算法。
对提取的主导谱角干涉模态进行一维傅里叶求和以估计声源深度。
de: KRAKEN normal-mode numerical simulations for a 32-element near-bottom VLA centered at 4900 m depth in a Munk sound-speed profile.
Moving shallow acoustic source (depths 60–200 m, band 100–300 Hz) tracked over 1 to 5 km intervals from 16 km initial range.
Performance evaluation across noise-free, -5 dB, -10 dB, and -15 dB SNR levels, including sound-speed mismatch and array-tilt perturbations.
基于KRAKEN简正波程序在Munk声速剖面下对中心深度4900米的32元近海底垂直阵进行数值模拟。
对60至200米深度、100–300 Hz频段的移动浅源在16公里初始距离处进行1至5公里的轨迹跟踪实验。
在无噪声、-5 dB、-10 dB和-15 dB信噪比条件下，结合声速剖面失配和阵列倾斜微扰进行性能评估。
li: Linear time-varying evolution is a local approximation that degrades over long tracking durations (>4 km) for lower modes due to strong bearing migration.
Accuracy degrades for deeper sources (>140 m) where surface-reflected paths traverse strong shallow sound-speed gradients, violating the simplified RAP model.
Sensitive to vertical array tilt, which induces an angular bias that linearly increases depth estimation error.
线性时变演化是一种局部近似，当跟踪距离过长（>4 km）导致强方位迁移时，低阶模态性能会退化。
对于较深声源（>140 m），海面反射路径穿过强浅层声速梯度，偏离简化RAP模型，导致精度下降。
对垂直阵列倾斜敏感，阵列倾斜会引入角度偏差并导致深度估计误差近似线性增加。

tm.why: The paper develops a signal processing method for acoustic source depth estimation using a deep-ocean near-bottom vertical line array (VLA).
It formulates passive source depth localization as a constrained low-rank tensor optimization problem solved via block coordinate descent.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF including equations, algorithms, tables, figures, and appendices was analyzed.

sum: This dataset supports the investigation of a potential fossil slab beneath northern Borneo using five deep-focus earthquakes (Mw 4.3–7.1, 610–670 km depth) recorded between 2019 and 2026. It contains cut seismic waveforms, P-wave first-motion polarity picks, and Bayesian full-moment-tensor (FMT) and static rectangular-source inversion products generated using the BEAT software. Additionally, it includes a relocated hypocenter catalog computed via NonLinLoc and the export scripts used to compile the archive. The data helps resolve the source mechanisms and precise locations of these rare deep events, providing critical constraints on the deep mantle structure and tectonic history of the Bornean lithosphere and subducted slabs.
该数据集支持对婆罗洲北部下方潜在化石板块的研究，涵盖了2019至2026年间记录的5个深源地震（Mw 4.3-7.1，深度610-670千米）。数据集包含切片地震波形、P波初动极性拾取，以及使用BEAT软件进行的贝叶斯全矩张量（FMT）和静态矩形震源反演产物。此外，还包括利用NonLinLoc计算的……

使用BEAT进行贝叶斯全矩张量和静态矩形震源反演，并结合NonLinLoc进行震源重定位。
Waveforms, polarity picks, and instrument responses for five deep-focus earthquakes (Mw 4.3–7.1, 610–670 km depth) beneath northern Borneo (2019–2026).
婆罗洲北部下方五个深源地震（Mw 4.3-7.1，深度610-670千米）的波形、极性拾取和仪器响应。
Relocated hypocenters and moment tensor solutions (including MAP-synthetic waveforms) for the five deep-focus events.
获得了这五个深源事件的重定位震源位置和矩张量解（包括最大后验概率合成波形）。
Small sample size of five events, reflecting the low rate of deep-focus seismicity in the northern Borneo region.
样本量较小（仅五个事件），反映了婆罗洲北部地区深源地震发生率较低的现状。
First comprehensive Bayesian source-inversion and relocation dataset targeting deep-focus earthquakes beneath northern Borneo to investigate a fossil slab.
首次针对婆罗洲北部下方深源地震提供完整的贝叶斯震源反演与重定位数据集，以研究化石板块。
