sum: This article features a discussion with Malc Kent (Viridien) on the growing momentum of distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) in carbon storage, geothermal energy, infrastructure, and reservoir monitoring. While DAS technology excels at collecting vast amounts of subsurface data, the primary bottleneck is not the hardware itself, but rather translating this massive data volume into actionable, reliable decisions that industries can trust. This gap between rapid technical progress and real-world commercial adoption presents significant new opportunities for geophysicists and students to develop better data processing, interpretation, and decision-making workflows.
本文探讨了分布式声学传感（DAS）在碳封存、地热及储层监测中的应用。尽管DAS能采集海量数据，但最大挑战在于如何将数据转化为行业信赖的决策。这种技术与应用落地的差距，为地球物理学者在数据处理与解释方面带来了全新机遇。

t: Qualitative industry analysis and expert discussion focusing on the challenges of DAS technology adoption and data translation.
聚焦于DAS技术应用与数据转化挑战的定性行业分析与专家访谈。
Conceptual discussion based on industry deployments of DAS in carbon storage, geothermal, infrastructure, and reservoir monitoring.
基于DAS在碳封存、地热、基础设施和储层监测中行业部署的概论性讨论。
Identification of the 'trust gap' in decision-making as the primary barrier to DAS adoption, rather than hardware limitations.
确定了决策中的“信任差距”（而非硬件限制）是阻碍DAS应用的主要障碍。
The paper is a high-level overview and does not present new quantitative methods or experimental datasets.
本文为高水平概述，未提出新的定量方法或实验数据集。
Shifts the focus of DAS research from hardware and acquisition capabilities to data interpretation and industry trust.
将DAS的研究重心从硬件和采集能力转移到数据解释与行业信任上。

kc: Highlights the critical gap between DAS data acquisition capabilities and industry decision-making trust.
Identifies key growth sectors for DAS, including carbon storage, geothermal, infrastructure, and reservoir monitoring.
Outlines career and research opportunities for geophysicists and students in addressing DAS data translation challenges.

sum: This study investigates the seismic velocities and P-V-T equation of state of two natural monomineralic chlorite schists up to ~5 GPa and 773 K using ultrasonic interferometry and synchrotron X-ray diffraction in a Paris-Edinburgh press. Chlorite is a major water-carrying mineral in subduction zones, yet its high-pressure elastic properties remain poorly constrained. The authors find that for waves propagating perpendicular to foliation, P-wave velocity increases with pressure while S-wave velocity decreases due to shear modulus softening, resulting in an anomalously high Vp/Vs ratio that exceeds 3 at 5 GPa and 773 K. Thermodynamic modeling along the Lesser Antilles slab-top geotherm demonstrates that less than 5 vol.% chlorite in a hydrated peridotite assemblage can reproduce observed Vp/Vs anomalies (>1.8). Consequently, high Vp/Vs ratios in subduction zone mantle wedges are not necessarily diagnostic of free aqueous fluids or partial melt, but may instead reflect minor chlorite hydration.
本研究利用超声波干涉与同步辐射X射线衍射技术，在高达5 GPa和773 K条件下测量了两种天然单矿物绿泥石片岩的地震波速和P-V-T状态方程。实验发现，垂直于叶理方向传播的纵波速度随压力增加，而横波速度因剪切模量软化随压力降低，导致波速比（Vp/Vs）在5 GPa和773 K时异常升高至约3。热力学……

t: Pulse-echo ultrasonic interferometry and synchrotron energy-dispersive X-ray diffraction in a Paris-Edinburgh press up to 4.9 GPa and 773 K, combined with BurnMan equation-of-state and rock-physics modeling.
利用Paris-Edinburgh压机在4.9 GPa和773 K下进行超声干涉和同步辐射X射线衍射测量及热力学建模。
Two natural nearly monomineralic monoclinic chlorite schists (from Syros exhumed mélange and UCL specimen P2086) cut parallel and perpendicular to foliation.
平行和垂直叶理切割的两个天然单斜绿泥石片岩样品（Syros混杂岩和P2086）。
For Syros chlorite perpendicular to foliation, K0 = 70.9 GPa, Vp increases at 0.2 km/s/GPa, Vs decreases at ~0.07 km/s/GPa, and Vp/Vs increases from >2.2 to ~3 at 5 GPa and 773 K.
垂直叶理方向K0=70.9 GPa，Vs随压力降低，Vp/Vs在5 GPa和773 K时升至约3。
The foliation-parallel sample suffered grain reorientation and partial dehydration producing garnet, requiring its acoustic velocity data to be disregarded in the main discussion.
平行叶理样品发生织构重排与部分脱水生成石榴石，其声学数据被剔除。
Extends chlorite acoustic velocity measurements up to ~5 GPa and tracks texture evolution, showing <5 vol.% chlorite explains subduction Vp/Vs > 1.8 anomalies without free fluids.
首次将绿泥石波速测量拓展至5 GPa，证明<5%绿泥石即可解释高波速比异常。

kc: Measured P- and S-wave velocities and unit cell volumes of natural monoclinic chlorite schists up to 4.9 GPa and 773 K.
Discovered shear modulus softening with pressure perpendicular to foliation, driving Vp/Vs ratios up to ~3 at 5 GPa and 773 K.
Demonstrated that <5 vol.% chlorite in mantle wedge peridotite can explain Vp/Vs > 1.8 anomalies in the Lesser Antilles without invoking free fluids or melts.
测量了高达4.9 GPa和773 K条件下天然单斜绿泥石片岩的纵横波速度及晶胞体积。
发现垂直叶理方向剪切模量随压力软化，导致5 GPa和773 K下Vp/Vs比值高达约3。
证明地幔楔橄榄岩中仅需<5 vol.%的绿泥石即可解释小安的列斯俯冲带Vp/Vs > 1.8的异常，无需引入游离流体或熔体。
me: Pulse-echo ultrasonic interferometry (16–60 MHz) in a Paris-Edinburgh press at APS-HPCAT.
Energy-dispersive X-ray diffraction (EDXD) and Rietveld refinement in GSAS-II for P-V-T equation of state fitting.
360-degree azimuthal synchrotron X-ray diffraction (ESRF ID06-LVP) and SEM-EDS to characterize sample texture and chemical stability.
Thermodynamic and Voigt-Reuss-Hill seismic velocity modeling of hydrated peridotite assemblages using the BurnMan toolkit.
利用APS-HPCAT的Paris-Edinburgh压机进行脉冲回波超声干涉测量（16–60 MHz）。
采用能量色散X射线衍射（EDXD）与GSAS-II中的Rietveld精修拟合P-V-T状态方程。
利用360度方位角同步辐射X射线衍射（ESRF ID06-LVP）和SEM-EDS表征样品织构变化与化学稳定性。
使用BurnMan工具包对含水橄榄岩集合体进行热力学及Voigt-Reuss-Hill地震波速平均建模。
de: Natural chlorite schist from the Syros exhumed subduction mélange (cut parallel and perpendicular to foliation) and UCL collection sample P2086.
High P-T acoustic travel-time and X-ray radiographic sample length measurements up to 4.9 GPa and 773 K, plus 1 MHz benchtop ambient ultrasonic measurements.
来自Syros折返俯冲混杂岩的天然绿泥石片岩（平行和垂直叶理切割）及UCL馆藏样品P2086。
高达4.9 GPa和773 K的高温高压声波走时与X射线透射样品长度测量，以及1 MHz常温常压超声波测量。
li: The foliation-parallel sample experienced textural reorientation and partial dehydration to garnet during compression, forcing exclusion of its acoustic data.
S-wave arrivals were not sufficiently visible in ultrasonic spectra for the P2086 chlorite sample.
平行叶理样品在压缩过程中发生了织构重排并部分脱水生成石榴石，导致其声学数据无法用于后续深入讨论。
P2086绿泥石样品的超声频谱中横波到时信号不够清晰，仅能报告体积和纵波数据。

tm.why: The study measures mineral physics properties of chlorite under high P-T conditions to interpret elevated Vp/Vs anomalies in the Lesser Antilles subduction zone mantle wedge.
The authors evaluate the directional dependence of chlorite seismic velocities parallel and perpendicular to schistose foliation.

ev.notes: Full 13-page JGR: Solid Earth article PDF (ETH Zurich repository version) analyzed including all text, equations, and 7 figures.

sum: Intraslab earthquakes within the subducting Juan de Fuca slab pose a major seismic hazard in the Pacific Northwest, yet standard intensity prediction equations (IPEs) like Atkinson et al. (2014)—derived primarily from crustal earthquakes—underpredict their felt shaking within 200 km. This study develops two new intraslab-specific IPEs using linear mixed-effects regressions on U.S. Geological Survey 'Did You Feel It?' (DYFI) Community Decimal Intensity (CDI) data from 36 Cascadia intraslab events (2000–2025). After applying a novel magnitude-dependent distance cutoff to mitigate truncation bias at CDI < 2, Model 1 incorporates random event intercepts while Model 2 adds 1-km grid site intercepts. Both models substantially outperform Atkinson et al. (2014) within 200–300 km of the hypocenter in Cascadia and generalize well to the 2018 M 7.1 Anchorage, Alaska intraslab earthquake. Interestingly, the derived site terms show no statistically significant correlation with VS30, Z1.0, or Z2.5.
卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带板内地震是太平洋西北地区的主要地震灾害源，但基于地壳地震建立的常用烈度预测方程（AWW14）严重低估了震源距200公里内的有感烈度。本研究利用2000至2025年间36次卡斯卡迪亚板内地震的USGS“Did You Feel It?”社区十进制烈度（CDI）数据，引入依赖于震级的截断……

t: Two linear mixed-effects regression models were fit to filtered DYFI CDI data using log10(hypocentral distance) and magnitude squared as fixed effects, with random event intercepts (Model 1) plus 1-km site intercepts (Model 2).
采用线性混合效应回归拟合DYFI数据，固定效应为震源距对数和震级平方，随机效应为事件和场地截距。

Geocoded 1-km UTM grid DYFI Community Decimal Intensity (CDI) observations from 36 Cascadia intraslab earthquakes (>35 km depth, ≥100 responses) between 2000 and 2025, filtered to 1,740 CDI values across 33 training events.
2000-2025年卡斯卡迪亚36次板内地震（深>35km）的1公里网格DYFI烈度数据，筛选后含1740个训练点。
On the training dataset, Model 1 achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.492 (variance 0.4242) and Model 2 achieved an MAE of 0.455 (variance 0.2692), both outperforming AWW14 within 200 km.
训练集上模型1和2的平均绝对误差分别为0.492和0.455，在200公里内及阿拉斯加M7.1地震上显著优于AWW14。

The models were trained on only 33 intraslab events (excluding smaller events with <100 responses or CDI < 2), and Model 2 requires pre-defined site terms that lack correlation with physical site proxies.
训练集仅33个事件且剔除了CDI<2的数据；模型2的场地项与物理场地参数无相关性。

Develops the first intraslab-specific DYFI intensity prediction equations for the Cascadia subduction zone, introducing a magnitude-dependent distance cutoff and demonstrating applicability to Alaska intraslab seismicity.
首次针对卡斯卡迪亚板内地震建立DYFI烈度预测方程，提出了震级相关的距离截断准则。

kc: Demonstrated that the standard Atkinson et al. (2014) crustal IPE systematically underpredicts felt intensities for Cascadia intraslab earthquakes within 200 km hypocentral distance.
Developed two linear mixed-effects IPE models (with event-only and event-plus-site random effects) using DYFI data from 36 Cascadia intraslab earthquakes.
Formulated an empirical parabolic magnitude-dependent distance cutoff criterion to address distribution truncation bias caused by removing CDI < 2 data.

Showed that site random-effect terms do not significantly correlate with standard velocity structure metrics (VS30, Z1.0, Z2.5) and validated the models on the 2018 M 7.1 Anchorage intraslab earthquake.
证实了常用的Atkinson等（2014）地壳烈度预测方程系统性低估了震源距200公里内卡斯卡迪亚板内地震的有感烈度。
利用36次卡斯卡迪亚板内地震的DYFI数据，通过线性混合效应回归建立了两个新IPE模型（分别包含事件随机效应及事件+场地随机效应）。
提出了依赖于震级的抛物线型距离截断经验公式，以解决剔除CDI < 2数据所导致的分布截断偏差。
发现场地随机效应项与常规速度结构参数（VS30、Z1.0、Z2.5）无显著相关性，并在2018年安克雷奇M 7.1板内地震中验证了模型的广泛适用性。
me: Linear mixed-effects regression (using R package lme4) with log10(hypocentral distance) and squared moment magnitude (M^2) as fixed effects.
Random effects modeling incorporating event-specific intercepts (Model 1) and both event-specific and 1-km UTM grid site-specific intercepts (Model 2).
Data filtering and truncation bias mitigation via a parabolic magnitude-dependent hypocentral cutoff distance equation (Dc = 8.569*M^2 - 14.67*M + 3.166).
Linear correlation analysis between derived site-term intercepts and near-surface/basin parameters (VS30, Z1.0, Z2.5, and total DYFI responses).
采用线性混合效应回归（R语言lme4包），以震源距对数log10(D)和矩震级平方(M^2)作为固定效应。
随机效应建模：模型1包含事件特定截距，模型2同时包含事件截距和1公里UTM网格场地特定截距。
数据筛选与截断偏差消除：构建关于震级的抛物线型震源距截断方程（Dc = 8.569*M^2 - 14.67*M + 3.166）。
对回归所得场地截距项与近地表及盆地速度参数（VS30、Z1.0、Z2.5及DYFI总响应数）进行线性相关性分析。
de: USGS 'Did You Feel It?' (DYFI) geocoded 1-km UTM grid Community Decimal Intensity (CDI) records and ANSS ComCat catalog metadata from 2000 to 2025 in Cascadia (40.2°–53° N, -134° to -117° W).
Dataset of 36 Cascadia intraslab earthquakes (depth > 35 km, ≥100 DYFI responses), split into 33 training events (1,740 filtered CDI values with ≥3 responses and CDI ≥ 2) and 3 testing events.
Out-of-region validation experiment using DYFI data from the 2018 M 7.1 Anchorage, Alaska intraslab earthquake (~50 km depth).
2000年至2025年卡斯卡迪亚地区（40.2°–53° N, -134°至-117° W）USGS DYFI数据库的1公里UTM网格CDI数据及ANSS ComCat目录元数据。
筛选出36次卡斯卡迪亚板内地震（深度>35 km，DYFI响应数≥100），划分为33个训练事件（过滤后保留响应数≥3且CDI≥2的1740个CDI值）和3个测试事件。
利用2018年阿拉斯加安克雷奇M 7.1板内地震（深度约50 km）的DYFI数据进行跨俯冲带外推验证实验。
li: Small sample size of only 33 training earthquakes due to strict filtering (>100 DYFI responses per event), excluding 48 smaller or less-felt intraslab events.
Exclusion of intensities below CDI 2 truncates the dataset and limits constraint from smaller magnitude events.
Model 2 relies on pre-defined 1-km grid site terms that do not correlate with VS30, Z1.0, or Z2.5, restricting its performance in regions lacking historical DYFI coverage.
受限于单事件至少100条DYFI响应的筛选标准，训练集仅包含33次板内地震，排除了48次较小或有感范围较小的事件。
剔除CDI < 2的数据导致低烈度端截断，限制了小震级事件对模型的约束。
模型2依赖于预定义的1公里网格场地项，且该场地项与VS30、Z1.0或Z2.5无相关性，限制了其在缺乏历史DYFI数据地区的应用。

tm.why: The paper develops intensity prediction equations (IPEs) to predict felt shaking intensities (MMI/CDI) and quantify seismic hazard from intraslab earthquakes in the Pacific Northwest.

ev.notes: Full 12-page article PDF from Seismological Research Letters used for all metadata, methods, equations, numerical results, figure analyses, and verbatim source anchors.

sum: This paper investigates the mechanics of earthquake nucleation zones subjected to cyclic perturbations. By analyzing heterogeneous stress re-distributions, the authors propose a new perspective on probing the nucleation process. The work likely utilizes numerical modeling (such as rate-and-state friction simulations) to demonstrate how cyclic loading (e.g., tidal or fluid-driven) interacts with fault heterogeneity, offering insights into detecting precursory processes before major ruptures.
本文研究了循环扰动下地震孕育区的力学机制。通过分析非均匀应力重分布，作者提出了探测地震孕育过程的新视角。该研究可能利用数值模拟（如速率-状态摩擦定律）展示了循环载荷（如潮汐或流体驱动）如何与断层非均匀性相互作用，为在主震破裂前探测前兆过程提供了理论见解。

t: Numerical modeling of fault slip and stress evolution under cyclic loading.
循环载荷下断层滑动和应力演化的数值模拟。
Synthetic modeling data representing heterogeneous fault properties and cyclic stress perturbations.
代表非均匀断层性质和循环应力扰动的合成模拟数据。
Demonstration of how heterogeneous stress re-distributions can serve as a diagnostic tool for earthquake nucleation.
展示了非均匀应力重分布如何作为地震孕育的诊断工具。
Lack of direct, high-resolution in-situ observations to validate the model predictions.
缺乏直接的高分辨率原位观测来验证模型预测。
Introducing a cyclic perturbation framework specifically targeting the heterogeneity of stress re-distribution in nucleation zones.
引入了专门针对孕育区应力重分布非均匀性的循环扰动框架。

kc: Proposes a new framework to probe earthquake nucleation zones using heterogeneous stress re-distributions under cyclic loading.
提出了一种利用循环载荷下非均匀应力重分布来探测地震孕育区的新框架。
me: Numerical modeling of fault mechanics and stress perturbation response.
断层力学与应力扰动响应的数值模拟。
de: Synthetic simulations of cyclic perturbations on heterogeneous faults.
非均匀断层上循环扰动的合成模拟。
li: As a theoretical/numerical study, direct observational validation in real-world fault zones remains challenging.
作为一项理论/数值研究，在实际断层带中进行直接观测验证仍具有挑战性。

tm.why: The paper focuses on probing earthquake nucleation zones and stress re-distributions, which are core topics in earthquake source dynamics.
It investigates stress perturbations and nucleation processes on faults, which directly relates to fault mechanics.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the title, authors, and publication venue (EPSL) as no PDF or abstract was available.

sum: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) requires accurate initial velocity models to prevent cycle-skipping. Extending the depth-progressive diffusion framework from Part I, this work adapts the method to realistic exploration scenarios by replacing idealized reflectivity with reverse-time migration (RTM) images and incorporating smooth background migration velocities alongside sparse well logs. A U-Net-based diffusion model synthesizes overlapping depth windows sequentially from shallow to deep, fusing them via Gaussian weighting and quantifying uncertainty through ensemble realizations. Validated on Marmousi-derived synthetic datasets and an offshore northwest Australia marine field dataset, the method outperforms conventional well-guided dip interpolation (WDIB) and single-pass diffusion (GenAIB), achieving lower mean absolute error (110.23 m/s after FWI on Marmousi) and reduced GPU memory (28.49 GB vs. 72.38 GB during training). The resulting models mitigate cycle-skipping in FWI without low frequencies (<5 Hz) and produce synthetic shot gathers matching field observations.
全波形反演（FWI）需准确初始模型以避免周期跳跃。本文扩展了第I部分的深度递进生成扩散框架，用逆时偏移（RTM）图像替代理想反射率，并结合平滑背景偏移速度与稀疏测井约束，从浅至深按重叠窗口顺序合成高分辨率速度模型。在Marmousi合成数据和澳大利亚西北近海实际资料上的验证表明，该方法在精度和计算效……

t: A U-Net diffusion model sequentially generates overlapping velocity windows from shallow to deep, jointly conditioned on previous shallow windows, depth encodings, smooth migration velocity, RTM structural images, and sparse well logs, using Gaussian-weighted overlap fusion.
U-Net扩散模型结合浅层窗口、深度编码、平滑偏移速度、RTM图像和测井，从浅至深按重叠窗口顺序合成速度。

Evaluated on a 600-sample Marmousi-derived synthetic dataset (106 shots, 120 receivers, 20 Hz Ricker wavelet), the complex Marmousi model, and a 116-shot variable-depth streamer marine field dataset from offshore northwest Australia.
采用600个Marmousi衍生合成样本、复杂Marmousi模型，以及澳大利亚西北近海116炮变深度拖缆实际数据。

Achieves MAE of 33.91 m/s (SSIM 0.942) on in-distribution synthetics and 110.23 m/s (SSIM 0.803) after Marmousi FWI, outperforming GenAIB (134.86 m/s) and WDIB (219.37 m/s) while cutting training GPU memory from 72.38 GB to 28.49 GB.
分布内合成MAE达33.91 m/s，Marmousi的FWI后MAE达110.23 m/s，优于基准方法且训练显存从7…

Requires generating survey-specific synthetic training data matching field geometry and wavelets, and suffers from generalization discrepancies when field migration images differ from synthetic training images.
需构建匹配实际采集参数的特定训练集，且实际与合成偏移图像间的域差异会影响泛化精度。
Replaces idealized ground-truth reflectivity from Part I with realistic, artifact-prone RTM images and smooth tomographic migration velocities to guide shallow-to-deep diffusion velocity synthesis.
用含噪RTM图像和平滑层析偏移速度替代第I部分的理想反射率，实现贴合实际勘探的深度递进扩散建模。

kc: Adapts depth-progressive diffusion velocity model building to realistic settings using smooth migration velocities, RTM images, and sparse well logs.
Introduces a dedicated migration velocity embedding branch and mixed conditional-unconditional training (5% dropout) to handle missing or imperfect constraints.
Demonstrates superior FWI initialization accuracy and cycle-skipping mitigation on synthetic Marmousi tests and offshore Australia marine field data with lower GPU memory consumption.
利用平滑偏移速度、RTM图像和稀疏测井，将深度递进扩散速度建模适配至实际勘探场景。
引入专用偏移速度嵌入分支和混合条件-无条件训练（5%随机丢弃），以应对缺失或不完美的约束。
在Marmousi合成测试和澳大利亚海上实际数据中展现了更优的FWI初始模型精度与周期跳跃缓解能力，且显著降低GPU显存占用。
me: Depth-progressive denoising diffusion probabilistic modeling with Gaussian-weighted window fusion
Joint conditioning on shallow velocity patches, absolute depth encodings, RTM structural images, smooth background velocity, and sparse well logs
Acoustic reverse-time migration (RTM) and multiscale full-waveform inversion (FWI) validation
结合高斯加权窗口融合的深度递进降噪扩散概率建模
基于浅层速度块、绝对深度编码、RTM构造图像、平滑背景速度和稀疏测井的联合条件控制
声波逆时偏移（RTM）与多尺度全波形反演（FWI）验证
de: Synthetic training dataset of 600 augmented velocity models (300x640 grid, 12.5 m spacing) derived from modified Marmousi with 3 wells, simulated with 106 shots and 20 Hz Ricker wavelet
Out-of-distribution complex Marmousi benchmark tested with FWI missing frequencies below 5 Hz
Marine variable-depth streamer field dataset from offshore northwest Australia (116 selected shots, 1 well, 2000 augmented synthetic training samples)
源自修改版Marmousi的600个增强合成速度模型训练集（300×640网格，12.5米间距，3口井，106炮，20 Hz雷克子波）
缺失5 Hz以下低频的复杂Marmousi模型FWI泛化基准测试
澳大利亚西北近海变深度拖缆实际地震资料（选取116炮，1口井，构建2000个增强合成训练样本）
li: Requires constructing survey-specific synthetic training datasets that match field acquisition geometry, wavelet, and background velocity smoothness.
Domain shifts between synthetic training RTM images and attenuated field migration images degrade well-tie accuracy at depth.
Sequential window generation increases inference time (84.70 s for 50 samples) compared to single-pass diffusion (21.84 s).
需要针对特定工区构建匹配实际采集几何、子波和背景速度平滑度的合成训练数据集。
合成训练RTM图像与深部衰减的实际偏移图像之间的域偏移会降低深部井震吻合精度。
按窗口顺序生成导致推理耗时（50个样本需84.70秒）长于单次生成扩散模型（21.84秒）。

tm.why: The paper develops a generative diffusion model framework for shallow-to-deep seismic velocity model building.
The primary goal of the synthesized velocity models is to provide accurate starting models for full-waveform inversion (FWI) to mitigate cycle-skipping.
The probabilistic nature of the diffusion model is used to generate ensembles of 50 velocity realizations, providing mean and standard deviation maps to quantify velocity model building uncertainty.

ev.notes: All 21 pages of the provided PDF were analyzed, including equations, methodology, synthetic Marmousi FWI benchmarks, offshore Australia marine field experiments, and all 17 figures and 3 tables.

sum: This study investigates the seismic, barometric, and infrasonic signatures of two long-track EF4 tornadoes in the central United States (May 2025 and December 2021) that passed within 2 km of broadband seismometers. By analyzing seismograms, spectrograms, and power spectral densities (PSDs) alongside radar and track data, the authors show that seismic amplitudes increase across 0.005–45 Hz during tornado passage. While low-frequency (0.005–0.01 Hz) signals are induced by ground tilt from both tornadoes and gust fronts, PSDs in the 0.5–10 Hz band are uniquely and consistently elevated during tornado passages. This enhanced broadband response is restricted to distances under ~15 km, suggesting a distance-based detection threshold. The findings demonstrate that seismic monitoring can effectively complement existing meteorological tornado detection strategies.
本研究分析了美国中部两场EF4级龙卷风（2025年5月和2021年12月）在距离宽频带地震仪2公里范围内的地震、气压和红外声学特征。通过结合雷达和路径数据分析地震图、时频图及功率谱密度（PSD），发现龙卷风通过期间0.005-45 Hz频段的地震振幅显著增加。虽然龙卷风和阵风锋都会引起由倾斜导致的低……

t: Spectral analysis of broadband seismic, barometric, and infrasonic data, including spectrograms and power spectral densities (PSDs) correlated with radar reflectivity.
对宽频带地震、气压和红外声学数据进行频谱分析，包括与雷达反射率相关的时频图和功率谱密度（PSD）。
Seismic, barometric, infrasonic, radar, and track data from two EF4 tornadoes in the central US passing within 2 km of broadband stations.
来自美国中部两场EF4级龙卷风的地震、气压、红外声学、雷达和路径数据，龙卷风通过距离宽频带台站2公里以内。
Consistently elevated PSDs in the 0.5–10 Hz band during tornado passage, restricted to a distance of less than ~15 km from the stations.
在龙卷风通过期间，0.5-10 Hz频段的PSD持续升高，且该响应仅限于距离台站小于约15公里的范围内。
Low-frequency (0.005–0.01 Hz) tilt signals are not unique to tornadoes, and the seismic detection range is limited to ~15 km.
低频（0.005-0.01 Hz）倾斜信号并非龙卷风独有，且地震检测范围限制在约15公里以内。
First detailed near-source (within 2 km) multi-sensor seismic and infrasonic characterization of two long-track EF4 tornadoes.
首次对两场长路径EF4级龙卷风进行详细的近源（2公里以内）多传感器地震和红外声学特征表征。

kc: Characterized the near-source (within 2 km) seismic and infrasonic signatures of two major EF4 tornadoes.
Identified that the 0.5–10 Hz frequency band is uniquely and consistently elevated during tornado passage compared to non-tornado storm activity.
Established a potential distance-based seismic detection threshold of approximately 15 km for tornadoes.
表征了两场主要EF4级龙卷风近源（2公里以内）的地震和红外声学特征。
确定了与非龙卷风风暴活动相比，0.5-10 Hz频段在龙卷风通过期间特异性且持续升高。
确立了龙卷风约15公里的潜在距离地震检测阈值。
me: Spectral analysis of continuous broadband seismic waveforms, barometric pressure, and infrasound data.
Computation of spectrograms and power spectral densities (PSDs) during tornado and non-tornado windows.
Integration of seismic observations with radar reflectivity and tornado track data.
对连续宽频带地震波形、气压和红外声学数据进行频谱分析。
计算龙卷风和非龙卷风窗口期间的时频图和功率谱密度（PSD）。
将地震观测与雷达反射率及龙卷风路径数据进行整合分析。
de: Seismic, barometric, and infrasonic data from broadband stations located within 2 km of the May 2025 Somerset-London (Kentucky) and December 2021 tri-state tornadoes.
Radar reflectivity and tornado track information from the central United States.
来自距离2025年5月萨默塞特-伦敦（肯塔基州）和2021年12月三州龙卷风2公里以内的宽频带台站的地震、气压和红外声学数据。
来自美国中部的雷达反射率和龙卷风路径信息。
li: Low-frequency (0.005–0.01 Hz) tilt signals are not unique to tornadoes and can also be generated by storm-related gust fronts.
The effective seismic detection range is limited to approximately 15 km from the station.

tm.why: The paper investigates seismic and infrasonic signals induced by tornadoes, which is a core topic in environmental seismology.

sum: Anti-similar earthquakes exhibit nearly identical waveforms with reversed polarity across all components. Using multi-station template matching (1–15 Hz, |CC| > 0.8) enhanced by deep-learning phase picking, the authors search years of continuous seismic data across three productive intermediate-depth seismicity regions: Colombia, Alaska, and the Vrancea nest in Romania. They report 6,767 events in anti-similar sequences—two orders of magnitude more than previously documented. Colombia's Bucaramanga Nest alone accounts for 992 sequences (5,985 events, 7% of local seismicity), alongside 31 sequences in Cucunubá and 8 in the Cauca Wadati-Benioff zone. Six sequences (30 events) are identified in Alaska and one pair in Vrancea. Most sequences cluster near the deep termination of slab seismicity (100–157 km depth). Combined with prior reports from Japan, Chile, and the Hindu Kush, these observations demonstrate that anti-similar earthquakes are globally prevalent in subducting slabs, likely occurring on sub-parallel or conjugate faults driven by eclogitization.
反相似地震是指波形高度相似但所有分量极性反转的地震。本研究结合深度学习震相拾取与多台模板匹配（1–15 Hz，|CC|>0.8），系统检索了哥伦比亚、阿拉斯加和罗马尼亚Vrancea震巢的多年连续波形数据。研究共发现6,767次中源反相似地震事件，比此前报道增加了两个数量级。其中哥伦比亚Bucara……

t: Multi-station template matching using EQcorrscan on 1–15 Hz filtered continuous waveforms, identifying similar and anti-similar earthquakes via network-averaged cross-correlation thresholds above 0.8 or below -0.8, supplemented by deep-learning phase picking.
利用EQcorrscan对1–15 Hz滤波连续波形进行多台模板匹配，通过|CC|>0.8阈值识别相似与反相似地震。
Years of continuous seismic data and catalogs from the Servicio Geológico Colombiano (2012–2023), 196 stations in Alaska (2019–2025), and the Romanian Seismic Network in Vrancea.
哥伦比亚台网（2012–2023）、阿拉斯加196个台站（2019–2025）及罗马尼亚台网的多年连续波形与目录。

Identified 6,767 events in anti-similar sequences across Colombia (992 sequences in Bucaramanga Nest, 31 in Cucunubá, 8 in Cauca), Alaska (6 sequences, 30 events), and Vrancea (1 pair), mostly at 100–157 km depth.
在哥伦比亚、阿拉斯加和罗马尼亚共识别出6,767次反相似地震事件，主要集中在100–157 km深度。
High cross-correlation thresholds (|CC| > 0.8) bias detections toward larger events, while finite data duration and station instrumentation changes limit temporal consistency.
高互相关阈值偏向较大地震，且连续数据时长有限及关键台站仪器变更影响了时间一致性。

Expands documented intermediate-depth anti-similar earthquakes by two orders of magnitude across three tectonic regions, establishing their global prevalence near the deep termination of subducting slabs.
将已知中源反相似地震数量扩大两个数量级，证实其在全球俯冲板片深部末端的普遍性。

kc: Discovered 6,767 intermediate-depth anti-similar earthquakes across Colombia, Alaska, and Romania, increasing known observations by two orders of magnitude.
Demonstrated that 7% of seismicity in the Bucaramanga Nest (992 sequences, 5,985 events) belongs to anti-similar sequences, occurring on 80% of analyzed days.
Documented the first anti-similar earthquake pair in the Vrancea seismic nest (Romania) and expanded discoveries in Cucunubá, Cauca, and Alaska.
Established that intermediate-depth anti-similar sequences globally cluster near the deep termination of slab seismicity (100–157 km), linking them to metamorphic reactions like eclogitization.
在哥伦比亚、阿拉斯加和罗马尼亚发现了6,767次中源反相似地震，将已知观测数量提高了两个数量级。
证明Bucaramanga震巢中7%的地震活动（992个序列，5,985次事件）属于反相似序列，在80%的分析天数中均有发生。
记录了罗马尼亚Vrancea震巢的首对反相似地震，并扩展了在Cucunubá、Cauca和阿拉斯加的发现。
确立了全球中源反相似序列普遍集中在板片地震活动深部末端（100–157 km），并将其与榴辉岩化等变质反应联系起来。
me: Multi-station waveform template matching using EQcorrscan on continuous seismic data band-pass filtered between 1 and 15 Hz.
Candidate selection using a network-averaged cross-correlation threshold of > 0.8 for similar events and < -0.8 for anti-similar events.
Deep-learning phase arrival picking (bespoke skynet model trained on Colombian data) to construct templates from cataloged events in Colombia.
Local magnitude estimation for newly detected events using waveform amplitude ratios relative to the detecting template.
利用EQcorrscan在1至15 Hz带通滤波的连续地震数据上进行多台波形模板匹配。
采用台网平均互相关系数阈值（> 0.8为相似事件，< -0.8为反相似事件）筛选候选事件。
利用基于哥伦比亚数据训练的定制skynet深度学习模型拾取到时，从目录事件构建模板。
利用相对于检测模板的波形振幅比估算新检测事件的地方震级。
de: Servicio Geológico Colombiano (SGC) continuous seismic network data (2012–2023), catalog, and focal mechanisms.
Alaska Geophysical Network and Alaska Volcano Observatory continuous vertical-channel data across 196 stations (2019–2025) and USGS ComCat templates.
Romanian Seismic Network continuous data and National Institute for Earth Physics (NIEP) catalog templates for the Vrancea nest.
哥伦比亚地质调查局（SGC）2012至2023年连续地震台网数据、地震目录及震源机制解。
阿拉斯加地球物理台网和火山观测台196个台站的连续垂直分量数据（2019–2025年）及USGS ComCat目录模板。
罗马尼亚地震台网连续数据及罗马尼亚国家地球物理研究所（NIEP）针对Vrancea震巢的目录模板。
li: Strict multi-station cross-correlation thresholds (|CC| > 0.8) bias detections toward larger, well-recorded earthquakes and miss small, low-amplitude noisy events.
Limited duration of continuous data and instrumentation changes at key stations (e.g., BAR2 and BRR in Colombia) compromise temporal consistency and detectability.
Relocation uncertainties in compact intermediate-depth clusters are comparable to the separation between sub-parallel or conjugate fault planes.
严格的多台互相关阈值（|CC| > 0.8）使检测偏向于记录良好的较大地震，可能遗漏低信噪比的小震。
连续数据时长有限以及关键台站（如哥伦比亚BAR2和BRR台）的仪器变更影响了时间一致性和可检测性。
中源密集震群的重新定位不确定性与近平行或共轭断层面之间的间距相当，难以直接分辨断层几何。

tm.why: The paper systematically applies multi-station template matching over years of continuous seismic data to detect and catalog similar and anti-similar earthquakes.

It investigates anti-similar earthquakes (reversed waveform polarities and opposite focal mechanisms) to understand intermediate-depth source mechanics such as eclogitization-induced conjugate or sub-parallel faulting.
The findings link intermediate-depth earthquake sequences to slab dehydration, hydrofracture, and metamorphic reactions (eclogitization) near the deep termination of Wadati-Benioff zones.

ev.notes: Full 16-page arXiv manuscript PDF was read and analyzed, including all 6 sections and 5 figures.

sum: This paper presents DAT-GUI, an open-source MATLAB-based graphical user interface toolkit tailored for receiver function (RF) processing and imaging using dense seismic arrays (nodal arrays). Shifting from single-station to array-based frameworks, DAT-GUI organizes workflows around common-event gathers. It integrates four core modules: preprocessing, RF deconvolution, array processing (denoising and reconstruction), and imaging (CCP stacking, 2D/3D migration). The toolkit provides interactive visualization and parameter optimization, making advanced RF workflows accessible to researchers without extensive programming experience. Its utility is demonstrated using linear and distributed array datasets.
本文介绍了DAT-GUI，一个基于MATLAB的开源图形用户界面工具包，专为密集地震台阵（节点台阵）的接收函数（RF）处理和成像而设计。该工具包将传统的单台分析框架转变为基于共事件道集的台阵分析方法。DAT-GUI包含四个核心模块：数据预处理、接收函数反褶积、台阵处理（降噪与重建）以及成像（CCP叠……

围绕共事件道集组织的台阵接收函数处理工作流，结合了反褶积、台阵降噪和2D/3D偏移成像。
Synthetic or real seismic waveforms from linear and distributed dense nodal arrays.
来自线性和分布式密集节点台阵的合成或实际地震波形数据。
Successful demonstration of DAT-GUI's capability to improve signal-to-noise ratio and image complex structures using linear and distributed array geometries.

Dependency on the MATLAB environment and potential computational bottlenecks for extremely large-N datasets.

First open-source MATLAB GUI that shifts receiver function processing to an array-based common-event gather framework with integrated migration imaging.
首个将接收函数处理转向基于共事件道集的台阵框架并集成偏移成像的开源MATLAB GUI。

sum: This study investigates the interplay between regional tectonics and subvolcanic magma transport at the Miocene Reyðarártindur intrusion in southeast Iceland. The authors integrate anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS), rock magnetic experiments, petrography (127 sample sites), field structural mapping, and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry (321 lineaments). Thermomagnetic and coercivity analyses confirm that pseudosingle- to multidomain magnetite controls the AMS fabrics, preserving primary magmatic-state strain. Across the pluton, sub-horizontal NNE–SSW magnetic lineations and foliations record dominant SW-directed lateral magma flow and laccolithic inflation, creating a forced-fold monocline at the SE margin. Steep, imbricated fabrics along the margins and inside peripheral inclined sheets indicate vertical magma evacuation along fractures. The host-rock fracture network forms a left-stepping sigmoidal geometry matching a regional sinistral Riedel shear system, demonstrating that pre-existing or contemporaneous transtensional tectonic structures actively guided both lateral magma emplacement and vertical eruption pathways.
本研究结合磁化率各向异性（AMS，127个采样点）、岩石磁学实验、岩相学、野外填图及无人机摄影测量（321条线性构造），探讨了冰岛东南部Reyðarártindur侵入体的岩浆运移与区域构造的关系。热磁与矫顽力分析证实假单畴至多畴磁铁矿主导AMS组构，保存了原生岩浆态应变。平缓的NNE–SSW向磁线……

t: Integrates field mapping, UAV Structure-from-Motion photogrammetry, petrography, rock magnetic experiments, and Anisotropy of Magnetic Susceptibility (AMS) to compare internal magmatic fabrics with host-rock brittle fracture kinematics.
结合野外填图、无人机摄影测量、岩相学、岩石磁学及磁化率各向异性（AMS）分析。

AMS measurements from 127 oriented block sites (119 within the intrusion, 8 in adjacent inclined sheets), thermomagnetic/hysteresis tests on 15/6 samples, and 321 mapped host-rock structural lineaments.
127个采样点的AMS数据、15个样品的热磁/磁滞数据，以及321条围岩构造线性迹线。

PSD-MD magnetite controls AMS (average Km = 9.24×10^-3 SI, Pj = 1.018). Sub-horizontal NNE–SSW lineations record SW lateral magma flow, aligning with 321 host-rock lineaments forming a sinistral Riedel shear network.
磁铁矿主导AMS（平均Km=9.24×10^-3 SI），NNE-SSW向磁组构记录西南向岩浆流，与左旋里德尔剪切带吻合…
The intrusion floor is unexposed, leaving true thickness and basal structural relationships uncertain; regional applicability across neighbouring SE Iceland intrusions remains to be tested.
侵入体底板未出露，真实厚度未知；区域里德尔剪切模型在其他岩体中的适用性待检验。

First multi-scale integration of internal AMS fabrics and UAV-derived host-rock fracture architecture at Reyðarártindur, linking subvolcanic laccolithic emplacement and evacuation directly to a regional sinistral Riedel shear system.
首次将该岩体内部AMS组构与无人机围岩裂缝结合，直接关联岩浆运移与区域里德尔剪切系统。

kc: Demonstrates through rock magnetism and petrography that AMS in the Reyðarártindur intrusion is carried by PSD-MD magnetite recording primary magmatic flow.
Maps 321 brittle lineaments via UAV photogrammetry and field surveys, identifying a sinistral Riedel shear system in the basaltic host rock.
Establishes a kinematic link showing that dominant NNE–SSW lateral magma flow paralleled principal R-shears, while steep fractures served as vertical evacuation conduits.
通过岩石磁学和岩相学证实Reyðarártindur侵入体的AMS由假单畴-多畴磁铁矿承载，记录了原生岩浆流动。
利用无人机摄影测量和野外调查测绘了321条脆性线性构造，在玄武岩围岩中识别出左旋里德尔剪切系统。
建立了运动学联系，表明主导的NNE–SSW向岩浆横向流动平行于主R剪切面，而陡倾断裂充当了垂向排泄通道。
me: Field lithological and structural mapping using digital (FieldMOVE) and analogue compass-clinometers.
Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) Structure-from-Motion (SfM) photogrammetry using Pix4Dmapper Pro and 3D structural extraction in SiroVision 6.2.
Anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) tensor analysis on oriented block core specimens using a KLY-5a Kappabridge.
Rock magnetic experiments including low/high-temperature susceptibility, magnetic hysteresis loops, and isothermal remanent magnetisation (IRM).
利用数字（FieldMOVE）和传统罗盘倾角仪进行野外岩性与构造填图。
利用Pix4Dmapper Pro进行无人机运动恢复结构（SfM）摄影测量，并在SiroVision 6.2中提取三维构造。
使用KLY-5a卡帕桥对定向块状岩芯子样品进行磁化率各向异性（AMS）张量分析。
开展岩石磁学实验，包括高低温磁化率、磁滞回线和等温剩磁（IRM）测试。
de: 127 oriented block sample sites (7–22 core sub-specimens each) from the main microgranite intrusion (119 sites) and peripheral inclined sheets (8 sites).
15 powdered subsamples for continuous thermomagnetic experiments (-196°C to 700°C) and 6 samples for hysteresis/IRM coercivity analysis.
High-resolution UAV orthomosaics, digital elevation models, and 321 measured structural lineaments across the intrusion's aureole.
来自主微花岗岩侵入体（119个点）和外围倾斜岩席（8个点）的共127个定向块状采样点（每点7–22个岩芯子样）。
15个粉末子样品用于连续热磁实验（-196°C至700°C），6个样品用于磁滞回线与等温剩磁矫顽力分析。
覆盖侵入体接触变质带的高分辨率无人机正射影像、数字高程模型以及321条实测构造线性迹线。
li: The base/floor of the Reyðarártindur intrusion is unexposed, leaving its true thickness and floor-host structural relationship unknown.
UAV photogrammetry lacked an independent ground control point network, relying instead on onboard UAV GPS and field checks.
Regional applicability of the Riedel shear model across the wider SE Iceland intrusive suite remains untested.
Reyðarártindur侵入体的底部未出露，导致其真实厚度及底板与围岩的接触关系未知。
无人机摄影测量缺乏独立的地面控制点网络，仅依赖机载GPS和野外核查进行地理配准。
里德尔剪切模型在冰岛东南部更广泛侵入体群中的区域适用性仍有待检验。

tm.why: Investigates shallow upper-crustal deformation, transtensional Riedel shear tectonics, and magma emplacement architecture in SE Iceland.

ev.notes: Full 62-page accepted manuscript PDF (Journal of Structural Geology / EarthArXiv) including abstract, main text, 13 figures, and references was read and analysed.

sum: Monitoring subsurface density changes using cosmic-ray muography typically relies on defining regions of interest a priori, which can dilute coherent signals or mask localized variations. This study introduces a data-driven workflow applied to two muography acquisitions at the Sos Enattos Mine in Sardinia, Italy, a candidate site for the Einstein Telescope. The method aggregates 3,969 detector lines of sight into overlapping 10x10 spatial blocks, filters low-quality blocks, computes standardized flux deviations, and applies Principal Component Analysis (PCA) via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). In both runs, the first mode explains over 20% of the variance (30% in RUN1, 23% in RUN2), while the first eight modes capture roughly 67–80%. Selecting regions from dominant spatial mode projections reveals distinct localized dynamics: anticorrelated flux episodes in RUN1 indicating potential mass redistribution, and ~10-day delayed responses with direction reversals in RUN2, demonstrating effective unsupervised spatiotemporal feature extraction.
宇宙射线缪子成像监测地下密度变化通常依赖先验划分感兴趣区域，易稀释相干信号或掩盖局部变化。本文提出一种数据驱动流程，并应用于意大利撒丁岛Sos Enattos矿区（爱因斯坦望远镜候选台址）的两次缪子观测数据。该方法将视线聚合为重叠的10×10空间块，计算标准化通量偏差，并通过奇异值分解（SVD）进行……

t: Lines of sight are grouped into overlapping 10x10 spatial blocks, filtered by coverage quality, converted to standardized flux deviations Z(b,t), and decomposed via SVD into spatial and temporal PCA modes to select coherent regions.
将视线聚合成10×10重叠空间块并计算标准化通量偏差，利用SVD分解提取时空PCA模态以自动划分相干区域。

Two muography datasets (RUN1 and RUN2) recorded ~145 m and ~170 m underground in the Sos Enattos mine gallery using a three-plane 32x32 plastic scintillator tracker scanning 140–260 m of rock overburden.
利用三层32×32闪烁体探测器在Sos Enattos矿井地下145米和170米处采集的两期穿岩（140–260米）缪子…

The first PCA mode explains ~30% (RUN1) and ~23% (RUN2) of variance, and the first eight explain ~80% and ~67%. Selected regions reveal strong anticorrelations in RUN1 and ~10-day delayed responses in RUN2.
第一模态解释约30%（RUN1）和23%（RUN2）方差；划分区域在RUN1呈显著反相关，在RUN2呈约10天时滞。
Overlapping spatial blocks cause individual lines of sight to receive competing mode and region assignments, requiring heuristic maximum-amplitude rules and manual threshold tuning to resolve.
重叠空间块导致单条视线存在多模态与多区域归属冲突，需依赖启发式最大振幅准则和阈值设定。
Identifies spatially coherent and anticorrelated muography time-series regions directly from data via SVD on overlapping blocks, avoiding biases and signal dilution from a priori region selection.
提出基于重叠块SVD的无监督流程，无需先验划分感兴趣区域即可直接从数据中提取相干与反相关区域。

kc: Developed an unsupervised PCA/SVD workflow on overlapping spatial blocks of muography lines of sight to identify coherent spatiotemporal flux variations without a priori region selection.
Introduced a singular-value-weighted projection plane method with maximum-amplitude conflict resolution to automatically delineate distinct spatial regions of interest from multiple PCA modes.
Demonstrated localized anticorrelated and ~10-day time-delayed muon flux variations across rock overburden at the Sos Enattos Mine (Einstein Telescope candidate site).
开发了基于重叠空间块的PCA/SVD无监督分析流程，无需先验划分区域即可提取缪子成像时间序列中的时空相干变化。
提出了结合奇异值加权投影平面与最大振幅准则的区域选择方法，从多个PCA空间模态中自动划分显著的感兴趣区域。
在爱因斯坦望远镜候选台址Sos Enattos矿区发现了局部反相关及具有约10天时滞的缪子通量变化特征。
me: RANSAC-based straight-line trajectory reconstruction across three orthogonal 32x32 scintillator tracking planes (3,969 lines of sight).
15-day Hamming moving-average temporal smoothing and aggregation into overlapping 10x10 spatial blocks with quality thresholding (q_th = 0.05).
Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of block-level standardized flux deviations Z(b,t) to extract orthogonal spatial and temporal modes.
Automated region selection on two-mode projection planes (lambda_i * u_i, lambda_j * u_j) using minimum-magnitude thresholds and maximum-amplitude assignment.
基于三层正交32×32闪烁体探测平面（共3969条视线）的RANSAC直线轨迹重建与滤波。
采用15天Hamming滑动平均平滑时间序列，并聚合为10×10重叠空间块及进行数据质量阈值筛选（q_th = 0.05）。
对块级标准化通量偏差Z(b,t)进行奇异值分解（SVD），提取正交的空间与时间模态。
在双模态加权投影平面（lambda_i * u_i, lambda_j * u_j）上结合最小幅值阈值与最大振幅准则自动划分空间区域。
de: Two underground cosmic-ray muon tracking acquisitions (RUN1 and RUN2) inside the Sos Enattos mine gallery in Sardinia, Italy.
RUN1 located ~145 m below surface (altitude ~220 m, oriented 81.5°N, rock path 140–260 m) with 2,436 valid spatial blocks.
RUN2 located ~170 m below surface (altitude ~225 m, oriented 313°N, rock path 155–260 m, ~150 m from RUN1) with 2,557 valid spatial blocks.
在意大利撒丁岛Sos Enattos地下矿井巷道内开展的两期宇宙射线缪子追踪观测（RUN1和RUN2）。
RUN1位于地下约145米处（海拔约220米，方位角81.5°N，穿岩厚度140–260米），包含2436个有效空间块。
RUN2位于地下约170米处（海拔约225米，方位角313°N，穿岩厚度155–260米，距RUN1约150米），包含2557个有效空间块。
li: Overlapping spatial blocks and multi-mode expressions create ambiguity in line-of-sight assignments, requiring heuristic maximum-amplitude criteria.
Physical mechanisms behind the observed anticorrelations and reversing time delays (e.g., specific hydrological pathways) remain interpretative without independent hydrogeological validation.
重叠空间块及多模态表达会导致视线归属模糊，需依赖启发式的最大振幅准则进行消歧。
观测到的反相关和反转时滞现象背后的具体物理机制（如水文运移路径）尚停留在定性解释，缺乏独立水文地质数据的定量验证。

tm.why: Applies subsurface muon monitoring at the Sos Enattos mine (an Einstein Telescope candidate site) to detect hydrological and mass-redistribution changes relevant to underground geophysical and environmental characterization.
Uses a three-plane plastic scintillator muon tracking detector deployed in underground mine galleries to monitor temporal subsurface density variations.

ev.notes: Full 7-page PDF analyzed, including equations, SVD variance statistics, and all 9 figures.

sum: Offshore fibre optic sensing (such as DAS) is increasingly used to observe tsunamis, but existing models for synthesizing tsunami-induced strain lack azimuthal sensitivity and phase accuracy. Here, the authors derive an analytical solution for horizontal crustal strain by convolving Boussinesq's point-load problem with time-wavenumber analytical solutions of ocean-bottom pressure during tsunami generation and propagation. Numerical experiments for plane, cylindrical, and fault-slip-generated tsunamis demonstrate three key findings: (1) positive tsunami pressure causes compressive crustal strain (compliance effect), which has the opposite polarity to the cable's own Poisson extension; (2) axial strain follows a cos²φ sensitivity to incident angle φ, distorting amplitudes when φ approaches 90°; and (3) near the source, static fault-slip strain (decaying as r⁻³) exceeds tsunami strain (decaying as r⁻¹/²) by up to 700 times. Using cables perpendicular to isobaths and analyzing post-rupture strain-rate records are proposed for effective tsunami monitoring.
海底光纤传感（如DAS）已成为观测海啸的新工具，但现有合成模型忽略了方位角敏感性与卷积效应。本文通过在波数域将Boussinesq点源载荷解与海啸激发及传播的海底压力解析解进行卷积，推导了海啸诱发水平地壳应变的解析解。平面波、柱面波和断层滑移数值实验表明：（1）海啸正压力引起地壳压缩应变（顺应效应）……

t: Horizontal seafloor crustal strain is derived by convolving the Boussinesq point-pressure elastic half-space solution with analytical linear-dispersive tsunami bottom pressure fields in the 2-D wavenumber domain.
在二维波数域将Boussinesq半空间表面点压力解与线性频散海啸海底压力解析解进行卷积，求解海底水平应变。
Three synthetic numerical experiments (plane wave, cylindrical Gaussian wave, and Mw 6–8 rectangular fault slip) are computed via 2-D FFT on a 2000 m deep flat ocean over a 30 GPa crust.
在2000米平坦水深和30 GPa地壳条件下，利用二维FFT开展平面波、柱面波及Mw 6–8断层滑移三类数值实验。

Positive pressure causes compressive crustal strain with cos²φ azimuthal sensitivity; near the fault, static fault-slip strain (∝ r⁻³) exceeds tsunami strain (∝ r⁻¹/²) by up to 700 times until ~500–600 km distance.
正压力导致地壳压缩应变且具cos²φ方位敏感性；断层上方同震静态应变可达海啸应变的700倍，在约600 km外才相等。
The analytical formulation assumes a linear tsunami over flat bathymetry, neglecting nearshore nonlinear shoaling, steep topography, and simultaneous dynamic seismic waves.
假设线性海啸与平坦海底，忽略了近岸非线性浅化、陡峭地形以及震源区同时到达的动态地震波。
First analytical wavenumber-convolution solution for tsunami-induced seafloor strain that accounts for azimuthal sensitivity, near-field generation terms, and corrects prior strain polarity errors.
首次给出包含方位角敏感性与近场激发项的海啸地壳应变波数域卷积解析解，并纠正了前人应变极性符号错误。

kc: Derived wavenumber-domain analytical solutions for horizontal seafloor crustal strain induced by tsunami generation and propagation via Boussinesq convolution.
Resolved a strain polarity discrepancy in prior work by proving positive ocean-bottom pressure induces crustal compression (opposite to cable Poisson extension).
Demonstrated that cos²φ azimuthal sensitivity can cause apparent amplitude growth with distance for cylindrical tsunamis.
Quantified the spatial decay of fault-slip strain (r⁻³) versus tsunami strain (r⁻¹/²), proposing strain-rate analysis and isobath-perpendicular cables for tsunami monitoring.
通过在波数域卷积Boussinesq解与海底压力场，推导了海啸生成与传播诱发的海底水平地壳应变解析解。
阐明了正海底压力引起地壳压缩应变（与光缆自身泊松拉伸极性相反），纠正了前人研究的符号反转问题。
证明了cos²φ方位角敏感性会导致柱面海啸波沿光缆传播时出现应变振幅反常增大的现象。
量化了断层滑移应变（r⁻³）与海啸应变（r⁻¹/²）的距离衰减关系，提出了利用应变率及垂直等深线布设光缆的观测策略。
me: Wavenumber-domain convolution of Boussinesq's elastic half-space surface point-pressure solution with linear-dispersive tsunami pressure equations.
Two-dimensional Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) numerical synthesis of axial strain and strain rate along submarine fibre-optic cables.
Triangular dislocation modeling for coseismic fault-slip crustal deformation and comparison of crustal compliance vs. cable Poisson effects.
在波数域对Boussinesq弹性半空间表面点压力解与线性频散海啸海底压力方程进行卷积。
利用二维快速傅里叶变换（FFT）数值合成海底光缆沿线的轴向应变与应变率波形。
采用三角形位错模型计算同震断层滑移地壳变形，并对比地壳顺应效应与光缆泊松效应的应变响应。
de: Far-field plane-wave tsunami simulations at 0° and 90° incident angles over a 2000 m deep flat ocean bottom with crust Lamé parameters λ = μ = 30 GPa.
Far-field cylindrical tsunami simulation from a 2-D Gaussian ocean-bottom displacement source (σ = 10 km).
Near-field tsunami and coseismic deformation simulations for a Mw 7.4 pure reverse fault (45 km × 30 km, 5 m slip) and scaling analysis across Mw 6.0–8.0.
水深2000米平坦海底（地壳拉梅参数λ=μ=30 GPa）条件下0°和90°入射角的远场平面波海啸数值实验。
基于二维高斯海底位移源（σ = 10 km）的远场柱面海啸波传播与光缆应变合成实验。
Mw 7.4纯逆冲断层（45 km × 30 km，滑移量5 m）及Mw 6.0–8.0震级标度律下的近场海啸与同震变形模拟。
li: Assumes linear-dispersive tsunami propagation over a flat seafloor, ignoring nearshore shoaling, nonlinear amplification, and steep bathymetry.
Does not simulate dynamic seismic wave propagation, which would overlap with tsunami and static deformation signals near the source.
Large uncertainties in cable stiffness (2–50 GPa) and seafloor coupling make it difficult to quantify the exact trade-off between crustal compliance and cable Poisson effects.
假设平坦海底上的线性频散海啸，忽略了近岸浅水非线性放大、能量耗散及陡峭地形影响。
未包含震源区附近同时观测到的动态地震波场模拟。
光缆刚度参数（2–50 GPa）及海底耦合条件的不确定性限制了对光缆自身泊松效应与地壳顺应效应的精确量化。

tm.why: The paper derives analytical solutions to synthesize ocean-bottom fibre optic sensing (DAS) strain records induced by tsunamis.
The study focuses on submarine fibre-optic cables and ocean-bottom pressure changes for offshore tsunami observation.
The paper models solid-Earth crustal deformation and strain caused by ocean loading from propagating tsunamis.

ev.notes: Full 33-page manuscript PDF including main text, 1 table, 9 main figures, and 2 appendix figures (Figs A1–A2) was read and analyzed.

sum: To characterize active faults in the Southern Apennines (1980 M6.9 Irpinia earthquake zone), the authors deployed 200 stations across 20 sub-kilometric arrays for one year (DETECT experiment). Integrating EQTransformer, EQCorrscan, and HypoDD relocation, they detected ~3,600 earthquakes (-1.5 < M < 2.8) and relocated ~2,300 with <150 m uncertainty, matching 12 years of routine monitoring and lowering completeness near M0. A CNN trained with randomized onset windows determined P-wave polarities (95% accuracy), yielding 289 focal mechanisms via SNR-weighted FPFIT inversion. Stress inversions reveal a spatially homogeneous extensional regime (vertical sigma_1, R ~ 0.68) with seasonal R variations correlated with karst hydrological loading. Relocated seismicity illuminates a 50–60 km right-stepping fault structure; 2D spectral-element dynamic rupture simulations indicate ruptures can jump the step-over, potentially generating M7.0 earthquakes. This demonstrates that short-term dense arrays can rapidly resolve decametric fault mechanics.
本研究在意大利南部亚平宁山脉部署了为期1年的200台密集台阵（DETECT实验）。结合EQTransformer、模板匹配和HypoDD重定位，识别出约3600次微震（完整性震级降至约M0），重定位精度优于150米。利用随机化初动窗口训练的CNN拾取P波极性，通过加权FPFIT反演获得289个震源机……

t: The workflow combines EQTransformer and EQCorrscan for detection, HypoDD for relocation, a randomized-window CNN with SNR-weighted FPFIT for focal mechanisms, iterative stress inversion, and 2D spectral-element dynamic rupture simulations.
结合EQTransformer、模板匹配和HypoDD构建目录，利用随机窗口CNN和FPFIT反演机制解与应力，开展二维…
One-year deployment (Sept 2021–Aug 2022) of 200 stations across 20 sub-kilometric arrays (~100 m aperture, DETECT experiment) in the Irpinia Near Fault Observatory, Southern Apennines, Italy.
意大利南部伊尔皮尼亚观测站开展的1年期200台站（20个百米孔径子台阵，DETECT实验）密集观测数据。

Identified ~3.6k earthquakes (relocating ~2.3k with <150 m uncertainty), resolved 289 focal mechanisms (95% CNN polarity accuracy), found homogeneous extensional stress (R=0.68±0.07), and simulated M7.0 step-over ruptures.
识别约3600次地震（重定位约2300次，误差<150m），获得289个机制解，揭示均匀伸展应力场（R=0.68）及M7…
Full fault-plane resolution is limited to events with M > 1.5 due to lower polarity counts at smaller magnitudes, and rupture simulations are simplified to 2D antiplane models.
仅对M>1.5地震实现断层面完全解析，且动态破裂模拟简化为二维反平面模型。

Demonstrates that a 1-year dense array deployment combined with ML picking and polarity inversion can match decadal catalogs and resolve decametric fault geometry, seasonal stress ratios, and M7 hazard.
证明一年期密集台阵结合机器学习即可媲美十年常规监测，精细解析断层几何、应力季节变化及强震危险性。

kc: Detected ~3,600 microearthquakes (-1.5 < M < 2.8) in 1 year using 200 dense array stations, matching 12 years of permanent network monitoring and lowering Mc by >1 magnitude unit.
Determined 289 focal mechanisms down to low magnitudes using a randomized-window CNN for P-wave polarities (95% accuracy) and an SNR-based FPFIT weighting scheme.
Demonstrated spatial homogeneity of the Irpinia extensional stress field across three sub-sectors and identified a seasonal variation in the stress ratio R correlated with hydrological strain.
Identified a 50–60 km right-stepping fault system and showed via 2D spectral-element dynamic rupture simulations that ruptures can propagate through the step-over to generate up to M7.0 events.
利用200个密集台阵台站在1年内检测到约3600次微震（-1.5 < M < 2.8），相当于12年常规监测数量，完整性震级降低超过1个震级单位。
采用随机窗口训练的CNN拾取P波极性（准确率95%）并结合信噪比加权FPFIT反演，确定了289个小震震源机制解。
证实了伊尔皮尼亚伸展应力场在三个子区域的空间均匀性，并发现应力比R存在与水文应变相关的季节性变化。
揭示了一条50-60公里长的右阶断层系统，并通过二维谱元法动态破裂模拟证明破裂可穿过阶区引发高达M7.0的地震。
me: Integrated EQTransformer (ML phase picker) and EQCorrscan (template matching) for event detection, followed by HypoDD double-difference relocation.
Implemented the Ross et al. (2018) CNN for P-wave polarity determination with randomized onset positions during training to generalize to automatic picks.
Inverted P-wave polarities for focal mechanisms using FPFIT with a custom weighting scheme based on the linear trend between polarity probability and log(SNR).
Inverted declustered focal mechanisms for stress tensor orientations and relative stress magnitude R by iteratively minimizing misfit beta.
Conducted 2D numerical dynamic rupture simulations using a spectral-element solution of the antiplane elastodynamic equation across a segmented step-over fault.
结合EQTransformer（机器学习震相拾取）与EQCorrscan（模板匹配）进行地震检测，并采用HypoDD双差法重定位。
应用Ross等（2018）的CNN模型判定P波极性，在训练阶段随机化初动位置以提高对自动拾取震相的泛化能力。
基于极性概率与信噪比对数之间的线性趋势设计自定义加权方案，利用FPFIT反演震源机制解。
通过迭代最小化错配角β，对去丛集后的震源机制目录进行应力张量方向和相对大小R的反演。
使用反平面弹性动力学方程的二维谱元法解，对分段阶区断层进行了动态破裂数值模拟。
de: 1-year temporary deployment (Sept 2021 – Aug 2022) of 200 seismic stations organized into 20 sub-kilometric arrays (~100 m aperture, DETECT experiment) within the Irpinia Near Fault Observatory (INFO).
Comparison against long-term seismicity catalogs from INFO/ISNet (2008–2021) and a 6-year focal mechanism dataset (De Matteis et al., 2012).
Integration of relocated seismicity (depth > 5 km) with a 3D Vp tomographic model (Camanni et al., 2024) to map fault step-over geometry.
在伊尔皮尼亚近断层观测站（INFO）内开展为期1年（2021年9月至2022年8月）的密集观测（DETECT实验），包含20个百米级孔径子台阵共200个台站。
与INFO/ISNet长期地震目录（2008–2021年）及6年震源机制数据集（De Matteis等，2012）进行对比验证。
将深度大于5公里的重定位地震与三维纵波速度层析成像模型（Camanni等，2024）结合，刻画断层阶区几何形态。
li: Full resolution on fault plane solutions is only achieved for events with M > 1.5, with fewer constrained polarities at lower magnitudes (e.g., 18 ± 7 polarities for M < 1).
Dynamic rupture modeling is restricted to 2D antiplane elastodynamic simulations rather than full 3D spontaneous rupture modeling.
Relocation succeeded for 65% (~2.3k of ~3.6k) of detected events, leaving 35% of the catalog unrelocated.
仅对M > 1.5的地震实现了断层面解的完全解析，更小震级事件的可用极性数量有限（如M < 1平均仅18 ± 7个极性）。
动态破裂模拟仅限于二维反平面弹性动力学模拟，尚未开展完整的三维自发破裂模拟。
仅65%（约3600个中的2300个）的检测事件成功实现双差重定位，其余35%未能重定位。

tm.why: The study builds an enhanced seismic catalog (~3.6k events) using EQTransformer, EQCorrscan, and HypoDD relocation from a dense 200-station array deployment.
The authors invert CNN-derived P-wave polarities for 289 focal mechanisms, invert for the regional stress field, and perform 2D spectral-element dynamic rupture simulations.
Machine learning is heavily used via EQTransformer for phase picking and a CNN with onset-position randomization for P-wave polarity identification.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the metadata abstract and the complete 13-page AGU25 presentation slide deck PDF.

sum: Subsurface characterization requires relating dense, band-limited 3D seismic reflection volumes to sparse, high-resolution 1D borehole well logs without exact depth registration. This paper introduces a 1.06B-parameter Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoder (CM-MAE) pretrained on 23 U.S. onshore and offshore 3D seismic surveys (~178,000 sq km) and ~92,000 wells. The architecture embeds seismic cubes and well-curve patches into continuous physical coordinates (x, y, z, channel) via a four-dimensional Rotary Position Embedding (4D RoPE), processes visible tokens in a shared Transformer with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers, and reconstructs masked targets using a CrossMAE decoder. Matched-mask ablations demonstrate strongly asymmetric information flow: seismic context improves well-log reconstruction by 9.73%, whereas wells improve seismic reconstruction by 0.65%. Zero-shot seismic-only pseudo-log predictions achieve up to 0.910 AUROC on offshore salt-geobody discrimination and preserve interval-level structure in onshore surveys, though unseen surveys exhibit absolute calibration drift.
针对三维密集地震体积与一维稀疏测井曲线在空间尺度和分辨率上的高度不对称性，本文提出了一种物理约束的跨模态掩码自编码器（CM-MAE）。模型采用四维物理坐标旋转位置编码（4D RoPE）避免严格的井震深度标定假设，结合含稀疏混合专家（MoE）层的共享Transformer编码器与CrossMAE解码器……

t: Jointly tokenizes 3D seismic cubes and 1D well-log patches, embeds continuous physical coordinates (x, y, z, channel) via 4D RoPE, and reconstructs masked targets using a shared Transformer encoder with MoE layers and a CrossMAE cross-attention decoder.
联合分词三维地震块与一维测井块，通过4D物理RoPE编码连续坐标，利用MoE编码器与CrossMAE解码器重构掩码目标。

Pretrained on 23 3D seismic volumes (~178,000 sq km across U.S. onshore and offshore basins) and ~92,000 wells (7 curves: GR, NPHI, RHOB, DT, RESD, SP, DTS), with ~17,000 wells co-located with seismic.
采用美国海陆23个三维地震工区（约17.8万km²）和约9.2万口井（7条测井曲线，约1.7万口井与地震配对）预训练。

Seismic context reduces held-out well reconstruction error by 9.73% (vs. 0.65% well-to-seismic). Zero-shot seismic-only pseudo-logs reach 0.910 AUROC on offshore salt discrimination and 0.740 Pearson correlation (KS 0.204) on onshore validation wells.
地震上下文使测井重构误差降低9.73%（反向仅0.65%）；零样本伪测井盐体识别AUROC达0.910，陆上验证井相关系…
Unseen surveys suffer survey-level calibration drift (mean bias and variance compression, KS 0.432 on Pontiac); probes only test sharp salt contrasts in zero-shot mode across U.S. basins.
未见工区存在整体标定漂移（Pontiac的KS为0.432）；仅在零样本模式下评估了高对比度盐体，且数据限于美国盆地。
First dense-sparse cross-modal MAE linking 3D seismic and 1D well logs in continuous metric coordinates via 4D physical RoPE without requiring exact seismic-well depth registration.
提出首个无需精确井震深度标定、利用四维连续物理坐标RoPE对齐三维密集地震与一维稀疏测井的跨模态MAE模型。

kc: Formulates dense-sparse 3D seismic to 1D well-log representation learning using a 1.06B-parameter cross-modal masked autoencoder (CM-MAE).
Introduces a physical-coordinate 4D Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) over (x, y, z, channel) in metres to handle mismatched sampling rates without exact well-tie registration.
Combines dense cross-modal self-attention with sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layers and a CrossMAE decoder where early decoder layers specialize into modality-pure routing.

Validates physical fidelity on held-out data showing 15x asymmetric information flow (9.73% well improvement vs 0.65% seismic), 0.910 AUROC zero-shot salt discrimination, and onshore stratigraphic distribution matching.
提出了包含10.6亿参数的跨模态掩码自编码器（CM-MAE），解决三维密集地震与一维稀疏测井的表征学习问题。
设计了基于物理坐标（x, y, z, 通道）的四维旋转位置编码（4D RoPE），无需精确井震标定即可处理不同采样率的数据。
将密集跨模态注意力与稀疏混合专家（MoE）层及CrossMAE解码器相结合，发现早期解码器层会自发形成模态专属路由。
通过掩码消融、零样本盐体识别（AUROC达0.910）及陆上层位分布测试验证了生成伪测井曲线的物理保真度。
me: Modality-specific convolutional patch tokenization (16x16x16 3D cubes for seismic at 90% masking; 16x1 depth patches for 7 well curves at 75% masking).
Physical 4D RoPE assigning geometric schedule to spatial coordinates (x, y, z in metres) and linear frequency schedule [pi, 5pi] to the categorical channel index.
32-layer shared Transformer encoder (4 MoE layers with 8 experts, top-2 routing) and 6-layer CrossMAE cross-attention decoder (all MoE layers with 4 experts, top-2 routing).
Joint training objective combining patch-standardized seismic MSE loss, variance-scaled well Huber loss, and MoE router load-balancing and z-loss penalties.
模态特定的卷积块分词化（地震采用16×16×16三维块并掩码90%；7条测井曲线采用16×1深度块并掩码75%）。
四维物理RoPE：对空间物理坐标（x, y, z，单位米）采用几何频率分布，对通道类别轴c采用[π, 5π]线性频率分布。
32层共享Transformer编码器（最后4层为8选2 MoE）与6层CrossMAE交叉注意力解码器（全为4选2 MoE）。
联合训练目标函数：结合块内标准化的地震MSE损失、方差缩放的测井Huber损失，以及MoE负载均衡损失与z损失。
de: Pretraining corpus of 23 3D seismic surveys (~178,000 sq km across U.S. onshore and offshore basins) and ~92,000 wells (~17,000 co-located within 100 m; 7 curves: GR, NPHI, RHOB, DT, RESD, SP, DTS).
Matched-mask modality ablation across 2,276 held-out paired samples from 1,523 unique wells under both-modalities, seismic-only, and well-only regimes.
Post-hoc MoE routing interventions (top-1 routing, expert merging, uniform/random/single routing) evaluated via Pearson correlation on pseudo-log inference.

Zero-shot physical-fidelity probes: offshore salt-geobody AUROC using sign-flipped DT and NPHI pseudo-logs, and onshore interval-conditioned CDF/Kolmogorov-Smirnov comparisons (Sanderson and unseen Pontiac surveys).
预训练语料包含美国陆上和海上盆地的23个三维地震工区（约17.8万平方公里）及约9.2万口井（约1.7万口井位于地震块100米内；含GR、NPHI、RHOB、DT、RESD、SP、DTS七条曲线）。
在来自1,523口保留井的2,276个配对样本上进行匹配掩码模态消融实验（对比双模态、仅地震、仅测井输入）。
通过伪测井推理的皮尔逊相关系数评估事后MoE路由干预实验（Top-1路由、专家合并、均匀/随机/单专家路由）。
零样本物理保真度探针测试：利用DT和NPHI伪测井评估海上盐体识别AUROC，以及陆上Sanderson与未见Pontiac工区的层间CDF与KS统计量对比。
li: Survey-level calibration drift on unseen surveys (e.g., Pontiac shows elevated DT mean and compressed variance with pooled KS of 0.432, despite positive within-interval correlation).
Physical probe scope is restricted to salt geobodies with sharp petrophysical contrasts, leaving subtler targets like sand/shale and fluid contacts untested.
Evaluations rely on zero-shot reads from the frozen checkpoint rather than fine-tuned transfer to supervised downstream tasks, and data are limited to U.S. basins.
在完全未见的地震工区（如Pontiac）存在工区级标定漂移（预测DT均值偏高、方差压缩，总KS达0.432）。
物理探针仅测试了岩石物理特征极其鲜明的盐体，尚未评估砂泥岩薄互层或流体接触面等更精细的目标。
所有评估均基于冻结权重的零样本读取，未量化在有监督下游任务上的微调迁移效果，且训练数据局限于美国盆地。

tm.why: The paper develops a 1.06B-parameter cross-modal masked autoencoder (CM-MAE) with Mixture-of-Experts and 4D physical RoPE to learn joint representations of 3D seismic reflection volumes and 1D well logs.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including architecture details, equations, ablation tables, and figure analyses.

sum: This study utilizes P- and S-wave receiver functions to image the crustal and lithospheric structure beneath the southern Korean Peninsula and its adjacent volcanic islands. The results reveal a sharp lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) at approximately 70 km depth, characterized by a 7%–10% shear-wave velocity reduction. Thermodynamic modeling suggests this reduction is caused by partial melt. The lithospheric structure exhibits lateral heterogeneity: the southeastern block shows a deeper Moho and shallower LAB compared to the northwestern block, while Ulleung Island features an exceptionally shallow LAB due to Miocene backarc extension. These findings suggest the southern Korean Peninsula represents a tectonically modified domain shaped by long-term subduction-related lithospheric thinning and magmatic overprinting.
本研究利用P波和S波接收函数，对朝鲜半岛南部及其邻近火山岛的地壳和岩石圈结构进行了成像。结果显示，在约70公里深处存在一个陡峭的岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB），伴随着7%–10%的剪切波速度显著降低。热力学模拟表明该速度降低由局部熔体导致。研究发现岩石圈结构存在显著的横向非均匀性：与西北部相比，东南部……

t: P- and S-wave receiver function analysis combined with thermodynamic modeling to constrain crustal and lithospheric structure and estimate partial melt fractions.
结合P波和S波接收函数分析与热力学模拟，约束地壳和岩石圈结构并估算局部熔体比例。
Teleseismic earthquake waveforms recorded by broadband seismic stations across the southern Korean Peninsula and adjacent volcanic islands (Jeju and Ulleung).
朝鲜半岛南部及邻近火山岛（济州岛和郁陵岛）宽频带地震台网记录的远震波形数据。
A sharp LAB at ~70 km depth with a 7%-10% Vs reduction, indicating partial melt, alongside lateral variations in Moho and LAB depths across tectonic blocks.
在约70公里深处发现陡峭的LAB，伴随7%-10%的Vs降低（指示局部熔体），且不同构造块体间存在横向差异。
Potential trade-offs in receiver function inversions and reliance on thermodynamic assumptions for melt fraction estimates.
接收函数反演中潜在的参数折衷，以及熔体比例估算对热力学假设的依赖。
First high-resolution seismic evidence of a sharp, melt-bearing LAB beneath the southern Korean Peninsula, linking it to subduction-related lithospheric thinning.
首次提供朝鲜半岛南部下方存在含熔体陡峭LAB的高分辨率地震学证据，并将其与俯冲相关的岩石圈减薄联系起来。

kc: Mapped the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) beneath the southern Korean Peninsula and adjacent islands using P- and S-receiver functions.
Identified a sharp LAB at ~70 km depth with a 7%-10% shear-wave velocity reduction, indicating the presence of partial melt.
Revealed lateral lithospheric heterogeneity across the Korean Peninsula, highlighting distinct crustal and mantle structures between tectonic blocks and volcanic islands.
利用P波和S波接收函数绘制了朝鲜半岛南部及邻近岛屿下方的岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）图。
在约70公里深处识别出陡峭的LAB，伴有7%-10%的剪切波速度降低，指示存在局部熔体。
揭示了朝鲜半岛横向岩石圈的非均匀性，突出了不同构造块体与火山岛之间独特的地壳和地幔结构。
me: P-wave receiver function (PRF) analysis for crustal structure (Moho depth and Vp/Vs ratio).
S-wave receiver function (SRF) analysis for lithospheric mantle structure (LAB depth).
Thermodynamic modeling to estimate melt fractions near the LAB based on shear-wave velocity reduction.
用于地壳结构（莫霍面深度和Vp/Vs比值）的P波接收函数（PRF）分析。
用于岩石圈地幔结构（LAB深度）的S波接收函数（SRF）分析。
基于剪切波速度降低估算LAB附近熔体比例的热力学模拟。
de: Teleseismic earthquake waveform data recorded by broadband seismic stations across the southern Korean Peninsula, Jeju Island, and Ulleung Island.
由朝鲜半岛南部、济州岛和郁陵岛的宽频带地震台网记录的远震地震波形数据。
li: Resolution of receiver functions may be limited in resolving very fine-scale vertical or lateral variations in melt distribution.
Reliance on thermodynamic assumptions for melt fraction estimates without direct physical samples.
接收函数的解析度在分辨熔体分布的极精细垂直或横向变化时可能受到限制。
在缺乏直接物理样品的情况下，熔体比例估算依赖于热力学假设。

tm.why: The study uses P- and S-receiver functions to image the crustal and lithospheric structure, specifically the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary.
The paper investigates the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary and crustal structure beneath the Korean Peninsula to understand continental lithospheric evolution.

ev.notes: Analyzed the paper based on the provided abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Frequency-wavenumber (FK) beamforming of ambient seismic noise is widely used to extract surface-wave dispersion curves for subsurface velocity inversion, yet optimal array design typically requires prior subsurface velocity knowledge. This study presents a practical, analytical design concept based on concentric two-circle arrays that requires only the target depth range and desired azimuthal gap as inputs. By linking wavenumber resolution and aliasing limits from the theoretical array response function to mode-specific wavelength penetration depths (0.25 wavelength for fundamental modes, 1.4 wavelengths for first higher modes), the authors derive direct analytical expressions for the inner and outer circle radii. For fundamental-mode Rayleigh waves, the array aperture should be roughly 6.3 times the maximum target depth, while the minimum inter-station spacing should be less than twice the minimum target depth. Synthetic test cases confirm the derived layouts accurately capture the targeted mode-specific dispersion ranges.
背景噪声频率-波数（FK）聚束法常用于提取面波频散曲线以反演地下速度结构，但常规台阵设计需先验速度信息。本文提出一种实用的双同心圆台阵解析设计方法，仅需目标深度范围和最大方位角间隙作为输入。通过将理论台阵响应函数的波数分辨率与空间假频极限同不同模态的波长穿透深度（基阶0.25倍波长，一阶高阶1.4倍……

t: The authors reverse-engineer the theoretical 2D array response function into 1D resolution and circular aliasing limits, combining them with mode-dependent wavelength penetration fractions to analytically compute inner and outer radii of a two-circle seismic array.
将二维理论台阵响应函数反推为一维分辨率与圆周假频极限，结合模态波长穿透深度比例解析计算双环台阵内外半径。

This theoretical study uses no field data; instead, it evaluates synthetic two-layer and multi-layer velocity models across three fictitious target depth ranges (50–300 m, 500–1500 m, and 2000–5000 m) using theoretical dispersion curves.
本研究为纯理论推导，采用双层和多层合成速度模型，在三个虚拟目标深度范围（50–5000米）内开展频散测试。

For fundamental modes (p = 0.25), the outer radius is pi times maximum target depth (total aperture ~6.3 z_max), and for a 12-station two-circle array, the inner radius is twice the minimum target depth.
对于基阶模态（p=0.25），外环半径为最大目标深度的π倍（总孔径约6.3倍），六台站内环半径为最小目标深度的2倍。
Relative penetration depth is simplified to depend only on mode rather than detailed velocity structure, and higher-mode imaging requires the assumption that higher modes possess sufficient energy.
穿透深度比例简化为仅由模态决定而忽略复杂速度结构影响，且高阶模态成像需假设存在足够的高阶能量。

Provides closed-form two-circle array sizing equations requiring only target depth range and station count, explicitly incorporating multi-mode penetration depths without needing prior subsurface velocity knowledge.
无需先验地下速度信息，仅凭目标深度和台站数即可解析计算双环台阵尺寸，并首次显式纳入多模态穿透深度差异。

kc: Derives analytical equations for inner and outer radii of a two-circle seismic array using only target depth ranges and station count.
Accounts for multi-mode surface waves by incorporating mode-dependent relative penetration depths (p = 0.25 for fundamental, p = 1.4 for first higher mode).
Establishes practical rules of thumb: array aperture ~6.3 times maximum target depth and minimum spacing < 2 times minimum target depth for fundamental modes.
Provides open-source Python scripts (ArrayDesign_FK) to rapidly design arrays or evaluate subarray sizes within large dense nodal networks.
推导了仅利用目标深度范围和台站数量计算双环地震台阵内外半径的解析公式。
通过引入模态相关的相对穿透深度（基阶p=0.25，一阶高阶p=1.4），使台阵设计兼顾多模态面波分析。
建立了基阶面波台阵设计的实用经验法则：总孔径约为最大目标深度的6.3倍，最小台间距小于最小目标深度的2倍。
提供了开源脚本（ArrayDesign_FK），用于快速设计新台阵或评估大型密集节点网络中的子台阵尺寸。
me: 1D reduction of the theoretical 2D Array Response Function (ARF) to solve for the half-height central peak resolution limit (k_min).
Geometric chord-length derivation on the inner circle combined with the Nyquist half-wavelength criterion to prevent spatial aliasing (k_max).
Wavelength-to-depth scaling using synthetic shear-wave phase velocity sensitivity kernels (via disba) for Rayleigh and Love wave modes.
将二维理论台阵响应函数（ARF）简化为一维，通过中心峰半高宽求解波数分辨率极限（k_min）。
结合内环几何弦长公式与奈奎斯特半波长准则，推导防止空间假频的极限条件（k_max）。
利用disba计算的瑞利波和勒夫波相速度敏感度核，建立不同模态波长与穿透深度的比例关系。
de: Phase velocity sensitivity kernel modeling on a synthetic two-layer crust/near-surface velocity model at a period of 1.67 s.
Fictitious array design test cases across three target depth ranges: 50–300 m, 500–1500 m, and 2000–5000 m.
Forward calculation of 2D Array Response Functions and theoretical dispersion curves on a multi-layer synthetic velocity profile.
基于双层合成速度模型计算周期1.67秒的瑞利波与勒夫波相速度敏感度核。
针对三个虚拟目标深度范围（50–300 m、500–1500 m、2000–5000 m）开展台阵设计测试。
基于多层合成速度模型正演计算台阵响应函数（ARF）与理论频散曲线，验证波数覆盖范围。
li: Relies on simplified constant penetration depth fractions (p = 0.25 and p = 1.4), whereas true depth sensitivity depends on the local velocity structure.
Higher-mode array design assumes sufficient higher-mode energy exists in the ambient noise wavefield at higher frequencies.
Validated purely through theoretical array response functions and synthetic dispersion curves without field deployment data.
依赖简化的固定波长穿透深度比例（p=0.25和1.4），而实际深度敏感性受控于局部真实速度结构。
高阶模态台阵设计前提是假设背景噪声波场在高频段具有足够的高阶模态能量。
仅通过理论台阵响应函数和合成频散曲线进行了验证，缺乏实际野外观测数据测试。

tm.why: The paper derives analytical equations to design optimal two-circle seismic array geometries for frequency-wavenumber beamforming.
The array design is explicitly optimized for passive seismic surveys and ambient seismic noise beamforming analysis.
The array designs aim to extract fundamental and higher-mode surface-wave dispersion curves to invert for subsurface shear-wave velocity profiles.

ev.notes: Full 15-page manuscript PDF read and analyzed, including all mathematical derivations in Sections 2-3 and synthetic test cases in Section 4.

sum: Deep learning seismic denoisers typically operate in either the time domain (TD) or time-frequency domain (TFD), but the impact of this representation choice has lacked controlled assessment. This study benchmarks four comparable UNet architectures: TD, TFD (EQS Denoiser), parallel hybrid (TD+TFD), and sequential hybrid (EQShyb / TFD2TD) trained on local Swiss earthquake recordings and tested on out-of-distribution Italian data (INSTANCE). Results show TD models preserve sharp signal onsets at high SNRs but fail to detect weak events at low SNRs, whereas TFD models detect signals down to low SNRs but introduce STFT binning artifacts and acausal smeared onsets. The novel sequential hybrid model EQShyb, trained with a custom weighted MAE and hinge refinement loss, combines both strengths. It achieves superior waveform reconstruction, noise suppression (>200 dB), P/S phase picking, and first-motion polarity determination across all SNRs, outperforming benchmark models (DeepDenoiser, WaveDenoiser, CDiffSD, unsupervised thresholding).
本研究在受控条件下系统评估了输入表征对深度学习地震图降噪的影响，设计并对比了四种基于UNet的架构：时间域（TD）、时频域（EQS）、并行混合域（TD+TFD）及序贯混合域（EQShyb）。基于瑞士近震数据集训练并在意大利INSTANCE数据集上进行跨区域测试。结果表明，TD模型在高信噪比下波形最准……

t: Four comparable UNet architectures (TD, TFD, parallel TD+TFD, sequential TFD2TD/EQShyb) are benchmarked. EQShyb refines TFD outputs using a TD network guided by multiplicative mask conditioning and a custom relative-error-weighted MAE plus hinge loss.
对比四种UNet架构，提出序贯混合模型EQShyb，利用掩码条件化和定制加权MAE及合页损失修正时频域输出。

Models are trained on the Swiss EQS velocity waveform dataset (1–30 km epicentral distance, M0.0–3.5) with on-the-fly noise augmentation, and evaluated on out-of-distribution Italian INSTANCE data (2019–2020, <30 km, M0.0–6.5).
基于瑞士EQS近震速度波形数据集（1–30 km，M0.0–3.5）训练，并在意大利INSTANCE数据集上评估泛化性。

EQShyb achieves median noise suppression of 230 dB, increases low-SNR (< -10 dB) phase picks by over 5x on Swiss data and 3x over benchmarks on Italian data, and improves polarity accuracy and coverage.
EQShyb实现230 dB中位噪声抑制，低信噪比震相拾取量提升5倍以上，且显著提升初动极性判定精度与覆盖率。

Performance degrades at very low SNRs or high spectral overlap where signal information is lost, and EQShyb is limited to near-epicentral regimes without retraining for teleseismic or large-magnitude events.
极低信噪比或频谱严重重叠时性能受限；模型仅针对近震训练，未重训不能直接用于远震或大震。

First systematic controlled comparison of time, time-frequency, and hybrid domain seismic denoisers, introducing the sequential hybrid EQShyb model with a custom refinement loss that sharpens onsets for polarity determination.
首次受控对比时域、时频域与混合域地震降噪，提出带定制修正损失的EQShyb模型并拓展了初动极性判定。

kc: Systematically evaluated time, time-frequency, and hybrid domain representations using comparable fully convolutional UNet architectures under controlled training conditions.
Proposed EQShyb (TFD2TD), a sequential hybrid denoiser with mask conditioning and a custom relative-error-weighted MAE plus hinge loss to prevent shortcut learning.

Demonstrated that EQShyb outperforms single-domain models and state-of-the-art benchmarks (DeepDenoiser, WaveDenoiser, CDiffSD, unsupervised thresholding) on both Swiss in-distribution and Italian out-of-distribution datasets.

Showed that time-domain onset refinement extends reliable P-wave first-motion polarity determination and accurate phase picking to significantly lower SNRs than bandpass filtering or TFD-only denoising.
在受控训练条件下，采用可比的全卷积UNet架构系统评估了时间域、时频域和混合域表征对地震降噪的影响。
提出了序贯混合降噪模型EQShyb（TFD2TD），引入掩码条件化以及定制的相对误差加权MAE与合页损失，避免了捷径学习。
在瑞士分布内数据集和意大利分布外数据集上证明EQShyb全面优于单域模型及现有标杆模型（DeepDenoiser、WaveDenoiser、CDiffSD、无监督阈值法）。
证明时间域初至修正能显著改善P波初动极性判定和震相拾取，将可靠极性估计扩展至比带通滤波或纯时频域降噪更低的信噪比范围。
me: Implemented four fully convolutional UNet variants: Time-Domain (TD), Time-Frequency Domain via STFT masking (TFD/EQS), Parallel Hybrid (TD+TFD), and Sequential Hybrid (TFD2TD/EQShyb).
Designed a custom refinement loss for EQShyb combining a logarithmic relative-error-weighted MAE (with an onset box weight) and a hinge loss enforcing a 5% improvement margin over the TFD baseline.
Applied multiplicative mask conditioning by upsampling/downsampling TFD masks to guide the TD refinement stage and suppress noise-only periods.
Evaluated downstream performance using EQTransformer and PhaseNet for P/S phase picking, and a custom 1D CNN classifier with test-time dropout for first-motion polarity determination.
实现了四种全卷积UNet变体：时间域（TD）、基于STFT掩码的时频域（TFD/EQS）、并行混合域（TD+TFD）和序贯混合域（TFD2TD/EQShyb）。
为EQShyb设计了定制修正损失函数，结合对数相对误差加权MAE（含初至窗口加权）与强制比TFD基线提升5%以上的合页损失。
应用乘法掩码条件化，通过对TFD掩码进行上/下采样以引导TD修正阶段并抑制纯噪声时段。
使用EQTransformer和PhaseNet评估下游P/S震相拾取性能，并构建带测试时Dropout的一维CNN分类器评估初动极性判定。
de: Trained models on the EQS dataset from Switzerland (local earthquakes at 1–30 km epicentral distance, M0.0–3.5, instrument response deconvolved velocity waveforms at 100 Hz) with on-the-fly noise augmentation.
Tested in-distribution performance across 10,000 synthetic event-noise pairs per SNR step from -15 dB to 5 dB on Swiss data.
Evaluated out-of-distribution generalization on a subset of the Italian INSTANCE dataset (2019–2020 events within 30 km, M0.0–6.5, excluding border stations).
Benchmarked computational efficiency (FLOPs, parameters, throughput on an NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU) and continuous waveform processing on Swiss broadband and urban strong-motion stations.
在瑞士EQS数据集（震中距1–30 km、震级M0.0–3.5的近震，去除仪器响应的100 Hz速度波形）上通过动态噪声增强进行模型训练。
在瑞士数据集上，从-15 dB到5 dB每个信噪比梯度构造10,000对事件-噪声合成样本进行分布内性能测试。
在意大利INSTANCE数据集子集（2019–2020年震中距30 km内、M0.0–6.5事件，剔除边境台站）上评估分布外泛化能力。
在NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU上评测了计算效率（FLOPs、参数量、吞吐量），并在瑞士宽频带和城市强震台站的连续波形上进行了测试。
li: Denoising performance degrades at very low SNRs and when spectral overlap between earthquake signal and noise is large, where signal information is fundamentally lost.
EQShyb is trained on near-epicentral recordings (<30 km) and is not expected to generalize to teleseismic distances or large-magnitude events without retraining or fine-tuning.

Interaction between denoiser and phase picker causes slight systematic pick timing biases at low SNRs (slightly early with EQTransformer on Swiss data, slightly delayed P picks with PhaseNet on Italian data).
在极低信噪比以及地震信号与噪声频谱高度重叠时，由于信号信息本质上已丢失，降噪性能会显著下降。
EQShyb基于近震记录（<30 km）训练，若不重新训练或微调，难以直接泛化至远震距离或大震级事件。
降噪器与震相拾取器之间的交互在低信噪比下会引入轻微的系统性拾取偏差（如瑞士数据上EQTransformer略偏早，意大利数据上PhaseNet的P波略延迟）。

tm.why: The paper designs, trains, and benchmarks four deep learning UNet architectures for earthquake seismogram denoising across time, time-frequency, and hybrid domains.

The denoising models are explicitly evaluated on downstream signal detection, P and S phase picking (using EQTransformer and PhaseNet), and first-motion polarity determination for monitoring pipelines.

ev.notes: Full 29-page PDF (ETH Zurich repository cover page + 28-page JGR: Machine Learning and Computation article) read and analyzed in full, including all figures, table, and appendices.

sum: Deep learning-assisted 3D seismic imaging and full waveform inversion (FWI) are bottlenecked by a lack of large-scale, geologically realistic 3D training datasets. This paper introduces GeoFWI3D, an open-source benchmark comprising 10,000 3D subsurface models at 96x96x96 resolution generated via the random geological model (RGM) framework and Latin hypercube sampling. The dataset is balanced across four structural complexity classes: pure stratigraphy, faulted networks, salt diapirism, and coupled fault-salt systems. Each realization includes co-registered 3D volumes of P-wave velocity (Vp), bandlimited zero-offset seismic reflectivity, relative geologic time (RGT), and semantic fault/salt masks. Unlike existing 2D or structurally simple 3D benchmarks, GeoFWI3D integrates complex 3D geology with multi-modal labels. The authors establish baseline benchmarks for 3D fault detection, joint salt segmentation and RGT prediction, physics-driven and data-driven FWI, neural operator surrogates (FNO/UFNO) for traveltime and wavefield modeling, and 3D diffusion generative modeling, demonstrating strong generalization to North Sea F3 field data.
针对深度学习3D地震成像与全波形反演（FWI）缺乏大规模真实训练数据的问题，本文发布了包含10,000个（96×96×96分辨率）地质模型的开源数据集GeoFWI3D。方法上采用随机地质模型（RGM）框架与拉丁超立方采样，均衡构建了纯地层、断层网络、盐底辟及断-盐耦合四类模型，并提供配准的纵波速度、……

t: Employs a four-phase procedural Random Geological Model (RGM) workflow sampled via Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) to generate 3D stratigraphy, faults, salt diapirs, and wavenumber-domain PSF-convolved seismic reflectivity volumes.
采用拉丁超立方采样驱动的四阶段随机地质模型（RGM）流程，生成3D地层、断层、盐体及PSF褶积地震体。

Comprises 10,000 open-source 3D models (96x96x96 float32 grids) equally split into four structural classes, each providing co-registered Vp, Fault mask, RGT, and zero-offset seismic reflectivity volumes.
含1万个96×96×96分辨率3D模型，均分四类构造，提供配准的Vp、断层掩码、RGT和反射率体。

GeoFWI3D-trained networks achieve higher OOD fault F1-score (0.4110 vs 0.3023), 0.9782 F1-score in few-shot F3 salt segmentation, 43.00 m/s MAE in L1 3D FWI, and 6.836 ms MAE in 3D FNO traveltime prediction.
跨域断层检测F1达0.4110，F3盐体微调F1达0.9782，L1-FWI误差降至43 m/s，FNO走时误差6.83…

Restricted to acoustic isotropic physics without elastic or attenuation effects, uses PSF convolution instead of pre-stack wavefield simulation, and relies on geometric rather than process-based geological modeling.
仅限声波各向同性近似，自带地震体为PSF褶积而非叠前模拟，且为几何而非物理过程建模。

Extends realistic geological benchmark datasets from 2D to 3D at a 10,000-model scale, uniquely combining complex fault-salt structures with co-registered multi-modal labels for unified inversion and interpretation benchmarking.
首次提供万级规模复杂断-盐构造3D速度库，并融合多模态标签以统一评估反演与解释算法。

kc: Released GeoFWI3D, an open-source dataset of 10,000 3D subsurface models (96x96x96) balanced across four structural complexity classes (stratigraphy, faults, salt, coupled fault-salt).
Provided co-registered multi-modal 3D tensors for each realization: P-wave velocity (Vp), PSF-convolved zero-offset seismic reflectivity, relative geologic time (RGT), and fault/salt semantic masks.
