sum: Salt tectonics is conventionally attributed to external (allogenic) triggers such as differential loading, gravity gliding, or regional shortening. Analyzing ~26,000 km² of 3-D seismic reflection data and 34 boreholes in the Southern North Sea, alongside 2-D finite-difference Stokes viscous flow simulations, this study demonstrates that the earliest regional deformation of the Zechstein Supergroup salt giant was autogenic. Synclines of the earliest salt-cored folds directly overlie a curvilinear network of anomalously thick zones (ATZs) in the Z3 anhydrite. Formed as gypsum ridges and converted to denser anhydrite (~700 kg/m³ denser than halite) during late Permian burial, these ridges foundered into underlying halite at 1–2 mm/yr. This sinking dragged down the connected Z3a stringer and top-salt surface, creating kilometer-scale depressions filled by onlapping Lower Triassic sediments. Thus, internal evaporite stratigraphy and diagenesis actively initiated and localized basin-scale salt tectonics rather than acting as passive strain markers.
传统观点认为盐构造由差异负载或区域挤压等外生因素触发。本研究结合北海南部约26,000 km²的三维地震反射数据、34口钻井及二维Stokes粘性流数值模拟，证明蔡希斯坦超群（Zechstein）巨型盐层的最早区域变形是自生起源的。早期盐核褶皱的向斜直接叠置在Z3硬石膏异常增厚带（ATZs）弯曲网络……

t: Combined regional 3-D seismic horizon/isopach mapping and RMS amplitude extraction with 2-D finite-difference marker-in-cell incompressible Stokes viscous modeling of dense anhydrite ridges sinking in Newtonian halite.
结合三维地震层位与等厚图解释、RMS振幅提取及二维交错网格有限差分Stokes粘性流数值模拟。
Interpreted ~26,000 km² of zero-phase 3-D seismic reflection data from the UK and Dutch sectors of the Southern North Sea, calibrated against 34 exploratory and production wells.
解释了北海南部英国和荷兰区块约26,000 km²的三维地震反射数据，并结合34口钻井进行标定。

Z3a thickness is bimodal (67% background at ~47 m; 33% ATZs >55 m). In models, ATZs sink at 1–2 mm/yr, forming 300-m-deep, 400–500-m-wide surface depressions within 200 kyr that deepen under sediment loading.
ATZs占研究区面积33%（>55 m）；模拟中ATZs以1–2 mm/yr下沉，20万年内形成约300米深的凹陷。
Numerical models use 2-D geometry, linear Newtonian salt rheology rather than stress-dependent creep, omit compaction and insoluble residue, and experience lateral boundary effects on outer blocks.
数值模型限于二维剖面与线性牛顿流变学，未考虑压实与不溶残渣及三维应力竞争。
Demonstrates that basin-scale salt tectonics can be initiated autogenically by intrasalt gypsum-to-anhydrite diagenetic density inversion rather than external tectonic or loading triggers.
首次证实盐内石膏向硬石膏转化的成岩密度倒置可自生启动盆地尺度的早期盐构造变形。

kc: Demonstrated from ~26,000 km² of 3-D seismic data that the earliest salt-cored synclines in the Southern Permian Basin track an unoriented intrasalt network of anomalously thick Z3 anhydrite zones (ATZs).

Showed via seismic stratigraphy (Lower Triassic onlap and Base Cretaceous truncation) that ATZ-cored synclines formed immediately after Permian salt deposition, predating regional tectonic shortening.

Confirmed with 2-D Stokes numerical modeling that a 700 kg/m³ density contrast from gypsum-to-anhydrite diagenesis suffices to founder ATZs, deflect the salt surface into 300-m-deep minibasins within 200 kyr, and explain why connected ridges remain suspended above the salt base.
利用约26,000 km²三维地震数据证明，南二叠盆地最早的盐核向斜走向受控于盐内无优选取向的Z3硬石膏异常增厚带（ATZs）网络。
通过地震地层学（下三叠统超覆与白垩系底界削截）证明ATZ核部向斜在二叠纪盐沉积后立即形成，早于区域构造挤压。
通过二维Stokes数值模拟证实，石膏转硬石膏产生的700 kg/m³密度差足以使ATZs沉降并在20万年内在盐顶产生300米深的凹陷，同时解释了连通硬石膏脊为何悬浮于盐底之上。
me: 3-D seismic horizon interpretation, seismic-to-well ties using synthetic seismograms, isopach mapping (55 m threshold for ATZs), and RMS amplitude extraction.
Seismic-stratigraphic analysis of syn-kinematic growth strata (onlap and truncation geometries) to separate early autogenic subsidence from post-Triassic halokinesis.

2-D incompressible Stokes finite-difference modeling on a staggered grid with Lagrangian markers for Newtonian viscous fluids (halite and anhydrite), testing density-driven foundering and subsequent sand loading.
三维地震层位追踪、合成地震记录井震标定、等厚图编制（采用55米阈值识别ATZs）以及均方根（RMS）振幅属性提取。
同构造生长地层（超覆与削截几何关系）地震地层学分析，以区分早期自生沉降与三叠纪之后的盐构造运动。
基于交错网格有限差分与拉格朗日标记点法的二维不可压缩Stokes牛顿粘性流数值模拟，测试密度驱动沉降及随后的砂质沉积加载响应。
de: 26,533 km² of zero-phase 3-D seismic reflection volumes from the UK (~16,000 km², PGS MegaSurvey) and Dutch (~10,000 km², TNO/NLOG) sectors of the Southern North Sea, calibrated with 34 boreholes.
Parametric 2-D numerical experiments comparing attached versus detached anhydrite ATZs across varying density contrasts (200–700 kg/m³), viscosity ratios (100–10,000), block sizes, and spacings.
北海南部英国区块（约16,000 km²）与荷兰区块（约10,000 km²）共26,533 km²的零相位三维地震反射数据体，并由34口钻井进行标定。
二维参数化数值模拟实验，对比连通与孤立硬石膏ATZs在不同密度差（200–700 kg/m³）、粘度比（100–10,000）、块体尺寸和间距下的演化。
li: Numerical models are restricted to 2-D cross-sections, whereas a 3-D polygonal ATZ network distributes stress and expels salt differently.

Halite is modeled as a linear Newtonian fluid, which captures initial high-stress foundering but does not directly model non-linear dislocation/pressure-solution creep arrest at low differential stresses.
Models omit insoluble residue, clastic compaction, and soft welding effects, and have a 5-km domain width where free-slip side walls accelerate the outermost ATZs.
数值模拟仅限于二维剖面，而三维多边形ATZ网络在应力分布与盐排出机制上存在三维效应差异。
石盐被简化为线性牛顿流体，虽能刻画初始高应力沉降，但未直接模拟低差应力下非线性的位错与压溶蠕变停滞过程。
模型未包含不溶残渣、碎屑压实和软焊合效应，且5公里宽计算域的自由滑移侧边界会加速最外侧ATZ块体的下沉。

tm.why: The paper investigates basin-scale salt tectonics and geodynamic viscous flow modeling in the Southern Permian Basin using 3-D seismic reflection data and 2-D Stokes simulations.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF including main text (pp. 1–16) and complete Supplemental Material (pp. 16–38, including Figs. S1–S16 and Tables S2–S3) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates the interaction between seismic and aseismic slip along the Mendocino oceanic transform fault (OTF) offshore Northern California by analyzing aftershock sequences of three Mw > 6.5 earthquakes (1994 Mw 7.0, 2016 Mw 6.6, and 2024 Mw 7.0). Using continuous waveforms from 54 onshore stations, the authors combine EQTransformer, PyOcto, Hypoinverse, hypoDD, and GPU-based template matching to build high-precision catalogs. They find that Mendocino OTF mainshocks produce ~15 times fewer aftershocks than comparable continental strike-slip events, indicating weak inter-event stress triggering. However, the aftershock zones expand along-strike with logarithmic time to 1.6–3.4 times the coseismic rupture lengths (~11 km/decade for the 2024 event), driven by propagating aseismic afterslip. Depth projections show coseismic slip patches are surrounded by aftershocks and repeating earthquakes, supporting a novel model where seismic asperities are heterogeneously embedded within a predominantly aseismic fault zone.
本研究分析了加州近海门多西诺洋中脊转换断层（OTF）三次Mw>6.5地震（1994、2016和2024年）的余震序列，探究地震与无震滑移的相互作用。基于54个陆上台站连续波形，结合EQTransformer、PyOcto、hypoDD及GPU模板匹配技术构建了高精度目录。研究发现这些OTF大震的余震……

t: The authors combine EQTransformer phase picking, PyOcto association, Hypoinverse and hypoDD relocation with FDTCC cross-correlation, and GPU-based template matching (GPU-M&L) to build high-resolution aftershock catalogs, then quantify ETAS aftershock productivity and logarithmic migration speed.
结合EQTransformer震相拾取、PyOcto关联、hypoDD重定位和GPU模板匹配构建目录，并量化ETAS余震…

Continuous waveforms from 54 Northern California Seismic Network stations for the 2024 Mw 7.0 event (yielding 8,015 detections), supplemented by the Northern California DD catalog (1994 event) and 3,226 USGS templates for the 2016 Mw 6.6 sequence.
北加州台网54个台站2024年连续波形（检出8,015个事件）、北加州DD目录（1994年序列）及3,226个USGS模…

Mendocino Mw > 6.5 mainshocks have ~15 times fewer aftershocks than continental strike-slip events (ETAS branching ratio 0.1), but aftershock zones expand logarithmically along-strike (~11 km/decade in 2024) to 1.6–3.4 times the coseismic rupture lengths.
门多西诺大震余震数比同级大陆地震少约15倍（分支比0.1），但余震区随对数时间沿走向扩展至同震破裂长度的1.6–3.4倍…

Offshore locations hinder direct geodetic afterslip measurements, 1994 lacks continuous waveforms, 2016 is far from onshore stations, and published 2024 slip models vary significantly with assumed hypocenter depth.
近海位置难以直接进行大地测量余滑观测，1994年无连续波形，2016年距台站远，且已有同震滑移模型受震源深度影响大。

Extends OTF aftershock productivity scaling to Mw 7.0 and reveals depth-dependent heterogeneous embedding of seismic asperities within an aseismic creeping zone that hosts triggered along-strike afterslip.
将OTF余震生产力标度律扩展至Mw 7.0，揭示了地震凹凸体在深度上非均匀嵌入无震滑移带并受触发余滑驱动的新机制。

kc: Constructed a 30-day high-precision catalog of 8,015 aftershocks for the 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino OTF earthquake using ML picking, hypoDD, and GPU template matching.
Extended the global OTF aftershock productivity scaling law up to Mmain - Mc = 5.6, confirming ~15 times lower productivity than continental strike-slip earthquakes.
Demonstrated that OTF aftershock zones expand logarithmically with time to 1.6–3.4 times the coseismic rupture length, driven by along-strike propagating afterslip.
Proposed a heterogeneous asperity-embedding model in depth and strike rather than simple along-strike segmentation or multimode switching.
利用机器学习拾取、hypoDD和GPU模板匹配，构建了2024年Mw 7.0门多西诺OTF地震包含8,015个事件的30天高精度余震目录。
将全球OTF余震生产力标度律上限扩展至Mmain - Mc = 5.6，证实其余震数量比同级大陆走滑地震少约15倍。
证明OTF余震区随对数时间沿走向扩展至同震破裂长度的1.6–3.4倍，由沿走向传播的震后无震滑移驱动。
提出了地震凹凸体在深度和走向上非均匀嵌入无震滑移带的物理模型，突破了以往仅关注走向分段的局限。
me: Machine-learning phase picking using EQTransformer (threshold 0.2) and phase association via PyOcto (at least 12 P and S picks).
Sequential absolute location (Hypoinverse) and double-difference relative relocation (hypoDD) with fast waveform cross-correlation (FDTCC).
GPU-based Match and Locate (GPU-M&L) template matching using S-wave windows on the 9 nearest stations.
Aftershock productivity quantification using ETAS scaling laws, MAXC/GFT completeness estimation, and beta-value seismicity rate analysis.
使用EQTransformer（阈值0.2）进行机器学习震相拾取，并通过PyOcto（至少12个P和S震相）进行震相关联。
结合Hypoinverse绝对定位与基于快速波形互相关（FDTCC）的hypoDD双差相对重定位。
利用最近9个台站的S波窗开展基于GPU的匹配定位（GPU-M&L）模板匹配检测。
基于ETAS标度律、MAXC/GFT完备震级估计和β值地震活动率分析量化余震生产力与扩展范围。
de: Continuous seismic waveforms from 54 permanent onshore stations of the Northern California Seismic Network for the 2024 Mw 7.0 sequence.
Northern California Double-Difference Earthquake Catalog (v202112.1) from 1984 to 2021 for the 1994 Mw 7.0 sequence and background seismicity.
30-day template matching catalog for the 2016 Mw 6.6 sequence using 3,226 M >= 2 USGS catalog templates (2008–2024).
Southern California Earthquake Data Center (SCEDC) catalog for Mw >= 6.5 continental strike-slip comparison up to 2024.
北加州地震台网54个陆上固定台站记录的2024年Mw 7.0地震序列连续波形数据。
1984–2021年北加州双差地震目录（v202112.1），用于提取1994年Mw 7.0序列及历史背景地震。
基于2008–2024年3,226个USGS M>=2模板事件构建的2016年Mw 6.6地震前后30天模板匹配目录。
南加州地震数据中心（SCEDC）截至2024年的Mw>=6.5大陆走滑主震目录，用于生产力对比。
li: No available continuous seismic data for the 1994 Mw 7.0 earthquake, restricting analysis to the existing DD catalog.
The 2016 Mw 6.6 mainshock occurred far offshore from onshore stations, causing ML phase pickers to struggle with small events.
Offshore fault location prevents direct onshore geodetic detection and inversion of postseismic afterslip.
Substantial discrepancies exist between published coseismic slip models (e.g., Ulrich et al. vs Pollitz et al.) due to assumed hypocenter depth differences.
1994年Mw 7.0地震缺乏连续波形数据，仅能依赖现有的双差目录进行分析。
2016年Mw 6.6地震距离陆上台站较远，机器学习拾取器难以有效识别微震震相。
断层位于近海，无法直接通过大地测量手段观测和反演震后余滑分布。
不同文献反演的2024年同震滑移模型深度差异显著（受初始震源深度假设影响）。

tm.why: The paper focuses on the physical interaction between seismic ruptures and propagating aseismic slip transients (afterslip) along the Mendocino oceanic transform fault.

The authors build high-precision 30-day aftershock catalogs using a machine-learning picker (EQTransformer), phase associator (PyOcto), double-difference relocation (hypoDD), and GPU template matching.
The study compares coseismic rupture zones with postseismic aftershock expansion and evaluates ETAS aftershock productivity scaling laws for Mw > 6.5 mainshocks.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF read and analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§4), and all 6 figures.

sum: Structural validation of subsurface prospects is typically done retrospectively after seismic horizon interpretation is finished. This paper introduces a rapid 3D kinematic forward modelling workflow built from four explicit structural rules: fault-parallel flow, along-strike slip decay, syn-rift deposition to a datum, and flagging of hangingwall strain/accommodation problems. Specified conversationally via a large language model and executed through an open-source Python module, models can be built in minutes and scaled onto mapped seismic horizons. The authors test this method on 2D and 3D seismic interpretations of the Katnook Graben, Penola Trough (onshore Otway Basin). Fitting just two parameters—pre-base Laira slip fraction (80%) and keystone throw (810 m)—reproduces the 1.2 km growth interval thickness along dip with an RMS misfit of 116 m and projects a 9.5 km detachment depth. Crucially, the model demonstrates that the Katnook Graben is a cover-detached crestal collapse structure, requiring no underlying basement fault.
地下远景区的构造验证通常在地震层位解释完成后回顾性地进行。本文提出一种基于四项明确构造规则（断层平行流动、沿走向滑移衰减、同裂谷基准面沉积、上盘应变调节问题标记）的快速三维运动学正演方法。结合大语言模型与开源Python模块，可在数分钟内建立模型并缩放至解释层位。作者利用Otway盆地Penola凹……

t: A 3D kinematic forward model built from four rules: fault-parallel flow, along-strike slip decay, syn-rift deposition to a datum, and flagging of hangingwall bed lengthening resolved via a crestal collapse graben.
基于断层平行流动、走向滑移衰减、基准面同裂谷沉积及顶部塌陷地堑应变调节四项规则构建三维运动学正演模型。

Four interpreted horizons (near top Sherbrook, top Crayfish, base Laira, top basement) gridded at 50 m over an 18 km by 16 km 3D seismic survey area in the Penola Trough, plus regional 2D depth sections.
Penola凹陷18×16公里三维地震区50米间距网格化的四个解释层位，以及约束主断层的区域二维深度剖面。

With detachment projected at 9.5 km depth, the model reproduces the 1.2 km base Laira to top Crayfish growth interval thickening with a 116 m RMS misfit (85–145 m across eight other sections) and 810 m fitted keystone throw.
滑脱面设在9.5公里深处时，以116米均方根误差重现1.2公里生长地层增厚趋势，拟合地堑断距为810米。
Models are purely kinematic, deform dip sections independently without out-of-plane flow, omit compaction and isostasy, and have non-unique trade-offs between slip and deep fault shape.
模型纯属运动学，各倾向剖面独立变形，忽略压实与均衡，且深部断层形态与滑移量存在多解性。
Integrates rapid, LLM-assisted 3D kinematic validation directly into early seismic interpretation, revealing the Katnook Graben is a cover-detached crestal collapse graben needing no basement fault.
将快速三维运动学验证融入早期地震解释，证实Katnook地堑为盖层内滑脱的顶部塌陷地堑，无需基底断层。

kc: Develops an open-source Python 'rules module' implementing four explicit kinematic rules for rapid, restorable 3D structural forward modelling during early-stage seismic interpretation.
Demonstrates that the Katnook Graben (Otway Basin) is a soft-linked crestal collapse graben detached within the sedimentary cover, revising earlier thick-skinned, basement-rooted interpretations.

Reproduces mapped syn-rift growth interval thicknesses (base Laira to top Crayfish) across nine dip lines with RMS misfits of 85–145 m (116 m on the reference line) and constrains master fault detachment depth to 9–10.5 km.

Re-evaluates fault seal integrity risk in the Penola Trough, showing that trap breach at the Pyrus field depends on present-day stress reactivation and sand-on-sand juxtaposition rather than basement fault linkage.
开发了开源Python“规则模块”，利用四条明确的运动学规则在地震解释早期实现快速、可复原的三维构造正演模拟。
证实Otway盆地Katnook地堑是沉积盖层内滑脱的软连接顶部塌陷地堑，修正了早期基底卷入型厚皮构造的解释。
在9条倾向剖面上重现了同裂谷生长地层厚度分布，均方根拟合误差为85–145米（主剖面116米），并将主断层滑脱深度约束在9–10.5公里。
重新评估了Penola凹陷的断层封堵风险，表明Pyrus圈闭的破坏取决于现今应力场下的断层再活动与砂对砂对接，而非基底断层连通。
me: 3D kinematic forward modelling on independent 2D dip sections using fault-parallel flow (conserving cross-sectional area) combined with an arcuate fault trace and along-strike slip decay profile.
Syn-rift stratigraphic growth modelling assuming material line deposition to a flat datum at successive slip increments.
Automated strain flagging for horizon lengthening (~20% between cutoff and rollover hinge), resolved by imposing a conjugate keystone (crestal collapse) graben.
Conversational model specification using a large language model (Claude) to rapidly generate parameterised browser-based 3D models, verified by a deterministic standalone Python module.
基于断层平行流动（保持剖面面积守恒），结合弧形断层迹线和沿走向滑移衰减剖面，在一系列倾向剖面上进行三维运动学正演。
假设同裂谷地层在连续滑移增量下沉积于平坦基准面，进行生长地层模拟。
自动标记上盘层位拉长应变（截线与翻转枢纽间约20%），通过在翼部施加共轭地堑（顶部塌陷地堑）解决空间调节问题。
利用大语言模型（Claude）通过自然语言对话快速构建参数化浏览器三维模型，并由确定性的独立Python模块进行验证。
de: 3D seismic horizon grids (50 m spacing over 18 km × 16 km) of four surfaces: near top Sherbrook Group, top Crayfish Group, base Laira Formation, and top basement in the Penola Trough.

Regional 2D depth-stretched seismic sections constraining the listric Hungerford Fault geometry (34–35° upper dip flattening to 20° at 9–10 km depth) and top basement cutoff (6.5 km below top Crayfish, requiring 13 km total slip).
Quantitative isopach fitting along reference dip line A–A' and eight additional north–south profiles across the 3D survey area.
Penola凹陷三维地震解释层位网格（18 km × 16 km区域，50米网格间距），包含Sherbrook群近顶界、Crayfish群顶界、Laira组底界和基底顶面。
区域二维深度拉伸地震剖面，用于约束铲式Hungerford主断层几何形态（上部倾角34–35°，9–10公里深处变缓至20°）及基底截点深度（需要13公里总滑移量）。
沿基准倾向剖面A–A'及另外8条南北向测线对生长地层等厚图进行定量拟合测试。
li: Purely kinematic rather than mechanical modelling; the crestal graben position and throw are imposed/fitted from maps rather than computed from rock mechanics.
Deformation is computed on independent 2D dip sections with dip-slip only, neglecting coupled 3D out-of-plane material transport.

Compaction, decompaction, isostasy, and regional subsidence beyond the rollover hinge are omitted, causing the un-fitted basement-to-Crayfish wedge to over-predict syn-rift thickness by ~1.5 km in the north.
Non-uniqueness due to trade-offs between total slip and master fault geometry below the 9 km seismic imaging limit.
模型纯属运动学而非力学模拟，顶部地堑的位置和断距由图件指定和拟合，而非根据岩石力学计算得出。
各倾向剖面独立变形且仅考虑倾向滑移，未处理三维耦合的剖面外物质运移。
忽略了压实、去压实、均衡调整和枢纽带以外的区域沉降，导致未拟合的基底至Crayfish群地层在北部高估了约1.5公里厚度。
解具有非唯一性，9公里地震成像深度以下的主断层形态与总滑移量之间存在折衷效应。

tm.why: The paper models 3D basin-scale extensional fault kinematics, syn-rift stratigraphy, and basement structure in the Otway Basin using 2D/3D seismic reflection interpretations.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 30-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF, including full text, equations/rules descriptions, code availability statements, and all 7 figures.

sum: This study evaluates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and eXtended LSTM (xLSTM) models for inverting debris-flow basal impact forces from seismic waveforms. Using seismic and impact-force data from the Illgraben torrent in Switzerland (2019 for training/validation, 2020-2023 for testing), the authors formulate the inversion as a regression task. Both models achieve high accuracy, with peak-force estimates yielding a mean absolute percentage error of ≤ 5% (≤10 kN). Furthermore, a strong correlation (r = 0.867) is found between the cumulative inverted impact force and the observed debris-flow volume. This work demonstrates the feasibility of using deep learning on seismic data to characterize debris-flow magnitude and physical properties, aiding early-warning systems.
本研究利用LSTM和xLSTM模型，通过地震波形反演泥石流底部冲击力。基于瑞士Illgraben观测站2019-2023年数十个泥石流事件的数据，研究表明两种模型均能高精度反演冲击力，峰值误差≤5%（≤10 kN）。此外，累积反演冲击力与泥石流体积高度相关（r=0.867）。该方法为地震信号表征泥石……

t: LSTM and xLSTM neural networks are trained to map seismic waveforms to debris-flow basal impact forces as a regression task.
利用LSTM和xLSTM神经网络，将地震波形回归映射为泥石流底部冲击力。
Seismic and direct impact-force measurements from 28 debris-flow events (2019–2023) at the Illgraben torrent in Switzerland.
瑞士Illgraben泥石流观测站2019至2023年间28次事件的地震与直接冲击力数据。
Both models achieve peak-force estimation errors ≤ 5% (≤10 kN), and cumulative inverted force correlates strongly (r = 0.867) with flow volume.
峰值力误差≤5%（≤10 kN），且累积反演力与泥石流体积呈强相关（r=0.867）。
The approach relies on rare co-located force-plate and seismic data for training, potentially limiting immediate global applicability.
依赖稀缺的同址力板与地震配对数据进行训练，限制了其在全球的直接推广。
First application of LSTM and xLSTM architectures to directly invert physical basal impact forces of debris flows from seismic data.
首次应用LSTM和xLSTM架构，直接从地震数据中反演泥石流的物理底部冲击力。

kc: Demonstrated the first application of LSTM and xLSTM models to invert debris-flow basal impact forces from seismic waveforms.
Achieved high-accuracy peak-force estimation with a mean absolute percentage error of ≤ 5% (≤10 kN).
Established a strong correlation (r = 0.867) between cumulative inverted impact force and debris-flow volume, enabling volume estimation.
首次应用LSTM和xLSTM模型，实现了从地震波形中反演泥石流底部冲击力。
实现了高精度的峰值力估算，平均绝对百分比误差≤5%（≤10 kN）。

sum: This study develops a supervised deep learning framework for probabilistic earthquake forecasting along the Tan-Lu fault zone in eastern China. Using the China Earthquake Networks Center catalog (1979–2025), seven seismological parameters (b, M, η, D, Mf, N, Rm) were calculated for ML≥2.0 events and transformed into probability-based time-series features. These features were input into an enhanced LSTM model with dual-task learning and dropout regularization. The probability-transformed ensemble achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.650 and average precision (AP) of 0.297, outperforming raw-parameter models and ablation baselines. While not a deterministic predictor, the model provides continuous risk-ranking scores, offering a useful data-driven complement to regional seismic hazard assessment.

sum: Conventional electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) struggles to resolve permeability in clayey landslides due to competing surface and electrolytic conduction. This study demonstrates the added value of time-lapse time-domain induced polarization (TDIP) for characterizing and monitoring the active Montgombert landslide in the French Alps. Across three campaigns, the authors inverted resistivity and chargeability, extracted relaxation time distributions via Debye decomposition, and applied Gaussian Mixture Model clustering to parameter variations. Comparing these geoelectrical results with surface displacements from terrestrial optical photogrammetry, piezometers, and inclinometers, they identified three hydrogeological units and delineated two distinct unstable volumes: a 17,500 m³ weather-sensitive shallow zone and a 17,000 m³ deeper zone driven by seasonal aquifer pressurization. This work represents the first application of time-lapse TDIP with Debye decomposition on an active landslide, enabling spatial and seasonal permeability estimation without relying on site-specific petrophysical model assumptions.
传统电阻率层析成像（ERT）难以区分粘土滑坡中的表面导电和电解质导电，无法准确表征渗透率。本研究在法国阿尔卑斯山Montgombert滑坡开展了三期时移时间域激发极化（TDIP）监测。通过反演电阻率与充电率，利用德拜分解提取弛豫时间分布，并对参数变化进行高斯混合模型（GMM）聚类，结合地面光学影像计……

t: Time-lapse Gauss-Newton inversion of ERT and TDIP windows in pyGIMLI, followed by Debye decomposition into a 200-step Relaxation Time Distribution and Gaussian Mixture Model clustering of temporal parameter variations.
利用pyGIMLI进行时移ERT和TDIP反演，结合德拜分解提取弛豫时间分布，并对参数变化进行GMM聚类。

Four 5-m-spaced ERT/TDIP profiles collected in April 2021, September 2021, and May 2022 on the Montgombert landslide, paired with 18-MPix terrestrial camera imagery, RTK-GNSS, piezometers, and inclinometers.
Montgombert滑坡三期4条ERT/TDIP剖面数据，结合地面光学相机影像、RTK-GNSS、水位计和测斜仪数据。

Identified three hydrogeological units and two unstable regimes: a 17,500 m³ weather-sensitive shallow volume and a 17,000 m³ deeper volume where relaxation time increased >200% and permeability ranged from 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻⁸ m/s.

Field decay curves were recorded over a limited time range (0.05 to 8 s) with a fixed pulse length, causing information loss at early and late times.

First application of Debye decomposition on time-lapse TDIP data to monitor spectral IP evolution and permeability changes in an active landslide.
首次在滑坡监测中应用时移TDIP与德拜分解，研究了滑坡频谱激发极化特征及渗透率的演化。

sum: This study systematically benchmarks the runtime performance of three open-source quantum circuit statevector simulators—Cirq (qsim), CUDA-Q (qpp/cuStateVec), and Qiskit (Aer)—across CPU and GPU backends. As a physically motivated workload, the authors implement the 2D isotropic acoustic wave equation via Trotterized Hamiltonian evolution in Fourier space, testing problem sizes from 7 to 29 qubits on a single Azure virtual machine with an AMD EPYC CPU and NVIDIA A100 GPU. Results show shifting relative rankings: on 16-thread CPUs, Cirq is fastest up to 23 qubits, while Qiskit overtakes it at 25–29 qubits due to superior multi-threading efficiency (80% at 16 threads). On GPUs, CUDA-Q leads for 13–21 qubits, whereas Cirq is fastest for 23–29 qubits (1.5x faster than CUDA-Q at 29 qubits). This provides the first cross-framework CPU/GPU statevector runtime benchmark, offering actionable hardware- and scale-dependent guidance for scientific computing.
本文系统评估了Cirq、CUDA-Q和Qiskit三种开源量子态矢量模拟器在CPU和GPU后端的运行性能。研究采用基于Trotter化哈密顿量演化的二维声波方程量子电路作为测试负载，在单台Azure虚拟机（AMD EPYC CPU与NVIDIA A100 GPU）上测试了7至29量子比特规模。结果显……

Benchmarks run a 2D Ricker wavelet for 100 Trotter steps across 7 to 29 qubits in single precision on an Azure VM with an AMD EPYC 7V13 CPU and NVIDIA A100 GPU.

On 16-thread CPUs, Cirq is fastest up to 23 qubits, while Qiskit leads from 25–29 qubits (294s vs 367s). On GPUs, CUDA-Q leads for 13–21 qubits, and Cirq leads at 23–29 qubits (19.1s at 29 qubits).

First systematic study benchmarking statevector simulation runtime across Cirq, CUDA-Q, and Qiskit on both CPU and GPU backends using a realistic scientific computing workload.

Evaluated multi-core CPU strong scalability (1 to 16 threads) at 27 qubits, revealing Qiskit's 80% parallel efficiency versus Cirq's saturation beyond 8 threads.
Demonstrated that GPU-over-CPU speedup ratios can be distorted by weak CPU baselines, proposing normalization against the best CPU performer across frameworks.
在Cirq、CUDA-Q和Qiskit中实现了统一的二维声波方程量子电路，并消除了字节序差异。

Bypassed gate-based state preparation by directly initializing the statevector with a normalized 2D Ricker wavelet, isolating pure simulation kernel performance.
利用二阶中心有限差分拉普拉斯算子和二维移位量子傅里叶变换（QFT），将二维各向同性声波方程映射为含时薛定谔方程。
通过一阶Trotter公式和阶梯算法将时间演化算子分解为基础单比特旋转门和CNOT门。
跳过基于门的态制备，直接将归一化二维雷克子波编码进态矢量，以纯粹评估模拟器内核性能。

Executed all benchmarks (10 measured runs after 1 warm-up) on an Azure Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4 VM (24-core AMD EPYC 7V13 CPU, 220 GB RAM, NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPU).

在21量子比特（1024×1024网格）下，将量子模拟结果与经典伪谱有限差分参考解（dt = 0.0001）进行了精度验证。

sum: This paper introduces GeoSim, a benchmark for multi-field neural operators in geodynamics comprising 237 high-resolution 2D mantle-plume trajectories generated with the I2VIS thermo-mechanical code across two parameter regimes. Each trajectory includes six coupled fields (density, pressure, temperature, log-viscosity, and horizontal/vertical velocities) with nonuniform physical timestamps and trajectory-level splits. Evaluating FNO, GNOT, Transolver, and graph baselines on short-window (10-to-10 frames) and autonomous rollout tasks reveals a pronounced scalar–velocity gap: models accurately reconstruct scalar fields while failing on velocities, and short-window accuracy does not guarantee long-horizon rollout stability. The authors propose MFGNO (Multi-Field Graph Neural Operator), which jointly encodes and decodes all six fields. Under a fixed per-field objective on GeoSim-Plume1, MFGNO reduces horizontal and vertical velocity errors by 58.4% and 38.5% relative to an independent-field graph baseline while reducing GPU memory and training time, though explicit neighbor-difference inputs show no statistically significant benefit.
本文提出了地球动力学多场神经算子基准GeoSim，包含使用I2VIS生成的237条高分辨率二维地幔柱演化轨迹及6个耦合场（密度、压力、温度、粘度及水平与垂直速度）。对代表性神经算子的短时窗预测与自主长时程推演评估揭示了显著的“标量-速度差距”：模型能准确重建标量场，但速度场误差依然很大，且短时窗精度……

t: MFGNO jointly encodes the 10-frame histories of all six physical fields at each spatial node, performs radius-graph message passing with relative positions and field differences, and jointly decodes future 10-frame states under a per-field relative-L2 loss.
MFGNO联合编码6个物理场的10帧历史，通过半径图进行消息传递，并在逐场相对L2损失下联合解码未来10帧状态。

GeoSim contains 237 2D I2VIS mantle-plume trajectories across two subsets (109 in Plume1 varying temperature; 128 in Plume2 varying temperature and lithospheric thickness), conservatively remapped from a 401x309 grid to 128x128 across six physical fields.
包含237条二维I2VIS地幔柱模拟轨迹（Plume1含109条，Plume2含128条），涵盖6个物理场并重映射至12…

On GeoSim-Plume1 short-window prediction, MFGNO achieves 4.95% and 3.47% relative L2 errors on horizontal and vertical velocity, reducing errors by 58.4% and 38.5% compared to the independent-field MPNN (11.9% and 5.64%).
在Plume1短时窗预测中，MFGNO水平与垂直速度相对L2误差达4.95%和3.47%，比独立场MPNN降低58.4%…
GeoSim is limited to 2D mantle-plume simulations without grid-convergence verification, uses a single seed for Plume2, and omits sub-grid Lagrangian marker history.

Provides the first multi-field geodynamic neural-operator benchmark diagnosing the scalar–velocity prediction gap and isolating joint multi-field graph representation from explicit difference inputs via controlled ablations.
提出首个多场地球动力学神经算子基准，揭示标量-速度预测差距，并通过受控消融证实联合多场表征对速度预测的增益。

kc: Introduces the GeoSim benchmark dataset (237 2D mantle-plume trajectories, 6 coupled fields, physical timestamps, trajectory-level splits) for multi-field geodynamic operator learning.
Identifies a pronounced scalar–velocity prediction gap across neural operators and shows that short-window accuracy does not imply autonomous long-horizon rollout stability.

Develops MFGNO, a joint multi-field graph neural operator that cuts horizontal and vertical velocity errors by 58.4% and 38.5% compared to independent-field modeling while lowering peak GPU memory and training time.

me: Conservative area-weighted interval-overlap remapping from a 401x309 nonuniform staggered Eulerian solver grid to a normalized 128x128 learning grid.
Multi-Field Graph Neural Operator (MFGNO) with joint 6-field history encoding, radius-graph message passing with instance normalization, and timestamp-scaled residual decoding.
Controlled A/B/C ablation study under an equal-weight per-field relative L2 objective comparing independent-field MPNN, joint MPNN without explicit differences, and full MFGNO.
利用守恒的面积加权区间重叠重映射，将401×309非均匀交错欧拉网格数据转换至归一化的128×128机器学习网格。
提出多场图神经算子（MFGNO），采用六场历史联合编码、带实例归一化的半径图消息传递以及时间戳缩放残差解码。
在等权重逐场相对L2损失下开展受控A/B/C消融实验，对比独立场MPNN、无显式差分的联合MPNN与完整MFGNO。

GeoSim-Plume2: 128 2D simulations (92 train, 11 val, 25 test) jointly varying plume temperature (2000–2150 K) and lithosphere thickness (160–220 km) via Sobol sampling.
Evaluations of Persistence, FNO, GNOT, Transolver, Independent MPNN, and MFGNO on 10->10 frame short-window prediction and 12-window (120 frames) autonomous rollout.

GeoSim-Plume2：128条二维模拟轨迹（92训练/11验证/25测试），通过Sobol序列联合改变地幔柱温度（2000–2150 K）与岩石圈厚度（160–220 km）。

The paper benchmarks neural operators (FNO, GNOT, Transolver, MPNN, and a new MFGNO architecture) as learned surrogates for solid-Earth geodynamic PDE simulations.

sum: This study quantifies the high-frequency (>1 Hz) seismic signature of large pedestrian crowds and vehicular traffic using recordings from 300 MeSO-Net school stations in Tokyo, 385 outdoor protest gatherings in the United States, and the 100,000-person 2021 Meron pilgrimage in Israel. Using spectral amplification factors relative to background noise and K-means clustering, the author first isolates early-morning truck and train traffic patterns in Tokyo. Analysis of pedestrian crowds shows that crowd-generated seismic energy peaks in the 1–2 Hz walking frequency band. After correcting for surface-wave geometrical spreading, seismic amplification scales linearly with the logarithm of crowd size across five orders of magnitude. Notably, the data separate into two distinct populations: coordinated outdoor protests and pilgrimages exhibit much stronger scaling (slope 0.81, R=0.77) than routine student activities in Tokyo schoolyards (slope 0.04, R=0.08), providing a novel framework for seismic monitoring of collective crowd dynamics.
本研究结合日本东京约300个MeSO-Net校园台站、美国385次室外抗议集会及以色列2021年梅隆10万人朝圣事件的地震记录，量化了人类活动产生的高频（>1 Hz）地震动特征。通过计算相对于背景噪声的谱放大因子并结合K-means聚类，作者首先分离了东京清晨卡车与火车交通的时空模式。对人群活动的分……

t: Computes spectral amplification factors in 5-min windows across octave bands (1–2, 2–4, 4–8 Hz) relative to background medians, applies K-means clustering to early-morning Tokyo series, and corrects crowd signals for surface-wave spreading.
计算5分钟窗倍频程谱放大因子，对东京清晨时间序列进行K-means聚类，并对人群信号进行面波几何扩散校正。

Analyzes ~300 MeSO-Net accelerometers in Tokyo schoolyards (October 2021–2023), seismic data near 385 U.S. outdoor protests from the Crowd Counting Consortium catalog (2017–2024), and the 2021 Meron pilgrimage in Israel (~100,000 people).
分析东京约300个MeSO-Net校园台站、美国385次室外抗议集会及以色列梅隆10万人朝圣事件的垂直向地震数据。

Crowd seismic energy peaks at 1–2 Hz. Distance-corrected amplification scales linearly with log10(N) across five orders of magnitude, with outdoor protests correlating strongly (R=0.77, slope=0.81) compared to Tokyo schools (R=0.08, slope=0.04).
人群地震能量在1–2 Hz最强；距离校正放大因子与人群规模对数呈线性关系，室外集会（R=0.77）远强于东京学校（R=0…
Media-derived crowd size estimates in the CCC catalog can have uncertainties of factors of two or more, and large gatherings have poorly constrained effective station-to-crowd centroid distances.
媒体报道的人群规模存在两倍以上误差，且大型集会的有效震中距约束较差。

First large-scale empirical scaling analysis relating seismic amplitudes to human crowd sizes across five orders of magnitude, revealing two distinct scaling regimes governed by collective crowd synchronization.
首次建立跨越5个数量级的人群地震动经验标度律，揭示了受群体行为同步性控制的双重标度机制。

kc: Demonstrates via K-means clustering of 2–4 Hz MeSO-Net data that early-morning (4–5 a.m.) seismic noise peaks in Tokyo are driven by heavy freight truck traffic rather than solely train operations.
Establishes that pedestrian crowd-generated seismic ground motions are strongest in the 1–2 Hz frequency band, corresponding to human walking frequencies.

Derives an empirical scaling relation across five orders of magnitude showing distance-corrected seismic amplification scales linearly with log10(N) but splits into two regimes based on collective synchronization (protests vs. schoolyards).
通过对2–4 Hz MeSO-Net数据进行K-means聚类，证明东京清晨（4–5点）的地震噪声峰值主要由重型货运卡车交通驱动，而非仅由列车运行引起。
证实人类群体产生的地震地面运动在1–2 Hz频段最为显著，与人类步行的特征频率一致。
建立了跨越5个数量级的经验标度关系，表明距离校正后的地震放大因子与人群规模对数呈线性相关，且根据群体行为同步性（室外抗议对比校园活动）分化为两个明显的序列。
me: Computation of spectral amplification factors (Af) in 5-min windows with 50% overlap across octave bands (1–2, 2–4, 4–8 Hz) relative to preceding background periods.
K-means clustering of smoothed, normalized early-morning (0–8 a.m.) amplification factor time series across the MeSO-Net array to classify anthropogenic traffic noise sources.
Surface-wave geometrical spreading correction (multiplying Af by square root of distance R) and linear regression against log10(crowd size) alongside synthetic background significance testing.
在50%重叠的5分钟时间窗内，计算三个倍频程频段（1–2、2–4、4–8 Hz）相对于前期背景噪声水平的傅里叶谱放大因子（Af）。
对平滑和归一化后的清晨（0–8点）MeSO-Net放大因子时间序列应用K-means聚类算法，以分类城市交通噪声源。
进行面波几何扩散校正（将Af乘以距离R的平方根），并对人群规模对数log10(N)进行线性回归分析及合成背景显著性检验。
de: Continuous vertical-component accelerograms from ~300 MeSO-Net stations located primarily in schoolyards across the Tokyo metropolitan area (weekdays in October 2021, 2022, and 2023).
Seismic recordings near 385 U.S. outdoor protests/rallies (2017–2024) from the Crowd Counting Consortium (CCC) catalog with crowd sizes from <10 to ~100,000 people.
Seismic recordings at station MRON from the 2021 Meron pilgrimage in Israel (~100,000 attendees).
日本东京都市圈约300个主要位于校园内的MeSO-Net三分量加速度计垂直分量连续记录（2021、2022和2023年10月的工作日）。
美国Crowd Counting Consortium（CCC）目录中385次室外抗议/集会（2017–2024年，规模从不足10人到约10万人）附近的地震记录。
以色列国家地震台网MRON台站记录的2021年梅隆朝圣集会（约10万人参加）地震数据。

The spatial extent and movement of large outdoor gatherings (>20,000 people) introduce uncertainty in the effective station-to-crowd centroid distance.

大多数美国集会地点缺乏当地车流量数据，无法直接验证集会前后2–8 Hz频段内与参与者往返相关的交通噪声贡献。

tm.why: The paper characterizes anthropogenic and urban seismic noise generated by human crowds and vehicular traffic.
The study analyzes continuous urban ambient seismic noise spectra (>1 Hz) and temporal amplification relative to background noise levels.
The author applies K-means clustering to spatiotemporal seismic amplification factor time series across a dense urban network.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of Inbal (2026) in Seismological Research Letters was read and analyzed, including all text sections, equations, and Figures 1–8.

sum: This study investigates the shallow internal structure and geothermal system of Cerro Machín Volcano, Colombia, using high-resolution terrestrial gravity (137 stations) and walk-mode magnetic (38,789 records) surveys. Residual anomalies were isolated via 500 m upward continuation and interpreted alongside tilt derivative and analytical signal filters. Joint 2D forward models along NW–SE and SW–NE profiles show the dacitic dome is 720–840 m thick, resting directly on the Cajamarca Metamorphic Complex at 1920–1850 m a.s.l.—much shallower than prior 2 km seismic estimates. Rather than a continuous clay cap, the unaltered high-susceptibility dome core (0.12 SI) acts as the reservoir seal, with hydrothermal alteration restricted to fault zones. Beneath the dome, a fractured metamorphic conduit (~0.6 km2, ≥800 m thick) forms the upflow reservoir, aligning with independent seismic and magnetotelluric models, while a structurally controlled outflow zone (~1.83 km2) extends ≥2 km toward the Santa Marta ravine.
本研究利用高精度地面重力（137测点）和走航磁法（38,789记录）探测哥伦比亚Cerro Machín火山浅部结构与地热系统。通过向上延拓500米提取剩余异常，构建了两条联合二维正演剖面。结果表明英安质穹丘厚720–840米，底部（海拔1920–1850米）直接接触Cajamarca变质杂岩，比早……

t: Joint 2D forward modeling of upward-continued residual gravity and reduced-to-the-pole magnetic anomalies along two orthogonal ~5 km profiles using GMSys-2D, constrained by surface geology and prior seismic/resistivity models.
利用GMSys-2D对向上延拓剩余重力和化极磁异常沿两条约5公里正交剖面进行二维联合正演。

High-resolution terrestrial potential-field survey comprising 137 gravity stations (Scintrex CG-6, 100–400 m spacing, mm-precision DGPS) and 38,789 walk-mode magnetic measurements (GEM GSM-19, 2-s interval) across the CMV crater and flanks.
覆盖火山口及侧翼的137个重力测点（CG-6，毫米级DGPS）和38,789个走航磁测记录（GSM-19）。
The dacitic dome is 720–840 m thick (base at 1920–1850 m a.s.l.), sealing a fractured metamorphic upflow conduit (ρ = 2.6 g/cm3, k = 0.008 SI, ~0.6 km2, ≥800 m thick) and a ~1.83 km2 outflow zone.
英安质穹丘厚720–840米，封闭下方约0.6 km2、厚≥800米的破碎变质上升流通道及约1.83 km2流出区。
Station distribution was restricted to accessible trails, creating interpolation uncertainty between anomalies, and models lacked direct petrophysical measurements from local outcrop samples.
测点受限于可用步道导致插值不确定性，且缺乏露头样品的实验室岩石物理测量。

First high-resolution joint gravity and magnetic survey across the CMV edifice, resolving dome thickness at the hundred-meter scale and identifying an unaltered dome core acting as a non-clay geothermal seal.
首次高密度重磁联合探测百米级穹丘结构，发现未蚀变穹丘核心充当非粘土型地热储层盖层。

kc: Resolves the Cerro Machín volcanic dome thickness at 720–840 m (base at 1920–1850 m a.s.l.), resting directly on metamorphic basement without an intervening pyroclastic layer.

Demonstrates that the unaltered, high-susceptibility dome core (0.12 SI) serves as a non-clay cap sealing the deeper two-phase geothermal reservoir, while hydrothermal demagnetization is confined to fault zones.
Identifies a fractured metamorphic conduit (~0.6 km2, ≥800 m thick) as the primary upflow reservoir and a structurally controlled ~1.83 km2 outflow zone extending ≥2 km toward the Santa Marta ravine.
确定Cerro Machín火山穹丘厚度为720–840米（底部海拔1920–1850米），直接覆盖在变质基底之上，中间无火山碎屑岩层。
证明未蚀变的高磁化率穹丘核心（0.12 SI）作为非粘土盖层封闭深部两相地热储层，而热液退磁局限于断裂带内。
识别出穹丘下方作为主要上升流储层的破碎变质通道（~0.6 km2，厚≥800米）以及向Santa Marta峡谷延伸≥2公里、受构造控制的流出区（~1.83 km2）。
me: Gravimetric reductions (drift, latitude, free-air, Nettleton Bouguer slab with 2.65 g/cm3 reference density, and DEM terrain corrections) and magnetic processing (diurnal, IGRF subtraction, low-latitude amplitude-corrected Reduction to the Pole).
Regional-residual separation via 500 m upward continuation, coupled with magnetic tilt derivative (TD) and analytical signal (AS) edge-detection filters.
Iterative 2D joint geological–geophysical forward modeling along two orthogonal profiles (~5.1 km NW–SE and ~5.2 km SW–NE) in GMSys-2D constrained by surface geology and prior seismic/MT models.
重力归算（零漂、纬度、自由空气、参考密度2.65 g/cm3的Nettleton布格板及DEM地形改正）与磁法处理（日变、IGRF扣除、低纬度振幅校正化极）。
通过向上延拓500米进行区域-剩余场分离，并结合磁倾角导数（TD）和解析信号（AS）边界识别滤波。
结合地表地质及前人地震/大地电磁模型约束，利用GMSys-2D沿两条正交剖面（~5.1 km NW–SE和~5.2 km SW–NE）进行迭代二维联合地质-地球物理正演建模。
de: 137 terrestrial relative gravity stations collected with Scintrex CG-6 Autograv units (100–200 m spacing in crater, 300–400 m on flanks) and static DGPS positioning.
38,789 ground magnetic records acquired in walk mode (2 s interval) using GEM GSM-19 proton precession magnetometers along volcano trails.
使用Scintrex CG-6重力仪和静态DGPS定位采集的137个地面重力测点（火山口内间距100–200米，侧翼300–400米）。
使用GEM GSM-19质子旋进磁力仪沿火山步道以走航模式（2秒间隔）采集的38,789条地面磁测记录。
li: Data acquisition was restricted to available trails in steep topography, causing sparse coverage in the western, northern, and southern sectors and interpolation uncertainty between anomalies.
Petrophysical properties were initialized from generic literature values without site-specific laboratory density and susceptibility measurements on Cerro Machín outcrop samples.
数据采集受限于陡峭地形中的可用步道，导致西部、北部和南部区域覆盖稀疏，异常之间存在插值不确定性。
岩石物理属性初始值取自通用文献，缺乏针对Cerro Machín露头样品的实验室密度和磁化率实测数据。

tm.why: Characterizes the shallow internal architecture and hydrothermal plumbing of Cerro Machín Volcano using potential-field surveys integrated with previous 3D seismic tomography and magnetotelluric models.
Models the upper crustal structure, fault systems, metamorphic basement, and volcanic dome geometry.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, 8 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This Science perspective paper by Kaj M. Johnson discusses the mechanisms of fault recovery and relocking following giant earthquakes. Utilizing long-term geodetic monitoring data (such as GNSS and InSAR) from major subduction zones and plate boundaries, the author reviews how postseismic processes—including viscoelastic relaxation, afterslip, and pore-fluid flow—interact to govern the temporal evolution of fault coupling. Understanding these recovery phases is crucial for refining seismic hazard assessments and forecasting future mega-thrust events. The paper highlights the transition from rapid postseismic deformation to steady inter-seismic relocking, emphasizing the need for continuous, decades-long observational datasets to constrain physical models of fault zone rheology.
本文是发表在《Science》上的展望文章，探讨了大地震后断层恢复与重新锁定的物理机制。文章结合长期大地测量（如GNSS）监测数据，评述了震后余滑、粘弹性松弛等过程如何控制断层耦合度的时空演化。理解断层从震后变形向震间锁定的过渡，对于评估地震危险性至关重要，强调了长期连续观测对约束断层流变学模型的作……

t: Synthesis of geodetic observations and physical models of postseismic deformation, including afterslip and viscoelastic relaxation.
综合分析大地测量观测与震后变形（包括余滑和粘弹性松弛）的物理模型。
Decadal geodetic monitoring data (GNSS, InSAR) capturing postseismic and interseismic deformation from giant earthquakes globally.
全球大地震后捕获震后和震间变形的数十年大地测量监测数据（GNSS、InSAR）。
Highlights how long-term monitoring constrains the temporal transition of faults from postseismic slip to interseismic relocking.
阐明了长期监测如何约束断层从震后滑动向震间重新锁定的时间过渡。
Limited duration of geodetic observations relative to the millennial timescales of giant earthquake recurrence cycles.
相比于大地震千年尺度的复现周期，大地测量观测的持续时间有限。
Provides a comprehensive perspective on the multi-decadal recovery phase of faults, linking geodetic observations directly to fault rheology.
提供了关于断层数十年恢复阶段的全面视角，将大地测量观测与断层流变学直接联系起来。

Highlights the role of long-term geodetic monitoring in distinguishing between different postseismic deformation mechanisms.
系统总结了大地震后断层恢复与重新锁定过程的最新研究进展。

对大地测量观测（GNSS、InSAR）及震后变形物理模型（余滑、粘弹性松弛）进行综合评述。

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the Science perspective abstract and the author's established research profile in geodetic monitoring of postseismic deformation.

sum: This paper presents a fully analytical framework to model the semidiurnal thermotidal torque on rocky planets with isentropic and isothermal atmospheres. The authors perform a functional analysis of the torque, focusing on the role of resonantly excited Lamb waves, which historically influenced Earth's length of day during the Precambrian. By comparing their analytical predictions with numerical simulations from General Circulation Models (GCMs), they demonstrate excellent agreement. The model successfully captures the torque peak near synchronous rotation and the asymmetry in braking versus accelerating torque near resonance, which is reproduced by incorporating a time lag in tidal heating relative to insolation. This suggests that thermal tides in benchmark GCMs are primarily driven by indirect thermal forcing with a substantial time delay.
本文提出了一个用于模拟岩石行星（具有等熵和等温大气）半日热潮汐力矩的完整解析框架。作者对所得力矩进行了全面的函数分析，重点探讨了共振激发的兰姆波（Lamb waves）的作用，该作用曾影响前寒武纪时期的地球自转日长。通过将解析预测与通用环流模型（GCM）的数值模拟结果进行对比，发现两者高度一致。该模……

t: Analytical formulation of atmospheric tidal response for isentropic and isothermal atmospheres to compute thermotidal torque.
用于计算热潮汐力矩的等熵和等温大气潮汐响应解析公式。
Numerical solutions and benchmark spectra from previous general circulation model (GCM) studies of paleo-Earth and present-day Earth.
来自先前古地球和现代地球通用环流模型（GCM）研究的数值解与基准谱。
The analytical model matches GCM results, capturing the torque peak near synchronous rotation and the asymmetry near Lamb-wave resonance.
解析模型与GCM结果一致，捕获了同步自转附近的力矩峰值及兰姆波共振附近的非对称性。
The framework is limited to simplified isentropic and isothermal atmospheric profiles.
该框架局限于简化的等熵和等温大气剖面。
Provides a fully analytical formulation explaining the frequency dependence and asymmetry of thermotidal torque near Lamb-wave resonance.
提供了首个解释兰姆波共振附近热潮汐力矩频率依赖性和非对称性的完整解析公式。

kc: Developed a fully analytical formulation for the semidiurnal thermotidal torque on rocky planets with isentropic and isothermal atmospheres.
Clarified the role of resonantly excited Lamb waves in atmospheric tidal response and their impact on planetary rotation.
Successfully matched analytical predictions with GCM simulations, explaining the asymmetry near resonance via a tidal heating lag.
开发了适用于等熵和等温大气岩石行星半日热潮汐力矩的完整解析公式。

Functional analysis of thermotidal torque.
Comparison with numerical General Circulation Model (GCM) simulations.

sum: This study investigates the short-distance ground-motion attenuation of induced earthquakes (ML 2.0–3.9) in the Rongxian shale-gas field, Sichuan Basin, using 7,249 accelerograms from 52 MEMS accelerometers. After applying deep-learning denoising and magnitude-dependent usable-period cutoffs, the authors evaluate existing GMMs (BSSA14 and NAA18), finding significant discrepancies. They develop a region-specific GMM using nonlinear mixed-effects regression for Mw 1.8–3.7, which smoothly transitions to stochastic simulations for larger magnitudes. This model provides a robust basis for rapid shaking estimation and hazard assessment of induced seismicity.

sum: This dataset and code package support the study of the tidally modulated intertidal zone at Rockaway Beach, Oregon, using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). By recording ambient noise from breaking waves, the study performs seismic interferometry via cross-correlation to image beach structure. It analyzes tidally modulated attenuation, phase velocity, and Rayleigh-Scholte wave propagation. The repository includes raw DAS recordings, processed data, acoustic-elastic simulation outputs, and plotting codes, demonstrating the utility of fiber-optic seismology for environmental and coastal monitoring.

sum: This paper presents a practical workflow for identifying strong impedance contrast interfaces in sedimentary basins using microtremor horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) data. To address the limitations of standard SESAME criteria in complex multi-peak environments, the authors combine automatic peak identification with manual spatial-consistency verification across a dense array of 919 stations in Tongzhou, Beijing. Instead of relying on regional empirical frequency-depth relations, they migrate the HVSR curves from the frequency to the depth domain using a pre-existing 3D S-wave velocity model derived from multimode surface waves. This migration successfully maps two major impedance contrast interfaces: a shallow soft sedimentary layer (50–100 m) and a deeper Quaternary-Tertiary boundary (100–600 m), demonstrating a robust approach for high-resolution urban sedimentary basin imaging.
提出结合自动与人工校验的HVSR峰值选择工作流，并利用3D S波速度模型将HVSR曲线运移至深度域。应用于北京通州919个密集台站，成功刻画了两个强阻抗界面：50-100 m深的浅部软沉积层，以及100-600 m深的第四系-第三系界面。该方法避免了经验频深关系，为城市沉积盆地结构探测提供了新思路。

sum: This study revisits Snoke’s (1987) spectral approach for estimating earthquake source parameters, correcting the low-frequency coefficient from 4^(1/4) to 2. Applying this to 1,303 ML 2.0–5.8 earthquakes in the southern Korean Peninsula (2006–2025) using S-wave displacement spectra, the authors find that this correction increases seismic moment (M0) by a median factor of 1.51 and decreases corner frequency (fc) by a median factor of 0.76. Although absolute stress drops and scaling relations vary significantly depending on the chosen estimator, attenuation model, and rupture model, relative differences between earthquake sequences (such as Gyeongju and Pohang) remain robust. The work highlights that while relative source parameter variations are stable, absolute values and physical interpretations are highly sensitive to methodological assumptions.

sum: This study investigates an ML 2.5 mining-induced earthquake at the Dongtan Coal Mine, China, using a cross-scale configuration of regional and source-proximal in-mine sensors. Regional waveform modeling and spectral analysis yield an Mw 2.7 event with a 3.0 Hz corner frequency and a 0.036–0.10 MPa stress drop. Double-difference relocation delineates an approximately 1.6-km-long activated zone striking 359°, consistent with regional focal mechanisms. Crucially, source-proximal waveforms reveal an emergent pre-main-pulse feature with coherent amplitude growth lasting 200–300 ms, which is absent in a nearby control event and unresolved by regional records. This study highlights how combining regional equivalent-source properties with local in-mine observations provides complementary constraints on the physical processes of mining-induced earthquakes.
